title: DevOps Engineer (f/m/d)
description: Clariness is looking for a DevOps Engineer (f/m/d) based in Berlin, Hamburg, Cape Town, UK, or Serbia. - Full-time; unlimited - About the role: This role is about ensuring that Clariness' global cloud infrastructure remains reliable, secure and ready to scale. You will join a collaborative technical environment where infrastructure enables our product, data engineering and AI teams to deliver meaningful solutions. As a DevOps Engineer, you would be responsible for: Building, operating and improving Clariness' global AWS infrastructure, with a particular focus on ECS, RDS and supporting services. Managing infrastructure through Terraform, contributing to reusable, maintainable and version-controlled infrastructure as code. Improving CI/CD pipelines and container deployment processes to support reliable, secure and efficient software delivery. Supporting our production systems by monitoring infrastructure, troubleshooting incidents and contributing to improvements in reliability, security and cloud cost efficiency. Collaborating with cross-functional product teams, as well as our data engineering and AI teams, to understand their requirements and provide effective infrastructure solutions. Contributing to infrastructure improvement initiatives, maintaining operational documentation and supporting technical excellence across Clariness. We would like you to have: A degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. Hands-on experience working with production infrastructure on AWS, ideally including ECS, RDS and supporting services. Practical experience with Terraform, including modules, state management and infrastructure changes through version control and code review. Experience with CI/CD pipelines, containerized applications and production deployments. Familiarity with backup and disaster recovery, high-availability configurations and safe database migrations. The ability to independently deliver well-defined infrastructure tasks, explain technical trade-offs and contribute to architectural discussions. Strong collaboration and communication skills (English at C1 level), along with an interest in using AI-assisted tools responsibly to support infrastructure development, testing and troubleshooting. You may ask now, why should I work for you? Let us give you a few reasons – and you'll learn more during the process. A varied and exciting job with a lot of personal responsibility in an international company, where you can develop and expand your skills. Professional and personal development opportunities - incl. personal development budget. Flexible working hours and mobile working. Regular team events and open feedback culture. A versatile field of activity and challenging projects. A supportive and open company culture, providing the opportunity to collaborate with a diverse and professional team. Impact healthcare by accelerating medical innovation through improved access to clinical trials, potentially bringing needed treatments to patients faster. Dies ist die Basis unseres Teams, in dem Eigenverantwortung und Sorgfalt ebenso wichtig sind wie unternehmerisches Denken und Zuverlässigkeit. Du qualifizierst Leads und erkennst konkrete Bedarfe. Du bereitest Erst- und Beratungsgespräche vor. Du entwickelst Kontakte zu echten Verkaufschancen weiter. Du übernimmst konsequent Follow-ups und nächste Schritte. Du dokumentierst Kontakte und Opportunities sauber im CRM. Du nutzt moderne KI-Tools für Recherche, Vorbereitung und Vertriebsarbeit. Dabei geht es nicht um möglichst viele Calls, sondern um gute Gespräche und echte Verkaufschancen. Das bieten wir Dir Du wirst bei uns nicht ins kalte Wasser geworfen, aber Du sollst schnell Verantwortung übernehmen. 1. Verstehen Produkte, Kunden, Zielgruppen und Vertriebsprozess kennenlernen. 2. Qualifizieren Eigene Erstkontakte und Discovery-Gespräche übernehmen. 3. Entwickeln Eigene Opportunities aufbauen und vorantreiben. 4. Verkaufen Schritt für Schritt eigene Verkaufsprozesse bis zum Abschluss führen. Unser Ziel: Aus Dir wird ein richtig guter B2B-Vertriebler. Dein Weg zu uns Eine kaufmännische oder technische Ausbildung (Bereich IT-System-Management, Büromanagement, Groß- und Außenhandel oder Dialogmarketing) ist von Vorteil, setzen wir nicht zwingend voraus Freude am Umgang mit Menschen und daran, aktiv auf andere zuzugehen Interesse an Vertrieb, Geschäftsentwicklung und unternehmerischen Zusammenhängen Eigeninitiative, Zuverlässigkeit und Verbindlichkeit – Du packst gerne selbst mit an Eine strukturierte und sorgfältige Arbeitsweise Lernbereitschaft, Neugier und Lust, Dich weiterzuentwickeln Interesse an IT, Digitalisierung und Künstlicher Intelligenz Keine Scheu vor Telefonaten und der aktiven Ansprache potenzieller Neukunden Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift So erreichst Du uns Gerne steht Dir unser Recruiting-Team unter ----- oder der 0211 908670 für jegliche Fragen zur Verfügung: Wir freuen uns auf Dich! title: Online Marketing und E Commerce Manager
description: Über Vlitex Die VLITEX GmbH mit Sitz in Bayreuth entwickelt und vertreibt innovative Brandschutzlösungen aus technischen Textilien mit Fokus auf Lithium-Ionen-Batterien. Zertifizierte "Feuerlöschdecken" und Sicherheitsprodukte des Unternehmens schützen weltweit Leben und minimieren Umweltschäden in Bereichen wie Feuerwehr, Industrie und E-Mobilität. Deine Aufgaben im Online-Marketing und E-Commerce · Onlineshop aufbauen und weiterentwickeln: Anforderungen definieren, externe Umsetzung koordinieren, Produktdaten pflegen, Kaufprozesse testen und technische Fehler konsequent nachhalten. · SEO und GEO entwickeln: Suchintentionen recherchieren, Produkt- und Anwendungsseiten optimieren und hilfreiche Experteninhalte erstellen. Inhalte, strukturierte Daten und Unternehmensinformationen so weiterentwickeln, dass VLITEX auch in Google AI Overviews, ChatGPT und vergleichbaren KI-Antwortsystemen als relevante Quelle sichtbar wird. · Google Ads und Paid Social steuern: Kampagnen, Zielgruppen, Anzeigenvarianten und passende Zielseiten entwickeln. Suchanfragen, Kosten und Ergebnisse auswerten und Budgets auf profitable Bestellungen und qualifizierte B2B-Anfragen ausrichten. · Amazon und Amazon Ads steuern: Produktseiten, Bilder und Texte verbessern, Sortiment und Preise intern abstimmen, Angebotsprobleme lösen und die Verfügbarkeit koordinieren. Kampagnen aufsetzen und optimieren, Suchbegriffe auswerten und Budgets auf wirtschaftliche Verkäufe ausrichten. · Content und Social Media organisieren: Themenplan führen, Texte und einfache Bild- oder Videoinhalte erstellen, Produktaufnahmen koordinieren und geeignete Inhalte für organische Kanäle veröffentlichen. · Messung und Reporting sicherstellen: Käufe und Anfragen nachvollziehbar erfassen, Kennzahlen wie Umsatz, Conversion Rate, Werbekosten und Deckungsbeitrag auswerten und daraus klare Handlungsempfehlungen ableiten. Das bringst du mit · Mehrjährige praktische Erfahrung im Online Marketing, E-Commerce oder Performance Marketing, idealerweise für erklärungsbedürftige Produkte im B2B- und B2C-Umfeld. · Nachweisbare operative Erfahrung mit mindestens zwei der Bereiche Amazon, Google Ads, SEO, Onlineshop oder Paid Social sowie die Bereitschaft, die übrigen Kanäle verantwortlich zu steuern. · Sicherer Umgang mit Webanalyse und Tracking, beispielsweise Google Analytics, Tag Manager, Search Console und den Auswertungen der Werbeplattformen. Deine Benefits Du erhältst eine Entschädigung für Reisekosten. Ein Firmenlaptop steht dir zur Verfügung. Flexible Arbeitszeiten und Homeoffice sowie Remote arbeiten unterstützen die Vereinbarkeit von Beruf und Alltag. Kostenlose Getränke und Snacks stehen am Arbeitsplatz bereit, und das Parken ist für dich kostenlos. Es erwartet dich eine lockere Kleiderordnung sowie regelmäßige Teamevents und Firmenfeiern. Vergütung Das Bruttogehalt für diese Position liegt bei EUR 42,000–53,000 per year. Was dich bei VLITEX erwartet · Eine verantwortungsvolle Rolle mit direktem Einfluss auf Umsatz, Nachfrage und den weiteren Aufbau unseres Onlinegeschäfts sowie kurze Entscheidungswege und viel Gestaltungsspielraum. · Ein kleines, interdisziplinäres Team und eine enge Zusammenarbeit mit Marketing, Vertrieb, Auftragsabwicklung und Geschäftsführung. · Moderne Arbeitsmittel, flexible Arbeitszeiten und eine Arbeitsweise, bei der Ergebnisse und verlässliche Umsetzung zählen. · Innovative Produkte mit einem klaren Nutzen für Sicherheit und umweltfreundlichen Brandschutz. title: Sr. Medical Director, Germany
description: <div class="content-intro"><p></p> <div data-ogsc="black"><span data-ogsc="" data-ogsb="yellow"><strong data-ogsc="" data-olk-copy-source="MessageBody">About Acadia Pharmaceuticals</strong></span></div> <div data-ogsc="black"> </div> <div data-ogsc="black"><span data-ogsc="" data-ogsb="yellow">Acadia is committed to turning scientific promise into meaningful innovation that makes the difference for underserved neurological and rare disease communities around the world. Our commercial portfolio includes the first and only FDA-approved treatments for Parkinson’s disease psychosis and Rett syndrome. We are developing the next wave of therapeutic advancements with a robust and diverse pipeline that includes mid- to late-stage programs in Alzheimer’s disease psychosis and Lewy body dementia psychosis, along with earlier-stage programs that address other underserved patient needs. At Acadia, we’re here to be their difference.</span></div></div><p><strong><u>Position Summary</u></strong></p> <p>The Sr. Medical Director, Germany will lead the development and execution of the local medical affairs strategy together with the field Medical Science Liaisons (MSLs) and in line with the European Medical Affairs strategy and the local country strategy for RETT syndrome including the integrated medical plans with full medical budget ownership and responsibility. Responsibilities will include building and maintaining external stakeholder relationships and collaborations, as well as continuing to position Acadia as a thought leader and valued partner with patient advocacy groups (PAG) and medical/scientific RETT community in Germany. This individual will be responsible for the effectiveness and compliance of scientific exchange conducted to meet the needs of clinicians, patient advocates, and other key external and internal stakeholders.</p> <p><strong><u>Primary Responsibilities</u></strong></p> <ul> <li>Provide scientific and medical leadership, including development of strategic country medical affairs (post-launch) plans, identifying specific unmet medical needs, and data gaps.</li> <li>Leading the local medical affairs team.</li> <li>Ensure strong medical/scientific leadership in coordination and participation in country MRC/MLR procedures.</li> <li>Establish appropriate strategic partnerships with Centers of Excellence, KOLs, and PAGs, in areas of scientific interest.</li> <li>Ensure aligned and close cross-functional collaboration, with country GM, Market Access, other relevant country and international staff to optimally manage relationships and ensure alignment and effective execution of the German medical strategy.</li> <li>Coordinate and ensure operational medical excellence, in collaboration with EU medical teams and aligned with country strategy, to capture and track key medical tactics and medical (post-launch) activities in Germany.</li> <li>Provide medical expertise and editorial support in data dissemination at conferences and in medical journals, as appropriate.</li> <li>Involvement with key HCPs in the exchange of scientific and medical information including Advisory Boards and presentations at national meetings and conferences.</li> <li>Develop and maintain, together with MSLs, close professional relationships with KOLs and emerging scientific leaders in the community.</li> <li>Oversee gathering and reporting field medical insights through existing Veeva CRM system and in line with company rules and requirements.</li> <li>Oversee and communicate to cross-functional stakeholders the insights the MSL team gains about competitive landscape, unmet needs of physicians and advocacy groups. Develops potential actionable plans to address these local insights.</li> <li>Manages publication activities, including review and approval of abstracts and manuscripts, local publication strategy and real-world evidence development and compliant collaboration with authors, as needed.</li> </ul> <p><strong><u>Education/Experience/Skills</u></strong></p> <ul> <li>MD highly preferred; PhD, PharmD, or an equivalent qualification may also be considered.</li> <li>15+ years of Medical Affairs leadership experience in the biopharmaceutical industry in Germany or the DACH region; broader regional experience is advantageous.</li> <li>Prior team-management experience is required.</li> <li>Substantial rare-disease—preferably neurological—experience in Germany and/or the DACH region.</li> <li>Extensive knowledge of the German healthcare system and applicable national rules and regulations.</li> <li>Significant experience coordinating and participating in national MLR/MRC procedures.</li> <li>Experience engaging with rare-disease patient advocacy groups is highly preferred.</li> </ul> <p><strong><u>Key Skills</u></strong></p> <ul> <li>Extensive knowledge to critically appraise studies and clinical evidence to allow engagement on higher scientific level with HCPs.</li> <li>In depth understanding of compliance and regulatory requirements, including extensive personal experience and expertise with MRC/MLR procedures, for pharmaceutical Medical Affairs, R&D and Commercial activities in Germany.</li> <li>Excellent communication, collaboration, and presentation skills, and experience in the delivery of scientific presentations.</li> <li>Agile, independent and proactive working style.</li> <li>Personal sense of purpose, confidence, and stand fest in challenging situations.</li> <li>Ability to build strong cross-functional and cross-company relationships.</li> <li>Ability to collaborate and share information to contribute to the planning process and execute the agreed local Medical (pre)launch plan, together with MSL team, and in line with Regional Medical Affairs strategy.</li> <li>Fluency in German at native or near-native level and strong English proficiency are required, with the ability to communicate complex details clearly.</li> <li>Ability to travel both locally and internationally is required.</li> </ul> <p><span style="color: description: <div class="content-intro"><p></p> <div data-ogsc="black"><span data-ogsc="" data-ogsb="yellow"><strong data-ogsc="" data-olk-copy-source="MessageBody">About Acadia Pharmaceuticals</strong></span></div> <div data-ogsc="black"> </div> <div data-ogsc="black"><span data-ogsc="" data-ogsb="yellow">Acadia is committed to turning scientific promise into meaningful innovation that makes the difference for underserved neurological and rare disease communities around the world. We are developing the next wave of therapeutic advancements with a robust and diverse pipeline that includes mid- to late-stage programs in Alzheimer’s disease psychosis and Lewy body dementia psychosis, along with earlier-stage programs that address other underserved patient needs. At Acadia, we’re here to be their difference.</span></div></div><p></p> <p><strong><u>Position Summary:</u></strong></p> <p>Senior Medical Science Liaison (MSL) for Germany plays a pivotal role in advancing our mission in rare pediatric diseases, with a core focus on Rett syndrome. This field-based role serves as a trusted scientific partner to healthcare professionals, researchers, advocacy groups, and decision makers across Germany. The MSL drives scientific exchange, supports evidence generation, and helps ensure patients, caregivers, and clinicians have access to high-quality scientific and medical information about Acadia’s therapeutic innovations.</p> <p><strong><u>Primary Responsibilities:</u></strong></p> <ul> <li>Act as the primary point of contact for scientific exchange in Germany, building trusted relationships with thought leaders, centers of excellence, and advocacy groups.</li> <li>Identify and maintain impactful collaborations opportunities, including publications, advisory boards, IIS, educational initiatives, speaker programs.</li> <li>Support Key Account Managers in engaging influential experts while ensuring compliance with local regulations.</li> <li>Collect and communicate field insights to inform medical strategy, publications, and messaging.</li> <li>Respond to unsolicited medical information requests in line with global standards.</li> <li>Support Phase IV studies, IIS, registries, and real-world evidence projects by identifying sites and acting as a liaison.</li> <li>Represent Acadia at congresses and scientific events; an MD or PhD, PharmD is preferred.The ideal candidate will have 6-8 years of relevant industry experience, including 3-5 years field-based MSL roles in CNS/neuroscience or rare disease.</li> <li>Proven ability to present complex scientific data clearly and effectively.</li> <li>Fluency in German and English.</li> <li>Clear organizational skills, independent working style, and fast learning mindset, with a collaborative approach.</li> <li>Strong interpersonal skills with an open, collaborative mindset; Parents giving birth are eligible for an extended leave and a ramp-back period to return part-time while they get settled.  </p> <p><strong>CAREER GROWTH:</strong> Access world-class platforms, participate in interactive sessions,  build your personalized development roadmap, and explore internal opportunities. To deliver on that promise, we need an engineer who can make the platform behave flawlessly under extreme load and recover gracefully when the unexpected happens.</p> <p>In this role you will own the reliability, performance, and observability of the entire inference stack. Your day starts with designing and refining telemetry pipelines — metrics, logs, and traces that turn hundreds of terabytes of signal into clear, actionable insight. From there you might tune Kubernetes autoscalers to squeeze more efficiency out of GPUs, craft Terraform modules that bake resilience into every new cluster, or harden our request-routing and retry logic so even transient failures go unnoticed by users. When incidents do arise, you’ll rely on the automation and runbooks you helped create to detect, isolate, and remediate problems in minutes, then drive the post-mortem culture that prevents recurrence. You identify a promising new audience and agree to test a different creative approach. Rather than just handing over your ideas, you jump into the advertising platform to help set up the campaign and work with the team to get the new creatives ready for launch. You've been exploring how AI and LLMs are changing the way HR professionals discover training providers. You identify a potential new acquisition opportunity, research the market, and put together a practical plan to test it. Later, you meet with the Head of Growth Marketing to challenge your assumptions, refine the approach, and agree on the next steps. On Thursday, you review the performance of our B2C email nurture flows with the Email Marketing team. You notice an opportunity to improve conversions from leads to MQLs and propose a change to the messaging and sequence. After lunch with colleagues in the office, you turn your attention to an upcoming quarterly campaign, working with the wider Marketing team to finalize the messaging and coordinate the launch. You also catch up with our BizOps team to improve HubSpot reporting, ensuring we have better visibility into acquisition performance and opportunities for growth. title: wo-stage onderzoek milieukosten m.b.v. bestaande afval- en emissiestatistieken
description: wo- afstudeerstage/praktijkstage, vanaf februari 2027 Ben jij die nieuwsgierige onderzoeker die energie krijgt van data, duurzaamheid en nieuwe inzichten? Wil jij een inhoudelijke bijdrage leveren aan de statistieken van het CBS? Dit is jouw uitdaging Het kabinet wil dat Nederland in 2050 volledig circulair is. Om te kunnen volgen of we die doelstelling halen, is betrouwbare informatie nodig over onder andere afval en emissies naar water. Het CBS verzamelt en publiceert deze gegevens voor bedrijven. Daarbij maken we vooral gebruik van gegevens uit het elektronisch Milieujaarverslag (e-MJV), aangevuld met enquêtes. Naast de hoeveelheid afval en wateremissies brengen we ook de milieukosten van bedrijven in kaart, bijvoorbeeld de kosten voor afvalverwerking en voor het lozen van afvalwater. Hiervoor wordt nu een aparte enquête gebruikt. Maar is dat eigenlijk wel nodig? Tijdens je stage onderzoek je of we de milieukosten voor afval en wateremissies kunnen berekenen met gegevens die al beschikbaar zijn. Je combineert bijvoorbeeld gegevens over de hoeveelheid afval en geloosd water met bestaande indicatoren, zoals gemiddelde kosten per ton afval en sectorspecifieke kosten per kubieke meter geloosd water. Je gaat onder andere: bestaande data en indicatoren analyseren en beoordelen op bruikbaarheid; onderzoeken welke methode het meest geschikt is om de milieukosten te schatten; een berekening of model ontwikkelen waarmee de kosten kunnen worden afgeleid; de uitkomsten vergelijken met de beschikbare gegevens uit de huidige enquête; onderzoeken hoe betrouwbaar en bruikbaar de schattingen zijn; je bevindingen vertalen naar een concreet advies voor het CBS. Met jouw onderzoek willen we bepalen of we meer uit bestaande data kunnen halen en minder hoeven uit te vragen bij bedrijven. Als blijkt dat de milieukosten betrouwbaar kunnen worden berekend, kunnen de uitkomsten bovendien worden gebruikt om de bestaande afval- en waterstatistieken te controleren. In het meest gunstige scenario kan de aparte enquête naar milieukosten gedeeltelijk of helemaal vervallen. Dat betekent minder administratieve lasten voor bedrijven, efficiënter gebruik van beschikbare data en mogelijk betrouwbaardere statistieken. Dit is jouw stageplek bij CBS Den Haag We verwelkomen je binnen de sector Leefomgeving bij team Milieu. Met 20 gedreven professionals werken we aan milieu gerelateerde statistieken en doen we onderzoek naar actuele thema’s zoals klimaat(verandering) en circulaire economie. We werken nauw samen met andere teams binnen het CBS. We werken hard aan het continu verbeteren van onze statistieken en de cijfers beschikbaar te stellen voor het publiek. Voorbeelden van recente publicaties uit ons team zijn: Bedrijven investeerden in 2024 minder in milieu | CBS Bijna 2 procent meer bedrijfs- en industrieafval in 2021 | CBS Milieukosten en -investeringen van bedrijven | CBS Dit breng jij mee Je volgt een wo-opleiding milieukunde, economie, technische bestuurskunde, data science of een aanverwante opleiding. Je hebt affiniteit met het onderwerp circulaire economie. Je bent analytisch sterk en kunt complexe vraagstukken gestructureerd onderzoeken en vertalen naar heldere inzichten. Je kunt goed programmeren in R. Je bent sociaal en communicatief vaardig en kunt je ideeën en bevindingen helder overbrengen aan verschillende gesprekspartners. Omdat tijdens de stage alle communicatie – zowel mondeling als schriftelijk – in het Nederlands plaatsvindt, is een goede beheersing van de Nederlandse taal noodzakelijk. Dit kun je van ons verwachten Een fijne leeromgeving waarin je: jouw competenties in kwantitatieve data-analyse versterkt door gebruik te maken van milieustatistieken en economische databronnen; jouw onderzoeksvaardigheden aanscherpt op het gebied van de circulaire economie en levenscyclusanalyse; jouw programmeervaardigheden in R verder ontwikkelt; ervaring opdoet met het interpreteren van verschillende datasets om betrouwbare profielen op te stellen. Voor jouw inzet ontvang je een stagevergoeding van € 800 bruto per maand (op basis van 40 uur per week). Samen met je stagebegeleider stem je af hoe je hybride kunt werken, met flexibele werktijden en de optie om deels vanuit huis aan jouw stageopdracht te werken. Dit zijn onze voorwaarden Het betreft een stageopdracht en geen werkervaringsplek. Voordat je aan de stage begint verwachten we dat je vanuit de onderwijsinstelling een stagebegeleider hebt, waarmee de stage is afgestemd en concrete leerdoelen zijn afgesproken. Deze stageopdracht is bedoeld voor studenten die momenteel staan ingeschreven bij een onderwijsinstelling; afgestudeerden komen niet in aanmerking. title: wo-stage woningmarkt onderzoek: verhuisketens, doorstroom en ouderenwoningen
description: wo- afstudeerstage, vanaf februari 2027 Ben jij die analytische wo-student die nieuwsgierig is naar de doorstroom op de woningmarkt? Experience with hardware certification planning, requirements management, verification and compliance evidence. title: Software Engineer (80-100%)
description: Worum geht es? Wenn in der Schweiz eine Feuerwehr alarmiert wird, läuft die Meldung mit hoher Wahrscheinlichkeit über unsere Systeme. Rund 400 Feuerwehren in 16 Kantonen arbeiten mit unseren Lösungen, von der Alarmierung über die Einsatzführung bis zur Einsatzplanung. Das heisst: Unsere Software muss funktionieren, auch nachts um 3 Uhr. Diese Verantwortung prägt, wie wir entwickeln. Wir suchen dich als Software Engineer, der unsere Plattform mitträgt. Nicht als weitere Person im Team, sondern als eine tragende Säule in unserem Team. Über uns Die EvoSys AG wurde 2011 gegründet und entwickelt seit 2016 eigene Software für Behörden und Organisationen für Rettung und Sicherheit (BORS). Wir sind ein inhabergeführtes Familienunternehmen in Thun mit 9 Mitarbeitenden und in unserem Markt führend. Unsere Produkte heissen AlarmHub, Intervento, FloriPlan, AlarmDisplay und SpotPilot. Sie decken den ganzen Ablauf ab, von der Alarmierung bis zur Auswertung nach dem Einsatz. 2028 kommt mit Respondo eine weitere Lösung dazu. Deine Aufgaben Du entwickelst unsere bestehenden Plattformen weiter und setzt neue Funktionen von der Idee bis in den Betrieb um. Du prägst unsere Architektur mit. Unsere Kundenbasis wächst stark, und unsere Systeme müssen mitwachsen. Konkret bereiten wir den Schritt auf Kubernetes vor und bauen Dienste so um, dass sie zuverlässig skalieren. Du arbeitest an Schnittstellen zu Einsatzzentralen, Partnersystemen und Behördenplattformen. Du setzt KI-gestützte Werkzeuge im Entwicklungsalltag ein, so wie wir alle. Du nimmst an Code Reviews teil und trägst zu Qualität und Dokumentation bei. Du unterstützt bei anspruchsvollen technischen Fragen aus dem Betrieb. Perspektive Mit der Zeit kannst du die fachliche Verantwortung für einen Produktbereich übernehmen. Und wenn es für beide Seiten passt, ist längerfristig auch eine technische Führungsrolle denkbar. Solche Rollen besetzen wir aus dem Team heraus. Voraussetzung für diese Stelle ist das aber ausdrücklich nicht. Deine Aufgaben Rund 2 Jahre Berufserfahrung in der Entwicklung von Webanwendungen. Die ersten Jahre hast du hinter dir und arbeitest selbständig, ohne enge Begleitung. Erfahrung mit Node.js und Vue.js, dazu Berührungspunkte mit PostgreSQL, Docker, Linux und Git. Du nutzt KI-Werkzeuge selbstverständlich und kannst beurteilen, wann du ihrem Ergebnis trauen kannst und wann nicht. Verständnis dafür, was im Produktivsystem passiert, wenn dein Code dort ankommt. Lust, Verantwortung für ein Thema zu übernehmen, statt nur Tickets abzuarbeiten. Sehr gutes Deutsch in Wort und Schrift, gutes Englischverständnis. Interesse am Blaulichtumfeld. Eigene Erfahrung in einer Feuerwehr oder im Zivilschutz ist ein Plus, aber keine Bedingung. Unser Technologiestack Node.js, TypeScript, Vue.js PostgreSQL und Redis Docker - auf dem Weg zu Kubernetes Linux, Git, CI/CD-Pipelines REST-APIs und Schnittstellen zu Drittsystemen KI-gestützte Entwicklungswerkzeuge Was dich bei uns erwartet Kurze Wege. Ein Standort, direkter Draht zur Geschäftsleitung. Entscheide fallen am selben Tag, nicht im nächsten Gremium. Sichtbare Wirkung. Was du baust, ist innert Wochen bei Feuerwehren im Einsatz. Du bekommst Rückmeldungen von Menschen, die damit arbeiten. Weiterbildung, die wir ernst meinen. Wir unterstützen berufsbegleitende Studiengänge. 5 Wochen Ferien, bei Teilzeit anteilig. Flexible Arbeitszeiten und ein modern ausgestatteter Arbeitsplatz. Mitgestaltung. Technologieentscheide treffen wir gemeinsam, nicht von oben herab. Thun. Arbeiten zwischen See und Bergen, 10 Minuten vom Bahnhof, 20 Minuten von Bern. Ein Hinweis mit Ehrlichkeit Wir arbeiten überwiegend vor Ort. Einzelne Homeoffice-Tage sind möglich, reine Remote-Arbeit passt nicht zu uns. Die kurzen Abstimmungswege in der Entwicklung gehören zu unserer DNA. Vergütung Der Lohn für diese Stelle liegt bei CHF 68'000-80'000 pro Jahr bei einem Pensum von 100%. So läuft die Bewerbung ab Bewerbung über die Plattform. Lebenslauf genügt, ein Motivationsschreiben brauchen wir nicht. Links zu Projekten oder Repositories schauen wir uns gerne an. Kurzes Kennenlernen, rund 30 Minuten per Video oder Telefon. Gespräch in Thun mit dem CTO und dem Entwicklungsteam, inkl. Blick in unsere Codebasis. Fachlicher Austausch anhand einer kleinen, realistischen Aufgabe. Kein Whiteboard-Rätsel, sondern etwas aus unserem Alltag. Entscheid spätestens 7 Tage nach dem letzten Gespräch. Wir melden uns auf jede Bewerbung zurück, auch bei einer Absage. Ein Gap Year bei Certa ist kein Praktikum mit Abstrichen, sondern eine vollwertige Rolle mit eigenen Verantwortungsbereichen. Du bekommst Zeit, in mehrere Themen tief reinzukommen, eigene Projekte aufzubauen und mit der Zeit echte Ownership zu übernehmen. Direkte Linie zu den Gründern: Du arbeitest täglich mit den beiden Gründern und Geschäftsführern. Keine Layer, keine Politik, keine Slide-Schlachten. Spielwiese für KI-Enthusiasten: Bei uns ist KI kein Buzzword, sondern Arbeitsalltag. Du bekommst Zugang zu allen relevanten Tools und Modellen. Echte Verantwortung: Du arbeitest an Themen, die wirklich zählen, nicht an Beschäftigungstherapie. Faire Vergütung: Anders als bei vielen Gap-Year-Programmen wirst Du bei uns als vollwertiges Teammitglied bezahlt. title: Senior Graphic Designer
description: About Withings Based in Issy-les-Moulineaux, Withings designs connected health devices that measure what your body is already saying: smart scales, hybrid smartwatches, blood pressure monitors, sleep analyzers, a connected stethoscope, and Withings+, the service that turns everyday data into a long-term reading of your health. Our products are sold around the world. The brand rests on a fine balance of medical rigor, premium design and a warm tone. Our products are built to last for years, not for a single product cycle. Your body already knows. Withings helps you hear it. Your Role As Senior Graphic Designer, you will be the graphic backbone of our in-house creative studio. You will create, adapt, challenge and grow the Withings brand image, from product launches to brand guidelines, and imagine the visuals that bring our products to life around the world. The studio is responsible for the graphic quality of every brand touchpoint, including product launches, communication and promotional campaigns, and high-impact projects for our markets in Europe, the United States and beyond, always to a premium standard. You will work alongside a motion designer and 3D artist and a graphic design apprentice to bring to life our premium universe, which we are reinventing for 2027. We are looking for a true creative at heart: an experienced designer who loves and needs to imagine, experiment and make. This senior role includes a large share of hands-on production, as you will design and execute your own work from concept to final file. You bring new ideas, defend them and carry them through to execution, and you raise the brand's visual bar without waiting to be asked. AI is already part of how the studio creates, with tools such as Krea, Nano Banana and Higgsfield, and its role keeps growing. You know how to use it to create more, faster, without compromising quality. Your Missions: Art direction and creation Imagine visual concepts and key visuals for product launches and campaigns. Design print and digital assets: packaging, retail and point of sale, social media, website, CRM emails, event booths such as CES, and presentations. Direct or support photo shoots and visual productions, from moodboards to selection and retouching. Own your projects end to end, from understanding the brief and setting creative directions to execution and final files. Exploration and ideas Continuously explore new visual directions, formats and techniques, without waiting for a brief. Propose innovative ideas for the brand and carry them through to production. Challenge briefs from the marketing teams against their objectives before production begins. Brand identity Help build and evolve the Withings brand guidelines toward a strong, premium and demanding universe worthy of our products. Ensure visual consistency across every touchpoint, including work delivered by our agencies and freelancers. Create and maintain organized, accessible templates and asset libraries. AI and new tools Use generative AI tools for image and video, including Krea, Nano Banana and Higgsfield, to speed up research and production: exploring directions, generating visuals, adaptations and retouching. Build and share AI ways of working with the studio, including prompts, workflows, best practices and quality control. Keep an eye on new tools and test them for the studio. Production and collaboration Adapt creations across formats and languages, down to the final production file, in line with the Brand Book. Collaborate closely with the motion designer and 3D artist, and share your practices with the graphic design apprentice. Brief and manage freelancers or vendors on selected projects. Work with the Head of Creative and with marketing, product and communications teams in France and internationally. Respect brand rules and health claims requirements in partnership with the legal and regulatory teams. Manage your own priorities and deadlines. Requirements About You: You have at least 4 years of experience in art direction or graphic design, gained in an agency, an in-house studio or a brand. Must have A real passion for creation: you need to imagine, experiment and make, and you want to stay at the heart of creative work rather than move toward project or budget management. A portfolio that shows your ability to bring a brand to life across many touchpoints with flawless execution, along with your creative explorations, including personal projects. Experience with premium or luxury brands in tech, beauty, lifestyle, design or health. A strong graphic culture, with solid layout and composition skills. Command of the Adobe suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign) and Figma. Advanced, regular use of generative AI tools (Krea, Nano Banana, Higgsfield or equivalent), demonstrated in your portfolio. Professional English, as our campaigns and teams are international. Nice to have Motion design (After Effects), video editing or 3D skills. Experience in health or wellness. Comfort using Notion to stay organized. How you work Autonomous, reliable and organized across several projects at once. Curious and proactive with ideas, and comfortable defending and presenting them internally. Demanding on detail, and open to feedback and teamwork. Able to bring the same passion and standards to a moodboard as to a flyer. Benefits Joining the Withings adventure means: Becoming part of one of the global pioneers and leaders in connected health, recognized with multiple awards at the Consumer Electronics Show (CES). Contributing to innovative, ambitious projects that are shaping the future of healthcare. Working in an international environment, with teams based in Issy-les-Moulineaux, Boston, Hong Kong and Shenzhen, among other locations. Playing a direct role in improving our products and services, including testing them before they launch. Deepening your medical knowledge through the Withings Med Academy and regular talks from healthcare professionals. Enjoying a wide range of perks: stock options, the smartphone and laptop of your choice, a company restaurant, cultural and sports benefits, and much more. Above all, joining passionate teams who want to make a real impact on how health will be monitored and managed in the future. In this role, you will also have: A real hand in building the Withings visual identity, with work seen around the world, from product launches to brand campaigns. A small, close-knit team where your voice counts. Room to explore new tools, AI and ways of working, where your ideas and experiments matter as much as production. Find Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

title: Strategy & Operations Lead, Data & Intelligence
description: GRESB is the global sustainability intelligence standard for real assets. You’ll move between sales enablement, product and data operations, and you’ll be trusted to run several projects at once without dropping any of them. You’ll see the whole business, from client conversations to product decisions to the CEO’s agenda, and you’ll have influence over how a new organization works. strategy Frame the problem, build the analysis, align stakeholders and drive the work through to a decision and implementation Bring a recommendation, not just options Operating rhythm and decision-making Run the team’s operating cadence: weekly deal desk, fortnightly product council and monthly business review Own the decision log, so it’s always clear what was decided, by whom and communication Build and run the monthly CEO dashboard and KPI reporting Prepare senior leadership, board and client materials that are clear, concise and decision-ready Act as the Chief Client & Data Intelligence Officer’s point of contact when they’re away What success looks like In your first six months The operating rhythm is running and people rely on it The decision log is live and used runs on a predictable monthly cycle with little rework Sales, product and data teams describe fewer handoff issues, and escalations get resolved faster Requirements Around 6–10 years of experience A grounding in top-tier management consulting or Big Four advisory, in strategy, sustainability, data or technology Ideally, spent time at a sustainability data, ESG ratings, real asset or financial title: System Identification Engineer
description: About Us Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces. Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected. About the role Every airframe Harmattan AI flies starts with a model. System identification turns flight data into the verified dynamics that guidance and control are designed, tuned and trained on. It is the foundation of an autopilot that adapts across multirotors, fixed wings, VTOLs and missiles. As a System Identification Engineer, working out of Paris, you will own the path from flight test to identified model. You will design and run your own experiments, build a repeatable identification pipeline, and deliver models the G&C team can trust. Responsibilities Experiment Design & Flight Test: Plan and run your own identification tests, from excitation design to flight tests, including coordinating with the . Model Identification: Identify rigid-body, aerodynamic, propulsion and actuator dynamics using frequency and time-domain methods, including closed-loop identification on vehicles flown under a controller. Propulsion & Actuators: Characterize motors, ESCs, propellers and control surfaces, including bandwidth, delays, saturation, and thermal and battery effects. Identification Pipeline: Build and maintain an automated, reproducible pipeline from flight logs to identified model. This covers ingestion, data-quality checks, estimation, validation and reporting. Model Validation: Validate models against held-out flight data, quantify uncertainty, and make sure each model is fit for purpose: controller design, simulation, or training learned G&C. New Airframes: Extend the capability from multirotors to control-surface multirotors, fixed wings, tail-sitters and missiles. Simulation & G&C Support: Deliver models into simulation, SITL and HITL, and work closely with control, guidance and embedded engineers to close the loop between models and flight results. Mentorship: Depending on seniority, support the team by mentoring junior engineers and interns. Candidate Requirements Educational Background: A strong academic record with a degree in aerospace, control, mechanical engineering or a related STEM field. A practical track record matters more than the specific degree. System Identification: Proven experience identifying dynamic models of flying platforms from real data, in both the frequency and time domain, including the pitfalls of closed-loop data. Flight Mechanics & Control: Solid grasp of rigid-body dynamics, aerodynamic forces and moments, non-dimensionalization, stability modes and propulsion models. Also enough control background to know what the model will be used for. Flight Testing: Hands-on experience planning and running flight tests and working from raw, imperfect logs. Software: Strong Python and scientific computing skills, with the discipline to build tools others can rerun. Nice to have Rigorous about data quality, uncertainty and validation; skeptical of models until they are proven. Autonomous and hands-on, comfortable moving between bench, field and code. Communicates clearly, able to present models and test results to engineers and senior stakeholders. Thrives under pressure in a fast-paced environment with a no-task-is-too-small mentality. Fixed-wing aerodynamic modeling; VTOL or tail-sitter dynamics; remote pilot certification; experience with real flight logs; structural or vibration modes; data-driven or learned dynamics models. Commitment: 100% dedication to Harmattan AI’s mission of providing a defensive edge to allied nations through ethical, high-impact technology. We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of autonomous defense systems at Harmattan AI. Find more English Speaking Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

Lead grid integration studies and analyses, including load flow, fault, stability, power quality, and protection coordination assessments. title: Senior Financial Systems Architect - Workday
description: Hi! We are AMBOSS and we are looking for a Financial Systems Architect to join our team, and shape the future of medical education with us! About AMBOSS AMBOSS is a dynamic learning and clinical decision support tool committed to empowering medical professionals globally to deliver optimal care. Since our inception in 2012, we've harnessed cutting-edge technology to transform the way physicians acquire and apply scientific knowledge. Each AMBOSSian is passionate about being the champion of clinicians today - this motivates and unites us each day towards success. And what does success look like? When a clinician or med student tells us, “AMBOSS makes practicing medicine easier and enjoyable. I love what I do, and a big part is because of AMBOSS.” Want to learn more about our culture? Watch our video to explore what makes us unique. Why Systems at AMBOSS? AMBOSS runs on a growing landscape of business systems: Workday as the ERP at the center, connected to Stripe, HubSpot, Pleo, Avalara, our banks, payroll and archiving. The Systems team, part of Data & Systems, makes this landscape develop as a whole: every problem solved in the system where it belongs, and processes that run smoothly from order to cash and from purchase to payment. Our expertise is platform-independent: accounting logic, process design, integration patterns and systems thinking. Working side by side with Finance, Accounting, Commercial, Data and IT, we support AMBOSS in pursuing its mission: empowering medical professionals worldwide to provide the best possible care. Why can this position be exciting for you? You are the technical owner of Workday Financials at AMBOSS: you take the tenant over from our implementation partner and run it. Some days that means a configuration fix before the close, other days the design of a new integration or the assessment of a new module. You are the expert and advisor for everything Workday. Our Business Systems Manager owns the roadmap, stakeholder coordination and partner management and works with you day to day. This is a senior individual contributor role: you build and own Workday the way a senior engineer owns a production system. It is not an administrator role with a ticket queue. Where we are Workday Financials goes live in November 2026 as our ERP for three entities in Germany, the US and Italy. Around twelve integrations connect it to the rest of the landscape, and they are the most demanding part of it. You join during hypercare and the first closes in Workday, with the first year-end close and statutory audit ahead. You will: Own the tenant technically. Configuration and business processes across record-to-report (General Ledger), procure-to-pay (Accounts Payable), order-to-cash (Accounts Receivable) and bank connectivity (Banking & Settlement), the security model and the financial data model. Take over from the implementation partner. Review, document and harden what was delivered, close the gaps and bring run responsibility in-house as early as possible after go-live. Where we still use consultants, you set the technical standard and review their work. Own the Workday side of every integration. Design and build the EIBs, Core Connectors, Studio integrations, web services and RaaS reports behind each interface and agree the interface contracts with our Data Platform engineers, who build and run the pipelines around the tenant. Advise Accounting and Finance. Translate requirements into system design, say clearly what Workday can and cannot do and advise where in the landscape a problem is best solved. Run it like a production system. Tier 2/3 support with root-cause fixes, testing discipline (unit, regression, UAT), the two Workday releases a year and a change log with configuration documentation. You enable the accounting stream leads who handle first-line questions. Build the reports, dashboards and calculated fields that Finance and leadership rely on, and make them self-serve where possible. Be the technical expert on expansions. HCM, treasury, automated VAT reporting and global payroll off DATEV: assess feasibility, design the solution and configure it. You bring: Workday Financials depth. 5+ years hands-on, including at least one full implementation and the post-go-live ownership of a tenant (hypercare, first closes, releases). Configuration expertise. Core modules (GL, AP, AR, Banking & Settlement), the business process framework, configurable security and the financial data model (FDM, worktags). Reporting. Custom and matrix reports, calculated fields and BIRT. Systems thinking. Experience connecting SaaS business systems (APIs, integration patterns) and the habit of thinking in end-to-end processes across tools. Accounting understanding. Chart of accounts, period close, reconciliations and audit requirements. Engineering mindset. Structured troubleshooting to the root cause, disciplined testing and documentation that others can use. Communication. Excellent English: precise with engineers, plain with finance colleagues. Nice to have: Hands-on experience with Workday integration tooling: EIBs, Core Connectors, Studio, web services, RaaS and XSLT Proficiency in German Workday Pro certification in Financials or Integrations Multi-entity, multi-currency or multi-GAAP experience (IFRS alongside local GAAP); experience with tax and e-invoicing platforms such as Avalara Accounting Center, Prism Analytics, Extend or Orchestrate A Workday consulting or CoE background A formal accounting background (degree, CPA or equivalent) or experience with internal controls and SOX in a Workday context You enjoy: Owning a system end to end. Taking over a freshly built tenant and knowing it better than anyone else in the company within months. Depth you can explain. You do the hard configuration and integration work yourself, and you explain the result to accountants and engineers in language each of them understands. Getting the details right where they matter. Financial systems punish sloppiness: a misconfigured business process or a broken integration shows up in the books. You can tell a load-bearing detail (audit trail, data integrity, reconciliations) from polish that can wait. Working like an engineer. You bring testing, documentation and versioned change into Workday and use modern tooling, including AI assistants, to move faster. When a release or a new module moves the ground, you question your own setup first. What success looks like after your first year: The tenant runs without the implementation partner. The integrations run reliably through every month-end and year-end close: data lands in Workday without manual intervention, and monitoring catches failures before Accounting does. The first year-end close and statutory audit in Workday are done with you answering the auditors' system questions, and two Workday releases are handled end to end. Accounting and Finance treat you as the expert and advisor for everything Workday: requirements are shaped with you from the start, and your call on how a process should run in the system is the one they act on. title: Senior Fleet Manager
description: Ben jij een vooruitdenker die complexe data moeiteloos vertaalt naar glashelder advies? Neem jij van nature de regie, ben je sterk in stakeholdermanagement en heb je affiniteit met de dynamische wereld van Schiphol? Lees dan snel verder! Binnen Orion Fleet Management zijn we op zoek naar een proactieve Senior Fleet Manager met een specifieke focus op onze klant Schiphol en ons label AirportPartners. Waar een reguliere Fleet Manager sterk leunt op de dagelijkse operatie, sta jij als Senior Fleet Manager daarboven. Jij kijkt verder dan de waan van de dag, anticipeert op wat komen gaat en gebruikt keiharde data om onze klant op strategisch niveau te adviseren. Wat ga je doen? In de rol van Senior Fleet Manager ben jij de absolute eigenaar van de vlootbeschikbaarheid voor Schiphol. Met ons label AirportPartners beheren wij hier de unieke en bedrijfskritische vloot van Schiphol: van de brandweerwagens en de onmisbare sneeuwvloot tot de personenwagens van het KLM-personeel. Jouw werk draait niet om achteraf reageren, maar om proactief sturen. Omdat jij de operationele basis feilloos begrijpt en beheerst, kun jij de vertaalslag maken naar optimalisatie en strategisch partnership. Jouw takenpakket als Senior Fleet Manager bestaat uit de volgende pijlers: Datagedreven Regie & Strategie: Proactieve advisering: Je wacht niet tot de klant belt met een probleem, maar je adviseert hen ongevraagd over rendementsverbetering en risicobeperking op basis van jouw data-analyses; Datagedreven regie: Je gebruikt voorspellende data om de vloot optimaal in te zetten en stilstand te minimaliseren. Vooruitdenken is jouw tweede natuur; Bewaking van SLA’s en KPI’s: Je monitort continu de prestaties, stuurt bij waar nodig en garandeert dat we onze beloftes aan de klant waarmaken (of overtreffen); Rapportage en overleg: Je zit regelmatig aan tafel met het management van klanten en leveranciers. Je presenteert heldere rapportages en treedt op als een volwaardig en strategisch gesprekspartner. Operationele Excellentie: Om op strategisch niveau te kunnen adviseren, zorg jij dat de basisprocessen, de motor van de afdeling, vlekkeloos verlopen: Triage en analyse: Je overziet de storingsmeldingen en zorgt voor een feilloze initiële beoordeling. Slimme planning: Je overziet de planning van (preventief) onderhoud, altijd met de impact op de 24/7 luchthaven operatie en veiligheid op Schiphol in je achterhoofd; Toetsing en beoordeling: Je beoordeelt complexe reparatie aanvragen kritisch op basis van historie, vastgelegde afspraken en toekomstige inzet van het voertuig; Wat vragen we van jou? Voor de rol van Senior Fleet Manager zoeken we iemand die stevig in zijn of haar schoenen staat. Je overziet het grote geheel, maar snapt de details die de data beïnvloeden. Verder zien wij graag het volgende terug: Denkniveau: Je beschikt over HBO of WO werk- en denkniveau; Sterk analytisch: Je bent een kei in het analyseren van data en haalt hier moeiteloos de juiste conclusies en actiepunten uit; Proactieve mindset: Je wacht niet af, maar signaleert kansen en knelpunten voordat ze een probleem vormen; Kennis & Ervaring: Je snapt hoe onderhoudsprocessen (triage, MTTR, MTBF) werken. Ervaring als Fleet Manager is een must en ervaring in de automotive of specifiek de OV-sector (bussen) is een zware pré; Overtuigingskracht: Je hebt uitstekende communicatieve vaardigheden. Je kunt draagvlak creëren en complexe technische of data-gerelateerde zaken begrijpelijk uitleggen aan directie, klanten en leveranciers. Ben jij klaar voor deze stap als Senior Fleet Manager en wil je bouwen aan de toekomst van ons wagenparkbeheer op Schiphol? Druk dan snel op de sollicitatieknop en laat jouw cv en motivatie achter! Wat bieden wij Een leuke en uitdagende baan met veel zelfstandigheid en verantwoordelijkheid. Je komt te werken in een professionele en stabiele kantooromgeving. Orion is een sterk groeiend bedrijf binnen de Pon-onderneming en biedt doorgroeimogelijkheden in de toekomst. Wat bieden we nog meer voor de functie van Senior Fleet Manager: Een goed salaris tussen de € 4.579,- en € 6.538,- o.b.v. fulltime. Uiteraard is dit afhankelijk van jouw kennis en ervaring; 28 vakantiedagen* en 6 ADV dagen; Een individueel keuzebudget (o.a. te besteden voor het aankopen van verlof); Directe en korte lijnen; je rapporteert rechtstreeks aan de Teamlead Operations; De mogelijkheid om deels thuis te werken; Een enthousiast, gezellig, compact en ambitieus team; Een ruime Pon-pensioenregeling; Een collectieve ziektekostenverzekering bij ONVZ of Zilveren Kruis waarbij Pon €300 per jaar bijdraagt; Pon Fit: sportieve activiteiten waar je aan kan deelnemen! Van bootcamp tot golfclinic; Korting op eigen producten van Pon (bijv. een nieuwe Gazelle fiets of privé lease auto), €500 per jaar; Lease-a-bike regeling voor het leasen van een Pon-fiets. Over de organisatie Orion ontzorgt bedrijven met grote complexe wagenparken door het reparatie- en onderhoudsproces optimaal te structureren. Binnen het netwerk heeft Orion een 15-tal eigen werkplaatsen onder de labels: AirportPartners, BusPartners en WastePartners. Onze werkplaatsen zijn gevestigd in: Almere, Amersfoort, Badhoevedorp-Schiphol (2 locaties), Ede, Emmeloord, Helmond, Leeuwarden, Leiden, Lichtenvoorde, Middelburg, Montfoort, Oosterwolde, Utrecht en Zwolle. Deze vacature is gericht op ons hoofdkantoor in Barneveld! Met circa 250 collega’s zetten wij ons dagelijks in om ervoor te zorgen dat onder andere huis en bedrijfsafval opgehaald kunnen worden, vliegtuigen kunnen blijven opstijgen en landen en OV-reizigers in veilige en betrouwbare bussen kunnen reizen. Wij staan midden in de maatschappij en spelen in op trends als verstedelijking, elektrificatie, duurzaamheid en digitalisering. Iedereen is welkom ! Bij Orion en Pon maken de mensen het verschil. Wij geloven dat een diverse en inclusieve organisatie zorgt voor meer werkplezier, creativiteit en betere resultaten. Welke achtergrond, leeftijd of identiteit je ook meebrengt: als jij de motivatie en het talent hebt, horen we heel graag van je. Heb je vragen over de vacature of de sollicitatieprocedure? That's your number. Sit in on live deals from day one : discovery calls, account plans, proposals and PoC scoping with our delivery team. Within 6 to 12 months you run your first deals yourself. Job specific requirements 1 to 3 years in consulting, investment banking, PE or a fast-growing B2B startup, or you built something yourself. You make things happen without a brief, and can show it with an example and a number. You win trust fast, with a CFO in a boardroom and with an operations manager on a factory floor. You think in funnels and business cases and turn data into a clear recommendation. New sectors, no playbook, channels nobody has tried: that energises you rather than stops you. A no on Monday doesn't define your Tuesday. Genuinely curious about how businesses make money and where they lose it. You want to own revenue within a year and know why. Fluent Dutch and English, German is a big plus Nice to haves Worked with or for manufacturing, wholesale, logistics or food companies. Hands-on with HubSpot, Clay or lemlist. Understanding of ERP-driven processes (SAP, Business Central, Exact). Sold something before: side business, campus sales, fundraising. Our Tech Stack You'll be working with best-in-class tools: CRM : HubSpot for pipeline management Prospecting : AI-powered research and outreach tools like Clay and Lemlist Communication : Multi-channel outreach across email, LinkedIn, and phone Analytics : Data-driven insights to optimize your approach And always exploring what's next We offer You are ready for the ride of a lifetime with experienced entrepreneurs and innovators who aim for hyper growth on a global scale. We look for an enormous drive and hands-on mentality. Somebody who can work with us in creating the best AI platform out there! We offer a good salary, a highly experienced (and very entertaining...) team and considerable share and bonus packages. And last but not least, this is the start of your career to grow to into a commercial lead and to lay the foundation for years to come. Find Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

title: Chef de produit digital F/H
description: LIANAKA est une filiale du Groupe Fondasol, spécialiste de l’ingénierie conseil de la construction. Allier le meilleur des données de sols, de l’IA et de l’analyse humaine dans une plateforme technologiquement avancée, pour permettre aux porteurs de projets de construction d’anticiper les risques et de saisir les opportunités liées à l'environnement des sites de leurs projets : tel est l’engagement de LIANAKA. Dès la recherche foncière , notre plateforme délivre aux acteurs de la construction un accès direct à une information globale, qualifiée et synthétique des risques et opportunités du sous-sol. Chaque phase du projet est également l’opportunité d’optimiser les hypothèses techniques et les solutions de travaux. Les bénéfices directs pour nos clients? Une fiabilité des données du sous-sol optimisée, sur les critères eau, pollution des sols, géotechnique et géothermie. Une meilleure anticipation et maitrise de leurs projets. Des décisions prises plus rapidement. Une identification immédiate des gains financiers. Une contribution à l’empreinte environnementale des projets. Le tout dans un environnement digital convivial et agile. Soyez le pivot stratégique de notre transformation numérique : entre expertise technique et performance commerciale, portez le succès d'une solution SaaS qui révolutionne l'analyse des risques de la construction. Le Projet Dans le cadre de notre développement numérique, le Groupe FONDASOL a déployé une plateforme SaaS innovante LIANAKA dédiée à la modélisation et l’analyse des risques du sous-sol. Elle offre aux acteurs de la construction une information fiable, rapide et optimisée en amont de leurs projets. Vos missions En tant que Chef de Produit, vous êtes le chef d'orchestre de cette solution et votre rôle est transverse : Comprendre le terrain et l'attente de nos clients Piloter la technique et l'évolution de la plateforme Booster le business et la commercialisation de cet outil Rattaché à la Direction Commerciale et sous la responsabilité du Responsable de la Filiale Digitale, vous êtes au cœur de notre stratégie de croissance et de transformation digitale. Vous recueillez et analysez les besoins clients : compréhension des usages et contraintes des promoteurs, entreprises de TP, collectivités, aménageurs fonciers, ou tout acteur ayant besoin d’anticiper les risques liés au sous-sol dans ses projets Vous transformez les besoins utilisateurs en spécifications fonctionnelles claires et tranchez sur les fonctionnalités à forte valeur ajoutée Vous portez la vision et la roadmap de la plateforme Saas et pilotez l’évolution du produit de la conception au déploiement Vous travaillez main dans la main avec les équipes techniques (Dev, Data, IT, ect.) et garantissez l’adéquation parfaite entre les contraintes techniques et les objectifs business Vous pilotez la croissance du produit en contribuant à sa stratégie commerciale et aux argumentaires commerciaux, tout en accompagnant les équipes marketing et ventes dans le lancement des nouveautés et l'optimisation des performances via le suivi des KPI (adoption, usages, ventes, satisfaction client). Vous êtes le trait d’union entre les clients, les équipes techniques et commerciales Vous sensibilisez les équipes interne aux enjeux du digital tout en étant force de proposition pour optimiser les processus et l’expérience utilisateur. La possibilité de participer à la création et au déploiement d’un produit numérique innovant à fort impact Être au cœur de la transformation digitale du Groupe Travailler sur des enjeux concrets liés à l’aménagement du territoire et à la gestion des risques Bénéficier d’une forte autonomie et d’un rôle stratégique dans le développement du produit Votre profil Issu d'une formation Bac+5 (Ingénieur, Commerce ou Université) avec une spécialisation en digital ou innovation Vous justifiez d'une expérience confirmée de 3 à 7 ans en tant que Product Manager, idéalement sur un produit SaaS. Curieux, rigoureux et attiré par l'innovation à fort impact terrain, vous disposez idéalement d'une connaissance du secteur de la construction, du BTP ou de l'aménagement. Doté d'un fort esprit entrepreneurial et d'une grande autonomie, vous maîtrisez le pilotage de produits numériques (roadmap, MVP, itérations) et possédez une réelle capacité à vulgariser des sujets techniques ou data complexes. Votre sens business et votre orientation résultats vous permettent de structurer une offre performante, tandis que votre aisance relationnelle fait de vous un leader naturel pour travailler en transverse avec des profils variés (ingénieurs, dev, commerciaux). title: Senior adviseur ecologie (Den Bosch)
description: Jouw impact bij Movares Met jouw ecologische expertise geef je richting aan de bescherming en versterking van natuur binnen uiteenlopende projecten. Je borgt kwaliteit, brengt ecologie strategisch in en zorgt dat natuur volwaardig wordt meegenomen in ontwerp- en besluitvorming. Dit ga je doen bij Movares je werkt aan complexe adviestrajecten op het gebied van natuurwetgeving, ecologisch onderzoek en vergunningverlening. title: Ontwikkelaar vastgoed
description: Wil jij bouwen aan de vastgoedopgave én aan een nieuwe ontwikkelorganisatie? Je werkt aan (middel)grote vastgoedontwikkelingen en ben je de verbindende factor tussen ontwikkeling en bouw. Al sinds 1855 bouwen we aan Nederland, in woningbouw, utiliteitsbouw, infrastructuur en techniek. Onze onafhankelijkheid en lange termijn visie vormen daarbij de basis. Met een omzet van € 2,6 miljard en ruim 3.700 collega’s behoren we tot de top van de Nederlandse bouwsector. Maar uiteindelijk draait het bij ons niet om die cijfers. Het draait om mensen. Om collega’s die samen werken aan projecten waar je trots op bent iconisch én dichtbij en bijdragen aan oplossingen voor maatschappelijke vraagstukken. Onze ambities zijn groot. En die maken we alleen waar met betrokken mensen. Daarom investeren we in goed werkgeverschap en een werkomgeving waarin jij je thuis voelt. Waar je jezelf kunt zijn, je veilig voelt en je uitspreekt. Zodat jij het beste uit jezelf haalt en samen met ons meer maakt. Hier zit je op jouw plek Bij Dura Vermeer Bouw en Vastgoed Utrecht staan we aan het begin van een nieuw hoofdstuk. Waar we jarenlang bekend stonden als een sterke renovatie/transformatiespecialist, zijn we sinds begin dit jaar uitgegroeid tot een volwaardige Bouw en Vastgoed organisatie. Naast renovatie en transformatie realiseren we nu ook nieuwbouwprojecten in de woning- en utiliteitsbouw én zetten we de volgende stap naar eigen gebieds- en vastgoedontwikkeling. Dat betekent dat je terechtkomt in een organisatie die volop in beweging is. De lijnen zijn kort, de ambities groot en de kansen om mee te bouwen aan nieuwe werkwijzen, teams en projecten liggen voor het oprapen. Hier krijg je de ruimte om impact te maken. Niet vanaf de zijlijn, maar midden in een frisse organisatie die zich verder ontwikkelt en waarin ondernemerschap, samenwerking en eigenaarschap centraal staan. Samen bouwen we aan projecten waar we trots op zijn én aan een organisatie die klaar is voor de toekomst. Je bent een ontwikkelaar die vooral energie krijgt om projecten na tendergunning/acquisitie verder te brengen richting realisatie. title: Data, Automatisation & IA – Investissement à impact
description: L’investissement à impact est un secteur d’activité en forte croissance. Cette organisation nous a permis de grandir rapidement. Aujourd’hui, nous souhaitons franchir une nouvelle étape. Notre ambition est de construire une véritable plateforme data et IA au service de l’ensemble de notre écosystème : L’équipe de gestion Les équipes middle office et conformité Nos investisseurs (LPs) Les entreprises de notre portefeuille Concrètement, nous souhaitons faire évoluer notre architecture de données, automatiser davantage nos processus, déployer des usages IA à forte valeur ajoutée et créer des espaces digitaux permettant à chacun d’accéder simplement aux informations dont il ou elle a besoin. Pour nous accompagner dans cette transformation, nous recrutons un.e stagiaire qui travaillera directement avec le Responsable Conformité & Middle Office ainsi qu’un.e Directeur.rice d’investissement. Ce stage est autant un projet de construction qu’un projet d’innovation : nous recherchons une personne capable de comprendre les enjeux métier, de proposer des solutions et de contribuer à leur mise en œuvre. Ce que vous construirez concrètement Pendant votre stage, vous contribuerez à : Structurer et faire évoluer plusieurs années de données d’investissement, impact et ESG Participer à la migration de notre socle de données vers une architecture moderne et évolutive Déployer des automatisations permettant de réduire les tâches manuelles et d’améliorer la qualité des données Concevoir les premiers assistants IA internes de la société Créer des outils utilisés quotidiennement par les équipes d’investissement, le middle office et la conformité Participer à la création de portails dédiés aux investisseurs et aux entreprises du portefeuille Contribuer à définir notre feuille de route data & IA pour les années à venir Vos missions Les projets seront menés en lien direct avec les équipes d'investissement, d’impact, le middle office et la conformité. Vous travaillerez dans un environnement très transversal, avec une forte autonomie et la possibilité de contribuer aussi bien à la réflexion qu'à l'implémentation des solutions. Les missions décrites ci-dessous constituent une feuille de route initiale. Elles évolueront naturellement en fonction de l’avancement du projet, de vos centres d’intérêt et des opportunités identifiées ensemble. Comprendre et structurer notre écosystème de données Vous participerez notamment à : Cartographier les bases Airtable existantes et leurs usages Comprendre les flux de données entre les différentes équipes Identifier les redondances, points de friction et opportunités d’amélioration Participer à la conception du modèle de données cible Contribuer, le cas échéant, à la migration progressive vers Supabase Structurer les données financières, impact et ESG Définir les règles d’accès et de gouvernance des données Documenter les modèles, processus et bonnes pratiques L’objectif est de construire un socle de données fiable, partagé et durable. 2. Automatiser les processus clés Une fois les données structurées, vous contribuerez à automatiser les tâches répétitives et à fluidifier les opérations. Exemples : Collecte de données auprès des participations, relances automatiques Consolidation de reportings Contrôles de cohérence Gestion documentaire Préparation de certains livrables réglementaires Qualification et enrichissement automatique d'opportunités d'investissement Circulation de l’information entre les outils Vous participerez à la conception et au déploiement de workflows no-code et low-code, principalement via N8N et les APIs des différents outils utilisés par la société. 3. Déployer des usages IA concrets Nous cherchons quelqu’un qui saura identifier où l’IA peut réellement créer de la valeur. Vous pourrez notamment travailler sur : Des assistants internes connectés à nos bases de données Des outils de recherche documentaire et de gestion des connaissances L'extraction automatique d'informations depuis des rapports, questionnaires ou documents de due diligence La pré-analyse de dossiers d'investissement La génération assistée de reportings, mémos d’investissement et comptes-rendus Des workflows mêlant automatisation et IA L’exploration de nouveaux cas d’usage liés à l’investissement, à l’impact ou à la conformité Vous serez encouragé.e à expérimenter, comparer les solutions disponibles sur le marché et proposer vos propres idées. 4. Construire les interfaces et portails utilisateurs À mesure que les fondations seront en place, vous participerez à la création des interfaces permettant aux différents utilisateurs d’accéder simplement à l’information. Cela pourra inclure : Portail équipe de gestion Suivi des participations Reporting portefeuille Outils internes de pilotage Portail investisseurs (LPs) Consultation des reportings Suivi des indicateurs de portefeuille Diffusion sécurisée des informations réglementaires Portail participations Collecte de données Suivi des indicateurs financiers et extra-financiers Partage documentaire 5. Accompagner l’adoption des nouveaux outils La réussite du projet ne dépend pas uniquement de la technologie. Vous contribuerez également à : Comprendre les besoins des utilisateurs Identifier de nouveaux cas d’usage Former les équipes aux outils déployés Produire une documentation simple et utile Diffuser les bonnes pratiques liées à la data et à l’IA Réaliser une veille active sur les nouveaux outils et tendances du marché Pourquoi ce stage est différent Vous ne rejoindrez pas une équipe technique isolée mais travaillerez directement avec les équipes métiers : Notre Responsable Conformité & Middle Office Notre Chief Impact Officer Nos Directeur.rices d’investissement Vous serez exposé.e à des problématiques à la fois stratégiques, opérationnelles et technologiques. Vous participerez à la transformation d’une société de gestion de l’intérieur, avec une forte autonomie et un impact visible dès les premières semaines. Les outils et processus que vous contribuerez à construire seront utilisés au quotidien par les équipes, les investisseurs et les entreprises que nous accompagnons. C’est une opportunité rare de développer une expertise à l’intersection de l’investissement, de la data, de l’automatisation et de l’intelligence artificielle. Candidature Envoyez-nous votre CV accompagné de quelques lignes expliquant : Ce qui vous attire dans ce projet Un outil, une automatisation ou un usage IA que vous avez déjà mis en place (ou que vous aimeriez explorer) Pas besoin de lettre de motivation formelle. Nous privilégions les personnes curieuses, pragmatiques et motivées à construire. Nous recherchons avant tout une personne curieuse, autonome et orientée solutions. Vous pourriez être la bonne personne si : Vous êtes en école d’ingénieur, école de commerce, université ou équivalent Vous avez une forte appétence pour la data, l’automatisation et l’IA Vous aimez expérimenter de nouveaux outils Vous êtes capable de transformer un problème métier en solution concrète Vous savez avancer de manière autonome tout en travaillant en équipe Des compétences ou expériences dans les domaines suivants seront appréciées : SQL et bases de données relationnelles Airtable, Notion, N8N, Make ou outils similaires APIs et intégrations IA générative et prompting Mais nous accordons autant d’importance à la curiosité, à la capacité d’apprentissage et à l’esprit d’initiative qu’aux compétences techniques. title: Data Analyst
description: Help launch our new temping product and drive commercial impact! At YoungOnes, data is at the start of every decision. Our Data & RevOps team has a seat at every table and takes a leading role in where the company goes next. Two years ago we rebuilt our data environment in Databricks from scratch, and it is fully ready for the future. There are few better environments to work in. We are looking for a Data Analyst with a focus on product, who also supports our marketing and commercial teams with deeper analyses. Someone with experience who is ready to take responsibility, and who does not stop at a report but actively steers on the outcome. What will you do? Your main focus is product. Next to that, you support marketing and the commercial teams, which keeps your work varied. Product In the flexible work market, companies used to choose between temping (uitzenden) and freelancers. Since last year we have been bringing a new proposition to market that sits in between: non-service temping. It combines the legal certainty of temping with the flexibility and personal control of freelancing, all through our platform. This is an important step in our strategy towards one app for work. Take the lead in tracking the progress of this new proposition; Define the KPIs and funnel that show whether the proposition is working; Analyse the full journey of workers and clients, from onboarding to repeat shifts; Spot problems early and actively steer where you see them; Translate insights into concrete improvements together with product and development; Work in a select team that operates as a startup within the company. Commercial & marketing support Next to product, you are the analytical sparring partner for our commercial teams and marketing. You go beyond the standard reports and dive deeper when questions get complex. Deliver deeper analyses for the commercial teams, for example on client potential, retention and growth opportunities; Support marketing with insight into campaign results and ROAS. This role is diverse, but above all it gives you a lot of freedom to take initiative and make an impact. Your team You will join an effective Data & RevOps team with 3 Analysts, 2 Engineers, a Performance Manager and 2 Process aAnalysts. You report to the Head of Data. The data itself is interesting: we support a two sided marketplace with workers on one side and clients on the other. AI is built into the design of how we work and makes the technical side of your job more simple. We use Genie within Databricks, which fully understands our data environment, Claude to connect multiple systems, and Gemini for quick support on smaller tasks. What are we looking for? title: QA Engineer
description: About the role At YoungOnes, you make sure our platform delivers on its promise: stable, reliable and free of surprises for the people who use it every day. title: DevOps Engineer
description: In a world where geopolitical tensions and security threats are accelerating, the way nations protect people and preserve peace is being redefined. This is our mission. At Intelic, we're building the intelligence layer for unmanned systems in defense. As a software-first company, we enable autonomous platforms to operate together - faster, smarter, and more reliably - across complex, mission-critical environments. As Nexus grows, so does the team, and we're adding someone to take real ownership of the pipelines, installers, and infrastructure that turn Nexus into something operators can trust, and who treats security as part of how the work gets done, not a separate project bolted on afterwards. What You Will Do You will join Product Adoption, the team that owns the last stretch between working software and a field-ready product: deployment, installers, monitoring, and everything that keeps Nexus running once it leaves the building. We are hiring at medior to senior level, roughly a 2 to 3, with room to flex higher for the right person. There is there is plenty of custom tooling to build. A level head under pressure. You can prioritise and stay steady when a few things break at once Nice to have: Experience with on-prem, bare-metal or virtulized infrastructure, not just cloud consoles Familiarity with Docker Exposure to dependency and package scanning tools such as Sonatype An interest in platform or infrastructure engineering as its own discipline. New projects, new problems, and a steady stream of things nobody has solved here before Real ownership from day one, not ticket-taking. If you see a better tool or approach, you're free to try it You'll work with hardware that matters: servers you can walk up to, deployments running in places with no internet, problems that cloud-only engineers rarely see A small team that leans on each other. When someone's on leave, the rest pick up the slack, and vice versa The mission is real. Nexus supports operators in the field, and how well you build and secure it has a direct effect on whether it works when it counts What We Offer Stock Appreciation Rights programme (equity) A vibrant office at NDSM Plein, Amsterdam Noord — where we come together in person every day, because we believe it matters for the kind of work we do Flexible pension plan 25 vacation days Travel allowance Urban Sports corporate membership Lease a Bike option Please note that, as part of our recruitment process, we may request a Certificate of Conduct (VOG) and conduct a background screening in accordance with our screening policy. Ensuring we maintain network uptime above 99% in your region through effective preventive maintenance plans and swift, high-quality reactive repairs.
