title: Stage de Master 2 : Comprendre les transformations structurales des hydrates de sels inorganiques pour le stockage d’énergie thermochimique - 5 à 6 mois
description: Rejoindre Mines Saint-Étienne , c’est s’engager dans une institution où la science et l’innovation bâtissent un avenir plus durable . Une école d’excellence où chacun a l’opportunité de révéler son plein potentiel et de contribuer à relever les défis de demain . Classée parmi les meilleures écoles d’ingénieurs en France et reconnue mondialement, notre école, membre de l’Institut Mines-Télécom, forme les talents de demain tout en contribuant activement à relever les grands défis industriels, numériques et environnementaux. Avec nous, vous intégrez une communauté de 500 collaborateurs, 2500 étudiants, et participez à un projet ambitieux : conjuguer excellence académique, recherche d’avant-garde et impact sociétal positif. L’Institut Mines-Télécom fédère les grandes écoles françaises autour des défis industriels majeurs, numériques, énergétiques et écologiques. Avec ses 8 Grandes Écoles publiques et 2 écoles filiales, il est le premier institut public dédié aux ingénieurs et managers. Ensemble, nous imaginons et construisons un avenir durable, en formant les acteurs qui façonneront les transitions de demain. À Mines Saint-Étienne, nos centres de recherche sont le cœur battant de notre École. Pensés comme de véritables hubs d’innovation, nos cinq Centres de Formation et de Recherche articulent leurs expertises autour de grands enjeux industriels, environnementaux, sociétaux et technologiques. Leur mission ? Imaginer le monde de demain en alliant excellence académique et impact concret. Vous rêvez d’une industrie propre, efficace et durable ? Le centre SPIN en fait sa priorité. Énergie, environnement, procédés industriels… on y conçoit des systèmes pour produire mieux, avec moins. L’objectif ? Limiter l’impact environnemental, réduire la consommation énergétique et booster l’efficacité. 🔧 Dans un monde en pleine mutation, nos équipes déploient leur créativité scientifique pour accompagner l’ industrie du futur. Et vous, prêt·e à innover à nos côtés ? 🎯 Ce que nous attendons de vous En tant que stagiaire de Master 2, vous êtes au cœur de nos missions de formation, recherche et innovation, au sein du Laboratoire Georges Friedel (LGF, UMR CNRS 5307), Centre SPIN. Dans ce laboratoire, vous conjuguez passion scientifique et impact sociétal. Le LGF est une unité mixte de recherche CNRS et Mines Saint-Étienne. Il étudie la structure, les propriétés et la réactivité des matériaux, des poudres aux procédés énergétiques. Sa force : relier ce qui se passe à l’échelle du cristal à la performance d’un procédé. Le stockage d’énergie thermochimique stocke la chaleur sous forme d’énergie chimique, grâce à des réactions solide-gaz réversibles. Les hydrates de sels inorganiques absorbent de la chaleur lors de leur déshydratation et la restituent lors de leur réhydratation, ce qui en fait des matériaux candidats pour le stockage de chaleur. Leur performance en cyclage dépend des structures cristallines traversées entre les états d’hydratation, dont le volume de maille et la symétrie peuvent différer fortement. Les caractérisations ex situ, avant et après réaction, ne donnent accès qu’aux états extrêmes, pas au chemin de transformation. Ce stage suivra la transformation in situ afin d’identifier quelles phases apparaissent, dans quel ordre et avec quelle cinétique, et de comprendre pourquoi la réhydratation peut rester incomplète. Les hydrates de SrBr₂ servent de système modèle ; l’approche s’étend à d’autres hydrates de sels et à d’autres réactions gaz-solide. • Vous réalisez une revue de la littérature sur les hydrates de sels pour le stockage thermochimique. • Vous menez des cycles de déshydratation/réhydratation suivis par diffraction des rayons X in situ, sous température et humidité contrôlées. • Vous quantifiez les fractions de phases par affinement de Rietveld (TOPAS, GSAS-II). • Vous reliez structure et performance (fraction récupérée, vitesse de réaction, stabilité en cyclage). • Vous rendez compte de vos résultats dans un mémoire et une présentation orale, avec une publication possible. Votre capacité à travailler en mode projet et faire dialoguer expérimentation, structure et performance sera essentielle pour réussir. 🔍 Ce que nous recherchons Vous préparez un diplôme Bac + 5 (Master 2 ou dernière année d’école d’ingénieurs) en science des matériaux, physique, chimie du solide ou génie des procédés. Ces émissions sont principalement liées à la combustion et à la décarbonatation du calcaire nécessaire à la production du ciment Portland conventionnel. Les liants à base de magnésie (MgO) sont étudiés comme alternatives potentielles aux ciments conventionnels, avec une empreinte carbone réduite. Le magnésium nécessaire à leur production pourrait être extrait de roches non carbonatées ou de saumures riches en magnésium. title: Stage : Construction automatique de modèles de processus hospitaliers multi- flux par grands modèles de langage (LLM)
description: Projet porté par : Marwa Trabelsi - IMT Mines Albi Centre Génie Industriel (CGI) Partenaires IMT impliqués : Telecom Sud Paris, Département Electronique et Physique, Laboratoire Services répartis, Architectures, Modélisation, Validation, Administration des Réseaux (SAMOVAR): Nel Samama Mines Saint-Etienne : Centre Ingénierie Santé (CIS), Marius Huguet Sujet proposé (5-6 mois à partir de Février): Acronyme : HOPAL : Hospital Process Automatic Learning Titre long : Construction automatique de modèles de processus hospitaliers multi-flux par grands modèles de langage (LLM) Description du projet : L’étude du processus de prise en charge aux urgences est essentielle pour comprendre et résoudre le problème croissant de surcharge, qui touche de nombreux pays. Cette surcharge, souvent liée à un déséquilibre entre la demande de soins et les ressources disponibles, a des conséquences graves : retards de traitement, allongement des temps de triage, et même une augmentation de la mortalité. Elle révèle aussi des défis systémiques, comme l’accès difficile aux soins primaires, qui poussent les patients vers les urgences. Optimiser l’utilisation des ressources humaines et matérielles permet non seulement de réduire les files d’attente, mais aussi d’améliorer la qualité des soins et l’efficacité globale du système. Enfin, analyser ces processus aide à identifier des solutions durables, comme une meilleure organisation ou une réallocation ciblée des moyens. Ces processus laissent des traces numériques dans le système d'information hospitalier (SIH), mais leur modélisation reste aujourd'hui largement manuelle, coûteuse et rapidement obsolète. Le process mining permet de découvrir des modèles de processus à partir de ces traces. Les techniques classiques de découverte atteignent toutefois leurs limites face à des logs hétérogènes, bruités et multi-flux. Les grands modèles de langage (LLM) ouvrent une voie nouvelle : générer automatiquement des modèles de processus (BPMN, graphes de processus) directement à partir de traces organisationnelles, sans intervention humaine, et en produire une lecture compréhensible par les acteurs de terrain. Par ailleurs, des travaux menés au CGI ont démontré la faisabilité de la prédiction de parcours patients par LLM. La question scientifique au cœur de ce stage est l'articulation de ces deux briques : comment relier la prédiction de parcours à la construction automatique de modèles, pour passer de modèles rétrospectifs (ce qui s'est passé) à des modèles prospectifs (ce qui va se passer) ? Ce projet s’inscrit dans une dynamique inter-écoles IMT autour de l’IA explicable pour la santé publique. Les équipes CGI, CIS et SAMOVAR collaborent déjà via le projet TRACKING (Carnot M.I.N.E.S – CARINGS), avec des travaux sur la géolocalisation indoor au sein des urgences de l’Hôpital Le Corbusier de Firminy. Cette synergie s’est prolongée par un stage M2 en 2025, financé par le Fonds d’amorçage Santé, dédié au prototypage d’une application mobile de localisation indoor/outdoor des patients. Une thèse INTERCARNOT a été lancé dans la continuité avec la validation des deux instituts Carnot (M.I.N.E.S et TSN) et va démarrer en Octobre 2026. Objectif du stage L'objectif est de concevoir et prototyper un pipeline dans lequel un même module de construction automatique de modèles par LLM est alimenté par deux sources : Branche A (rétrospective) : les logs SIH réels, normalisés en event logs, produisent des modèles as-is des processus observés ; Branche B (prospective) : dans la suite des travaux réalisés, les parcours prédits par LLM sont sérialisés au même format de traces (activité, timestamp, ressource) via un adaptateur, et produisent des modèles to-be des processus à venir. La comparaison des modèles as-is et to-be permet la détection d'écarts, l'anticipation des goulots d'étranglement et le support à la décision explicable, jusqu'à la simulation contrefactuelle (perturber les prédictions, reconstruire le modèle, observer l'impact). Profil recherché Formation : M2 ou dernière année d'école d'ingénieur en informatique, science des données, IA ou génie industriel ; Compétences techniques : Python indispensable ; une expérience des LLM (fine-tuning, prompting, API) et/ou du process mining (pm4py) est un atout fort ; Qualités : rigueur scientifique, autonomie, goût pour le travail avec des données réelles imparfaites, intérêt pour le domaine hospitalier. title: CENTRALE LYON - Postdoctoral Researcher Position Deep Learning for Functional-Oxide Growth Video-to-Spectrum Prediction by RHEED / XRD Fusion
description: PROJECT OVERVIEW We are looking for a highly motivated Postdoctoral Researcher to develop innovative deeplearning models that predict the structure of functional-oxide thin films directly from their growth dynamics. Positioned at the interface between Artificial Intelligence and materials physics, the OXYD-IA project aims to design a deep model able to predict the final X-ray Diffraction (XRD) spectrum of an oxide thin film from the sole Reflection High-Energy Electron Diffraction (RHEED) video recorded during its growth by Molecular Beam Epitaxy (MBE). The resulting tool will open the way to predictive, in situ control of oxide epitaxy – a process today dominated by a costly trial-and-error approach, in which the structural and functional properties of the films are only validated ex situ. You will join a genuinely multidisciplinary collaboration between the INL (Institut des Nanotechnologies de Lyon), which provides the operando experimental data and materials-physics expertise, and the LIRIS (équipe Imagine), which provides the deep video-learning and probabilistic-modelling methodology – both at École Centrale de Lyon. A high-impact opportunity. AI for experimental physics is a fast-growing field, and OXYD-IA offers a genuine first-mover advantage within it: you would work on a unique, unpublished dataset of paired RHEED videos and XRD spectra to build one of the first video-to-spectrum models with calibrated uncertainty for oxide growth. By learning directly from experimental 1 data, such a model can short-circuit the traditional trial-and-error loop, accelerate discovery and drastically cut experimental time, cost, precursor consumption and instrument occupancy – turning routine in situ diagnostics into predictive tools. Scientific context. Epitaxial perovskite-oxide thin films exhibit rich, tunable functional properties (thermoelectricity, ferroelectricity, piezoelectricity) governed by their structure and composition, themselves correlated with the growth conditions. MBE offers independent control of each element but, applied to oxides, is notoriously unstable and poorly reproducible because of the oxidising atmosphere. RHEED tracks the surface dynamics in real time (lattice parameter, surface reconstructions, roughness) but does not give access to the final bulk microstructure, which is only reachable ex situ via XRD / XRR. There is therefore a strong physical link – so far unexploited quantitatively – between RHEED dynamics and final XRD microstructure, which OXYD-IA proposes to learn directly. Figure 1 – OXYD-IA pipeline. At inference, the RHEED video acquired during growth (INL) feeds a deep video encoder (LIRIS) and a probabilistic regression module that predicts the final XRD spectrum together with its uncertainty. During training, the predicted spectrum is compared with the ex situ XRD / XRR spectrum measured at INL (ground truth); this discrepancy is the supervised learning signal that adjusts the model parameters. KEY RESEARCH AREAS AND RESPONSIBILITIES You will drive the core computational research along a risk-managed, phased 12-month roadmap. The primary target is a versioned RHEED / XRD dataset, growth-regime classification and probabilistic regression of the key structural parameters with calibrated uncertainty; full-spectrum prediction, a real-time demonstrator and cross-oxide generalisation are stretch and follow-on objectives. The work is organised around three technical pillars: 1. Corpus structuring and spatio-temporal RHEED representation • Build a versioned dataset by cleaning, temporally aligning and pairing the RHEED video sequences, the associated MBE parameters (temperature, oxygen pressure, source fluxes) and the ex situ XRD / XRR spectra (SrTiO3 reference system). • Pre-train, in a self-supervised manner, a spatio-temporal video encoder (3D CNN, e.g. R(2+1)D, or temporal Vision Transformer) fine-tuned on the laboratory corpus. • Perform fuzzy / Bayesian classification of the growth regimes (2D vs. 3D modes, transitions, RHEED oscillations), building on LIRIS expertise in the statistical analysis of sequences. 2. Probabilistic RHEED →XRD regression with uncertainty quantification • Design a latent representation that couples the video encoding with the physical MBE parameters. • Learn stepwise – first scalar structural parameters (lattice parameter, density, mosaicity), more robust at small N, then the full 1D XRD spectrum. • Provide calibrated uncertainty estimates (Bayesian approaches or deep ensembles), indispensable for guiding real-time decisions during growth. 3. Real-time demonstrator and dissemination (stretch / follow-on) • Validate the model on new SrTiO3 growths and prototype an in-growth inference tool at the end of the NANOFUTUR MBE line. • Mitigate the small-data and generalisation challenges through temporal data augmentation, transfer learning from pre-trained video encoders and domain adaptation towards other functional oxides. • Contribute toward a high-impact joint publication at the AI / materials interface (the project milestone is the submission of a joint paper). REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS • A Ph.D. in the field of Artificial Intelligence – Computer Science, Machine Learning, Computer Vision or Signal Processing, and we are looking for a senior postdoc with 2–5 years of post-PhD experience. • Deep learning on sequential / video data: demonstrable, hands-on experience with 3D CNNs, temporal transformers and / or probabilistic models. title: Senior Accountant – Finanzbuchhalter:in (m/w/d)
description: <p><strong>Location:</strong> Berlin, Hamburg,</p> <p> </p> <p>Wir suchen kurzfristig einen erfahrenen Finanzbuchhalter</p> <p>Die Kings Road Merch GmbH ist ein weltweit etablierter Full-Service Anbieter von Merchandise-Produkten und -Dienstleistungen.</p> <p>Als eigenständige deutsche Tochter eines weltweiten Musikkonzerns bieten wir individuelle Webshops für Bands oder Künstler an. Auf ihren Touren betreuen wir das Merchandising in Spielstätten in ganz Europa.</p> <p>Unsere Services reichen dabei von der Herstellung der Merch-Produkte über die Lagerung und Logistik in unserem Logistikzentrum in Dortmund, die europaweite Tourbetreuung sowie den Betrieb individualisierter Webshops.</p> <p>Wir suchen dich, wenn du Spaß daran hast, in der Musikindustrie rund um bedruckte T-Shirts und Fanartikel zu arbeiten. Europäische Umsatzsteuern, OSS und Quellensteuern schrecken dich nicht ab? Du möchtest mit unserem ERP-System NetSuite und eng mit internationalen Finance-Partnern arbeiten?</p> <p>Als Senior Accountant übernimmst du eine zentrale Rolle bei der Steuerung, Überwachung und kontinuierlichen Weiterentwicklung der Finance- und Accounting-Prozesse für das europäische Geschäft von Kings Road Merch. In enger Abstimmung mit dem europäischen Management und der globalen Finance-Organisation stellst du sicher, dass Abschlüsse, Reporting, Compliance und interne Kontrollen verlässlich, fristgerecht und nach einheitlichen Standards umgesetzt werden.</p> <p><strong>Aufgaben</strong></p> <ul> <li>Zentrale Steuerung und kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung der Accounting-Prozesse für das europäische Geschäft von KRM</li> <li>Eigenständige Betreuung der Debitoren- und Kreditorenbuchhaltung</li> <li>Prüfung von Rechnungen und Abwicklung des Zahlungsverkehrs</li> <li>Forderungsmanagement</li> <li>Erstellung der Umsatzsteuermeldungen in allen europäischen Ländern in Zusammenarbeit mit unserem internationalen Compliance Partner</li> <li>Vorbereitung und Koordination der Monats- und Jahresabschlüsse nach HGB sowie des Reportings</li> <li>Erstellung und Qualitätssicherung des monatlichen Finanzreportings an die US-Muttergesellschaft</li> <li>Funktion als zentrale Finance-Schnittstelle zwischen KRM EU, dem europäischen Management und der globalen Finance-Organisation</li> <li>Sicherstellung verlässlicher interner Kontrollen, Dokumentationen und einheitlicher Accounting-Standards</li> <li>Identifikation und Umsetzung von Verbesserungen und Automatisierungen innerhalb der Finance-Prozesse</li> <li>Unterstützung bei der Weiterentwicklung und effizienten Nutzung von NetSuite</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>Profil</strong></p> <ul> <li>Abgeschlossene kaufmännische Ausbildung, idealerweise als Steuerfachangestellte:r oder Finanzbuchhalter:in; alternativ eine vergleichbare Qualifikation</li> <li>Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung in einer eigenverantwortlichen Accounting-Funktion</li> <li>Fundierte Kenntnisse der Finanzbuchhaltung und Abschlusserstellung nach HGB</li> <li>Erfahrung mit Monats- und Jahresabschlüssen sowie Finanz- und Konzernreporting; IFRS-Kenntnisse sind wünschenswert</li> <li>Erfahrung in der Steuerung und Verbesserung von Accounting-Prozessen, idealerweise in einem internationalen Unternehmensumfeld</li> <li>Fähigkeit, eigenständig zu arbeiten und gleichzeitig eng mit internationalen Finance- und Managementteams zusammenzuarbeiten</li> <li>Erfahrung mit NetSuite oder die Bereitschaft, sich einzuarbeiten</li> <li>Gute Englischkenntnisse für die regelmäßige Zusammenarbeit mit der globalen Finance-Organisation</li> </ul> <p><strong>Unser Angebot</strong></p> <ul> <li>Spannende und abwechslungsreiche Tätigkeiten im Musikbusiness</li> <li>Sicherheit und Möglichkeiten eines internationalen Konzerns</li> <li>Modernes, digitalisiertes Accounting im weltweiten Umfeld</li> <li>Eigenverantwortung und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten</li> <li>Flache Hierarchien und kurze Entscheidungswege</li> <li>Flexible Arbeitszeiten (Mo-Fr) mit der Möglichkeit zum mobilen Arbeiten</li> <li>Vielfältiges Team</li> <li>Moderne Altersvorsorge</li> <li>Fahrkostenzuschuss oder Jobrad</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p>English Translation:</p> <p><strong>Location:</strong> Berlin, Hamburg, </p> <p><s><br></s>We are currently seeking a Senior Accountant.</p> <p>Kings Road Merch GmbH is a globally established full-service provider of merchandise products and services. As an independent German subsidiary of a global music group, we offer customized online shops for bands and artists. We manage merchandising at venues throughout Europe during their tours.</p> <p>Our services range from the production of merchandise products to storage and logistics in our logistics center in Dortmund, Europe-wide tour support, and the operation of customized online shops.</p> <p>We are looking for you if you enjoy working in the music industry with printed T-shirts and merchandise. European VAT, OSS and withholding tax requirements do not intimidate you, and you are keen to work with NetSuite and collaborate closely with international Finance partners.</p> <p>As Senior Accountant, you will play a key role in overseeing and continuously improving the finance and accounting processes supporting KRM's European business. Working closely with the European management team and the global Finance organization, you will ensure that financial close, reporting, compliance and internal controls are accurate, timely and consistently applied.</p> <p> </p> <p><strong>What you will do:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Central oversight and continuous improvement of the accounting processes supporting KRM’s European business<s><br></s>Independent management of accounts receivable and accounts payable processes</li> <li>Invoice review and payment processing</li> <li>Accounts receivable management</li> <li>Preparation of VAT returns in all European countries in collaboration with our international compliance partner</li> <li>Preparation and coordination of monthly and annual financial statements in accordance with the German Commercial Code (HGB), as well as reporting</li> <li>Preparation and quality assurance of monthly financial reporting to the US parent company</li> <li>Act as the central Finance interface between KRM EU, the European management team and the global Finance organization</li> <li>Ensure reliable internal controls, documentation and consistently applied accounting standards</li> <li>Identify and implement improvements and automation opportunities across Finance processes</li> <li>Support the continued development and effective use of NetSuite</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>Who you are:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Completed commercial training, ideally as a tax clerk or financial accountant, or an equivalent qualification</li> <li>Several years of professional experience in an accounting role with a high level of ownership</li> <li>Strong knowledge of financial accounting and financial statement preparation under the German Commercial Code (HGB)</li> <li>Experience with monthly and annual financial statements as well as financial and group reporting; IFRS knowledge is desirable</li> <li>Experience in overseeing and improving accounting processes, ideally within an international business environment</li> <li>Ability to work independently while collaborating closely with international Finance and management teams</li> <li>Proficiency in Oracle NetSuite and Microsoft Excel is highly desirable.</li> <li>Good English skills for regular collaboration with the global Finance organization</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>What we offer</strong></p> <ul> <li>Exciting and varied activities in the music business</li> <li>Security and opportunities of an international corporation</li> <li>Modern, digitalized accounting in a global environment</li> <li>Personal responsibility and development opportunities</li> <li>Flat hierarchies and short decision-making processes</li> <li>Flexible working hours (Mon-Fri) with the option of remote working</li> <li>Diverse team</li> <li>Modern pension plan</li> <li>Travel allowance or company bike</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>Equal Opportunities</strong><br><br>As an active part of a culturally and socially diverse society, Sony Music’s aim is that our workforce is diverse and inclusive. Sony Music is an equal opportunity employer and supports workforce diversity.<br><br>We employ, retain, promote and otherwise treat all employees and job applicants according to their merit, qualifications, competence and talent. We apply this policy without regard to any individual’s sex, race, religion, origin, age, sexual orientation, marital status, medical condition or disability.<br><br><strong>Privacy Policy</strong><br><br>Please click <a href="https://www.sonymusic.com/privacy-policy/">here</a> to read our privacy policy before beginning the application process as you will need to agree to the terms of the policy before submitting your information.</p> <p> </p> <p> </p> Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Copywriter
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>Hi, we’re Phiture — the mobile growth consultancy working with the teams behind leading apps like Adobe, Headspace, and LEGO® 👋. We’re setting the standard for growth in the brave new digital world, and we need great people to join our global team!</p></div><h3><strong>WHAT TO EXPECT:</strong></h3> <p>We're looking for a sharp, versatile <strong>Senior Copywriter</strong> to own copy across some of Phiture's biggest accounts, including one of Europe’s biggest mobile gaming companies, the USA’s largest retailer, a fintech that keeps families connected across borders, and a fast-growing productivity app.</p> <p>You'll join a close-knit creative pod, working side by side with our Creative Lead, designers and Growth Consultants. Together, you'll <strong>turn briefs, audience insights and testing hypotheses into conversion-focused copy</strong> that reaches millions of users in app stores around the world.</p> <p>This isn't copywriting in a vacuum. You'll see how your messaging performs, learn from every test and use those insights to make the next round sharper. You'll switch between very different brands, tones and formats, often within tight character limits and on deadlines tied to larger experiments. It's a role for a writer who cares as much about why copy works as how it sounds, and who wants to grow into ASO, experimentation and creative strategy.</p> <h3><strong>WHAT YOU'LL DO:</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Own copy delivery across your assigned accounts, from brief interpretation through to final QA on production and market localisation</li> <li>Translate creative briefs, audience insights and testing hypotheses into clear, conversion-focused copy, and ask the right questions when context or objectives are missing</li> <li>Write across a range of formats, including: <ul> <li>App store metadata, screenshot captions and in-app events</li> <li>Promotional content, storyboards and CRM campaigns</li> </ul> </li> <li>Build deep knowledge of each client's brand, products, features and audiences, understanding not just what we're promoting, but why</li> <li>Switch confidently between distinct brand voices, formats and markets, keeping each brand's identity intact while leaving room for creative testing</li> <li>Partner closely with designers so that copy and visuals work towards the same objective</li> <li>Write English source copy that translates well, and adapt messaging for different English-speaking markets</li> <li>Use creative testing and performance results to shape your recommendations and bring new ideas to the table</li> <li>Present and explain your creative rationale in meetings, alongside the Creative Lead</li> <li>Brief, guide and review freelance copywriters when the workload calls for it</li> <li>Carry client feedback, brand preferences and past learnings into every new piece of work</li> <li>Run copy QA and proofreading, including checking final designs for accuracy, localisation and consistency</li> <li>Plan your own workload and capacity, flagging risks early so copy never holds up design, testing or launches</li> <li>Use AI tools thoughtfully to work smarter, with the judgement to critically edit what they produce</li> </ul> <h3><strong>WHAT YOU'LL NEED:</strong></h3> <ul> <li><strong>Native-level English copywriting ability, with excellent grammar, editorial skills and exceptional attention to detail</strong></li> <li><strong>Proven experience in a senior copywriting role, writing compelling digital copy across different formats and brands</strong></li> <li><strong>Strategic and commercial thinking: you can find the real user benefit in a brief and explain why your copy will work, not just why it sounds good</strong></li> <li><strong>A strong portfolio that shows range across brand voices and clear, benefit-led messaging</strong></li> <li>Experience managing multiple projects in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment, with full ownership of quality, priorities and delivery</li> <li>A collaborative mindset: you enjoy working closely with designers and strategists, and respond constructively to feedback</li> <li>Confident communication with clients and internal stakeholders at all levels</li> <li>Experience in a creative or digital agency, ideally in mobile, performance or growth marketing</li> <li>Experience with ASO, SEO, UX or performance copywriting is a plus, but not essential, we'll teach you the ASO side. What matters most is strong craft, curiosity and a real interest in how ASO works beyond the copy itself</li> <li>Curiosity about products, audiences and the data behind them</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><em>We encourage all qualified individuals to apply, regardless of their age, gender identity, ethnicity, sexual orientation, disability status, or religion. We celebrate diversity and are excited about building teams that represent a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills. All employment decisions are based on qualifications, merit, and business needs.</em></p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Associate/Pricing & Market Access (m/w/d)
description: <p><strong>About Charles River Associates</strong></p> <p><a href="https://www.crai.com/"><strong>Charles River Associates</strong></a> is a leading global consulting firm that provides economic, financial, and business management expertise to major law firms, corporations and governments around the world. CRA advises clients on economic and financial matters pertaining to litigation and regulatory proceedings, and guides corporations through critical business strategy and performance-related issues. Since 1965, clients have engaged CRA for its combination of industry experience and rigorous, fact-based analysis that provides clients with clear, implementable solutions to complex business concerns. </p> <p><strong>Position Overview</strong></p> <p>CRA’s <a href="https://nam04.safelinks.protection.outlook.com/?url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.crai.com%2Findustries%2Flife-sciences%2F&data=05%7C02%7Cakimball%40crai.com%7Cea67c91398754dca094608ded2ba7e0c%7C4a156c19bc9441acaacf954686490869%7C0%7C0%7C639179895609780605%7CUnknown%7CTWFpbGZsb3d8eyJFbXB0eU1hcGkiOnRydWUsIlYiOiIwLjAuMDAwMCIsIlAiOiJXaW4zMiIsIkFOIjoiTWFpbCIsIldUIjoyfQ%3D%3D%7C0%7C%7C%7C&sdata=KsJhZhqtnMhJKdJrhhCfvbIxa7MQpmtL2vIB9OXdxAk%3D&reserved=0"><strong>Life Sciences</strong></a> practice helps pharmaceutical, biotechnology, diagnostics and medical device companies achieve optimum performance across key aspects of their business, including innovation, commercial success, organization, and reputation, all for the long-term benefit of patients, clinicians, employees, and shareholders. We work with life sciences businesses directly as well as with their legal counsel, industry associations, government organizations, and advocacy groups from the earliest stages of research into new therapy areas, through product development, to the delivery of products that will achieve commercial success and fulfill the expectations of our clients and their key stakeholders.</p> <p>Senior Associates at CRA work on project teams with senior and junior consultants on a variety of client engagements across industries. Senior Associates conduct advanced strategic analysis and assist in the management of consulting projects. They serve as a project manager, direct the work of others, oversee analysis, manage mid-level client relationships, and/or communicate project results. Staff at this level are expected to work independently with minimal supervision.</p> <p>To be successful in this role, you must be able to effectively plan and manage the execution of smaller projects or significant sub-tasks on larger, more complex projects, conceptualize and analyse issues, and perform or direct a wide variety of analytical tasks. We also highly value a strong work ethic, creativity, a positive attitude, and a high level of energy. At this time, we are specifically seeking consultants with strong knowledge of pricing and access systems in Europe and globally. Typical Senior Associate responsibilities include:</p> <ul> <li>Independently identify/design analytic tasks and contribute to the development of overall analytic framework for consulting projects;</li> <li>Interface with client representatives to communicate developments and present results;</li> <li>Draft reports or presentations, or sections of reports or presentations;</li> <li>Contribute to project planning and budget management efforts;</li> <li>Provide training and technical supervision to less-experienced staff, including reviewing their analyses and providing coaching/direction;</li> <li>Contribute to business development efforts and draft client proposals.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Desired Qualifications</strong></p> <ul> <li>Bachelor's or Master's degree in life sciences (e.g., biology, biotechnology, biochemistry, pharmacology, chemistry etc.) or a relevant analytical degree, with significant work experience;</li> <li>3-6 years previous consulting experience;</li> <li>Strong skills in quantitative and qualitative analysis methods and techniques;</li> <li>Proven staff and project management skills;</li> <li>Client interaction, facilitation, presentation, budgeting, and project planning skills;</li> <li>Strong knowledge of pricing and market access issues in the European markets (and globally);</li> <li>Occasional travel required.</li> </ul> <p><strong>To Apply</strong></p> <p>To be considered for this position, we require the following:</p> <ul> <li><strong>Resume</strong> – please include current address, personal email and telephone number;</li> <li><strong>Cover letter</strong> – please describe your interest in CRA and how this role matches your goals.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Career Growth and Benefits </strong></p> <ul> <li>CRA’s robust <a href="https://www.crai.com/cra-careers/talent-development/"><strong>skills development programs</strong></a>, including a commitment to offering training annually through formal and informal programs, encouraging you to thrive as an individual and team member. Beginning with skill building, training continues with technical training, presentation skills, internal seminars, and career mentoring and performance coaching from an assigned senior colleague. Additional leadership and collaboration opportunities exist through internal firm development activities.</li> <li>We offer a comprehensive total rewards program including a superior benefits package, <a href="https://www.crai.com/benefits/"><strong>wellness programmin</strong>g</a> to support physical, mental, emotional and financial well-being, and in-house <a href="https://www.crai.com/cra-careers/immigration-global-mobility/"><strong>immigration support</strong></a> for foreign nationals and international business travelers.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Work Location Flexibility</strong></p> <p>CRA creates a work environment that enables our colleagues to benefit from being together in the office to best deliver on our promise of career growth, mentorship and inclusivity. At the same time, we recognise that individuals realise a range of benefits when working from home periodically. We currently expect that individuals spend at least 3 to 4 days a week working in the office (which may include traveling to another CRA office or to client meetings), with specific days determined in coordination with your practice or team.</p> <p><strong>Responsible AI Use in Recruiting</strong></p> <p>We believe that recruiting is fundamentally a human process, and we are committed to a hiring process that is consistent, transparent, and people-focused. While AI and other technology-enabled tools help our team operate more efficiently, we strive to provide every candidate with a personalized, thoughtful, and high-touch experience. As CRA invests significant human effort to find qualified members for our teams, we expect candidates to invest corresponding human effort to learn about CRA, prepare thoughtful application materials, and engage with our interviewers. Read more about appropriate hiring manager, recruiting team, and candidate AI at CRA <a href="https://www.crai.com/cra-careers/ai-recruiting/">on our website</a>.  </p> <p><strong>Our Commitment to Equal Employment Opportunity</strong></p> <p>Charles River Associates is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other protected characteristic under applicable law.</p> <p>______________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________</p> <p><strong>Über Charles River Associates</strong></p> <p><strong>Charles River Associates</strong> ist eine führende globale Beratungsfirma, die wirtschaftliche, finanzielle und betriebswirtschaftliche Expertise für große Anwaltskanzleien, Unternehmen und Regierungen weltweit bietet. CRA berät Kunden in wirtschaftlichen und finanziellen Angelegenheiten im Zusammenhang mit Rechtsstreitigkeiten und behördlichen Verfahren und unterstützt Unternehmen bei kritischen Geschäftsstrategien und leistungsbezogenen Fragen. Seit 1965 engagieren Kunden CRA aufgrund der Kombination aus Branchenerfahrung und rigoroser, faktenbasierter Analyse, die klare, umsetzbare Lösungen für komplexe Geschäftsprobleme bietet.</p> <p><strong>Stellenübersicht</strong></p> <p>Die Life Sciences Practice von CRA hilft Pharma-, Biotechnologie-, Medtech- und Digital-Health-Unternehmen, optimale Leistungen in wichtigen Geschäftsbereichen wie kommerzielle Strategie, Preisgestaltung und Zugang, Innovation, Organisationsstruktur, Politikanalyse, medizinische Angelegenheiten, Stakeholder-Management und Marketing zu erzielen – alles zum langfristigen Nutzen von Patienten, Ärzten, Mitarbeitern und Aktionären. Wir arbeiten direkt mit Life-Sciences-Unternehmen sowie mit deren Rechtsberatern, Industrieverbänden, Regierungsorganisationen und Interessengruppen zusammen.</p> <p>Senior Associates bei CRA arbeiten gemeinsam mit erfahrenen und jüngeren Consultants in Projektteams an einer Vielzahl von Kundenprojekten in unterschiedlichen Branchen. Sie führen anspruchsvolle strategische Analysen durch und unterstützen bei der Steuerung von Beratungsprojekten. Dabei übernehmen sie die Projektleitung, koordinieren die Arbeit anderer Teammitglieder, verantworten Analysen, betreuen Kundenbeziehungen auf mittlerer Ebene und/oder kommunizieren Projektergebnisse. In dieser Position arbeiten Sie weitgehend selbstständig und eigenverantwortlich.</p> <p>Für eine erfolgreiche Tätigkeit in dieser Position sollten Sie in der Lage sein, kleinere Projekte oder wesentliche Teilaufgaben größerer und komplexerer Projekte effektiv zu planen und zu steuern, Fragestellungen zu strukturieren und zu analysieren sowie ein breites Spektrum analytischer Aufgaben selbst durchzuführen oder anzuleiten. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><h2>Available Locations</h2><ul><li>Singapore</li></ul><h2>About the Role</h2><p>The Cloudflare APAC sales organisation operates as one integrated revenue system. The work itself, however, remains human. The role of every seller at Cloudflare is to bring critical thinking, judgment, and trust to customer relationships and outcomes.</p><p>In this role, you will be responsible for driving significant growth by landing and expanding a portfolio of assigned customers in your assigned territory. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. If the internet moves information, we move value: crypto, stablecoins, tokenized assets, and whatever comes next. Four offerings make that real: fund, tokenize, trade, and spend. MoonPay Enterprise is the fund layer built for businesses. We power how stablecoins move through real financial operations: enterprises, fintechs, PSPs, wallets, and marketplaces running their treasuries, their cross-border flows, and their stablecoin operations on us. The goal is to make moving real money at scale as predictable as any other piece of financial infrastructure, with the compliance and controls CFOs need to say yes. AI is the default operating mode here. It's woven into every role, and we expect you to use it daily. It handles the manual work so you can deliver on what actually matters. You'll thrive here if outcomes excite you more than process, if impact motivates you more than titles, and if you want hard problems, real ownership, and teammates who love winning, building, and doing it together. The bar is high. The pace is real. We're building the rails that businesses run real money on, for humans and agents. You know how to drive AI-assisted development productively while staying firmly in control of correctness, security, and design quality Interest in crypto, stablecoins, and the future of payments. Design, build, deploy, and maintain Electrical Ground Support Equipment (EGSE) that interfaces with space vehicles under Assembly, Integration & Tests, allowing Validation and Verification of spacecrafts and their software before their launch campaigns. Develop tools and frameworks that allow teams to simulate faults, edge cases, and mission scenarios that are difficult or costly to reproduce with physical hardware alone. Work closely with systems, software, hardware, and operations teams to understand evolving test requirements and integrate feedback into the platforms. Maintain and extend test infrastructure to support continuous integration (CI) pipelines, ensuring every code change is validated with realistic system-level tests. Troubleshoot complex system issues spanning software, embedded hardware, networking, and system configuration. Our culture at Loft Orbital promotes collaboration and ownership among our developers, fostering efforts hand in hand with other teams, internally and externally. Must Haves: 2+ years working with Linux systems, including configuration, debugging, and system-level troubleshooting. Strong understanding of networking fundamentals ( OSI layers, packet analysis, data exchange protocols like TCP/IP and UDP ). Hands-on experience with embedded systems or low-level hardware (Raspberry Pi, Arduino, microcontrollers, or similar). Proficiency in Python (3.9+) for building test automation frameworks, device drivers, or test orchestration tools. Experience containerizing applications with Docker. Familiarity with at least one modern CI tool (e.g., Jenkins, GitLab CI, Buildkite, CircleCI) and integrating test pipelines. Nice to Haves: Experience designing or automating complex HIL / SIL testbed, signal conditioning, fault injection, or hardware emulation. Experience with “Infrastructure-as-Code” systems, specifically NixOS. Familiarity with networking simulation tools (e.g., network emulators, virtual switches) for testing data flows under realistic mission constraints. Interest or experience with hardware test automation frameworks (e.g., custom Python-based test rigs). Master’s degree in Computer Science or a similar field. We integrate, launch, and operate spacecraft, offering end-to-end missions as a service across Earth observation, IoT connectivity, on-orbit AI, national security missions, and more. description: ÜBER UNSERE COMPANY freiheit.com wurde 1999 in Hamburg gegründet und entwickelt seitdem custom large-scale Softwareprodukte. Unsere Mission ist: “Ship great software”. ÜBER DEINEN JOB Zusammen mit unserem CEO übernimmst du Verantwortung für die erfolgreiche Geschäftsentwicklung bei freiheit.com Dafür hast du immer ein klares Ziel im Blick: Den Erfolg Deiner Kunden. Enge Kundenbeziehungen sind für uns selbstverständlich, als verlässlicher Partner bist du öfters beim Kunden vor Ort und identifizierst mit ihm zusammen seine wichtigen strategischen Ziele. title: Senior Software Engineer - Kubernetes platform
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p><strong>Available Locations</strong></p> <ul> <li>Atlanta, US</li> <li>Austin, US</li> <li>Denver, US</li> <li>New York, US</li> <li>San Francisco, US</li> <li>Seattle, US</li> <li>Washington DC, US</li> <li>Canada</li> </ul> <p><strong>About the role</strong></p> <p>Many of Cloudflare’s critical internal services run on Kubernetes. These services include those responsible for Cloudflare’s control plane and APIs, data analytics and other internal tools used to manage our global network. These Kubernetes platforms are purpose-built from the ground up and run on bare metal Linux in different regions around the world. The scale we work at involves tens of thousands of containers and terabits per second of network traffic. The team takes pride in knowing this platform helps run parts of the global Internet.</p> <p>As an engineer on the Kubernetes platform team, you'll be building the tools to help engineers deploy and operate the services that make Cloudflare work. Our mission is to provide a reliable and flexible platform to help product teams release new software efficiently and safely. The role includes both software engineering and DevOps operational responsibilities.</p> <p><strong>Responsibilities</strong></p> <ul> <li>Design scalable and resilient systems that can keep up with company growth.</li> <li>Work with application teams to understand their needs and challenges, and help them choose the best way to architect their systems to run well in our Kubernetes environment.</li> <li>Harden the platform against security threats, noisy neighbours, and accidents.</li> <li>Improve the efficiency of our use of resources such as CPU, memory, bandwidth, and storage.</li> <li>Help respond to, resolve, and prevent incidents impacting the platform or our users.</li> <li>Contribute back to the open source community. Some of our favorite open source projects include: Envoy, Contour, Consul, etcd, cdk8s, Cloudprober, Calico, Ceph, Rook, KubeVirt, and more.</li> </ul> <p>Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience</p> <ul> <li>Experience managing production Kubernetes clusters.</li> <li>Experience operating systems on-premise at scale in roles such as SRE, systems design or architecture.</li> <li>Excellent debugging skills in a Linux environment.</li> <li>Knowledge of how container runtimes work inside of Linux (isolation, storage, and networking).</li> <li>A firm grasp of IP networking including routing and iptables/nftables.</li> <li>Ability to work with codebases in Go, TypeScript, and Bash/shell.</li> <li>The ability to break down complex problems into smaller pieces, provide options, talk through trade-offs, build consensus, and drive the effort to solve the problem.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Bonus Points</strong></p> <ul> <li>Familiarity with building platforms across multiple zones and regions as the foundation for other teams to build distributed highly-available applications.</li> <li>Experience with configuration management frameworks such as SaltStack or Ansible.</li> <li>Experience with continuous deployment tooling like ArgoCD and Argo Rollouts.</li> <li>Operational/administrator experience with etcd, Ceph, Rook, KubeVirt, CNIs, ClusterAPI, Envoy, and/or Contour.</li> <li>Experience as a user of Prometheus, Elasticsearch/Kibana, Vault, Redis, and/or Consul.</li> </ul> <h3>Compensation</h3> <p>Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location.</p> <ul> <li>For California based hires: Estimated annual salary of $194,000 - $266,000</li> <li>For Colorado based hires: Estimated annual salary of $168,000 - $231,000</li> <li>For New York based hires: Estimated annual salary of $185,000 - $254,000</li> <li>For Washington based hires: Estimated annual salary of $185,000 - $254,000</li> <li>For Washington DC based hires: Estimated annual salary of $185,000 - $254,000</li> <li>For Canada based hires: Estimated annual salary of $150,000 - $206,000</li> </ul> <h3>Applications will be accepted until December 25, 2026.</h3> <h3>Equity</h3> <p>This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare's equity plan.</p> <h3>Benefits</h3> <p>Cloudflare offers a complete package of benefits and programs to support you and your family. Our benefits programs can help you pay health care expenses, support caregiving, build capital for the future and make life a little easier and fun! The below is a description of our benefits for employees in the United States, and benefits may vary for employees based outside the U.S.</p> <p>Health & Welfare Benefits</p> <ul> <li>Medical/Rx Insurance</li> <li>Dental Insurance</li> <li>Vision Insurance</li> <li>Flexible Spending Accounts</li> <li>Commuter Spending Accounts</li> <li>Fertility & Family Forming Benefits</li> <li>On-demand mental health support and Employee Assistance Program</li> <li>Global Travel Medical Insurance</li> </ul> <p>Financial Benefits</p> <ul> <li>Short and Long Term Disability Insurance</li> <li>Life & Accident Insurance</li> <li>401(k) Retirement Savings Plan</li> <li>Employee Stock Participation Plan</li> </ul> <p>Time Off</p> <ul> <li>Flexible paid time off covering vacation and sick leave</li> <li>Leave programs, including parental, pregnancy health, medical, and bereavement leave</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: We released</span><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">1.1.1.1</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our</span><a href="https://developers.cloudflare.com/1.1.1.1/privacy/public-dns-resolver"> privacy commitment</a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs.  More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.  We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all people and place great value in both diversity and inclusiveness.  All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to their, or any other person's, perceived or actual</span> <span style="font-weight: 400;">race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, family care status, or any other basis protected by law. </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">We are an AA/Veterans/Disabled Employer.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities.  Please tell us if you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job.

You'll design and develop systems that ingest, store, index, and query security report data, including integrations with key third-party systems. With a strong focus on PostgreSQL and scalable backend design, your work will support security features delivered by teams across GitLab.</p> <p>You'll take ownership of large deliverables from early ideas through implementation, working directly with product, design, frontend, and engineering partners to shape the technical and product roadmap. You'll stay hands-on across GitLab's Ruby on Rails application and newer services, including greenfield projects, while helping the team build its expertise in modular service design.</p> <p><strong>What you’ll do</strong></p> <ul> <li>Lead large technical deliverables from initial problem definition through delivery, often across multiple months or quarters.</li> <li>Design and develop backend systems for vulnerability and dependency management, including security report ingestion, storage, indexing, querying, and integrations with key third-party systems.</li> <li>Build and improve systems using Ruby on Rails and PostgreSQL, and contribute to newer services using technologies such as Go or Rust where appropriate.</li> <li>Shape technical plans, break down complex work, and help other engineers deliver effectively.</li> <li>Work directly with product, design, frontend, and engineering partners to make clear decisions, resolve constraints, and deliver measurable progress.</li> <li>Influence the team's product and technical roadmap through hands-on investigation, clear proposals, and iterative delivery that demonstrates progress in each monthly release cycle.</li> <li>Apply a security mindset when designing systems, including considering how GitLab identifies and handles malicious or vulnerable software packages.</li> <li>Define patterns for modular services, provide technical leadership when vulnerability management work spans multiple GitLab areas, and share that expertise across GitLab Security.</li> <li><span data-sheets-root="1">Take part in on-call or operational support where your team’s ownership model requires it.</span></li> </ul> <p><strong>What you’ll bring</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience leading complex backend projects from idea through delivery while remaining hands-on with design and development.</li> <li>Strong PostgreSQL experience, including evidence of query optimization, table optimization, and write-ahead log Our SREs combine a pragmatic operations mindset with strong software engineering practices to drive automation, reduce toil, and improve resilience across our platform.</p> <p>In the Environment Automation specialization, your focus is on operating and automating hundreds of GitLab environments—from initial provisioning to day-to-day maintenance tasks. </p> <p>Unlike other SRE roles, this position centers on automating the lifecycle of many tenant environments, ensuring they remain secure, consistent, and reliable at scale.</p> <p>Some examples of the projects you could work on:</p> <ul> <li>Designing infrastructure automation that provisions and operates GitLab environments using Terraform, Ansible, and Kubernetes</li> <li>Creating and maintaining deployment packages for GitLab, such as Helm Charts and omnibus-gitlab</li> <li>Building and operating Dedicated GitLab instances integrated with cloud-native services (e.g., GCP, AWS)</li> <li>Developing tools to orchestrate infrastructure-as-code workflows across multiple tenants</li> <li>Deploying and managing microservices on Kubernetes clusters at scale</li> <li>Enhancing GitLab’s observability stack (e.g., Prometheus, ELK) to support proactive monitoring and incident response</li> <li>Integrating with and operating infrastructure in cloud provider ecosystems (e.g., IAM, networking, storage)</li> <li>Championing and implementing cloud security best practices across automated infrastructure</li> </ul> <p><strong>What You’ll Do</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Build & Scale Multi-Tenant Infrastructure:</strong> Design and implement automation that provisions and manages hundreds of isolated GitLab environments using Terraform, Ansible, and Kubernetes. Manage complex state strategies and workspace configurations to support scale and maintainability.</li> <li><strong>Debug & Resolve Production Issues: </strong>Troubleshoot issues across Kubernetes clusters, cloud services, and GitLab apps—identifying root causes of failed deployments, crash loops, and scheduling conflicts to ensure service continuity.</li> <li><strong>Automate Operations at Scale: </strong>Replace manual workflows with infrastructure-as-code solutions, including automated version upgrades, configuration rollouts, and provisioning pipelines that operate reliably across all tenants.</li> <li><strong>Monitor & Predict Capacity: </strong>Build observability systems that detect bottlenecks, predict usage trends, and optimize resource consumption using tools like Prometheus, ELK, and Grafana.</li> <li><strong>Respond & Lead During Incidents: </strong>Lead incident response and postmortem efforts, applying technical depth to resolve issues and establish operational standards that reduce future risk.</li> <li><strong>Architect & Collaborate: </strong>Influence architectural decisions around automation, scalability, and operational excellence. Partner with engineering teams to improve automation, platform resilience, and production-readiness.</li> <li><span data-sheets-root="1"><strong>On Call Support:</strong> Take part in on-call or operational support where your team’s ownership model requires it.</span></li> </ul> <p><strong>What You’ll Bring</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Production-Scale Experience: </strong>Proven ability to operate and troubleshoot production workloads across multiple tenants or environments. Deep understanding of how distributed systems fail at scale and how to build in resilience.<br><strong>Terraform & IaC Mastery:</strong> Strong hands-on experience with Terraform, including workspace strategies, state management, and automation patterns that scale. Comfortable solving state isolation issues and building reliable, reusable infrastructure code. Experience with Ansible and templating tools like Jsonnet is a plus.<br><strong>Kubernetes in Production: </strong>Skilled at diagnosing deployment failures, interpreting pod logs, and debugging scheduling issues and rollback scenarios in live environments. Understands how pods, ReplicaSets, and controllers interact in production.<br><strong>Programming & Code Analysis: </strong>Ability to read and debug code in Go and/or Ruby. Familiar with identifying performance issues, scalability concerns, and contributing to infrastructure tooling through thoughtful code analysis.<br><strong>Large Scale Operations Background: </strong>Experience supporting infrastructure for many customers or environments simultaneously. Comfortable managing isolation, scaling, monitoring, and incident response across diverse workloads.<br><strong>Architecture & Incident Response:</strong> Able to reason through complex systems and operational challenges. Brings on-call experience and can lead technical discussions and incident resolution efforts under pressure.<br><strong>Customer-Focused Collaboration: </strong>Proven ability to work across teams and with internal or external customers to solve technical problems while maintaining service commitments and clear communication.<br><strong>GitLab Platform Proficiency: </strong>Comfortable using GitLab as a daily tool for infrastructure automation, collaboration, and operational workflows.</li> </ul> <p><strong>About the team</strong><br>GitLab’s Dedicated team, where the SRE Environment Automation role sits, is on a mission to deliver a fully managed, single-tenant GitLab experience through the GitLab Dedicated platform. Our goal is to eliminate manual operations across the entire lifecycle of customer environments, including provisioning, upgrades, security, and monitoring, so customers can focus on unlocking the full potential of The One DevOps Platform without managing the underlying infrastructure. We build scalable, automated systems that ensure each GitLab Dedicated instance is secure, consistent, and production-ready—whether we're managing 10 environments or hundreds.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><h4><strong>How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees</strong></h4> <ul> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/">Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/time-off-and-absence/time-off-types/#flexible-paid-time-off-pto">Flexible Paid Time Off </a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/company/culture/inclusion/tmrg-tmag/">Team Member Resource Groups</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/stock-options/">Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/learning-and-development/growth-and-development/">Growth and Development Fund</a></li> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/#parental-leave">Parental Leave</a> </li> </ul> <p>Please note that we welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; many successful candidates do not meet every single requirement. description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>About Dashlane</strong></p> <p style="margin-left: 0.0in;">Dashlane’s mission is to deliver the credential security every business and employee needs to thrive. Founded in Paris, Dashlane has since established offices in New York and Lisbon, and has grown to more than 300 Dashlaners globally.</p> <p style="margin-left: 0.0in;">We're looking for people who actively use AI tools to drive efficiency, creativity, and impact in their work. Learn more about <a href="https://lifeatdashlane.com/" data-prosemirror-content-type="mark" data-prosemirror-mark-name="link"><u data-prosemirror-content-type="mark" data-prosemirror-mark-name="underline">life at Dashlane</u></a>, including <a href="https://lifeatdashlane.com/how-we-work" data-prosemirror-content-type="mark" data-prosemirror-mark-name="link"><u data-prosemirror-content-type="mark" data-prosemirror-mark-name="underline">how we work</u></a>, <a href="https://lifeatdashlane.com/how-we-hire" data-prosemirror-content-type="mark" data-prosemirror-mark-name="link"><u data-prosemirror-content-type="mark" data-prosemirror-mark-name="underline">how we hire</u></a>, and the <a href="https://lifeatdashlane.com/benefits-dashlane" data-prosemirror-content-type="mark" data-prosemirror-mark-name="link"><u data-prosemirror-content-type="mark" data-prosemirror-mark-name="underline">benefits of being a Dashlaner</u></a>.</p> <p style="margin-left: 0.0in;"> </p></div><div class="_3iDTPbvLZJ renderer-heading-wrapper" data-testid="renderer-heading-wrapper" data-level="2"> <h2 id="About-the-role" data-local-id="19912f4e57bc" data-renderer-start-pos="5090">About the role</h2> </div> <p data-renderer-start-pos="5106" data-local-id="aad315eed8c9">As our Staff Product Manager for Agentic Capabilities, you will own the vision, strategy and roadmap for how Dashlane becomes an interface for AI agents and assistants for consumers and businesses. Success means people hand real, valuable tasks to agents through Dashlane and keep doing it, and companies trust it enough to let their teams do the same.</p> <p data-renderer-start-pos="5461" data-local-id="8eccdecf657e">You will own the product alongside senior engineers as a Staff-level individual contributor in a 0-to-1 role where standards are still unsettled. We are looking for strong familiarity with the modern AI landscape, including LLMs, assistants and agentic workflows, and sound judgment about what agents can and cannot be trusted with.</p> <p data-renderer-start-pos="5797" data-local-id="34d4eaf63e5f">At Dashlane, we embrace a hybrid culture that combines the best of both worlds: the creativity and energy of in-person collaboration with the flexibility of remote work. Our model is designed to strengthen team connections while supporting individual productivity and work-life balance. To maximize collaboration, we come together in the office on Mondays, Tuesdays, and Thursdays, while Wednesdays and Fridays offer more flexibility for focused work.</p> <div class="_3iDTPbvLZJ renderer-heading-wrapper" data-testid="renderer-heading-wrapper" data-level="2"> <h2 data-local-id="77482dc82bc5" data-renderer-start-pos="6251"> </h2> <h2 id="Key-Responsibilities" data-local-id="77482dc82bc5" data-renderer-start-pos="6251">Key Responsibilities</h2> </div> <ul class="ak-ul" data-local-id="0a99785c0c6d" data-indent-level="1"> <li> <p data-renderer-start-pos="6275" data-local-id="59efdc1c591a"><strong data-renderer-mark="true">Set the direction.</strong> Form and defend a point of view on how agents and assistants should act with what Dashlane protects, for consumers and businesses, and turn it into a strategy, positioning, and multi-year plan that leadership will back.</p> </li> <li> <p data-renderer-start-pos="6517" data-local-id="bce92e95e7ad"><strong data-renderer-mark="true">Read the market and judge readiness.</strong> Keep a living view of how agent makers, assistants, browsers, identity vendors and password managers are moving. title: (Senior) Legal Counsel
description: <div><strong>Your Role</strong><br>As a (Senior) Legal Counsel, you will take ownership of legal topics that shape the company’s growth and day-to-day operations. You will work across commercial, corporate, compliance, and regulatory areas, supporting a fast-scaling business with pragmatic, business-oriented legal guidance.</div> <div> </div> <div>You will join a small, collaborative, and international legal team, working closely with the VP Legal & General Counsel and cross-functional stakeholders across the business.</div> <div> </div> <div>Depending on your experience, you will either take full ownership of topics end-to-end or further develop into this level of responsibility with support from the team.</div> <div> </div> <div><strong>Your Impact</strong></div> <ul> <li>Advise on a range of legal matters, with a primary focus on commercial topics and exposure to corporate, compliance, and regulatory areas</li> <li>Draft, review, and negotiate contracts with customers, suppliers, and strategic partners, independently or with support depending on complexity and experience</li> <li>Support cross-functional initiatives by embedding legal thinking into business decisions and processes</li> <li>Identify and mitigate legal and commercial risks through practical, scalable approaches</li> <li>Contribute to broader legal topics such as compliance, governance, or M&A activities where relevant</li> </ul> <div><strong>What We Expect</strong></div> <ul> <li>Qualified to practice law in Germany (2. Juristisches Staatsexamen with befriedigend or better), the United States (admitted to a state bar), or England & Wales (Solicitor qualification)</li> <li>Proven experience handling commercial contracts in a B2B environment, with the ability to manage negotiations with a good degree of autonomy</li> <li>Solid commercial judgment and the ability to balance legal risk with business objectives</li> <li>Experience working across multiple topics or projects, ideally in a cross-functional environment</li> <li>Clear and effective communicator, able to translate legal concepts into practical guidance for business stakeholders</li> </ul> Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Medical Writer (UK Based/US Position)
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>At Real Chemistry, making the world a healthier place isn’t just an aspiration—it’s our everyday reality. Our drive to transform healthcare is informed by our blend of deep scientific expertise, human-centred creativity, and AI-driven insights, fostering a unique environment where innovation thrives and our people are impact-obsessed. As a global agency, we provide a full suite of services across healthcare communications and marketing to our clients, including top players in the pharmaceutical and biotech industries.</p> <p>Our #LifeatRealChem culture is rooted in our people—we believe we are best together and are committed to excellence for both our clients and colleagues. Whether you're a seasoned professional or just starting your career, if you share our passion for healthcare and connection, we invite you to explore our opportunities.</p> <p>Discover your purpose. Embrace innovation. Experience #LifeatRealChem.</p></div><h2><strong>Senior Medical Writer </strong></h2> <p><strong>Please note: We are unable to offer visa sponsorship. Applicants must already have the legal right to work in the UK. If you do not meet this requirement, please do not apply. This is a hybrid position and is not a fully remote role.</strong></p> <p>Our <strong>Senior Medical Writers</strong> are responsible for driving day-to-day project delivery (with support from others) within an account in order to create outstanding medical content across a variety of therapy areas. This position is ideal for an experienced writer who has a passion for scientific and medical developments, a keen interest in AI, and who enjoys tackling new problems, interacting with clients, and mentoring internal team members.</p> <p><span data-teams="true"><em><strong>This role is based in the UK and employed under a UK contract of employment, with contractual working hours of 40 hours per week, but works as part of teams supporting US business and clients. The role works closely with US-based colleagues and may have day-to-day line management from leaders supporting US business. As for any role in Real Chemistry, reasonable flexibility to work across US and other time zones will be required depending on business need.</strong></em></span></p> <p> </p> <h2>Key Responsibilities</h2> <ul> <li><strong>Scientific knowledge:</strong> <ul> <li>Confidently steps into new therapeutic areas</li> <li>Starting to lead discussions with clients and external experts on therapy area, drivers which influence treatment decision-making and patient pathways</li> </ul> </li> <li><strong>Strategic knowledge:</strong> Helps to lead meetings and strategic discussions with clients</li> <li><strong>AI</strong> <ul> <li>Proactively utilizes a broad range of AI solutions to streamline complex projects, with support from others</li> <li>Evaluates and implements AI-driven solutions to enhance the efficiency and effectiveness of projects, identifying opportunities for improvement and collaborating with team members to optimize project delivery</li> <li>Provides guidance and training to team members on best practice</li> </ul> </li> <li><strong>Project ownership:</strong> <ul> <li>Leads content delivery for complex projects with supervision from senior team, delegating to AMW/MWs as needed and where appropriate to ensure timely execution to a high standard</li> <li>Skilled in achieving communications objectives by employing a broad range of channels and formats</li> </ul> </li> <li><strong>Project development: </strong> <ul> <li>Interrogates briefs from clients/internal teams and proactively flags any queries or potential issues</li> <li>Applies critical thinking skills towards a project brief to achieve deliverables in a timely and efficient manner</li> <li>Provides a proactive, solution-focused approach towards resolving queries, and addressing feedback</li> <li>Initiates discussions with Account Teams regarding potential barriers to successful project completion that may arise</li> </ul> </li> <li><strong>Editorial:</strong> <ul> <li>Develops compelling narratives from complex information</li> <li>Structures and writes novel projects that may not have been executed previously</li> </ul> </li> <li><strong>Quality control:</strong> <ul> <li>Takes responsibility for overall quality of deliverables with supervision from senior team</li> <li>Reviews JMWs’ work for adherence to brief, client objectives and quality of writing, providing constructive feedback</li> </ul> </li> <li><strong>On site: </strong>Leads elements of the on-site programme across a variety of events with support from others</li> <li><strong>Client liaison: </strong>Leads scientific discussion with clients and external experts as appropriate to capture briefs, resolve queries, and progress scientific content development in timely and efficient manner</li> <li><strong>Growth and new business</strong> <ul> <li>Supports development of scientific content for new therapeutic areas for new business</li> <li>Proactively identifies new business opportunities with new and existing clients</li> </ul> </li> <li><strong>Project management: </strong>Provides timely and accurate communication to accounts team on writer hours, and project progress</li> <li><strong>Teamwork</strong>: Trains/mentors junior writers on account-specific therapy area knowledge and processes</li> </ul> <h2>Qualifications and skills</h2> <ul> <li>You should bring a strong scientific background with a degree in a scientific or medical discipline (post-graduate degree preferred). Previous experience mentoring MWs and interacting regularly with clients is essential</li> </ul> <p> </p> <h2>What Real Chemistry offers</h2> <p>Real Chemistry offers a comprehensive benefit program and perks.
