title: Build Your Own Internship – m/f/d (min. 6 Months)
description: Help Us Change the Way the World Works Build something that matters. Langdock exists to change the way the world works, bridging the gap between what technology can do and what people actually do with it. We bring all leading AI models into one secure, model-agnostic platform and make them usable across entire organizations. Over 10,000 companies use our platform every day, from fast-growing startups to some of Europe’s largest enterprises. Their employees open Langdock to draft strategies, analyze documents, or automate workflows, helping them to work smarter, think more creatively, and reach their full potential. About the Role This is a full-time internship of at least 6 months at our Berlin HQ, and it is not a regular internship application. We don’t want your CV first. We want to see what you have built. If you build with AI because you can’t stop, with Langdock, Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, or anything else, show us. If your project convinces us, we shape the internship around you and your strengths. What We Want to See Record a Loom of something you built with AI. It should be no longer than 5 minutes. Two kinds of projects get our attention: Something that would help Langdock. Look at our product roadmap and at our product, and build something that solves a real problem for us or our customers. That could be a feature prototype, an internal tool, a GTM engine, a support automation, an eval setup, or something we haven’t thought of yet. A genuine passion project. Something you built because you couldn’t stop thinking about it, and that shows how you think. What we don’t want: basic chatbots, simple prompt wrappers, “summarize my inbox” agents, or linear three-step workflows. Our customers build those every day. Show us something that made you think hard, and that makes us think too. What Your Loom Should Cover The problem: what you solved and why it matters. The demo: show it working live, not on slides. How it’s built: the models, tools, architecture, and key decisions behind it. What broke: where it failed and what you learned from that. What’s next: what you would build at Langdock if you joined. What You Will Do Own a real project. Ideally it’s the one you showed us. You take it from prototype to something our team or customers actually use. Work directly with the team. You work alongside Product, Engineering, or GTM, depending on where your project lives. Ship, measure, iterate. You present your progress regularly and decide based on real feedback. How to Apply Paste your Loom URL into the field “Your Build” in the application form. Your LinkedIn profile is enough; a CV is optional. You Might Be a Fit If… You build, not just talk about AI. You have shipped things that work, even if they’re rough. You think in impact, not just in technology. You show high agency. You don’t wait for tasks; you find them. You experiment constantly with new models and tools. You communicate clearly and professionally in English. German is a plus. You are kind and care about the people around you. What We Need Availability for a full-time internship of at least 6 months, 100% on-site in Berlin. A work permit for Germany. The Environment You will work from our Berlin office at Greifswalder Straße 212, where all of us work together in person, surrounded by people building AI products and infrastructure every day. Lunch and dinner are catered in the office. We look after ourselves, and gym membership and coaching resources are part of the standard package. We value Calm Urgency, Ambitious Execution, and Caring Ownership. The vibe is calm but intense. Next Steps We move fast. If you have built something you’re proud of, show us. title: Compliance Director
description: About Doit We are focused on reinventing how people spend, save, invest, exchange, travel, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and become an expert at ease. We believe AI will help make finance smart, accessible and safe. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who love building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who care about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few. We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future for our society. In 2019, we built the first mobile-first insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it’s the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia. The Role Doit is building its investment business from Vilnius. As Compliance Director and AML at Doit Lithuania, you will build and run our compliance and anti-money-laundering function from day one. You will act as our Compliance Officer and AML Officer, and report directly to the management board. You will be independent of the business lines you monitor. You will run compliance and AML for a digital investment platform serving clients in Lithuania and across the European Economic Area. What You’ll Own Write and own the compliance and AML/CTF policies and procedures. Build the business-wide AML risk assessment, customer risk scoring and risk appetite. Design remote onboarding controls with our KYC partners, including enhanced due diligence for PEPs and high-risk clients. Design and tune transaction monitoring scenarios for brokerage activity. Run sanctions screening at onboarding, on an ongoing basis and on payments. File suspicious activity reports with the FNTT and suspicious order reports under MAR. Run the compliance monitoring programme and report to the board. Approve marketing communications and oversee product governance, complaints and conflicts of interest. Manage the regulatory relationship with the Bank of Lithuania on compliance and AML matters. Prepare the firm for the EU AML Regulation, which applies from July 2027. Build the compliance and AML team as the business grows. What We’re Looking For Significant experience in AML/CTF at a regulated EU financial institution. Ideally at an investment firm, neobroker, neobank or e-money institution. Experience with digital onboarding and remote identity verification at scale. Hands-on experience building risk assessments, monitoring scenarios and EDD processes. Experience filing suspicious activity reports and handling regulatory inspections. Knowledge of MiFID II conduct and investment-services compliance, or the ability to learn it fast. Experience selecting and overseeing KYC, screening and monitoring tools. Strong judgment and the confidence to challenge senior colleagues. Clear, concise writing for policies, board reports and regulators. A clean record and good reputation, suitable for regulatory approval as a key function holder. Based in Lithuania, or open to relocating to Lithuania. Nice to Have Lithuanian language ability. An existing working relationship with the Bank of Lithuania or the FNTT. Knowledge of Lithuanian AML law and Bank of Lithuania instructions. Experience with clients across several EEA countries. CAMS (ACAMS) or ICA certification. This Role Is Not For People who only want to attend meetings. Candidates who cannot follow up aggressively and professionally. People who copy policies from templates without fitting them to the business. People who say no without offering a compliant way forward. People who produce long updates without clear decisions or next actions. Location This role is based in Vilnius, Lithuania. This is a hybrid role. You are expected to work from our Vilnius office at least 3 days per week. You must be a European citizen or already hold a valid right to work in Lithuania. We are not able to offer visa sponsorship for this role. Language English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required. Interview Process Our process is designed to move fast: Online assessment or practical task Role-specific interview CEO / final round For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritised. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Business Development Manager
description: Do you want to contribute to Western resilience? Do you want to protect people and critical infrastructure – ultimately saving lives? Do you want to work at the frontier of high-performance autonomous systems? Join us at CDDS to bring high-speed kinetic interceptor drones into the hands of armed forces, law enforcement agencies, and critical infrastructure operators. CDDS specialises in developing low-collateral kinetic interceptors designed to neutralise malicious drones (Mavic drones, FPV racing drones, and fast fixed-wing drones). Our solutions are built for precision and safety, minimising risk to the surrounding area while effectively countering unauthorised or threatening unmanned aerial systems. We work at the cutting edge of counter-drone technology, delivering reliable protection for critical assets and environments. Your Mission We are looking for a Business Development Manager to help grow CDDS's business from Switzerland across selected European and global markets. Your main focus will be identifying prospective customers and partners, opening new conversations, qualifying leads, and turning early interest into well-defined opportunities. Working closely with our engineering, product, operations, and leadership teams, you will connect customer needs with CDDS's capabilities and help build a strong, sustainable commercial pipeline. What You'll Do Help grow CDDS's business in selected European and global markets by building a healthy pipeline of prospective customers and partners. Research and identify relevant organisations, programmes, decision-makers, and potential partners across defence, law enforcement, critical infrastructure, and the wider security ecosystem. Generate and qualify leads through targeted outreach, procurement monitoring, referrals, industry networks, events, and inbound enquiries. Conduct initial discovery conversations to understand customer needs, stakeholders, timelines, budgets, and next steps, and document clear qualification criteria. Build trusted relationships with prospective customers and partners, maintain regular follow-up, and create momentum from first contact to active opportunity. Keep CRM records, lead statuses, contact information, and follow-up actions accurate and current, providing clear visibility of the developing pipeline. Coordinate customer meetings, demonstrations, and events with engineering, product, and operations teams, prepare relevant commercial materials, and manage follow-up actions. Support responses to requests for information, proposals, and public tenders by coordinating inputs and ensuring opportunities continue to progress. Work with leadership to prioritise qualified opportunities and support them through trials, proposals, contract discussions, and handover to delivery teams. What You Bring 2+ years of experience in business development, sales, partnerships, market development, or a related customer-facing role, ideally in defence, security, public-sector technology, or another technical B2B environment. Demonstrated ability to identify prospects, conduct outreach, build relationships, and convert early conversations into qualified opportunities. Strong research and commercial curiosity, with the ability to understand an organisation, identify relevant stakeholders, and recognise where CDDS can create value. Confident communication and presentation skills, including the ability to explain technical capabilities in clear customer and operational terms. Professional proficiency in English. A structured approach to CRM, follow-up, prioritisation, and pipeline management, with attention to detail and reliable execution. A proactive, hands-on mindset and the ability to collaborate effectively with technical and operational colleagues in a fast-moving startup. Based in Switzerland with eligibility to work in Switzerland and availability to travel regularly for customer meetings, demonstrations, and events. Nice to have Previous experience with UAS, counter-UAS, autonomous systems, air defence, or related defence and security technologies. Experience working with armed forces, law enforcement agencies, critical infrastructure operators, government customers, or defence and security partners. Familiarity with European defence and public-sector ecosystems, procurement processes, or industry networks. Experience in a startup or scale-up environment, or in bringing an emerging technical product to new customers and markets. You'll extend how the engine models programs, from parsing source code and resolving symbols to building call graphs and tracking tainted data across files and languages. Measure detection quality against known vulnerabilities, judging changes primarily on false positive and false negative rates.</li> <li>Develop static application security testing (SAST) rules mapped to Common Weakness Enumeration (CWE) and the Open Worldwide Application Security Project (OWASP), along with test fixtures that demonstrate they work.</li> <li>Implement component specifications with engineers and AI agents through phased plans and small, reviewable changes. Keep specifications and code in sync.</li> <li>Improve the harness, agent instructions, and skills that keep agent-written code trustworthy. Use separate coding and reviewing agents, performance checks, application programming interface (API) checks, and dependency checks, and escalate risky changes to human review.</li> <li>Solve technical problems of moderate scope and complexity, and identify and address technical debt that slows the team down.</li> <li>Write maintainable code that meets our internal standards, and help maintain those standards through code review.</li> <li>Participate in on-call rotations to help troubleshoot product operations, security operations, and urgent engineering issues.</li> <li>Take part in on-call or operational support where your team’s ownership model requires it.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What you'll bring</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Experience using AI or large language model (LLM) tools to generate or evaluate technical content, with the judgment to assess when their output is trustworthy.</li> <li>Solid professional experience writing and testing production code in a systems language, particularly Rust or Go. Our engine is written in Rust, the analyzer wrapper in Go, and the monolith integration in Ruby. You'll be willing to work across them.</li> <li>An interest in static analysis and application security, including parsing, intermediate representations, taint and data-flow analysis, and how vulnerabilities arise in code. Deep expertise isn't required; we'll help you grow it.</li> <li>Organize and progress your work independently in a remote, largely asynchronous environment.</li> <li>The ability to communicate technical problems clearly and concisely and propose iterative solutions.</li> <li>Helpful but not required: experience with performance optimization, Docker and continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD), web or mobile frameworks, guardrails for agent-written code such as mutation testing and fuzzing, or program analysis and security research through publications or open source contributions. Willingness to learn performance optimization and containerized workflows is also welcome.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>About the team</strong></h2> <p>The Security Factory: Code Scanning team develops GitLab's SAST capabilities for customer software repositories. You'll work alongside experienced engineers who guide the larger design decisions, delivering well-scoped changes and growing into ownership of larger parts of the system.</p> <p>Today, that work is Ruby on Rails. Roughly 400 policy classes and a catalog of about 1,900 permissions sit behind every application programming interface (API) request. You'll work on fine-grained token permissions, custom roles, and the GraphQL and representational state transfer (REST) APIs that enforce them. A single request can trigger hundreds of permission checks, so correctness and performance both matter.</p> <p>You'll also contribute to moving the permission model to a new authorization stack that pairs the Rails monolith with a Rust policy engine. The engine represents access relationships and evaluates permission rules, and can run within the monolith's process or be reached through remote procedure calls using gRPC. You don't need prior Rust experience: several engineers on the team learned it for this work, and we'll support you doing the same.</p> <p>Some examples of our projects:</p> <ul> <li value="1">Refactoring GitLab's policy layer so the same permission definitions can be evaluated by the monolith and the new authorization service</li> <li value="2">Extending fine-grained token permissions to more resources, with guidance from senior engineers on the design</li> </ul> <h2>What you'll do</h2> <ul> <li value="1">Implement authorization changes in GitLab's Ruby on Rails monolith so permission checks allow intended access and deny unauthorized access.</li> <li value="2">Deliver well-scoped workstreams from feature-flagged rollout through verifying that the old and new systems produce the same results, with review and guidance from senior engineers.</li> <li value="3">Build and extend fine-grained permissions for tokens and roles so additional resources have permission coverage consistent with the established catalog.</li> <li value="4">Extend and fix authorization enforcement so GraphQL and the REST API enforce the intended permissions consistently.</li> <li value="5">Make incremental refactors to long-lived policy code without changing behavior for existing customers.</li> <li value="6">Investigate and fix reliability, performance, and security issues so affected permission checks return the expected results without regressions.</li> <li value="7">Work with the authentication, platform, and artificial intelligence (AI) teams to document interface contracts that keep permission checks consistent as authorization moves toward a shared service.</li> <li value="8">Contribute to design documents, merge requests, and code reviews so proposed changes have a documented rationale and review feedback is addressed asynchronously.</li> <li value="8">Take part in on-call or operational support where your team’s ownership model requires it.</li> </ul> <h2>What you'll bring</h2> <ul> <li value="1">Solid experience building and maintaining production Ruby on Rails applications, typically gained over 2 to 4 years or more.</li> <li value="2">Hands-on experience with authorization concepts, such as role-based access control or fine-grained permissions, from work or projects.</li> <li value="3">A security mindset: you treat a permission bug as a security bug and consider who a change could affect before choosing an implementation.</li> <li value="4">Experience making careful changes to existing codebases, including incremental refactors and feature-flagged rollouts that preserve existing behavior.</li> <li value="5">Familiarity with GraphQL or API authorization patterns.</li> <li value="6">Awareness of performance, including how repeated permission checks can add up on every request.</li> <li value="7">Strong written communication and the ability to work effectively when most decisions happen in a document or merge request rather than a meeting.</li> <li value="8">Helpful, but not required: hands-on PostgreSQL experience, or experience with Rust, gRPC or Protocol Buffers, Cedar or other policy languages, Zanzibar-style authorization systems, Go, or service-oriented architecture.</li> </ul> <p>We welcome transferable experience from adjacent domains such as identity, policy engines, and platform security.</p> <h2>About the team</h2> <p>We work in a fully asynchronous organization, with most decisions made in documents or merge requests rather than meetings.</p> <p>GitLab's mission is to enable everyone to contribute to and co-create the software that powers our world. Our values include collaboration, results, efficiency, diversity, inclusion and belonging, iteration, and transparency. We expect all GitLab team members to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><h4><strong>How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees</strong></h4> <ul> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/">Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/time-off-and-absence/time-off-types/#flexible-paid-time-off-pto">Flexible Paid Time Off </a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/company/culture/inclusion/tmrg-tmag/">Team Member Resource Groups</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/stock-options/">Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/learning-and-development/growth-and-development/">Growth and Development Fund</a></li> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/#parental-leave">Parental Leave</a> </li> </ul> <p>Please note that we welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; many successful candidates do not meet every single requirement. title: Staff Site Reliability Engineer - Monitoring and Anomaly Detection (Monetization)
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.</p> <p>The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OuZIb5zszQI">Co-create the future with us</a> as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.</p> <p>*<em>Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><h2>An overview of this role</h2> <p>The Observability, Monitoring, and Integrations team manages observability, monitoring, and detection for systems that support customer purchasing and use of GitLab. As a Staff Backend Engineer on the Fulfillment Workflow Monitoring (Catch All) team, you'll set the technical direction for the telemetry, detection, and reconciliation tooling that identifies billing, data, and event anomalies across CustomersDot, Salesforce, and Zuora before they can affect revenue or the customer experience.</p> <p>This is a greenfield team. You'll help build it from the ground up, shaping its operating rhythm, incident response model, and quality bar. You'll use telemetry and machine learning to identify issues early and help resolve them. Because Monetization changes can directly affect revenue and often involve confidential or financial information, you'll use strong judgment, careful rollout practices, and a high bar for reliability. This role is opening at the Staff Backend Engineer level (grade 8).</p> <h2>What you’ll do</h2> <ul> <li value="1">Design, build, and operate observability across the Monetization stack, including metrics, logs, and traces, using tools such as Prometheus and Grafana.</li> <li value="2">Implement automated detection for billing, data, and event anomalies, and route alerts to the responsible feature teams.</li> <li value="3">Develop reconciliation and data integrity checks across usage and billing pipelines.</li> <li value="4">Define and track service level objectives and service level indicators, write runbooks, and take part in incident response to measure and improve Monetization system reliability.</li> <li value="5">Explore artificial intelligence and machine learning techniques to predict system anomalies and accelerate resolution.</li> <li value="6">Review and offer feedback on merge requests from other Monetization engineers.</li> <li value="7">Collaborate with Product, Finance, Support, and other partners to turn operational needs into reliable tooling.</li> <li value="7">Take part in on-call or operational support where your team’s ownership model requires it.</li> </ul> <h2>What you’ll bring</h2> <ul> <li value="1">Professional experience with Ruby on Rails, including building and operating applications such as CustomersDot.</li> <li value="2">Experience in site reliability or observability engineering, including monitoring, alerting, service level objectives and indicators, runbooks, and incident response.</li> <li value="3">Experience setting technical direction for observability, reliability, or detection work and bringing other engineers along.</li> <li value="4">Experience building anomaly detection, monitoring, or risk management tooling.</li> <li value="5">Familiarity with observability tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, and OpenTelemetry.</li> <li value="6">Exposure to analytical data stores such as ClickHouse and the change data capture and event-streaming pipelines that feed them, including NATS JetStream.</li> <li value="7">Experience owning projects from concept through production, communicating clearly about complex technical and organizational problems, and proposing iterative solutions.</li> <li value="8">Working knowledge of Python for anomaly detection and data work, or experience with billing, financial, or other business-critical systems, including Zuora or Salesforce, is a plus.</li> </ul> <h2>About the team</h2> <p>The Observability, Monitoring, and Integrations team is part of GitLab's Monetization section, a highly cross-functional group that partners with Sales, Finance, IT, and Support to deliver secure and reliable purchasing, billing, provisioning, and utilization workflows. The Monetization section includes the Purchase, Subscription Lifecycle, Billing Engine, Platform and Infrastructure, Observability, Monitoring, and Integrations, and Compliance teams.</p> <p>This role is on the Fulfillment Workflow Monitoring (Catch All) team and reports to the Engineering Manager, Observability, Monitoring, and Integrations. We work asynchronously, plan and reflect regularly, and share responsibility for deployments, incident management, testing, and safe rollouts. We're increasingly focused on how artificial intelligence and machine learning can improve our Monetization infrastructure and provide predictive insights.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><h4><strong>How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees</strong></h4> <ul> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/">Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/time-off-and-absence/time-off-types/#flexible-paid-time-off-pto">Flexible Paid Time Off </a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/company/culture/inclusion/tmrg-tmag/">Team Member Resource Groups</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/stock-options/">Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/learning-and-development/growth-and-development/">Growth and Development Fund</a></li> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/#parental-leave">Parental Leave</a> </li> </ul> <p>Please note that we welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; many successful candidates do not meet every single requirement. Additionally, studies have shown that people from <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/company/culture/inclusion/#examples-of-select-underrepresented-groups">underrepresented groups</a> are less likely to apply to a job unless they meet every single qualification. If you're excited about this role, please apply and allow our recruiters to assess your application.</p> <hr> <p><strong>Country Hiring Guidelines: </strong>GitLab hires new team members in countries around the world. All of our roles are remote, however some roles may carry specific location-based eligibility requirements. Our Talent Acquisition team can help answer any questions about location after starting the recruiting process.  </p> <p><strong>Privacy Policy: </strong>Please review our <a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/hiring/candidate-faq/recruitment-privacy-policy/" target="_blank">Recruitment Privacy Policy.</a> Your privacy is important to us.</p> <p>GitLab is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. GitLab’s policies and practices relating to recruitment, employment, career development and advancement, promotion, and retirement are based solely on merit, regardless of race, color, religion, ancestry, sex (including pregnancy, lactation, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression), national origin, age, citizenship, marital status, mental or physical disability, genetic information (including family medical history), discharge status from the military, protected veteran status (which includes disabled veterans, recently separated veterans, active duty wartime or campaign badge veterans, and Armed Forces service medal veterans), or any other basis protected by law. GitLab will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics. See also <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/people-policies/inc-usa/#equal-employment-opportunity-policy" target="_blank">GitLab’s EEO Policy</a> and <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/labor-and-employment-notices/#eeoc-us-equal-employment-opportunity-commission-notices" target="_blank">EEO is the Law</a>. If you have a disability or special need that requires <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/people-policies/inc-usa/#reasonable-accommodation" target="_blank">accommodation</a>, please let us know during the <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/hiring/interviewing/#adjustments-to-our-interview-process" target="_blank">recruiting process</a>.</p></div>

description: <p><strong>Account Executive, Strategic Deals - Attribute™</strong></p> <p><strong>Location</strong><strong><br></strong>This is a <strong>fully remote</strong> opportunity based out of any of the following with travel as needed: UK, Ireland, Netherlands, Sweden, Estonia.</p> <p><strong>Who We Are</strong><br>Become part of the team behind <strong><a href="https://www.doit.com/blog/why-we-are-launching-attribute?_gl=1*j8dlue*_up*MQ..*_ga*MTUwMzU2OTc0NS4xNzgzNDEzMDIx*_ga_Y90QRD61TR*czE3ODM0MTMwMjAkbzEkZzEkdDE3ODM0MTMwMzMkajQ3JGwwJGg2MjkyMjk4OTAkZDN4YlFHcnJpZVVJUzJiV2JORC02QXZmOGtLLWJzczczelE" target="_blank">Attribute™</a></strong>. Following our recent acquisition, we're bringing together visionary engineers and go-to-market leaders to disrupt cloud management with real-time, tagless cost visibility across cloud and AI workloads. As an Account Executive focused on Strategic Deals, you'll join a founding GTM movement inside an established market leader trusted by over 4,500 global customers, unlocking high-impact opportunities through top-tier strategic partnerships.</p> <p>DoiT empowers cloud-native organizations to scale faster and innovate with confidence. By combining our Cloud Intelligence technology with Forward Deployed Engineers and deep specialization across AWS, Google Cloud, and Azure, we help tech-forward companies navigate their toughest infrastructure and cost governance challenges end to end.</p> <p><strong>The Opportunity</strong><br>As an Account Executive, Strategic Deals for <strong>Attribute™</strong>, you will be at the forefront of building a brand-new region from scratch and introducing a groundbreaking solution to a fundamental business problem in modern FinOps. You will work on Strategic Deals, leveraging strategic partnerships with AWS, OpenAI, Top Private Equity firms, and our global current install base. A strong focus will be placed on co-selling and unlocking strategic deal opportunities with AWS, ISVs, and channel partners. Traditional cloud cost allocation methods rely heavily on static tagging—an approach that becomes obsolete in modern, shared cloud and AI infrastructure. When multi-tenant clusters, shared GPUs, microservices, and dynamic AI workloads dominate, organizations face severe blind spots: they cannot accurately determine the true cost-to-serve for specific applications, autonomous agents, or business teams, making it impossible to calculate true gross margins at a granular customer level.</p> <p>Attribute™ solves this by taking a completely different approach. Leveraging runtime eBPF technology, Attribute™ captures real-time network traffic signals and kernel-level observability without requiring engineering teams to manually tag or instrument code. By analyzing actual runtime consumption across CPU, GPU, memory, network, and AI model API requests, it provides accurate total cost of ownership (TCO) and unit economics based on real usage. Organizations finally get precise cost governance and gross margin visibility across complex cloud and AI environments with zero developer overhead.</p> <p>As an Account Executive building this region from scratch, you will establish a high-potential greenfield territory. You will drive sales end-to-end with a heavy emphasis on net-new logo acquisition, defining the regional go-to-market strategy and creating the foundational customer success stories that define this category.</p> <p>You will own full-cycle deal execution across Startup, Digital Native, and Enterprise segments—prospecting new accounts, running compelling solution pitches, navigating complex technical evaluations alongside engineering partners, and closing strategic partnerships end to end.</p> <p>You'll have the rest of the Cloud Intelligence portfolio behind you: 4,500 customers, AWS/Google Cloud/Azure partnerships, and Forward Deployed Engineers who solve problems other vendors walk away from. But the product you'll carry every day is Attribute™, and the market is only just learning it exists. That's the opportunity.</p> <p>Expect to travel 10–15% of the time to meet customers, engage with hyperscale teams, and show up at industry events that matter.</p> <p><strong>Responsibilities</strong></p> <ul> <li>Own the full sales cycle from first conversation to closed deal, consistently hitting and exceeding quota and pipeline targets</li> <li>Build a high-volume pipeline and establish the region from scratch with a hunter mindset, driving outbound prospecting and net-new logo acquisition across EMEA</li> <li>Build the first wave of reference customers and case studies the rest of the GTM org will run on</li> <li>Develop and execute a regional strategy that identifies high-growth opportunities and untapped markets across EMEA</li> <li>Build deep, mutually valuable relationships with AWS Sales Leaders and Partner Managers to co-sell and expand market share</li> <li>Partner with Forward Deployed Engineers and Solutions Architects to solve the toughest technical challenges prospects face</li> <li>Maintain rigorous forecast accuracy in Salesforce and ensure every proposal reflects the quality of what we actually deliver</li> <li>Guide customers from initial curiosity through contract execution, setting them up for a world-class onboarding experience</li> <li>Feed real customer signal back to product and marketing every week — in a founding team, that loop is the job</li> <li>Generate your own pipeline through prospecting, networking, and creative outreach — not just working what's handed to you</li> </ul> <p><strong>Qualifications</strong></p> <ul> <li>Proven track record of full-cycle B2B SaaS sales experience with a strong emphasis on net-new logo acquisition and building a regional territory from scratch</li> <li>A track record of selling cloud services and understanding how consumption-based models work</li> <li>Hunting mentality: demonstrated drive to self-generate pipeline, prospect into target accounts, and close new business independently</li> <li>Experience selling to platform engineering / DevOps teams.</li> <li>Comfort selling something new — you've sold a product before there was a Gartner quadrant for it, and you preferred it that way</li> <li>Technical curiosity: you understand the cloud computing market and can hold your own in conversations about AWS, Google Cloud, or Azure products and architecture</li> <li>Genuine interest in FinOps and how engineering organisations actually consume the cloud — you don't need to be a practitioner, but you need to care</li> <li>Ability to build influential relationships across matrixed organisations and turn professional networks into real partnerships</li> <li>"Roll up your sleeves" attitude that pervades both sales and business development activities</li> <li>Prior experience at AWS, ISVs, or in strategic partnerships is a big plus</li> </ul> <p><strong>Are You a Doer?</strong><br>Be your truest self. Work on your terms. Make a difference.</p> <p>We are home to a global team of incredible talent who work remotely and have the flexibility to have a schedule that balances your work and home life. We embrace and support leveling up your skills professionally and personally.</p> <p>What does being a Do'er mean? We're all about being entrepreneurial, pursuing knowledge, and having fun!<a href="https://careers.doit.com/life-at-doit/"> Click here to learn more about our Life at DoiT</a>.</p> <p>Sounds too good to be true? Check out our<a href="https://www.glassdoor.com/Overview/Working-at-DoiT-International-EI_IE1972488.11,29.htm"> Glassdoor reviews</a>.</p> <p>We thought so too, but we're here and happy we hit that 'apply' button.</p> <p>Full-time employee benefits include:</p> <ul> <li>Unlimited PTO</li> <li>Flexible Working Options</li> <li>Health Insurance</li> <li>Parental Leave</li> <li>Employee Stock Option Plan</li> <li>Home Office Allowance</li> <li>Professional Development Stipend</li> <li>Peer Recognition Program</li> </ul> <p><strong>Many Doers, One Team</strong><strong><br></strong>DoiT unites as Many Do'ers, One Team, where diversity is more than a goal — it's our strength. We actively cultivate an inclusive, equitable workplace, recognizing that each unique perspective enhances our innovation. By celebrating differences, we create an environment where every individual feels valued, contributing to our collective success.</p> <p>#LI-Remote</p> Find more English Speaking Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

title: Senior DevOps Engineer
description: <p><strong>SENIOR DEVOPS ENGINEER</strong></p> <p>Catapult is building the future of sports performance technology, with a mission to <strong>Unleash the Potential</strong> of every athlete and team on earth. We don't just work in the sporting industry; we are actively changing it.  Since 2006, our solutions have been leading the way in sports performance software, science, and data, in a world where 1% can literally mean the difference between winning and losing.</p> <p>We work with over 5,000+ teams around the world, empowering coaches, managers and trainers in premier teams in the NFL, NBA, NHL, MLS, EPL, AFL, NRL, NCAA and more. We provide the information they need to optimize athletes’ health, game-day readiness, and performance, as well as in-game tactics.  </p> <p>Catapult is a sports technology company that empowers professional teams to make data-driven decisions. We deliver health, performance, video, and AI insights from the locker room to competitive environments, ensuring every decision is an opportunity to gain an advantage, sharpen performance, and build lasting success. </p> <h3><strong>WE WANT PEOPLE WHO ARE PASSIONATE ABOUT SOLVING HARD PROBLEMS</strong></h3> <p>We are looking for a <strong>Senior DevOps Engineer</strong> to help build, operate and improve the infrastructure, platforms and tools that enable our teams to develop, deliver and run reliable software at scale.</p> <p>Based in Cologne, you will join a team with broad ownership of our technical environment. We take a cloud-agnostic approach, combining cloud services and self-hosted infrastructure to meet the needs of our products and engineering teams. Our responsibilities span the full lifecycle, from provisioning and deployment to observability, security and ongoing operation.</p> <p>You will combine infrastructure expertise with automation and software engineering to improve how our software is built, deployed and operated. This includes streamlining development workflows, integrating and maintaining shared tools, and supporting demanding workloads across data processing, media and machine learning. Working closely with engineering teams and colleagues across the business, you will build practical solutions that support our expanding product portfolio.</p> <p>This role is ideal for someone who enjoys solving a wide range of technical problems, takes ownership from initial idea through to production, and thrives in a fast-growing environment where priorities and requirements evolve quickly. You will help shape how our infrastructure, platforms and tools adapt as the business grows.</p> <h3><strong>WHAT YOU’LL DO </strong></h3> <ul> <li><em>Design, operate, and continuously improve our Kubernetes platform across both self-hosted clusters and AWS</em></li> <li><em>Own our infrastructure as code using Terraform and Ansible, driving a GitOps workflow to ensure all changes are versioned, reviewed, and reproducible</em></li> <li><em>Build and maintain robust CI/CD pipelines (GitLab CI) and shared templates that empower product teams to build, test, and deploy reliably</em></li> <li><em>Operate and scale specialized infrastructure for demanding workloads, including GPU clusters for computer vision models, media engines, and data analytics platforms </em></li> <li><em>Evolve our observability stack to proactively monitor system health, define meaningful alerting, and ensure high availability</em></li> <li><em>Drive platform security and compliance through continuous vulnerability scanning, automated image screening, robust secrets management, and strict access controls</em></li> <li><em>Collaborate closely with software engineers, data scientists, and product teams to design scalable architectures and act as a strategic technical partner for new infrastructure initiatives </em></li> </ul> <p><em>Help define technical direction, engineering best practices, and quality standards within the infrastructure domain </em></p> <h3><strong>WHAT YOU’LL NEED</strong></h3> <ul> <li><em>5+ years of professional experience in DevOps, Site Reliability Engineering, or Platform Engineering, with a proven track record of designing and scaling highly available production environments </em></li> <li><em>Strong hands-on experience running Kubernetes in production, including upgrades, networking and troubleshooting</em></li> <li><em>Solid understanding of cloud infrastructure (AWS) combined with experience operating bare-metal or self-hosted environments</em></li> </ul> <p><em>Proven experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, Ansible) and modern container build or GitOps workflows</em><em>Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to evaluate technical trade-offs between reliability, scalability, and maintainability</em><em>Experience collaborating across engineering and product teams to deliver secure and robust infrastructure solutions</em><em>Deep understanding of Linux operating systems and strong programming or scripting skills (e.g., Python, Go, or Bash) focused on automation and tooling. </em></p> <p><em>Nice to have – and what would make you exceptional:</em></p> <ul> <li>Experience operating GPU workloads on Kubernetes or Machine Learning infrastructure</li> <li>Familiarity with specialized Kubernetes ecosystem tools such as FluxCD, Rancher, or RKE2.</li> <li>Experience working with large-scale video/streaming workflows or AWS media services</li> <li>Experience managing and scaling messaging or event-streaming systems (e.g., Kafka) </li> <li>Experience operating and optimizing relational databases (e.g., PostgreSQL) </li> <li>Experience building internal developer platforms or self-service tooling for engineering teams</li> </ul> <h3><strong>WHAT YOUR SUCCESS WILL LOOK LIKE</strong></h3> <ul> <li>In 6 months time… You know our clusters and pipelines, handle title: Software Engineering Internship Program (Summer 2027)
description: <div class="content-intro"><h2 style="font-family: GothamBold,Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif; color: #662d91;">Teamwork makes the stream work.</h2> <p> </p> <h3 style="font-family: GothamBold,Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif;"><strong>Roku is changing how the world watches TV</strong></h3> <p>Roku is the #1 TV streaming platform in the U.S., Canada, and Mexico, and we've set our sights on powering every television in the world. Roku pioneered streaming to the TV. Our mission is to be the TV streaming platform that connects the entire TV ecosystem. We connect consumers to the content they love, enable content publishers to build and monetize large audiences, and provide advertisers unique capabilities to engage consumers.</p> <p>From your first day at Roku, you'll make a valuable - and valued - contribution. We're a fast-growing public company where no one is a bystander. We offer you the opportunity to delight millions of TV streamers around the world while gaining meaningful experience across a variety of disciplines.</p> <p> </p></div><p><strong><span data-contrast="auto">About the role</span></strong><span data-ccp-props="{}"> </span></p> <p><span data-contrast="auto">Join Roku as an Engineering Intern, where your passion for technology and creativity will drive our success. We offer a paid 12-week internship, running from June to early September 2027.</span><span data-ccp-props="{}"> </span></p> <p><span data-contrast="auto">As an Engineering Intern, you’ll be assigned a scoped project with one of our engineering teams, working on real Roku products and platforms. We’ll match you to the team that best fits your skills and interests, so you may work on anything from user interfaces and embedded or platform software to automation, developer tooling and AI-powered workflows. </span><span data-ccp-props="{}"> </span></p> <p><span data-contrast="auto">Our teams work across a variety of languages and technologies and embrace GenAI-assisted development to boost productivity and quality.</span><span data-ccp-props="{}"> </span></p> <p><span data-ccp-props="{}"> </span></p> <p><strong><span data-contrast="auto">What you’ll be doing</span></strong><span data-ccp-props="{}"> </span></p> <ul> <li><span data-contrast="auto">Own a well-defined project that contributes to the success of your team.</span><span data-ccp-props="{}"> </span></li> <li><span data-contrast="auto">Write clean, well-tested, maintainable code using modern languages, tools and engineering practices.</span><span data-ccp-props="{}"> </span></li> <li><span data-contrast="auto">Debug, test and profile your work, and document it so others can build on it.</span><span data-ccp-props="{}"> </span></li> <li><span data-contrast="auto">Collaborate with engineers and mentors, take part in code reviews, and share your progress and learnings.</span><span data-ccp-props="{}"> </span></li> </ul> <p><span data-ccp-props="{}"> </span></p> <p><strong><span data-contrast="auto">Apply if</span></strong><span data-ccp-props="{}"> </span></p> <ul> <li><span data-contrast="auto">You are a penultimate-year student, or a final-year student planning to go on to a one-year master’s course.</span><span data-ccp-props="{}"> </span></li> <li><span data-contrast="auto">You hold a permanent right to work in the UK. Unfortunately, we are unable to consider candidates on a student visa.</span><span data-ccp-props="{}"> </span></li> <li><span data-contrast="auto">You are available for full-time work for the whole 12-week program, from June to early September in Cambridge.</span></li> <li><span data-contrast="auto">You are keen to work with AI technologies and have previous experience building AI agents and automated workflows.</span><span data-ccp-props="{}"> </span></li> </ul> <p><span data-ccp-props="{}"> </span></p> <p><strong><span data-contrast="auto">We’re excited if you have</span></strong><span data-ccp-props="{}"> </span></p> <ul> <li><span data-contrast="auto">Currently enrolled in a degree program in Computer Science, Engineering or a related field.</span><span data-ccp-props="{}"> </span></li> <li><span data-contrast="auto">Proficiency in one or more of C, C++, Python, JavaScript, TypeScript or similar languages, ideally with projects, open source or hackathon work beyond your coursework.</span><span data-ccp-props="{}"> </span></li> <li><span data-contrast="auto">A solid grounding in computer science fundamentals such as data structures, algorithms, and operating systems or networking concepts.</span><span data-ccp-props="{}"> </span></li> <li><span data-contrast="auto">Hands-on experience using GenAI tools in your coursework, projects or personal work.</span><span data-ccp-props="{}"> </span></li> <li><span data-contrast="auto">Strong problem-solving and technical communication abilities.</span><span data-ccp-props="{}"> </span></li> <li><span data-contrast="auto">Proactive mindset with passion for continuous learning and fast iteration.</span></li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong><span data-contrast="auto">How will I use AI at Roku?</span></strong><span data-ccp-props="{}"> </span></p> <p><span data-contrast="auto">At Roku, we don’t just use AI, we work with it. AI agents and smart tools help power drafts, analysis, and repetitive workflows, while our people bring direction, judgment, and accountability. We’re looking for curious, adaptable builders who can show how they’ve used AI or automation to move faster, raise the bar, and scale their impact.</span><span data-ccp-props="{}"> </span></p> <p><span data-contrast="auto">We value your AI skills if you have built fluency across the agentic engineering toolchain — coding harnesses like Claude Code or Cursor, MCP servers, custom skills, or agent frameworks. You know how to drive an agent, verify its output, and ramp on an unfamiliar codebase with an agent helping you.</span><span data-ccp-props="{}"> </span></p><div class="content-conclusion"><h3><strong><span style="font-family: GothamBold, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif;">What's Roku's approach to hybrid working?</span></strong></h3> <p>Roku fosters an inclusive and collaborative environment where teams generally work in the office Monday through Thursday. Fridays are generally flexible for remote work, except for employees whose specific roles or assigned office location require five days' a week attendance.</p> <p> </p> <h3 style="font-family: GothamBold,Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif;"><strong>What are some of the benefits?</strong></h3> <p>Roku is committed to offering a diverse range of benefits as part of our compensation package to support our employees and their families. Our comprehensive benefits include global access to mental health and financial wellness support and resources. Local benefits include statutory and voluntary benefits which may include healthcare (medical, dental, and vision), life, accident, disability, commuter, and retirement options (401(k)/pension). Employees are supported in taking time off, in accordance with local leave policies and other personal needs to support their evolving work and life needs. It's important to note that not every benefit is available in all locations or for every role. For details specific to your location, please consult with your recruiter.</p> <p> </p> <h3 style="font-family: GothamBold,Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif;"><strong>Accommodations</strong></h3> <p>Roku welcomes applicants of all backgrounds and provides reasonable accommodations and adjustments in accordance with applicable law. If you require reasonable accommodation at any point in the hiring process, please direct your inquiries to <a ---------- <p> </p> <h3 style="font-family: GothamBold,Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif;"><strong>What should I know about Roku's culture?</strong></h3> <p>Roku is a great place for people who want to work in a fast-paced environment where everyone is focused on the company's success rather than their own. We try to surround ourselves with people who are great at their jobs, who are easy to work with, and who keep their egos in check. We appreciate a sense of humor. We believe a fewer number of very talented folks can do more for less cost than a larger number of less talented teams. We're independent thinkers with big ideas who act boldly, move fast and accomplish extraordinary things through collaboration and trust. In short, at Roku you'll be part of a company that's changing how the world watches TV. </p> <p>We have a unique culture that we are proud of. description: StackFuel/Multiverse Germany verbindet Arbeit und Lernen, um einen chancengerechten Zugang zu wirtschaftlichen Perspektiven zu schaffen. Wir schließen kritische Kompetenzlücken in den Bereichen Daten und KI, mit praxisnahen, begleiteten und messbaren Upskilling- und Reskilling-Programmen. Client Operations ist der Ort, an dem unsere Programme auf die Praxis treffen: Fördergeber, Arbeitgeber, Partner und Lernende sind darauf angewiesen, dass dieses Team einen hervorragenden Job macht – von der Anmeldung und Förderverwaltung bis hin zur täglichen Kundenkommunikation und Problemlösung. Die Qualität, Geschwindigkeit und Konsistenz dieser Arbeit wirkt sich unmittelbar auf die Lernendenbindung, die Kundenzufriedenheit und unsere regulatorische Stellung aus. Diese Rolle gibt es, um dieses Team exzellent zu machen. Du stellst sicher, dass jedes Mitglied von Client Operations bereit, auf dem neuesten Stand und selbstsicher ist; von der ersten Woche an und bei jeder Prozess-, Tool- und Regulierungsänderung, die danach folgt. Du setzt KI-Tools täglich in deiner eigenen Arbeit ein und unterstützt das Team dabei, sie zu nutzen, um klüger statt nur härter zu arbeiten. Du arbeitest bereichsübergreifend mit Menschen auf allen Ebenen zusammen – Client Operations, Delivery, Learning, Quality und der Geschäftsleitung – und lernst, wie ein Bildungsanbieter von Anfang bis Ende funktioniert. Und du hast ein Mitspracherecht dabei, wie wir uns weiter verbessern. Deine Aufgaben: Du verantwortest das Onboarding und Reboarding für Client Operations: Du setzt den Standard, entwickelst die Inhalte und führst die Sessions durch. Du integrierst regulatorische und prozessuale Änderungen (AZAV, Agentur für Arbeit, Förderrichtlinien) in die Enablement-Arbeit, sodass das Team bereits vor dem Inkrafttreten von Änderungen auf dem aktuellen Stand ist. Du definierst den Standard für Kundenkommunikation, Fallbearbeitung und Dokumentation – schriftlich festgehalten, geschult und messbar. Du erstellst Playbooks und Schulungsinhalte, die Teamleitungen gemeinsam mit ihren Teams verankern. Du machst aus Qualitätsdaten gezieltes Enablement: Du erkennst Muster bei Fehlern, Eskalationen und Audit-Feststellungen und übersetzt sie in Schulungen, die diese nachweislich reduzieren. Du treibst die Einführung von Tools und KI voran: Du findest heraus, wo KI manuelle Arbeit abnehmen kann, pilotierst sie und schulst das Team. Du baust Multiplikatoren auf: Du gibst Aufgaben an Champions und Buddys im Team weiter und unterstützt sie dabei, diese erfolgreich zu übernehmen. Das bringst du mit: Umfangreiche Erfahrung in den Bereichen Operations, Kundenservice oder Programmadministration, idealerweise im öffentlich geförderten Bildungsbereich oder in einem anderen regulierten Umfeld. Erfahrung in der Konzeption und Durchführung von Onboardings oder Trainings für operative Teams – und darin, zu überprüfen, ob sie wirksam waren. Ausgeprägtes Prozessdenken und Sicherheit im Umgang mit Qualitätsdaten: Du erkennst Muster und leitest daraus einen Plan ab. Souveränität darin, ehrliches Feedback zu geben und Ergebnisse durch Menschen zu erzielen, denen gegenüber du keine Führungsverantwortung hast. Praktische Neugier auf KI-Tools. Das bieten wir Dir Arbeitskultur Dich erwartet eine lösungsorientierte und datengetriebene Arbeitsweise, eine offene Feedbackkultur sowie ein starker Teamspirit. Zwei vom gesamten StackFuel-Team gewählte Trustees unterstützen Dich bei Fragen und Anliegen als neutrale, vertrauliche Anlaufstelle. Ownership Übernehme ab dem ersten Tag Verantwortung, bringe Deine eigenen Ideen aktiv ein, gestalte Prozesse nachhaltig und präge unsere Abläufe maßgeblich mit. Raum für Austausch Regelmäßiger Austausch im Team, saisonale Feiern und eine immer gut gefüllte Küche sorgen für ein lebendiges Miteinander. This isn't a research project waiting for its first customer. We already have a product, customers are ready to use it, and we are launching now. Your work will directly shape the electronics, actuators, and embedded systems that make that possible. You will join at the moment when the hard engineering questions become real product decisions: how do we make a highly capable robotic hand reliable, manufacturable, serviceable, and simple enough to deploy on a real shop floor? The Role TACTILIA is entering a new chapter as an independent company, following its spin-off from SCHUNK. As Chief of Staff, you will work closely with the leadership team as a key operational and strategic partner, helping shape and drive the company’s next phase of growth. This is a high-ownership role, you will operate across strategy, technology, product, business and operations, taking on the TACTILIA’s most important and ambiguous problems and driving them from idea to outcome. You will help build the operating infrastructure that allows TACTILIA to scale without losing its speed, ambition or quality. What you will do: Act as a trusted thought partner to the leadership and help drive the company’s highest-priority initiatives. Own the leadership´s operating rhythm, including strategic planning, leadership meetings, company priorities. Take ownership of complex cross-functional problems where no obvious owner exists from defining the problem through to execution. Build the processes, tools and systems that help TACTILIA operate more effectively as the team grows. Drive strategic and operational initiatives across technology, product, commercial, hiring and organisational development. Build and maintain a clear view of company performance, translating data into insights, priorities and actions. Partner with the leadership on headcount planning, resource allocation, partnerships, fundraising and other critical company decisions. Identify bottlenecks and opportunities before they become problems, and design pragmatic solutions. What you bring: Several years of experience in a highly demanding and fast-paced environment, such as a startup, scale-up, consulting, investment, strategy, operations, or another relevant leadership environment. Tool stack fluency/requirements Project management, collaboration and productivity tools? Advanced proficiency in Excel/Google Sheets and strong presentation skills in PowerPoint/Google Slides. Excellent project and stakeholder management skills. Exceptional communication skills and the ability to communicate clearly with senior leaders and diverse teams. Strong judgment and the ability to handle sensitive and confidential information. A high level of ownership, initiative, and personal accountability. Comfortable working in an ambiguous and rapidly changing environment. The ability to move seamlessly between high-level strategic thinking and hands-on execution. Bonus: Exposure to a corporate spin-off or carve-out process — understanding how a new entity separates from and continues to work with a parent company Experience working in or with a startup or scale-up in robotics, deep-tech, or another hardware-intensive industry As Chief of Staff, you will work closely with the leadership team, gain broad exposure across the organization, and have the opportunity to make a tangible impact on the company's strategy, execution, and development. You will join an ambitious team working on meaningful challenges and will have significant ownership from day one. The next chapter of robotics won't be built in a lab. It will be built by people who care about what happens when technology meets the real world. At TACTILIA, you'll work on one of the hardest open problems in robotics: giving machines the dexterity, reliability and robustness to interact with the physical world at industrial scale. The technology is taking shape, the team is being built, and the standards around robotic hands and their skills are still open. That means your decisions will have a lasting impact — not just on a product, but on what comes next for Physical AI. Build the hand. Define the standard. Shape what comes next. If you're excited by the challenge of building robotic hands that works reliably in the real world, we'd love to hear from you. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Business Development / BDR (m/w/d)
description: Unterstütze uns im Business Development als BDR (m/w/d) bei Carwow UNSERE MISSION Carwow ist Europas führende Plattform für den Autowechsel – wir verändern, wie Menschen Autos kaufen, verkaufen, inserieren und leasen. Mit Technologie, Medien und Automotive-Expertise haben wir uns von einer reinen Bewertungsplattform zu einem der größten Online-Marktplätze entwickelt. 2024 wurden über unsere Plattform fast 3 Mrd. £ an Autokäufen und 1,8 Mrd. £ an Fahrzeugverkäufen abgewickelt. Durch die Übernahme von Autovia (AutoExpress und Evo) haben wir unsere Reichweite verdoppelt: 10 Mio. YouTube-Abonnenten, 1,2 Mio. Magazinverkäufe und mehr als 350 Mio. jährliche Online-Leser. Und wir stehen gerade erst am Anfang. DEINE MISSION Du treibst das Wachstum von Carwow voran , indem du unabhängige Händler und Händlergruppen gewinnst und erfolgreich an Board holst. Mit beratungsorientiertem Verkauf , gezielten Demos und viel Telefonpower sorgst du für Carwow Begeisterung. Dabei arbeitest du eng mit dem Account-Management zusammen, um langfristige Partnerschaften aufzubauen. DEINE AUFGABEN Gewinnung neuer Händler und Aktivierung auf der Sell-my-Car-Plattform (Gebote & Käufe). Neukundengewinnung durch Kaltakquise und Bearbeitung von Inbound-Leads – primär telefonisch, bei Bedarf auch durch Vor-Ort-Termine. Identifikation und Entwicklung von Cross- und Upselling-Potenzialen (z. B. Transport, Wallet, Finanzierungen und weitere Services). Aufbau nachhaltiger Geschäftsbeziehungen zu Händlern aller Größenordnungen. Enge Zusammenarbeit mit dem Account-Management für eine reibungslose Übergabe und Reaktivierung inaktiver Händler. Durchführung überzeugender Pitches – vom Geschäftsführer bis zum Einzelunternehmer. Pflege und Dokumentation aller Aktivitäten im CRM (z. B. Salesforce). DEIN PROFIL Hinweis: Niemand erfüllt alle Anforderungen zu 100 %. Wenn du dich stark mit der Rolle identifizierst, freuen wir uns trotzdem auf deine Bewerbung. Erfahrung im Automotive Retail / Autohandel oder vergleichbaren Business-Development-Rollen. Hunter-Mentalität: Freude am Prospecting, an Akquise und am Aufbau neuer Partnerschaften. Kommunikations- und Verhandlungssicherheit, gepaart mit nachweislicher Sales-Erfahrung. Analytisches Denken: Fähigkeit, Daten zu nutzen, um Chancen und Risiken zu erkennen. Sicheres Auftreten in Präsentationen – mit Anpassungsfähigkeit an unterschiedliche Zielgruppen. Erfahrung mit CRM-Systemen (z. B. Salesforce). Hands-on-Mentalität, hohe Eigenmotivation und Belastbarkeit in einem dynamischen Scale-up. UNSER BEWERBUNGSPROZESS In der Regel kannst du etwa mit zwei bis drei Wochen für den Bewerbungsprozess rechnen. title: Senior Android Developer (f/m/d)
description: adjoe builds the technologies behind mobile apps growth and monetization. adjoe Ads is our programmatic in-app advertising platform that seamlessly connects advertisers and publishers through direct integration of our Android and iOS SDKs. Every ad decision happens in under 200ms across 10 million daily users, powered by real-time bidding algorithms and user quality prediction models that match the right ad to the right user at the right moment. Where 50 Billion Daily Predictions Begin The User Experience team is the origin point of adjoe Ads. Everything the system knows about a user, every prediction the ML models make, every bid placed in an auction. It all starts with code this team ships. The team owns two responsibilities. On the SDK side, a native Kotlin and Swift code runs inside hundreds of publisher apps. It participates in 120 million daily auctions , renders ad creatives across multiple formats, and captures the behavioral signals that power 50 billion predictions per day . The constraint that defines this work: you're executing inside someone else's app, on someone else's device, with zero tolerance for instability. Every ad impression has to feel native and fast to the user. On the analytics side, the dashboards, investigation tools, and data frameworks that turn raw data into decisions: real-time revenue performance across active campaigns, infrastructure cost visibility, and data quality assessments. If a number matters to the business or to engineering, this team makes it accessible. Your Mission & Who We Are Looking For: Kotlin & Android Internals Expertise: You will own the core development and optimization of the adjoe Ads SDK, which runs inside hundreds of publisher apps. We are looking for someone with 8+ years of Android experience (or 3+ years specifically in SDK/library development) who works primarily with Kotlin and has a deep understanding of Android lifecycles, ProGuard/R8, and multithreading to ensure zero tolerance for instability on millions of devices. High-Performance Network Design: You will collaborate with backend teams to design APIs and capture behavioral signals that power 50 billion daily ML predictions. You need a strong track record in API design, maintaining strict backward compatibility for thousands of external integrators, and working with high-performance networking protocols like gRPC, Protobuf, Wire, and OkHTTP. Resource-Constrained Optimization: You will ensure every ad impression feels native and fast while participating in 120 million daily auctions. You must know how to design for minimal footprint, optimizing battery impact and memory usage, as your code executes directly inside someone else’s app and device. Data-Driven Observability: You will monitor, debug, and maintain SDK reliability at scale across millions of global users. You will leverage observability and data tools—including Sentry, Kibana, and AWS (S3, QuickSight, Athena)—to track errors, investigate SDK behavior, and turn raw data into clear engineering decisions. Build Automation & Delivery: You will maintain and improve our CI/CD pipelines to guarantee efficient, reliable SDK delivery. This requires hands-on experience with Gradle and GitLab CI to automate the testing, building, and packaging of our mobile libraries. Plus – AdTech & Low-Level Systems: It is a major plus if you bring experience in ad-tech or programmatic advertising (aligning products with IAB specifications). Additionally, experience with NDK/JNI (C/C++ interop on Android) or parallel iOS development experience is highly valued to help support our cross-platform ecosystem. 🌎 We welcome applications from talent worldwide and provide relocation support to Hamburg, Germany for those ready to join our team. What’s in It for You? At adjoe, you’re not here to just close JIRA tickets, you’re helping build the infrastructure behind one of the most impactful platforms in adtech. The systems you work on will reach hundreds of millions of users and power billions of decisions every day. Go Big. Own projects with impact on 770M users and push adtech boundaries. Move Fast. Grow with a diverse, global team of people from over 40 different countries that learn from each other. Have Fun. Celebrate wins, enjoy daily victories, and bring your energy. We welcome applications from people who will contribute to the diversity of our company. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

We are looking for an experienced people manager who mentors team members in product thinking, delivery accountability, and commercial ownership. Hands-On AI Prototyping: You will accelerate product discovery and requirements definition by building functional proof-of-concepts yourself rather than waiting on dev cycles. You must be fluent enough with modern AI tooling to independently build and demonstrate a working prototype of a feature. The partnerships you close, the strategies you execute, and the markets you develop will directly shape how adjoe scales globally. Go Big. title: Responsable enquêtes & plaidoyer
description: Green-Got est une institution financière française qui permet à chacun de choisir ce que son argent finance. Nous avons été distingués pour notre exclusion des énergies fossiles par Reclaim Finance, bank.green, Bank for Good ou encore Moralscore. Green-Got est aussi lauréat de l'Impact 40 depuis 3 années consécutives. Depuis cinq ans, nous montrons où va l'argent. Nos membres ont sorti 300 millions d'euros des grandes banques. Notre mission est de définir de nouveaux standards pour le secteur financier, alignés avec la science, et non pas les intérêts des industries fossiles. Pourquoi ce recrutement ? Les banques traditionnelles ont des lobbyistes. Ils défendent leurs profits et les industries qu'elles financent. Les citoyens, eux, n'en ont jamais eu. C'est désormais le cas. Pendant plusieurs mois, nous avons enquêté sur le financement des pesticides par les banques françaises. Mais dénoncer ne suffit pas : la prochaine étape, c'est la loi. Nous recrutons la personne qui enquêtera à nos côtés, dévoilera ce que le système préfère laisser dans l'ombre et proposera des solutions concrètes pour changer les règles. Elle racontera chaque étape du combat à nos membres, en toute transparence. Missions Ton travail tient en trois verbes : enquêter, dévoiler, proposer. Tu portes 2 à 3 grandes campagnes par an, de la première piste jusqu'au texte de loi, et tu les incarnes. 1. Enquêter Faire la veille de l'actualité politique, réglementaire et scientifique (Parlement européen, Assemblée nationale, comitologie, ONG), et nourrir l'équipe Média pour nos contenus réactifs. Repérer les sujets de nos grandes campagnes de mobilisation et les valider avec nous : fludioxonyl, TotalEnergies financé par les Livrets A . 2. Dévoiler Mener les recherches sur les campagnes validées. Ce n'est pas de la réaction à chaud : ce sont 2 à 3 combats de fond par an. Creuser les rapports, les bilans et les sources primaires que personne ne lit, et en sortir des informations inédites . Trouver les angles : quelles personnes interroger (un agriculteur, une famille touchée), comment les contacter, quels contenus en tirer avec l'équipe Média. Incarner l'enquête pendant qu'elle se fait, face caméra et sur le terrain : Prendre la parole face caméra (vidéos, lives, interventions médias) et partager régulièrement où en est le combat. Répondre aux commentaires sur tes sujets et publier dans l' onglet Communauté de l'app. Tu vois comment nos membres réagissent, et cela nourrit tes prochaines enquêtes. 3. Proposer : plaidoyer et lobbying institutionnel Construire la feuille de route plaidoyer à partir de nos enquêtes : quelles demandes, auprès de quelles institutions, avec quel calendrier. Évaluer la faisabilité juridique et politique des leviers possibles : interdire certaines substances, encadrer ou interdire les financements aux producteurs de pesticides, exiger la transparence sur la présence d'entreprises fossiles ou de pesticides dans les produits d'épargne. Repérer les fenêtres déjà ouvertes : renouvellements d'autorisation de substances, textes européens en discussion (Omnibus, décisions du SCoPAFF), propositions de loi, projets de loi de finances. Rédiger les notes de position, propositions d'amendements et argumentaires , toujours adossés à la science et à des données indépendantes. Cartographier et rencontrer les décideurs : Parlement européen , Commission européenne , Représentation permanente de la France , Assemblée nationale , Sénat , ministères, agences et régulateurs. Analyser leurs prises de position et leurs votes passés. Rester strictement apartisan : nos demandes s'appuient sur la science, pas sur un camp. Construire des coalitions avec les ONG, scientifiques, juristes et journalistes, et représenter Green-Got dans les coalitions françaises et européennes de la finance durable (Sustainable Banking Coalition/FEBEA, Impact France, Fair Finance). Une victoire collective reste collective : tes contacts doivent être dans toutes les ONG. Devenir à terme un visage récurrent : « votre lobbyiste à Bruxelles ». Compétences recherchées Indispensable Une expérience solide en plaidoyer, affaires publiques ou journalisme d'enquête : ONG, think tank, collaboration parlementaire, cabinet ministériel ou rédaction. Un flair d'enquêteur. Tu sais où chercher l'information que personne n'a sortie (bilans, comitologie, listes de vote, thèses), et tu la vérifies avant de l'affirmer. Une maîtrise en profondeur les deux arènes. Tu connais de l'intérieur le fonctionnement des institutions européennes (commissions, trilogues, comitologie) et du Parlement français (navette, amendements, PLF), et tu as déjà travaillé avec l'autre. Un réseau actif de parlementaires, collaborateurs, conseillers et ONG sur ces sujets. Une plume à deux registres : une note de position qui tient face à un juriste, un post LinkedIn qui tient face à un scroll. De l'aisance face caméra et avec les journalistes. Tu acceptes d'incarner un combat, dans le respect strict des faits. Un fibre en contenus : tu sais quels angles vont attirer l’attention, comment raconter des sujets compliqués… Un vrai plus Une culture scientifique et réglementaire sur la finance durable et la santé environnementale : taxonomie, SFDR, évaluation des risques, cadre européen d'autorisation des substances. Une expérience dans une ONG de finance climat, ou une connaissance de la régulation financière (règles prudentielles). Une expérience d'animation de coalitions. Profil recherché Green-Got est un employeur inclusif. Tous les profils qui se reconnaissent dans cette annonce sont les bienvenus, quels que soient leur parcours, leur genre ou leur origine. Tu vas chercher toi-même. Tu ne reprends pas les enquêtes des autres : tu remontes aux sources. Tu arrives avec un dossier. Pas seulement une dénonciation : ce qu'il faudrait changer, comment, et avec qui. Tu es crédible partout. Dans le bureau d'un conseiller ministériel comme dans une story Instagram. Tu tiens la distance. Le plaidoyer est lent et échoue souvent. Un échec bien raconté ne te fait pas peur : il prépare la suite. Tu es rigoureux (mais genre, vraiment). Une seule affirmation fragile ruinerait la crédibilité de toutes les autres. Chaque chiffre est sourcé, chaque victoire attribuée à sa juste part. Tu es owner. Tes réussites comme tes échecs t'appartiennent. Tu avances même quand c'est flou. Tu veux un impact réel. Changer les règles, pas seulement en parler. Le package Lieu : Paris, avec des déplacements réguliers. Contrat : CDI, statut cadre Arrivée : ASAP BSPCEs (equity) RTTs Mutuelle santé Alan Déplacements à Bruxelles pris en charge Une journée d'équipe tous les semestres Nous avons hâte de te rencontrer. title: Principal, Customer Strategy & Storytelling
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><h2>Available Locations</h2> <ul> <li>Austin, US</li> <li>New York, US</li> <li>San Francisco, US</li> </ul> <h2>About the Role</h2> <p>The Developer Platform is the fastest growing set of products in Cloudflare. As an early member of this team, you will have the autonomy to experiment, to learn what resonates, and to establish scalable operating rhythms and success metrics. You’ve shipped your first customer story.</p> <p>First 6 months:<br>Translate and distribute your first stories across internal and external channels. You’ve shipped a way for customer stories to be easier to find for our field teams, and they hit their goals faster because of it. </p> <p>First year:<br>Build a scalable customer engagement and storytelling capability that is measurably supporting Dev GTM’s growth.
