You don’t need to tick every single box to be right for this role. If you are excited about building a better Internet and ready to make an impact, please apply.</span></em></p> <ul> <li><strong>Customer Experience</strong>: 8-10 Years Experience in Customer Success, Customer Strategy, Strategic Account Management, or Customer Marketing.</li> <li><strong>Customer Presence.</strong> Excellent internal and external relationship building and stakeholder management.</li> <li><strong>Program Builder. </strong>Demonstrated experience working cross functionally to deliver results. Proven success building new programs and processes in fast-growing organizations.</li> <li><strong>Technical Fluency: </strong>5+ Years experience working on developer-first products with a highly technical customer base. Comfort working with that audience, telling their stories. An instinct for what will “hit” on Hacker News paired with commercial acumen for enterprise buyers.<strong> </strong></li> <li><strong>Storytelling Excellence: </strong>Exceptional one-to-many (writing, communication, decks) and one-to-one (stakeholder management) communication skills.</li> <li><strong>Entrepreneurial Mindset:</strong> Comfort navigating ambiguity and driving initiatives independently. title: Credit Risk Manager
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong><em>🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.</em></strong></p> <p>We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.</p> <p>After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/personal">personal</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/business-banking">business</a> bank accounts, we offer <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/joint-account">joint accounts</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/16-17">accounts for 16-17 year olds</a>, a <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/under-16s">free kids account</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/flex">credit cards</a> in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also <a href="https://monzo.com/savings">save</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/investments">invest </a>and <a href="https://monzo.com/pensions">combine their pensions</a> with us. </p> <p>With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!</p> <p>We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️</p> <hr> <p> </p></div><p>📍Dublin | 💶 €93,500 - €114,000 + Incentive Awards tied to your performance + benefits | <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=U62l09nB0M4">Hear from the team</a> ✨</p> <p><strong>⭐ About the team:</strong></p> <p>Our Borrowing (lending) business is growing rapidly across both existing products and the planned launch of new initiatives. We aim to create a genuine feel-good factor when it comes to personal credit, and are looking for driven, analytical and creative individuals to help us achieve this goal.</p> <p>We’re looking for a Credit Risk Manager to help drive the credit and growth strategy for our consumer lending products as we grow our business in Ireland. Our credit teams are part of our Credit Discipline which drives a strong culture of data-driven decision making across the whole company. We’re great believers in powerful, real-time analytics and empowerment of the wider business. All our data lives in one place and is super easy to use. 90% of day-to-day data-driven decisions are covered by self-serve analytics through Looker which gives analysts the head space to focus on more impactful business questions and analyses.</p> <p>Join a team where your ideas can rapidly transform into reality, leveraging our cutting-edge technology and agile ways of working. Our credit analysts and managers are fully embedded into a product squad alongside Product Managers, Engineers, Designers, Marketers, Customer Researchers, Data Scientists etc. This enables us to solve customer problems in a fast paced and innovative way.</p> <p><strong>🔑 You'll play a key role by:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Working closely with Borrowing squad leadership to develop and execute an ambitious growth strategy </li> <li>Collaborating with people from engineering, marketing, product, risk and control to design and deliver new products and customer journeys</li> <li>Leading the development and maintenance of the NPV models and affordability strategies that underpin the Borrowing underwriting decisions</li> <li>Monthly monitoring and reporting on Borrowing performance to stakeholders up to executive level</li> <li>Collaborating with the Decision Science team to maximise value from our internal and external data through cutting-edge ML models</li> <li>Promoting a culture of proactive, high quality analysis and ensure we have the right credit capabilities, infrastructure and talent in place to scale safely</li> </ul> <p><strong>🤩 You should apply if:</strong></p> <ul> <li>What we’re doing here at Monzo excites you!</li> <li>You have extensive experience in unsecured lending in Ireland</li> <li>You have a deep understanding of lending economics and have experience developing and deploying underwriting strategies and credit models</li> <li>You have strong analytical and data capabilities, backed up by technical coding skills. SQL, Python and Looker experience is a plus</li> <li>You have experience with the development and maintenance of NPV models</li> <li>You have a strong understanding of the regulations that apply to lending in Ireland</li> <li>You thrive in a fast-paced environment and are keen for the chance to improve our products and help ship changes to our customers</li> <li>You are a strong communicator, able to cut through complex problems and articulate decision points, particularly to senior leadership</li> <li>You have experience in project management and coordination across teams</li> <li>You work well collaborating in a team with diverse skill-sets and personality types</li> <li>You are highly motivated and energised by the idea of bringing a positive impact to our customers and Monzo</li> </ul> <p><strong>🙌 What’s in it for you</strong></p> <p>💶 A salary range of €93,500 - €114,000 + Incentive Awards tied to your performance</p> <p>📍This role will have a hybrid working model, based in our Dublin office 3 days a week. You will also travel to Monzo’s head office in London from time to time</p> <p>⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, and at times that suit you and your team</p> <p>🏝 Annual Leave - 34 days including public holidays (24 holiday days + 10 public holidays)</p> <p>📚€1,200 learning budget each year to use on books, training courses and conferences</p> <p>🏥 Private healthcare scheme</p> <p>💰Pension scheme: the minimum contribution is 4% and Monzo matches any additional contributions that you make up to a maximum of 6%</p> <p>💛 Wellbeing benefits: financial education, women’s and men’s health support, mental health benefits, including coaching and counselling</p> <p><strong>🌈 The application journey has 4 key steps</strong></p> <ol> <li>An introductory video call with a member of the Monzo Recruitment team</li> <li>An initial video call with the hiring manager</li> <li>A series of role specific, case study & behavioural interviews</li> <li>A final call with senior leadership</li> </ol> <p>This process should take around 4-5 weeks - your schedule is really important to us, so we promise to be as flexible as possible! We have some guidelines on using Artificial Intelligence (AI) to ace an application and interview at Monzo. <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/the-ultimate-guide-on-using-ai-to-ace-an-interview-at-monzo">You can read them here.</a></p> <p>We'll only close this role once we have enough applications for the next stage. Please submit your application as soon as possible to make sure you don't miss out.</p> <p>#LI-MOS1</p><div class="content-conclusion"><hr> <p><strong>Equal opportunities for everyone</strong></p> <p>Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. At Monzo, we’re embracing diversity by fostering an inclusive environment for all people to do the best work of their lives with us. This is integral to our mission of making money work for everyone. You can read more in our <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/diversity-and-inclusion">blog</a>, 2026 <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/our-2026-diversity-and-inclusion-report" target="_blank">Diversity and Inclusion Report</a> and 2025 <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/gender-pay-gap-report-2025">Gender Pay Gap Report.</a></p> <p>We’re an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to age, ethnicity, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, or veteran, neurodiversity or disability status.</p> <p>If you have a preferred name, please use it to apply. We don't need full or birth names at application stage 😊</p></div>

title: Senior Full-Stack Engineer (m/f/d)
description: Our Company "Buying Labs is the leading global partner for sourcing and distributing premium consumer goods!" We're looking for a Senior Full-Stack Engineer (m/f/d) to join our Tech team at our Hamburg headquarters. Our goal is to supercharge how our business works with AI and technology, wherever it makes a real difference. You'll build the systems our teams rely on every day, from internal applications to the data and AI capabilities behind them, and see the impact of your work directly in the business. This is a role for an experienced engineer who takes real ownership: someone who designs solid systems, builds AI into them where it adds value, and drives their work through to production and real users. Your Mission Own systems end to end: Design, build and run features across frontend and backend, from technical approach through deployment and support in production. Build AI into our products: Design and integrate AI-powered features such as structured extraction, classification, automation and agentic workflows. Make them reliable through validation, evaluation and human review where it matters. Data modelling and architecture: Build solid data models in PostgreSQL that serve as the foundation for our applications and AI features. Make architecture decisions that keep our systems maintainable as they grow. Modern and established codebases: Build new applications on our modern stack, and maintain and modernise our established JavaScript platform, which our teams rely on every day. Quality you can stand behind: Write tested, reviewed code and verify your own work before it reaches users. Monitor and troubleshoot production issues. Work closely with the business: Understand the processes behind what you build, work directly with our commercial and operational teams, and help shape what gets built and why. Raise the bar: Share knowledge, Your Profile 6+ years of professional software engineering experience, with a track record of building and running production applications end to end. Proven experience building AI into production systems or applications, for example LLM-based extraction or classification, RAG, or agentic and tool-use workflows. You know how to make AI output reliable through validation, evaluation and fallbacks. Using AI coding assistants alone does not meet this requirement. You use AI tools in your daily development work and have solid habits for checking and reviewing what they produce. Strong TypeScript and JavaScript, and modern React, including hooks and state management. Strong backend experience with Node.js and Express or a comparable framework, REST APIs, and integrating external systems. Deep PostgreSQL and SQL skills, with solid data modelling and experience with an ORM or query builder such as Knex, Sequelize or Prisma. Comfortable working across both modern TypeScript applications and an established JavaScript codebase. Strong quality mindset: automated testing, code reviews, and taking responsibility for what you ship. High ownership and drive: you push your work through to done, raise problems early, and don't wait to be told what to do next. Clear communication with both technical and non-technical colleagues. Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent experience. Fluent English required; German is a plus. Based in Hamburg or willing to relocate. Nice to Have Depth in LLM tooling: provider APIs (Anthropic, OpenAI, Gemini), agent and tool-use patterns (MCP), and evaluating output quality. Vector search (pgvector or similar). Product or process awareness: experience understanding how a business works and turning messy processes into structured systems. Experience integrating ERPs or operational systems (orders, inventory, master data). Our wider stack: Bun, Vite, Redis, RabbitMQ, Docker, GitHub Actions, AWS. description: About VIA HealthTech VIA turns a therapy session into a finished session note, and session notes into a complete psychological report. You say no to candidates the founders like, and you say it with reasons Candidate experience. Answers within days, not weeks. You build the path from signed contract to productive, together with the hiring lead A lean people function. Contracts, probation reviews, feedback and performance cycles, compensation bands and the tooling behind them. Founders' time out, structure in. Our ISO 27001 and C5 frameworks carry HR controls, from joiner and leaver processes to security training, and you own those with the Security & Compliance Lead (who may be one of your first hires) The team as it doubles. Rituals, offsites, the things that keep a company twice this size feeling like the 12-person one that got here Your profile Must-have A track record of closing hard roles yourself, in-house or at an agency, with numbers you can show: hires per year, time to hire, offer acceptance. Senior engineers and salespeople at minimum Real sourcing craft. You find people who are not applying and get them to take the call Judgement about people. You can tell exceptional from polished in a first conversation, and explain the difference Closing instinct. You know what moves a candidate who holds three offers, and you negotiate for us without losing them Builder mentality. Processes, templates and tooling you set up yourself, because there is nobody else to do it Working knowledge of German employment basics: contracts, probation, notice periods and the thresholds that matter as we grow. Payroll and legal are outsourced; you know when to call them Hunger. You want to build the people function of a company that is going to be much bigger, not run one that already exists Fluent German and English. Our candidates and contracts are in German, parts of our team work in English Strong plus You have been the first People hire somewhere and built from zero Employer branding, from the careers page to events AI tools as a matter of course. title: Solutions Architect, EMEA
description: <h2><strong>About the Role</strong></h2> <p>Abnormal AI is seeking a <strong>Solutions Architect</strong>, that will play a key role in the pre-sales process, serving as a technical expert and trusted advisor to prospects and customers. A primary focus of this role will be assisting organizations in transitioning from legacy Third Party Secure Email Gateways (SEGs) to Abnormal AI’s platform. You will partner with sales teams to deliver impactful presentations, lead migration planning sessions, and architect technical solutions that address complex customer requirements.</p> <p>This role demands deep expertise in email systems (Microsoft 365, Google Workspace, and Exchange on-premises) and email security technologies (legacy SEGs, API-based vendors), as well as the ability to communicate effectively with technical and business audiences. Your contributions will directly impact Abnormal’s success in strategic and large-scale opportunities.</p> <p>The ideal candidate for the role will have the following skillset: </p> <ul> <li><strong>Technical Expertise:</strong></li> <ul> <li>Deep understanding of email systems: Microsoft 365, Google Workspace, and Exchange on-premises.</li> <li>Strong knowledge of Secure Email Gateways (Proofpoint, Mimecast, Barracuda) and API and Transport Rule-based vendors.</li> <li>Expertise in email security protocols and standards, such as SPF, DKIM, DMARC, encryption, spam scanning, sandboxing and emulation.</li> </ul> <li><strong>Customer-Facing Skills:</strong></li> <ul> <li>Proven ability to earn “trusted advisor” status with large and strategic customers.</li> <li>Exceptional presentation and communication skills with the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.</li> <li>Demonstrated experience in architecting solutions for enterprise customers during pre-sales engagements.</li> </ul> <li><strong>Problem Solving and Leadership:</strong></li> <ul> <li>Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills in high-pressure, customer-facing scenarios.</li> <li>Ability to prioritize and manage multiple opportunities simultaneously while delivering consistent results.</li> </ul> </ul> <h2><strong>What you will do </strong></h2> <h4><strong><em>Pre-Sales Enablement</em></strong></h4> <ul> <li>Partner with sales teams to provide deep subject matter expertise (SME) on email security architectures, technologies and infrastructures.</li> <li>Build trusted relationships with customers’ technical staff and leadership to identify pain points and align solutions with business goals.</li> <li>Lead technical workshops, solution presentations, and roadmap discussions to drive buy-in and support for SEG displacement initiatives.</li> <li>Architect complex, tailored solutions that address customer requirements and ensure seamless migrations to Abnormal AI.</li> </ul> <h4><strong><em>SEG Displacement and Migration</em></strong></h4> <ul> <li>Guide customers through the migration process, including evaluating their current SEG setup, identifying gaps, and creating comprehensive transition plans.</li> <li>Act as a technical lead for SEG replacement projects, troubleshooting challenges, and ensuring a seamless transition to Abnormal’s platform.</li> <ul> <li>You are the SME</li> </ul> <li>Educate customers on the advantages of API-based email security and provide expert recommendations on best practices for adoption.</li> </ul> <h4><strong><em>Product Expertise and Feedback Loop</em></strong></h4> <ul> <li>Serve as a conduit between the field (sales, customers) and R&D/Product teams to provide actionable insights on customer needs, technical challenges, and feature requests.</li> <li>Collaborate with Product Management to prioritize roadmap features based on customer feedback, opportunity size, and strategic importance.</li> <li>Stay informed about industry trends, competitive products, and customer challenges to position Abnormal AI effectively.</li> </ul> <h4><strong><em>Enablement and Thought Leadership</em></strong></h4> <ul> <li>Develop and deliver training sessions and technical content to upskill sales engineers and enhance their ability to handle complex customer scenarios.</li> <li>Create repeatable and consumable technical assets, such as blog posts, videos, and presentations, that showcase your expertise and support the broader team.</li> <li>Represent Abnormal AI at industry conferences, webinars, and customer events to share thought leadership and deepen relationships.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Must Haves </strong></h2> <ul> <li>Certifications: Microsoft Certified: Messaging Administrator, Google Workspace Administrator, CISSP, GIAC, or similar.</li> <li>Familiarity with advanced email security technologies, such as Email Authentication, Sandboxing, Machine Learning, and Behavioral Analysis.</li> <li>Experience in SEG replacement projects or equivalent migrations to API-based email security solutions.</li> <li>Knowledge of regulatory and compliance requirements (e.g., GDPR, HIPAA) relevant to email security.</li> </ul> <p><em>#LI-AA1</em></p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>A note on AI in our process: <br></strong>Abnormal AI uses AI-assisted tools to help our recruiting team prepare for candidate interviews. These tools analyze resume content and role requirements to suggest interview questions and areas for the interviewer to explore.They do not make hiring decisions or screen candidates automatically. Every decision about a candidacy is made by a person. Further, if your application is successful and Abnormal AI makes a conditional offer of employment, we will carry out pre-employment checks which must be successfully completed to progress to a final offer. All processes and pre-employment checks are in line with prevailing legislation and Abnormal AI's policies relevant to our security and privacy standards.</p> <p>Abnormal AI is an equal opportunity employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, protected veteran status or other characteristics protected by law. For our EEO policy statement please <a href="https://assets.contentstack.io/v3/assets/blt3a076cfd9753fa1f/blt9cbda641db7c0045/6a1e3d3a66aea075cd33e462/AAP_and_EEO_Statement.pdf" target="_blank"><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><em>click here</em></span></a>. title: Senior Fraud Investigator, Prevent
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong><em>🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.</em></strong></p> <p>We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.</p> <p>After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. Please note you may be required to work bank holidays, including Christmas Day, Boxing Day and New Years Day.</p> <h4>Start date - Monday 18th Jan 2027</h4> <p><strong>⭐ About our Financial Crime & Fraud Team:</strong></p> <p>Our Mission in the Financial Crime & Fraud Collective is to earn and keep our customers’ trust, support Monzo’s safe growth, and contribute to building a safer society. Our Senior Fraud Investigators are crucial to the success of this mission.</p> <p><strong>🔑You’ll play a key role by...</strong></p> <p>As a Senior Fraud Investigator, you will be part of the Prevent pillar which provides vital intervention and education to Monzo customers who are experiencing potential active fraud attempts on their funds across two main channels:</p> <ul> <li>Authorised card payment fraud</li> <li>Authorised faster payment fraud</li> </ul> <p><strong>Your day to day; </strong></p> <p>Senior Fraud Investigators in our Prevent pillar support the quality of performance and knowledge across the pillar by answering escalations, supporting operational changes, and speaking to our customers who are at potential risk of the most complex scams. We’re looking for investigators with in-depth knowledge of cryptocurrency and understanding of how this can be used by fraudsters across a range of typologies as we continue to develop and optimise our controls. This means you can complete a complex investigation from start to finish for our customers and provide clear feedback to our teams as we work together to become the most trusted bank in the UK. </p> <p>Specific responsibilities include: </p> <ul> <li>Gathering evidence from flagged transaction data </li> <li>Use of Monzo’s values to investigate the nature of suspicious transactions with empathy and attention to detail.</li> <li>Use of Monzo’s values to reassure and support customers through the process of identifying active fraud.</li> <li>Independently making decisions on cases and releasing or blocking flagged transactions up to a case value of £59,999.00.</li> <li>Submitting accounts for closure where first party concerns are held following investigation (in line with relevant guidance).</li> <li>Triaging cases with a value of more than £59,999.00 for upwards escalation</li> <li>Safeguarding compromised accounts and taking appropriate remedial action to ensure customers can resume safe usage of their Monzo account.</li> <li>Providing advice and support to victims of fraud on how they can protect themselves in the future.</li> <li>Handling non-FOS complaints and feeding back to Investigators and their managers where required as part of our continuous improvement feedback loop.</li> </ul> <p><strong>🤩 We’d love to hear from you if…</strong></p> <ul> <li>A strong understanding of regulatory requirements in fraud and/or financial crime</li> <li>A strong knowledge of cryptocurrency and how this is used in fraud typologies </li> <li>Excellent English written & verbal communication skills and experience speaking to victims of potential fraud</li> <li>Ability to be persuasive and empathetic</li> <li>Strong expertise in investigating, problem solving and decision making</li> <li>Ability to work well independently & be collaborative with the wider team</li> <li>Ability to work to deadlines</li> <li>Values driven approach in line with Monzo’s core values</li> </ul> <p><strong>🙌 What’s in it for you</strong></p> <p>💰 £31,100 - £39,350 ➕ Incentive Awards tied to your performance </p> <p>📚 £1,000 learning budget each year to use on books, training courses and conferences.</p> <p>🏡 We will set you up to work from home; all employees are given MacBooks and for fully remote workers we will provide extra support for your work-from-home setup.</p> <p>➕ Plus lots more! Read our full list of<a href="https://monzo.com/careers"> benefits</a></p> <p><strong>🌈 The Interview Process:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Some initial application questions (please take your time, we read these carefully!)</li> <li>A short call with a Recruiter</li> <li>A remote interview, lasting approximately 1 hour with two team members from the Fraud Team.</li> </ul> <p>This process should take around 3-4 weeks - your schedule is really important to us, so we promise to be as flexible as possible! </p> <p>We have some guidelines on using Artificial Intelligence (AI) to ace an application and interview at Monzo. <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/the-ultimate-guide-on-using-ai-to-ace-an-interview-at-monzo">You can read them here.</a></p> <p>We’ll only close this role once we have enough applications for the next stage. Please submit your application as soon as possible to make sure you don’t miss out. </p> <p>Linkedin Tags:  #LI-REMOTE #LI-SK2</p> <section class=""></section> <div id="ember214" class="ember-view messaging-side-panel__overlay"></div> <p> </p><div class="content-conclusion"><hr> <p><strong>Equal opportunities for everyone</strong></p> <p>Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. title: Model Risk Officer
description: Build with us Since 2004, we've had one clear goal: to make payments and money management effortless for every business in Europe. Today, more than 250,000 companies use Mollie to get paid, manage money and grow, with products designed to be simple, scalable, and dependable. With 950+ Mollies across 14+ locations, we care deeply about autonomy and craft. So we work in small teams, with real ownership, and we trust you to make the right decisions. We're building for the long term, so we provide the tools you need, processes you can rely on, and a balanced work environment to help you do work you're proud of. Sound like your kind of place? Let's build together. Your impact Credit, IRRBB and capital models sit at the heart of how a bank measures its own risk. Mollie already uses models in day to day processes, but nobody challenges them independently from a second line perspective yet. As Model Risk Officer, you'll help build the second line model risk function that gives Mollie, and its regulator, confidence that models can be trusted before they're used. This is a true 0 to 1 role. Mollie isn't a bank today, so there's no model risk framework, validation methodology or model inventory to inherit. You'll design the policy, validation approach and governance from scratch, starting with the credit, IRRBB and capital models already in design for our future capital and liquidity planning. Your work feeds into our licence application and, once authorised, into how we manage model risk every day. You'll also work with our Machine Learning team and the Domains already deploying models, so you can shape how we manage model risk today, not just in a banking future. Your challenge and sign off will be visible to senior leadership, audit and, eventually, our regulator. As Mollie grows and matures its model risk management, your scope grows from building the framework to running an ongoing model risk cycle. What you'll ship Build and own Mollie's model risk management framework and policy, including model risk appetite, validation standards and the model risk lifecycle. Set up and maintain the model inventory for credit, IRRBB and capital models, with materiality and risk tiering for each. Coordinate independent second line validation and challenge before models are used, including credit risk and ECL, IRRBB, and Pillar 1 and Pillar 2 capital models. Design the ongoing monitoring and re-validation cycle with the Machine Learning team, covering performance testing, limitation tracking and re-validation triggers. Partner with model owners in Credit Risk and Treasury ALM, and coordinate within the second line Risk function, so model risk challenge is built into the wider risk and capital frameworks. Coordinate clear, well documented validation reports and model risk information that stand up to scrutiny from DNB/ECB, external auditors and internal audit. What you'll bring Around 5 to 7 years of experience in model risk management or model validation within a bank, preferably across at least one of credit, IRRBB and capital models. Solid working knowledge of ECB model risk expectations and how model validation should be structured and evidenced. Comfort building a model risk framework and validation approach from the ground up. You're excited to write the first playbook. Strong quantitative skills to critically assess model methodology, assumptions and performance, and the discipline to document your findings so others, including a regulator, can follow them. The ability to explain model limitations and validation findings to model owners and senior stakeholders, and the confidence to hold your ground under challenge. Genuine curiosity about how AI can speed up the parts of model validation that don't need a human, so more of your time goes toward judgement and challenge. Grow your way At Mollie, growth is personal. We believe everyone should have the chance to develop their skills, explore new challenges and shape their career on their own terms. You'll get regular feedback and performance reviews to support your development, with fair and transparent salary reviews along the way. Many Mollies move into new roles or take on new projects to stretch themselves, and we actively hire from within to help you take the next step. No matter if you're aiming for promotion, exploring a different career path or building new skills, you'll be supported with the tools, trust and opportunities to grow your way. Unlock your full potential and join us to eliminate financial bureaucracy If you're excited by the idea of building what's next, for yourself and for thousands of businesses across Europe, we'd love to hear from you. Apply with your CV (in English) using the form below. Want a peek behind the scenes? Check out what life at Mollie is really like. AI at Mollie We believe in Always Be Shipping, and AI brings that philosophy to life across every team, every role, every day. AI is core to how we build. It helps us move faster, simplify work and make smarter decisions, creating real impact for the businesses we serve. We're looking for people who are excited to use AI to shape the future of finance with us. Find Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

description: Director Service Accounts @ Sereact 🦾 Director Service Accounts (m/f/d) · Stuttgart, with frequent travel to customer sites across Europe · Reports to the VP Operations · Full-time Who we are Sereact builds the robot brain for physical work. From that day our robots pick in someone else’s building, every shift, against targets the customer measures. Many of our customers buy Sereact as a service: they pay for robots that work, not for robots that were delivered. Our deployments are growing from single robots to fleets, and the site that performs is the site that grows. We now want one leader who owns every live site from SAT on: keeps it at target, brings it everything we ship in software and hardware, speaks for the customer inside Sereact, and turns a working site into a growing one. The Real-World Learning Loop runs through your sites Cortex learns from live deployments. Every station at a customer is part of that loop, so a station that is down is more than a service problem: a cell sitting dark is a stopped sensor. In-Situ Policy Execution. Every live station runs the current policy in a real operation. Your surface on it: each site at target, every shift. Continuous Data Acquisition. Robots annotate their own work while they run. Your surface on it: stations that run and stay connected, so the data keeps coming. Data Curation and Learning. Failures and edge cases decide what Cortex learns next. Your surface on it: what your sites tell us reaches engineering and research with the context they need. Evaluation and Policy Redeployment. Updated policies pass validation gates before they return to the fleet. Your surface on it: they land in your customers’ operations on a schedule the customer can plan around, with a way back if something is off. A site that runs well teaches Cortex more, and it grows. Responsibilities Take over every site at SAT. Set the standard for what a site needs before your team takes it on: documentation, open points, spare parts, contacts and targets. If a site is not ready, it stays with deployment until it is. Keep every site at target. Own each site’s performance against its contract: availability, throughput and pick success. See a problem coming before the customer does, and run the recovery plan when a site falls behind. Run planned change. Software releases and model updates reach customer operations in a rhythm customers can plan around: release notes, change windows, blackout periods, validation on site and a rollback path. Run hardware updates and retrofits across the installed base, from new gripper generations to station upgrades and fixes, with Hardware Engineering and the field teams, without stopping the customer’s operation. Get every site ready for peak: hypercare and coverage plans for the weeks that matter most to our customers, from Black Friday to the January returns wave. Be the customer’s advocate inside Sereact. Bring their priorities into product, R&D, hardware and operations, make sure what we promised at SAT holds, and own the customer communication when something goes wrong. Take each site from SAT to expansion with Strategic Accounts: the performance evidence, the site capacity and the technical plan for the next stations. Strategic Accounts own the contract; you make the expansion ready to happen. Report site health customers trust: one view of every site, monthly performance reports and the operational part of every business review. Build and lead the Service Accounts team: Service Account Managers who each own a portfolio of live sites, and a playbook that still works when the installed base is ten times larger. Work hand in hand with Deployment, Technical Support & Field Service, Hardware Engineering, R&D and Strategic Accounts, so a live site gets one coordinated answer, not five. Not in scope, by design Deployment up to SAT stays with our deployment teams. You set the bar for what you take over. Incidents, the support desk, field technicians and spare parts logistics stay with Technical Support & Field Service. You own the site; they own the ticket. Contracts, pricing and the expansion deal itself stay with Strategic Accounts. You make the case; they sign it. Product and hardware design stay with engineering. You bring them what the field needs. What makes this role hard Every change to a live operation is a risk, and not changing is a risk too: the fleet only gets better if updates reach it. You make both safe. Our robots work in other people’s buildings: their WMS, their conveyors, their shift patterns, their peak. Much of what decides a site’s performance is not ours, and it is still your problem. You sit between the customer and our teams. Sometimes the customer’s priority is not ours. You argue for it, or you explain honestly why not. The installed base grows faster than any team. What works by heroics today breaks at ten times the size. Your first 12 months First 90 days: know every live site and its people; one named owner, one health view and a clear status against target for each; a handover standard at SAT agreed with deployment. By month 6: releases and retrofits in a rhythm customers can plan around; peak season run on hypercare plans; account plans with Strategic Accounts for the largest customers; the first Service Account Managers hired. By month 12: every site at target or on a dated recovery plan; expansions coming out of the installed base; a playbook ready to take to the US. What you bring 8+ years owning live installations of complex automation after go-live (warehouse automation, intralogistics, robotics or comparable 24/7 systems), as service account manager, technical account manager, customer success or service delivery lead, including at least three years leading a team. You did it while the installed base grew from tens to hundreds of sites, and you built the processes rather than inheriting them. Technical enough to read a log, follow a root cause and hold your own with engineers. Commercial enough to sit with a customer’s operations director and talk performance, cost and growth. You have run releases, upgrades and retrofit programs in live operations without stopping them. Customers trust you because you tell them early and you tell them straight. Fluent English and German; another European language is a plus. You are happy to spend a large part of your week at customer sites. Nice to have: subscription or Robotics-as-a-Service models · goods-to-person and AS/RS integrations · e-commerce, returns or grocery fulfilment · experience in both a scale-up and an established automation vendor. Not the right fit: account management without technical depth, or running a ticket queue without ever owning a customer. Three questions we will ask you Tell us about a live site that fell behind its targets. What did you change in the first two weeks, and how did it end? A customer’s peak starts in four weeks. Engineering wants to ship a model update and a gripper retrofit before then. What do you do? How do you know a site is about to grow, or about to leave, before the customer tells you? What we offer A fleet in live production that grows every month, and the mandate to build the team that keeps it at target. A key role in the operations leadership of a company scaling from Europe into the US, with equity. Travel, accommodation and meals covered when you are on site. Our HQ in Stuttgart, with teams in Zurich and Boston. How we hire Conversations with our VP Operations and the founders, a working session on a real case from one of our live sites, and time with the team in Stuttgart. We move fast. You carry both sides of that trade, in front of Sales and in front of Deployment. By month 6: reference designs for our three main use cases; a throughput model validated against live sites; interface specifications agreed with our three most important integration partners; the first solutions engineer in the US onboarded. By month 12: deals signed in 2027 go live at the throughput in the concept, without redesign; a Solutions team in Europe and the US; a library that makes the standard deal routine. What you bring 8+ years in warehouse or factory automation, several of them in solutions, application engineering or deployment of robotic systems. You have personally deployed robots in live operations , from site survey to commissioning: piece-picking arms, dual-arm cells, mobile manipulators or AMR fleets. You know what a go-live night feels like. You did it while your company grew from its first sites to dozens or hundreds, and you built the solution process rather than inheriting it. You can do the work yourself: a site survey, a layout in CAD, a material-flow and throughput model, an interface specification for a WMS or WCS (APIs, PLC handshakes), a risk assessment for a cell. And you can explain it to a customer’s operations director and to our machine learning engineers in the same afternoon. You have worked side by side with sales teams as their technical counterpart and helped win deals by finding a solution that works. You have led solutions or application engineers, and when a sales team pushed for a bigger number, you held the line with evidence. You know the intralogistics ecosystem: AutoStore and goods-to-person systems, conveyors, the integrators; ideally e-commerce, returns or grocery fulfilment. Fluent English; German is a strong plus, since many of our customers are in the DACH region. You are happy to spend a large part of your time at customer sites in Europe and the US. Nice to have: piece-picking or dual-arm robotics · systems whose capability is driven by machine learning and moves every quarter · robotics-as-a-service models · deployments in the US. Not the right fit: pre-sales architects who have never commissioned a system, solutions as slide-making, or anyone who needs a finished product specification before they can start. Three questions we will ask you Walk us through a site you designed that went live at the throughput you promised, and one that did not. What was the difference? Sales wants to sign a deal this quarter with a KPI 50% above what your model says the site can do. What do you do in the next 48 hours to still make the deal work? A customer’s goods-to-person ports are fixed, and the layout leaves 30 cm less reach than our standard cell needs. What are the options, and which one do you choose? What we offer A product in live production with some of Europe’s largest operators, and the mandate to decide what we promise and what we build. A seat in the leadership team of a company scaling from Europe into the US, with equity. Travel, accommodation and meals covered when you are on site. Our HQ in Stuttgart, with teams in Zurich and Boston. How we hire Conversations with the founders and our VP Operations, a working session on a real site (we give you a layout, an item spectrum and a target; you tell us what to build and what to promise), and time with the team in Stuttgart. We move fast. Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

description: Ready to start or take the next step in your pharmacy career? At Montu, we are doing things differently, and that includes how we recruit. We are hosting a Pharmacy Assessment Centre on Monday 2 November 2026 , giving you the opportunity to experience a different approach to recruitment, demonstrate your skills and learn more about what it is like to work at Montu. You do not need previous pharmacy experience for all of our opportunities. For our entry-level positions, what matters most is your attitude, willingness to learn and genuine commitment to making a difference to patients. Our pharmacy is busy. Really busy. It is a lively, energetic environment where things move quickly, teamwork is essential and no two days are quite the same. If you enjoy being on your feet, working alongside others and being part of a team where everyone has a role to play, you could feel right at home. Behind every prescription we process is a patient relying on us to get things right. Whether you are packing medication, dispensing prescriptions or completing final accuracy checks, your contribution matters. Opportunities Available We are recruiting across several positions within our pharmacy team, with opportunities for both experienced pharmacy professionals and individuals looking to enter the industry. Pharmacy Assistant An excellent entry point into the pharmacy sector, with no previous pharmacy experience required. You will support the day-to-day operations of our busy pharmacy, including preparing orders, packing medication, supporting stock management and helping ensure prescriptions are processed accurately and efficiently. We are looking for individuals who are organised, reliable, comfortable with repetitive tasks and enjoy working in a hands-on, fast-paced environment. Trainee Pharmacy Dispenser Looking to develop a career in pharmacy? This could be your opportunity. No previous dispensing experience is required. You will receive training and support as you develop the knowledge and practical skills needed to work within our dispensing team. You will learn about prescription processing, medication handling, accuracy, pharmacy procedures and the importance of maintaining high standards of patient safety. Accuracy Checking Technician (ACT) For qualified Pharmacy Technicians with an accredited accuracy checking qualification and current GPhC registration. You will bring confidence, attention to detail and the ability to work effectively in a high-volume dispensing environment. What Is Our Pharmacy Assessment Centre? Adaptable: You are comfortable learning new processes and responding to change. Eager to learn: Whether you are new to pharmacy or already experienced, you are motivated to develop your skills. You do not need to be the loudest person in the room or have years of experience to succeed here. What matters is your work ethic, your attention to detail and your commitment to doing things properly. Through our specialist clinical services and pharmacy operations, we support patients receiving prescribed cannabis-based medicines for a range of eligible medical conditions. Our multidisciplinary teams bring together clinicians, pharmacists, pharmacy technicians, dispensers and operational colleagues, all working towards the same goal: delivering safe, effective and patient-centred care. title: Privacy & Product Counsel
description: This role can be office-based in Freiburg, Germany/ San Francisco, USA or remote-first, with a requirement to be in the office one full week per month. About Black Forest Labs We’re the team building the foundational layer for visual intelligence: multimodal models trained jointly on images, video, audio, and action to see, generate, and understand the world. Our founding team pioneered latent diffusion and Stable Diffusion, the breakthroughs that made generative AI accessible to millions. With FLUX, we're pushing into generative media at scale, machines that act in the physical world, and emerging applications in computer use. Our FLUX models top public benchmarks and run in production in some of the world's biggest platforms. We're a small, fast growing research lab competing with the largest companies in the world. From our labs in Freiburg to San Francisco, we're building what comes next. Why This Role Every FLUX release, API feature and enterprise offering requires legal oversight. Black Forest Labs’ (BFL) frontier technologies raise questions where there is no established precedent – especially as we push further into video, perception and physical AI. We’re hiring a Privacy & Product Counsel to find solutions and help drive our product teams forward. You’ll sit in our Legal, Policy & Assurance (LPA) team and be embedded with research, product and engineering, shaping how BFL builds and ships. This is a hands-on role for someone who wants to build a privacy function at the frontier of AI and robotics. What You’ll Work On Product counselling. Be the go-to lawyer for product teams on new models, API features and innovative products, from first spec to launch, giving clear, risk-calibrated advice that keeps us shipping. Marketing. Partner with our Growth, Marketing and DevRel teams to review launch announcements, model cards and campaign copy so that our claims about FLUX are accurate. Advise on privacy matters relating to product marketing, analytics, commercial and creator partnerships, and advertising claims. Privacy by design. Own BFL’s GDPR programme across the model lifecycle: training data, fine-tuning, inference, logging and retention. Run point on DPIAs and privacy documentation as required. Customer commitments. Partner with GTM on DPAs, zero-data-retention and no-training terms, security questionnaires and enterprise negotiations – and work with the team to ensure that what we promise matches what we do. International transfers and vendors. Manage EU–US transfer mechanisms (SCCs, the EU–US Data Privacy Framework and TIAs), and run privacy diligence on sub-processors and AI tooling. US privacy. Track and implement obligations under US state privacy laws (CCPA/CPRA and peers) and emerging AI-specific state legislation. Regulatory interface. Prepare BFL for engagement with data protection authorities, and handle data subject requests, complaints and incidents, including breach assessment and notification. Policy and documentation. Draft and maintain privacy notices, internal policies, records of processing and the privacy elements of compliance documentation. Scale the function. Build playbooks, templates and training so the rest of BFL can handle routine privacy questions without you. What We’re Looking For 5–8 years’ PQE as a qualified lawyer in an EU/EEA jurisdiction or the UK, with a substantial focus on data protection and product counselling Experience at a technology company, in a top-tier law firm’s privacy or tech practice, or both – ideally including time in-house advising product teams directly Deep, practical command of the GDPR (and the German BDSG), the ePrivacy framework and international transfer rules, plus a working knowledge of how other relevant EU regulations, such as the EU AI Act, interact with them Familiarity with US privacy and AI law (CCPA/CPRA, BIPA, and state AI and deepfake statutes) A track record of advising on AI, ML or data-intensive products: you understand training pipelines, inference and feature releases well enough to ask engineers the right questions Comfort giving direct, pragmatic advice under uncertainty – you can turn a novel legal question into a clear recommendation and workable product guidance Strong drafting skills across DPAs, privacy notices, DPIAs and commercial privacy terms Excellent written and spoken English; you can explain complex issues to researchers, executives and regulators alike An ownership mindset and low ego: you’re comfortable in a fast-moving, high-growth environment where you build processes, not just follow them While not required, it’s an added plus if you also have: Experience with generative AI, computer vision or media products – particularly involving biometric data, likeness rights or synthetic media Direct experience engaging with data protection authorities or the EU AI Office CIPP/E, CIPT or equivalent certification German language skills An interest in adjacent areas such as security and trust & safety How We Work Together We’re a distributed team with real offices that people actually use. You’ll be based in Europe or the US and work from your home location, with one week each month spent with us in Freiburg / San Francisco to stay connected with the team. Everything we do is grounded in four values: Obsessed. We are a frontier research lab. The science has to be right, the understanding deep, the product beautiful. Low Ego. The work speaks. The best idea wins, no matter who said it. Credit is shared. Nobody is above any task. Bold. We take the ambitious bet. We ship, we do not wait for conditions to be perfect. Kind. People over politics. We treat each other with genuine warmth. Agency without empathy creates chaos. Closing If this sounds like work you’d enjoy, we’d love to hear from you. Compensation EU: €150,000 - €200,000 + equity US $200,000 - $250,000 USD Note: We may use AI-assisted tools to help organize applications. All hiring decisions are always made by our team. title: Senior Robotics Autonomy Engineer - Planning, Decision & Intercept
description: Building autonomous supremacy systems in Berlin Promethion Industries is a European defence technology company building autonomous supremacy systems for aerial and multi-domain operations. We design tightly integrated autonomy stacks in Europe to enable decisive autonomy for NATO-aligned forces, focusing on defensive and counter-system capabilities including anti-UAS and resilient autonomy under contested conditions. We are looking for a Senior Robotics Autonomy Engineer to build the intelligence that turns mission objectives, target information and vehicle state into executable autonomous behaviour. Your mission with us Build the autonomy layer of our high-speed aerial robotic systems. Convert mission objectives, target state and vehicle state into real-time actions and trajectories. Develop algorithms for dynamic rendezvous, pursuit, interception and terminal approach. Build target-motion prediction and intercept-point estimation for moving airborne targets. Develop real-time path planning, trajectory generation and replanning under uncertainty. Account for aircraft capabilities, energy, maneuverability, sensing uncertainty and changing target behaviour. Build decision and behaviour logic that allows the system to adapt continuously during a mission. Combine classical robotics, optimization, MPC and learned approaches where appropriate. Explore reinforcement learning, imitation learning and policy-based autonomy where they provide meaningful advantages. Work closely with perception, estimation and control engineers to close the autonomy loop. Take algorithms from simulation into real aircraft and validate them through repeated flight testing. Your contribution to the team (required) Strong robotics or autonomous-systems background with significant real-world deployment experience. Strong experience with motion planning, trajectory generation or autonomous decision-making. Deep understanding of kinematics, dynamics and optimization. Experience with dynamic environments and moving-target problems. Experience with trajectory optimization, optimal control, MPC or comparable approaches. Strong C++ skills and good Python skills. Experience deploying autonomy algorithms onto real robotic systems. Strong understanding of uncertainty and its implications for decision-making and planning. Ability to design algorithms that operate under real-time compute constraints. Hands-on attitude and willingness to participate directly in flight testing and system debugging. Big plus UAV / fixed-wing autonomy. High-speed aerial robotics. Rendezvous, pursuit or intercept problems. Target-motion prediction. Aggressive flight. Reinforcement learning on real robots. Imitation learning / learned policies. PX4. ROS2. Optimal control and trajectory optimization. Aviation, defence or space systems. title: Client Sales Director (m/f/d)
description: Your wellbeing, our mission. Join a company shaping a healthier world. GET TO KNOW US At Wellhub we're revolutionizing workplace wellness. Our platform connects employees worldwide to the best partners for fitness, mindfulness, therapy, nutrition, and sleep—all in one simple subscription. Headquartered in NYC with team members in Europe, North America and South America, we're on a mission to make every company a wellness company. We believe work should be fulfilling, inspiring, and balanced. Here, you'll find a team that values wellbeing, collaboration, and different perspectives, where passion and creativity push boundaries to create real impact. Your contributions will help shape a healthier, more balanced world for you and millions of people globally. Join us in redefining the future of wellbeing! THE OPPORTUNITY We're hiring a Client Sales Director to lead one of our Client Enterprise Sales teams in Germany. You will manage and develop a senior team of Sales Managers, providing coaching and mentorship, shaping deal strategy, supporting high-stakes negotiations, and designing complex commercial initiatives. You'll build strategic partnerships with enterprise prospects, leading consultative sales cycles and crafting solutions tailored to their specific challenges. Beyond team leadership, you'll act as a cross-functional connector, partnering closely with Marketing, Product, Operations, Finance, Legal, Revenue Operations, and Customer Success to ensure strategic alignment, remove roadblocks, and accelerate outcomes. This is more than a job . It's a high-impact opportunity for professional and financial growth, with competitive, performance-based compensation. It's ideal for collaborative, entrepreneurial leaders who thrive in dynamic environments and value long-term customer relationships. YOUR IMPACT Enterprise Deal Execution & Commercial Acumen: Proven track record of navigating complex, multi-stakeholder SaaS sales cycles, building data-driven ROI business cases, and consistently closing six-figure enterprise contracts. Pipeline Generation & Regional Territory Health: Demonstrates proactive outbound prospecting, tight collaboration with SDR partners, and rigorous pipeline inspection to maintain high forecasting accuracy and predictable revenue growth. Executive Presence & Stakeholder Management: Commands high-level conversations with C-suite and senior HR/Total Rewards leaders, establishing credibility, handling objections effectively, and building lasting strategic partnerships. Cross-Functional Orchestration: Effectively aligns cross-functional internal resources—including onboarding, legal, and product teams—to ensure seamless deal execution and post-sale client success. Product Mastery & Solution-Selling: Articulates Wellhub's market value proposition clearly, translating product capabilities and case studies into bespoke executive solutions tailored to enterprise pain points. Industry Representation & Network Expansion: Actively expands Wellhub's regional footprint and brand authority through targeted networking, industry event engagement, and relationship building within the HR community. Mission Alignment & Culture Contribution: Exemplifies a commitment to workplace wellbeing, modeling sustainable high performance, collaborative empathy, and strong alignment with Wellhub's core mission. Live the mission: inspire and empower others by genuinely caring for your own wellbeing and your colleagues. Bring wellbeing to the forefront of work, and create a supportive environment where everyone feels comfortable taking care of themselves, taking time off, and finding work-life wellness. WHO YOU ARE Leadership & People Management: Proven experience leading and coaching senior sales managers and high-performing SaaS teams, cultivating a culture of accountability, operational rigor, and consistent quota achievement. Enterprise Revenue Growth: Track record of driving new business acquisition and closing high-value, complex deals, ideally within SaaS, HR consulting, or corporate benefits environments. Executive Presence & Stakeholder Influence: Exceptional ability to build trusted relationships with C-level buyers, navigate intricate decision-making units, and align cross-functional partners to drive strategic outcomes. Data-Driven Strategy & Pipeline Execution: Highly analytical approach to sales metrics and forecasting, leveraging CRM insights to optimize team performance, identify growth levers, and maintain predictability. Persuasive Communication & Fluency: Professional business and technical English fluency, with strong acumen in delivering executive-level presentations, financial business cases, and consultative narratives. Sales Tech & Modern Prospecting Acumen: High technical proficiency across modern sales stacks (e.g., Salesforce, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, SalesLoft) to scale pipeline generation and streamline sales workflows. Growth Mindset, Agility & Client Centricity: Proactive, outcome-oriented approach with a strong commitment to continuous learning, client advocacy, and navigating change in high-growth, fast-paced environments. We recognize that individuals approach job applications differently. We strongly encourage all aspiring applicants to go for it, even if they don't match the job description 100%. We welcome your application and will be delighted to explore if you could be a great fit for our team. For this specific role, please note that prior experience leading senior sales teams, driving new business growth, and successfully securing significant contracts with complex organizations and advanced English are mandatory requirements. WHAT WE OFFER YOU With thoughtful benefits, emotional wellbeing resources, and a culture that empowers you to take ownership of your role and your wellbeing, we create an environment where you can thrive in all dimensions of your life. Our benefits include: WELLHUB: Free Gold membership with access to onsite gyms and studios, digital fitness programs, and online wellness resources for meditation, nutrition, mental wellbeing support, and more! Add up to three family members to your plan, ensuring access to wellness for those who matter most to you. FLEXIBLE WORK: As a Flexible First company, we offer hybrid and remote options to give you the freedom to work in a way that suits you. The model for this specific role can be discussed with your recruiter and hiring manager. We offer all employees a one-time reimbursement to set up their home office equipment and a monthly work allowance to help cover the costs of working from home. Our offices are in Germany, Italy, Netherlands, Portugal, Romania, Spain, and the UK. You can work from any office or remotely based in any of these countries. FLEXIBLE SCHEDULE: Flexibility for us isn't just about where we work—it also means being able to shape how and when we get things done. Together with their leaders, employees define schedules that align with their time zones, team needs, and personal routines. PAID TIME OFF: We know how important it is to take time away from work to recharge. Employees receive 30 days paid holiday per year in addition to annual holidays (including an extra holiday on your birthday!). PARENTAL LEAVE: Welcoming a new child is one of the most special moments in your life. Take the time to be present and enjoy your growing family. We offer 100% paid parental leave to all new parents. Parents giving birth are eligible for an extended leave and a ramp-back period to return part-time while they get settled. CAREER GROWTH: Access world-class platforms, participate in interactive sessions, build your personalized development roadmap, and explore internal opportunities. We focus on continuous learning and feedback to support your journey toward personal and professional success. CULTURE: You'll join a team of passionate people who come together to break boundaries, support each other, and create a meaningful impact in workplace wellness. We win together, building trust through open communication and a culture where every perspective matters. Learn more about our shared culture and values here. Want to see what it's really like to work here? Follow us on Instagram @lifeatwellhub and watch our team video on YouTube ! Diversity, Equity, and Belonging at Wellhub We aim to create a collaborative, supportive, and inclusive space where everyone knows they belong. At Wellhub, we welcome and celebrate your authentic self. Wellhub is committed to creating a diverse work environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, non-disqualifying physical or mental disability, national origin, veteran status, or any other basis covered by appropriate law. Our commitment to inclusion also extends to how we recognize and reward our people. We're proud to be Syndio Fair Pay Certified, reflecting our ongoing dedication to equitable and fair pay practices across our global team. Read more about it here. Questions on how we treat your personal data? See our Job Applicant Privacy Notice. #LI-HYBRID Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

Du bringst deine eigene Perspektive ein, triffst Designentscheidungen auf Basis von Daten und arbeitest in einem überschaubaren Team mit direktem Draht zu allen Abteilungen und zur Geschäftsführung. Du sorgst dafür, dass Menschen auf dem Weg zur Einbürgerung sich zurechtfinden, Sicherheit gewinnen und ein neues Kapitel aufschlagen können. Vertrauensarbeitszeit und flexible Teilzeit Keine Kernzeiten, keine vorgeschriebenen Zeitfenster. Ob 4-Tage-Woche, 30 Stunden oder ein individuelles Modell: Dein Job soll zu deinem Leben passen, nicht andersherum. Homeoffice nach der Einarbeitung Grundsätzlich arbeiten wir im Büro, weil Zusammenarbeit und Austausch vor Ort für uns wichtig sind. Nach deiner Einarbeitung ist gelegentliches Homeoffice aber kein Problem, auch spontan. Spontan frei, wenn das Leben dazwischenkommt Kranke Kinder, Elternabend, kurzfristiger Arzttermin oder einfach mal eine Auszeit: Wir planen unsere Teams so, dass auch spontane freie Tage möglich sind, ganz ohne Stress oder schlechtes Gewissen. Familie und Gesundheit haben bei uns Vorrang. Modernes Altbau-Büro mit Fitnessraum Hohe Decken, viel Tageslicht, Pflanzen und ein Innenhof für die Pause zwischendurch, mitten im Herzen von Cottbus. Unser eigener Fitnessraum im Haus steht dir kostenlos und jederzeit zur Verfügung. Einen Einblick in unsere Räume bekommst du auf unserer Website. Team-Events und Feel-Good-Angebote Sommerfest am See, Weihnachtsfeier, Halloween-Sause, gemeinsame Lunches oder Afterwork-Dinner: Wir feiern gern. Erscheinen ist keine Pflicht, und früher gehen ist auch kein Problem. Zwischendurch sorgt unsere Feel-Good-Managerin für kleine Auszeiten, von Nacken- und Schultermassagen bis zu kurzen Entspannungs-Sessions. Mögliche Aufgabenbereiche Wie verhalten sich Nutzer:innen auf unserer Website? Wo springen sie ab, wo zögern sie, wo verstehen sie nicht, was als Nächstes zu tun ist? Als UI/UX Designer (w/m/d) treiben dich diese Fragen an, und du beantwortest sie nicht mit Bauchgefühl, sondern mit Methode. Konzeption & Design von User Interfaces Du erstellst Wireframes und Prototypen in Figma für unsere Websites, Landingpages und Apps. User Journey Mapping & Optimierung Du analysierst die komplette Customer Journey, vom ersten Klick bis zur erfolgreichen Einbürgerung und Kundenbewertung, und sorgst dafür, dass unnötige Reibungspunkte, Rückfragen und Bedenken verschwinden. Usability-Testing & Research Du bist Ansprechperson für Usability-Testing, von Eye-Tracking-Analysen über User-Interviews bis zu regelmäßigen Gesprächen mit unseren kundennahen Teams, damit unsere Designentscheidungen auf echten Daten und echtem Feedback beruhen. Conversion-Rate-Optimierung Du planst, implementierst und analysierst A/B-Tests, etwa für Formulare oder Call-to-Actions, um die Abschlussrate zu steigern. Mobile First Du stellst sicher, dass alle Interfaces auf mobilen Geräten einwandfrei funktionieren, mit Fokus auf Touch-Interaktionen und Performance. Kann jemand, der gerade im Zug zur Arbeit sitzt, unsere Website problemlos nutzen? Design-System-Management Du baust unser zentrales Design-System in Figma weiter auf, pflegst es und entwickelst es gemeinsam mit dem Frontend-Team weiter, damit alles konsistent und skalierbar bleibt. Tracking & Datenanalyse Du richtest Tracking-Events ein (z. B. über Google Analytics oder HubSpot) oder wertest sie mit aus, um aus echten Nutzungsdaten Designentscheidungen abzuleiten. Zusammenarbeit mit Marketing & Content Gemeinsam mit dem Marketing-Team setzt du visuell starke Landingpages, Kampagnen und Social-Media-Grafiken um. Du weißt, was Nutzer:innen anspricht und wo ihre Bedenken liegen. UX-Standards & Prozesse Du entwickelst Standards, Templates und Workflows, die die Designarbeit für das gesamte Team effizienter machen. Dein Profil Kein Zertifikat der Welt ersetzt echte Erfahrung und Know-how aus der Praxis. Genau die suchen wir. Uns interessiert, was du wirklich kannst und wie du denkst, und das zeigst du uns am besten mit einem Portfolio. Direkte Kommunikation und Hands-on-Erfahrung sind uns wichtiger als jeder Abschluss. Und wir suchen jemanden, der bereit ist, Verantwortung zu übernehmen. Praxis im UI/UX-Design Du hast bereits Websites oder Web-Apps gestaltet, die live gegangen sind, kannst sie uns in deinem Portfolio zeigen und kennst die typischen Herausforderungen digitaler Produkte. Festanstellung vor Ort in Cottbus Du möchtest fest bei uns angestellt sein und im Team vor Ort in Cottbus arbeiten. Für Freelance-Aufträge oder reine Remote-Stellen sind wir leider nicht die richtige Adresse. Figma als Handwerkszeug Auto-Layout, Komponenten, Prototyping und Design-System-Elemente sind für dich tägliches Handwerkszeug. Sicherer Umgang mit UX-Methoden Du beherrschst User-Centered Design und weißt, dass UX kein Synonym für „schönes Design“ ist. Erfahrung im UX-Research Du hast bereits Interviews, Usability-Tests oder Auswertungen durchgeführt oder begleitet und weißt, wie man daraus konkrete Verbesserungen ableitet. Design-Sensibilität Du erkennst gute Typografie, klare Layouts, starke Kontraste und ein modernes Look-and-Feel auf den ersten Blick. Verständnis für Microinteractions Du weißt, wie kleine Animationen und Interaktionen das Nutzererlebnis verbessern können. Teamspirit & Humor Du arbeitest am liebsten gemeinsam, denkst nutzerzentriert und bringst eine ordentliche Portion gute Laune mit. Kommunikation auf Augenhöhe Eigentlich wollen wir hier nichts Generisches schreiben, aber dieser Punkt ist uns wichtig: Gute Zusammenarbeit zählt für uns genauso viel wie Know-how. Jemand, mit dem die Zusammenarbeit angenehm und reibungslos läuft, ist im Alltag oft wertvoller als jemand mit noch mehr Know-how, mit dem die Kommunikation aber schleppend ist. Deutsch oder Englisch Du sprichst Deutsch oder Englisch, am besten beides (ca. B2-Niveau). Keine Sorge, einen Nachweis brauchen wir nicht. Plus: Frontend-Grundkenntnisse Kein Muss, aber hilfreich: Du verstehst HTML, CSS und JavaScript so weit, dass du Designs technisch durchdacht planen kannst. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion. Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work. ABOUT THE ROLE: Notion is shaping the future of Go-To-Market, and as a Solutions Consultant (SC), you’ll bring that future to life by building alongside customers and turning their biggest challenges into measurable outcomes. As a customer-facing, quota-carrying SC, you’ll bring together technical fluency and commercial ownership to grow your book of business. You’ll build pipeline with BDRs, engage key stakeholders, lead discovery, co-build workflow solutions live with customers, and guide opportunities through close. You’ll connect each solution to a clear business case and stay engaged through adoption, expansion, and renewal so customers realize the value of what they buy. You’ll partner with BDRs, Outcomes Architects, and technical or product specialists while maintaining clear ownership of customer relationships, opportunity momentum, and next steps. If you’re a builder who loves to sell—and want to work at the intersection of AI, productivity, and enterprise—this is the role. This role will be based in Dublin. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE: - Create pipeline across your book of business. Build target-account plans with BDRs and initiate outreach to priority stakeholders to generate qualified opportunities, alongside BDR-sourced pipeline. - Own opportunities from first conversation through close. Lead discovery, qualify business needs and urgency, align stakeholders, shape the solution and business case, and drive the evaluation and commercial decision. Navigate commercial sizing, proposal construction, procurement, legal, and security review to close deals with the right scope, credits, and implementation path. - Design and validate workflow solutions that deliver measurable value. Map current- and future-state workflows, co-build solutions live in Notion, and define realistic scope, success criteria, and an implementation path. Translate customer needs and validated outcomes into a clear business case, commercial recommendation, and decision path. Treat discovery as an opportunity to build and validate. - Orchestrate the right partners while maintaining ownership. Engage BDRs, Outcomes Architects, and technical or product specialists at the right moments, with clear context and asks, while owning opportunity momentum, customer communication, and next steps. - Drive customer value and commercial growth after signature. Partner with Outcomes Architects, guide the initial path to value with a clear adoption plan, on onboarding and ongoing multi-workflow adoption, and own expansion strategy and renewal planning. Stay accountable for translating credits sold into credits consumed, and surface risks or expansion opportunities as customer workflows mature. SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: - Commercial ownership and pipeline generation. You can demonstrate how you created or advanced business, influenced customer decisions, and owned measurable outcomes. Relevant experience may come from quota-carrying sales or adjacent customer-facing roles. - Technical fluency and builder mindset. You are comfortable building live in software and can demo, co-design, and troubleshoot with a customer without needing a specialist in the room. - AI fluency. You are excited about AI, build with new tools, and continually learn new ways of working. - Discovery, qualification, and value articulation. You can uncover customer needs, map workflows, qualify business impact and urgency, and translate what you learn into commercial outcomes, adoption plans, and clear success criteria. - Agency, urgency, and learning velocity. You set clear goals, take initiative, learn from customer interactions, and apply those learnings to improve outcomes. You bring new ideas and workflows to customers and make complex problems easier to solve. - Complex customer engagement. You can lead multi-stakeholder interactions and navigate procurement, legal, and security review cycles. - Fluency in German. NICE TO HAVES: - Full-cycle B2B software sales experience or solutions engineering experience, with a consistent track record of exceeding quota across new-logo acquisition and expansion motions. - Familiarity with usage-based or consumption-based pricing models and the ability to structure credit-based commercial proposals. - Prior experience selling to mid-market and enterprise accounts in productivity, collaboration, or workflow software. - Experience in a shared account ownership model, partnering with a post-sale or Customer Success team as part of an integrated customer motion. Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role's scope and complexity, and the candidate's experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. The estimated range for total on target earnings (including base salary and on target incentive pay) for this role is €144,000 - €156,000 per year. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on. EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. Notion is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristic.
