title: Head of Growth / Sales Lead (all genders)
description: Über Zenon Bei Zenon besetzen wir die Rollen, die über den Erfolg der größten Tech-Transformationen der kommenden Jahre entscheiden. Als Boutique für Executive Search im IT-Umfeld arbeiten wir für führende Tier-1-Unternehmen und ambitionierte Tech-Player, um die Menschen zu finden, die den Unterschied machen. In unserem kompakten Team in Hamburg gestaltest du als Head of Growth / Sales Lead den Ausbau unseres Geschäfts maßgeblich mit. Mission Du baust ein skalierbares Sales-Modell auf, das Zenon von einem stark personengetriebenen 360-Grad-Ansatz zu einer systematischen, datengetriebenen und spezialisierten Organisation entwickelt. Operatives Business Development & Staffing Sales Du übernimmst aktiv die Neukundenakquise und gewinnst eigenständig neue Recruiting- und Staffing-Mandate. Du identifizierst potenzielle Kunden, analysierst deren Hiring-Bedarfe und entwickelst gezielte Akquisestrategien. Du führst Kundenmeetings, präsentierst unsere Dienstleistungen und verantwortest Vertragsverhandlungen bis zum erfolgreichen Abschluss. Du baust langfristige Beziehungen zu Hiring Managern, HR-Entscheidern und Führungskräften auf. Du entwickelst bestehende Kundenbeziehungen weiter und identifizierst neue Umsatzpotenziale. Du übernimmst persönlich Verantwortung für strategische Accounts und relevante Umsatz- und Wachstumsziele. Sales Strategy & Growth Du entwickelst und setzt unsere Sales- und Wachstumsstrategie um. Du etablierst strukturierte Outbound-Prozesse und entwickelst neue Wege zur systematischen Kundengewinnung. Du identifizierst neue Märkte, Branchen und Geschäftspotenziale für Zenon. Du entwickelst skalierbare Sales-Prozesse, Playbooks und KPIs. Du analysierst unsere Pipeline, Conversion Rates und Umsatzentwicklung und leitest daraus konkrete Maßnahmen ab.Das bringst du mit Mehrjährige Erfahrung im anspruchsvollen B2B-Vertrieb mit Enterprise-Kunden, idealerweise in der Personalberatung Nachweisbarer Track-Record im eigenständigen Aufbau und Abschluss komplexer Deals Erfahrung mit strukturierten Sales-Methoden und modernen Outbound-Ansätzen Fähigkeit, kommerzielle Strukturen selbst aufzubauen statt nur bestehende Teams zu verwalten Stark in Executive-Stakeholder-Management, Discovery, Verhandlung und Closing Eigenverantwortliche Arbeitsweise mit Perspektive auf die Führung einer größeren Sales-Organisation Das bieten wir Für deinen Arbeitsweg und deine Mobilität stehen dir ein Firmenwagen, ein Fitnessabo sowie Optionen zur beruflichen Bildung und internen Mobilität zur Verfügung. Profitiere von Mentoring, regelmäßigen Teamevents und Firmenfeiern sowie kostenlosen Getränken am Standort Hamburg. Ausstattung wie ein Firmenlaptop und ein Firmenhandy gehören zu deiner täglichen Ausrüstung. 30 Tage Urlaub Why Zenon? Wir bauen nicht einfach ein weiteres Recruiting-Unternehmen. Wir entwickeln eine Organisation, die durch Spezialisierung, Qualität und systematische Kundenentwicklung nachhaltig wächst. Dafür suchen wir Menschen, die Lust haben, Verantwortung zu übernehmen, Neues zu lernen und gemeinsam mit uns etwas aufzubauen. Ready to grow with us? Let's talk. Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Social Media & Content-Marketing Werkstudent:in (w/m/d)
description: Du lebst auf TikTok, Instagram und YouTube? Canva, CapCut, ChatGPT hast immer im Einsatz? Du siehst ein Reel und weißt sofort, warum es funktioniert – und wie Du es besser gemacht hättest? Super. Wir suchen für Social Media & Content-Marketing eine Werkstudentin bzw. einen Werkstudenten in unserer Werbeagentur in Passau (vor Ort). Bitte ausschließlich digitale Bewerbungen; postalische Bewerbungen werden nicht berücksichtigt oder zurückgesandt. — Bewerbungen werden auf Deutsch entgegengenommen. Aufgaben Reels, Shorts und TikToks konzipieren, drehen, schneiden und veröffentlichen – von der Idee bis zum fertigen Post. Pins, Grafiken und Kurzvideos für Instagram, TikTok, YouTube und Pinterest aufbereiten. Content für Webseiten, Social Media und KI-Systeme erstellen und optimieren. Trends, Sounds und Formate beobachten und für unsere Kunden übersetzen. Verstehen, warum ein Video läuft und ein anderes nicht – und daraus lernen (ja, ein bisschen Zahlen gucken gehört dazu). Bestehende Inhalte analysieren und hinsichtlich Reichweite, Interaktionen und Performance verbessern. KI-Tools sinnvoll zur Ideenfindung, Recherche und Content-Produktion einsetzen. Mit superlieben Kunden kommunizieren oder mal was wegfuttern, wenn die vor Freude was vorbeibringen. Qualifikation Irgendwas mit Medien, Marketing oder Gestaltung: Du bist ordentlich immatrikuliert an einer (Fach-)Hochschule in Passau oder Umgebung wie Deggendorf, Hagenberg, Linz. Gerne Medien und Kommunikation (MuK), Journalistik und Strategische Kommunikation (JoKo), Medientechnik, Mediengestaltung/-produktion oder irgendwas mit Schwerpunkt Marketing. Muss: Du bist selbst aktiv auf TikTok, Instagram, YouTube & Co. – und verstehst, was dort gerade läuft. Du hast Spaß daran, Inhalte zu erstellen, die Menschen wirklich anschauen, und zu analysieren, was warum trendet. Canva, CapCut, ChatGPT, Claude oder Gemini sind deine Werkzeuge. Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift Plus: Bock, auch mal selbst vor die Kamera zu gehen? Pluspunkt, aber kein Muss. Du nimmst gerne Kritik an, um Dich zu verbessern. Zuverlässige, kreative, solide Arbeitsweise. Bonus: Eigene Projekte, Instagram-, TikTok- oder YouTube-Kanäle freuen uns mehr als perfekte Zeugnisse. Interesse an und Zeit für eine längerfristige (>1 Jahr) Zusammenarbeit. Du probierst gerne neue Apps und KI-Tools aus und hast Spaß daran, Dinge selbst herauszufinden. Benefits Uni geht vor – Zeit für Lernpausen und Urlaube ist selbstverständlich. Echte Projekte mit Impact. Faire Bezahlung: ab 15 €/Stunde – pünktlich und zuverlässig. Unabhängig von Geschlecht etc. (Equal Pay). Persönliche Wertschätzung, offener Umgang auf Augenhöhe. Umfangreiches Onboarding vom ersten Tag an, damit Du Dich sofort wohlfühlst. Schulungen, Wissensteilung – Du wirst ordentlich was dazu lernen. Überschaubares, großartiges Team von Profis. Proaktive, ehrliche, unkomplizierte Kommunikation. Individuell flexible Arbeitszeiten. Keine Überstunden, keine Erreichbarkeit nach Feierabend – außer wir feiern. Modernes, helles Büro in unmittelbarer Uni-Nähe im Stadtturm in Passau. Bewerben ist ganz einfach . Spar Dir Motivationsschreiben und Volksschulzeugnisse. Zeig uns Deinen Lebenslauf – und vor allem Social-Media-Profile , an denen Du bastelst, oder eine Idee, wie Du unsere Kanäle besser machen würdest. Schick uns ruhig unfertige Projekte. Uns interessiert mehr, wie Du denkst, als perfekte Beispiele. Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

description: (Junior) Controller (m/w/d) - Vollzeit | München Im Auftrag unseres Partnerunternehmens in München suchen wir Sie zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt als „(Junior) Controller (m/w/d)“. title: Technischer Mitarbeiter* Leitwarte / technische Betriebsführung
description: Du suchst einen Job mit Zukunft? Bei der Energiebauern GmbH entwickeln, bauen und betreiben wir seit 2003 leistungsstarke Anlagen im Bereich erneuerbare Energien. Unser über 100-köpfiges Team deckt mit dem breiten Know-How die gesamte Wertschöpfungskette - von der Projektentwicklung und Finanzierung über Planung, Bau und Inbetriebnahme bis hin zu Netzbetrieb, Energiewirtschaft und Instandhaltung - ab. Neben den Photovoltaikfreiflächenanlagen umfasst unser Portfolio mittlerweile Umspannwerke, Batteriespeicher, Einspeisetrassen und Windenergieanlagen. Als familiengeführtes Unternehmen legen wir Wert auf Teamgeist und bieten dir gleichzeitig spannende Herausforderungen in einem dynamischen und zukunftssicheren Umfeld. Bewirb dich und werde Teil unseres Teams - Begleite von unserem Standort in Aichach den Bau der modernsten und innovativsten Wind- und PV-Projekte in Deutschland! title: Offensive Security Engineer
description: <blockquote>Shape our offensive security services</blockquote> <p>Ready to immerse yourself in the world of securing critical IT by thinking and acting like a real adversary? You will scope, execute, and report on penetration tests, purple and red teaming engagements, and threat modeling assessments tailored to our unique and complex mission-critical environments. We are actively seeking security professionals at various seniority levels to join our security team. We provide a challenging and rewarding atmosphere where autonomy in your day-to-day operations is valued.</p> <p>We are a small team and we are part of the team that works on our value propositions for security. This means we have a lot of mandate to define and shape offensive security services within Schuberg Philis. <br><br>In this role, you will work with cutting-edge technologies, spanning private and public clouds and VMs to serverless - all highly automated. As an offensive security specialist your skills will be put to the test in a diverse technological landscape.<br><br></p> <p><strong>Success in this role requires a unique blend of skills and traits</strong></p> <ul> <li>7+ years of experience (the more the better) in an offensive security role.</li> <li>A security mindset aimed at identifying realistic attack paths from a real-world adversaries' perspective.</li> <li>Giving security advice that fits the unique and challenging mission-critical environments we manage to help our teams set up strong defense-in-depth. Every environment is unique, and we expect our engagements to treat them as such as well.</li> <li>Build and maintain tools to help scale our offensive security services well beyond a small team. As an example: by building and maintaining a secure AI penetration testing methodology and toolkit that can be used by our customer teams.</li> <li>Collaborating with all customer teams, offering guidance on security-related topics.</li> <li>Evaluating and improving the security resilience of Schuberg Philis itself through red and purple teaming engagements.</li> <li>Using your technical and soft skills to guide the organization in adopting security measures along with the broader security team. We show impact, and can help limit it.</li> </ul> <p><br><strong>Where we would love to grow as a team</strong><br>We care more about mindset, experience, and being calm under pressure than a checklist of specific technologies. However, if you bring depth in advanced malware development, Kubernetes, or OT security, you'll find eager sparring partners and plenty of room to make those areas your own.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><em>Everyone we work with and consider working with has a right to equal treatment. Ondertussen pak je WhatsApp-berichtjes van klanten op. Je helpt ze met het aanpassen van hun bestelling, het kiezen van een bezorgtijd of beantwoordt vragen over ons assortiment. Je merkt dat er veel vragen zijn over een bepaalde marketingactie. Dat geef je dus meteen even door aan de juiste collega. De collega's die 's avonds werken nemen jouw taken over. Dat zorgt ervoor dat je de feedback die klanten doorgeven via de app nog even kunt verwerken. Tijd om af te sluiten. Samen met je collega's drink je nog een ijskoud Crisp-drankje in onze gezellige keuken. Dit ben jij Je herkent je in het volgende profiel: Je bent parttime (16-24 uur per week) beschikbaar. Je woont in omgeving Amsterdam en bent voor minimaal één jaar beschikbaar. Een kantoor in de Amsterdamse Pijp met een grote keuken waar flink wordt geluncht, gezellig gekookt en waar de kans op zelfgebakken taart of vegan roze koeken groot is. Goed om te weten: vanaf januari 2027 groeien we door en verhuizen we naar een gloednieuwe, grotere locatie in de buurt van Zaandam, Sloterdijk en de Houthavens, waar we vanaf dan onze nieuwe thuisbasis hebben. Je schrijft en spreekt vloeiend Nederlands. Op een persoonlijke en creatieve manier reageren op klanten gaat jou makkelijk af. Je bent oplossingsgericht en empathisch. Je kunt je verplaatsen in onze klanten en begrijpt wat er nodig is om hun ervaring met Crisp nog beter te maken. Je bedenkt creatieve oplossingen om onze klanten te verrassen en verwachtingen te overtreffen. Als je klantenservice-ervaring hebt binnen organisaties waar kwaliteit hoog in het vaandel staat, is dat super! Wat wij bieden Een marktconform salaris, afhankelijk van leeftijd. Een gezellig en hecht team. Veel verantwoordelijkheid, uitdagend werk en een dynamische omgeving. Een kijkje in de keuken van een snelgroeiende start-up. We zijn volop in ontwikkeling dus jouw ideeën tellen mee. Werken bij een B-Corp gecertificeerd bedrijf, waarbij je de kans krijgt om je stempel te drukken op ons voedselsysteem en échte verandering teweeg te brengen Enthousiaste en ondernemende collega’s om mee te werken en te leren. Voor straks een perfect pensioen via BPFL. Voor nu een persoonlijk budget voor yoga, sport, mobiliteit en downtime via bijvoorbeeld ClassPass, Pathé en Blendle. Elke maand food for thought, met workshops en talks via de Crisp University. Tijd om je collega’s te leren kennen tijdens sport, events en proeverijen. Een kantoor in de Amsterdamse Pijp met een grote keuken waar flink wordt geluncht, gezellig gekookt en grote kans op zelfgebakken taart of vegan roze koeken. En... fikse korting op je Crisp boodschappen, omdat je thuis natuurlijk ook goed wilt eten. Ben jij geïnteresseerd? Is de functie van Service Agent jou op het lijf geschreven, solliciteer dan via onderstaand button. Hoe meer je kunt delen over jezelf en de reden dat je solliciteert, hoe beter. Bij Crisp streven we naar een inclusieve en diverse werkomgeving waarin iedereen welkom is, ongeacht hun achtergrond, geslacht, leeftijd, etniciteit, seksuele geaardheid, religie of beperking. We waarderen de unieke bijdragen die elke medewerker kan leveren en zijn vastbesloten om een inclusieve werkplek te creëren waarin iedereen wordt gerespecteerd en gewaardeerd. title: Senior Penetration Tester API, Web & Cloud – 6 Months Contract (all genders)
description: Distribusion is the world’s leading ground transportation marketplace and gives travellers seamless access to ground transportation online, from search to ticket purchase. We have built a cutting-edge B2B technology platform that connects bus, rail and ferry operators in 70+ countries with the biggest online retailers including Google Maps and Booking.com. We are shaping the future of travel and building the largest global network of transport providers and retailers. We are one of the fastest growing startups in travel, backed by leading venture capital investors including TQ Ventures, Lightrock, Creandum, and Northzone, and are headquartered in Berlin, Germany. Following our recent $80m Series C funding, we are ready to push beyond. We are looking for an experienced Senior Penetration Tester to join us on a 6-month contract, and start as soon as possible. You will run hands-on, authenticated security testing across a real attack surface: public partner-facing booking APIs, payment flows, web and mobile apps used by millions of travellers, and the cloud infrastructure behind them. You’ll plan and run your own testing, work directly with our engineering squads to get findings fixed, and see your impact in production within weeks. What you will do: Test our partner-facing booking APIs against the OWASP API Security Top 10, with a focus on object- and function-level authorization, tenant isolation, mass assignment, data exposure and rate limiting. Assess API authentication and integrity end to end, including OAuth 2.0/OIDC, API keys, JWTs, webhooks and request signing. Hunt for business-logic abuse in booking, checkout, payment and refund flows, including race conditions and pricing manipulation. Run authenticated tests of traveller-, partner- and operator-facing web and mobile apps following OWASP WSTG and ASVS, including how passenger personal data is stored, shown and exported. Review cloud, Kubernetes and CI/CD configurations and secrets handling for attack paths that could be chained from an application bug. Map and regularly test our internet-facing attack surface. Red-team our AI features (assistants, agents, support bots) against the OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications. Write clear, reproducible, risk-rated findings with practical remediation guidance, walk engineers through fixes and verify them with retests. Workplace: We are a remote-first company with teams located around the Globe and a HQ in Berlin. Who you are: You bring 5+ years of hands-on penetration testing, mainly of web applications and APIs, and can point to recent engagements you’ve led end to end. You have deep, practical knowledge of the OWASP API Security Top 10, WSTG and ASVS, including authentication/authorization models (OAuth2/OIDC, JWT), IDOR/BOLA, mass assignment, SSRF, injection and XSS. You have found business-logic and race-condition vulnerabilities in transactional systems such as booking, e-commerce, payments or fintech. You are fluent with Burp Suite Pro (or similar) and write your own scripts and tooling (Python, Go or similar). You are comfortable assessing cloud and container environments (GCP preferred, Kubernetes) and CI/CD pipelines. You work independently: you scope, prioritise, test and report with minimal guidance, and you explain complex risks plainly to engineers and leadership. You are available to start at short notice. Bonus Points: OSCP, OSWE, BSCP or similar certifications; experience red-teaming LLM applications or AI agents; testing in PCI-DSS environments. What you can expect: You will join a fast-paced travel tech company with a flat organizational structure. You will have exciting opportunities, ownership, and responsibility and contribute directly to the success of the company. You will join an international team of talented and driven people with a clear mission. Expect your colleagues to inspire, support and challenge you every day! We have a flexible work policy with the option of working remotely and international opportunities arising as we continue to expand our global footprint – Our heart is in Berlin, but you’ll find us across the globe. You will get a competitive salary. Our hiring team for this role: Your Talent Partner (TP) and point of contact is Lorena Rebenciuc, and the Hiring Manager (HM) is Ilya Isakov. For any queries, contact your Talent Partner at Do you want to work on a product that is used by millions of people daily with a high load, availability and scalability, and most advanced technology? Come join us! Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Software Engineer - ZTC
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p><strong>Available Locations: Lisbon, London, Austin</strong></p> <p><strong>About the team</strong></p> <p>The Zero Trust Connectivity team builds the hub that connects Cloudflare One and Zero Trust products such as Cloudflare WAN, Cloudflare One Client, Cloudflare Tunnels, Gateway and Workers VPC. Powering this hub is a set of Rust-based services operating on every one of the data-centers that Cloudflare runs. These services route all of Cloudflare One traffic end to end. By leveraging Cloudflare's incredible infrastructure and programming languages such as Rust, this critical service is safe, performant and secure.<br>As Cloudflare Zero Trust set of features evolves, this team is responsible for evolving these hub services to deliver those new capabilities while guaranteeing scalability and reliability as top priority.</p> <p>We are a team of engineers who obsess over building reliable services which leverage Cloudflare's unique architecture and global network footprint.</p> <p>You can read more about what we work on here:</p> <ul> <li><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/introducing-cloudflare-one/">https://blog.cloudflare.com/introducing-cloudflare-one/</a></li> <li><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/from-ip-packets-to-http-the-many-faces-of-our-oxy-framework/">https://blog.cloudflare.com/from-ip-packets-to-http-the-many-faces-of-our-oxy-framework/</a></li> <li><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/workers-vpc-open-beta/">https://blog.cloudflare.com/workers-vpc-open-beta/</a></li> </ul> <p><strong> </strong></p> <p><strong>About the role</strong></p> <p>As a software engineer on the Zero Trust Connectivity team, you will contribute across a wide range of technologies and systems to deliver new solutions that connect Cloudflare One products together. You will build connectivity in a user-space service that can identify and route flows across our global network. This work requires close collaboration with other teams while leveraging powerful frameworks and libraries that power many Cloudflare products. Our technology stack includes Rust, Linux networking, Clickhouse, SaltStack, Prometheus, AI harnesses, and our own Cloudflare Workers platform. We're looking for determined, curious, empathetic engineers to join our team!</p> <p><strong> </strong></p> <p><strong>Desirable skills, knowledge, and experience</strong></p> <ul> <li>Programming experience in Rust</li> <li>Familiar with Layer 3 and Layer 4 Networking</li> <li>Systems-level programming experience in Linux</li> <li>Experience building large-scale, reliable, highly distributed systems</li> <li>Attention to detail and ability to solve complex customer problems</li> <li>Own solutions end-to-end and driving the design, development, and deployment process</li> <li>Able to work across teams and level common, sustainable solutions</li> <li>Creative, open-minded, collaborative problem solver</li> <li>Focus on clarity in written and verbal communication</li> <li>Leveraging AI coding assistants to accelerate development</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>Compensation</strong></p> <p>Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location.</p> <ul> <li><span data-sheets-root="1">For Lisbon based hires: Estimated annual salary of €66,000-83,000</span></li> </ul> <p><strong>Equity</strong></p> <p>This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare’s equity plan.</p> <p> </p><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: We released</span><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">1.1.1.1</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our</span><a href="https://developers.cloudflare.com/1.1.1.1/privacy/public-dns-resolver"> privacy commitment</a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs.  More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.  We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all people and place great value in both diversity and inclusiveness.  All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to their, or any other person's, perceived or actual</span> <span style="font-weight: 400;">race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, family care status, or any other basis protected by law. </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">We are an AA/Veterans/Disabled Employer.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities.  Please tell us if you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job. Examples of reasonable accommodations include, but are not limited to, changing the application process, providing documents in an alternate format, using a sign language interpreter, or using specialized equipment.  If you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job, please contact us via e-mail at </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">hr@cloudflare.com</span><span style="font-weight: 400;"> or via mail at 101 Townsend St. San Francisco, CA 94107.</span></p></div>

title: Founders Associate Intern: AI Product Consultant (m/w/d)
description: We are building the AI platform for procurement. Procurement manages the largest cost in enterprises . With tools from the past, trying to find savings in scattered data systems. Increasing cost pressure puts CPOs on the spot to change this . Our integrated AI agents autonomously run negotiations, ensure contracted savings actually reach the bottom line, and add intelligence to boring, manual tasks. We don’t shy away from tapping into complex data and add intelligence that changes the economics of procurement , moving far beyond simple agentic workflows. We are funded by top tier VCs (10x and Plug and Play) and business angels, and our founders have strategy consulting and high growth startup experience. We are three friends that have known each other for years. We have fun while moving quickly, and care about real outcomes. Tasks You're a Swiss Army knife : technically fluent and brilliant with customers , energized switching between topics five times a day. One hour you're across the table from a CPO making our AI click; the next you're in the product, debugging why an agent didn't deliver and shaping the fix. You want to turn an "interesting AI demo" into a signed enterprise contract with proven value , and you refuse to let great ideas die in translation between customers and techies. This is a Founders Associate role in the truest sense: you work shoulder-to-shoulder with the founders , responsible for Customers and Product, with a front-row seat to how an enterprise AI company actually gets built, and real ownership of product and customer relationships from day one. You'll learn directly from founders who've built and scaled before. You sit at the intersection of product, sales, and the customer , working directly with the founders. Concretely: Build demos that make CPOs lean forward. You craft sharp, tailored demos that turn our agents' capabilities into an obvious "we need this," built around the prospect's real data and real pain, not a generic walkthrough. Drive Proof of Values to success. You support the POV from kickoff to outcome: define what "success" means up front, keep the customer engaged, debug what isn't working, and land a business case the customer can defend internally. Run product discovery end to end. title: Social Media Manager (m/w/d)
description: DEINE MISSION Lust, Ernährung neu zu denken? Bei yfood machen wir seit 2017 gutes Essen alltagstauglich – ausgewogen, praktisch und richtig lecker. Mit unseren Produkten haben wir eine eigene Kategorie geformt: Smart Food. In ganz Europa unterwegs, rasant wachsend und immer auf der Suche nach neuen Ideen. Wenn du Teil eines dynamischen Teams sein möchtest, das die Lebensmittelbranche revolutioniert, dann bist du bei yfood genau richtig. Du postest eh schon jeden Tag. Mach daraus deinen Job. Du scrollst nicht nur – du weißt, warum ein Video durch die Decke geht und warum das nächste floppt. Genau dieses Gespür suchen wir. Der Großteil unserer Reichweite entsteht über Creator, nicht über uns selbst – und weil du selbst postest, sprichst du ihre Sprache und zeigst auf unseren eigenen Kanälen das Beste davon. Die Rolle ist global gedacht: Du denkst unsere Social-Strategie nicht nur für DACH, sondern sparrst dich dabei auch mit unseren internationalen Marketing Leads, zum Beispiel dem Head of Marketing in UK. Die Position ist zunächst als Elternzeitvertretung auf zwei Jahre befristet. Deine Aufgaben als Social Media Manager Strategie, global gedacht: Du entwickelst unsere Social Media Strategie nicht im stillen Kämmerlein in München, sondern im Austausch mit unseren internationalen Marketing Leads. Du hinterfragst HQ-Vorgaben, wenn UK oder ein anderer Markt etwas anderes braucht, und sorgst dafür, dass Strategie und lokale Realität zusammenpassen. TikTok ist dein zweites Zuhause: Du erkennst Trends, bevor sie durch sind, und weißt sofort, welche Formate zu yfood passen und welche nicht. Instagram und YouTube bespielst du mit, aber TikTok ist dein Hauptrevier. Deine eigenen Kanäle, dein Anspruch: Du verantwortest unsere DACH-Kanäle und zeigst dort die stärksten Creator Videos, Produktlaunches und informativen Content. Qualität vor Quantität. Du sprichst Creator-Sprache: Weil du selbst Content machst, schreibst du Briefings, die Raum für eigene Ideen lassen, und gibst Feedback, das Creator tatsächlich weiterbringt, statt sie nur zufriedenzustellen. Du machst Markenmomente viral: Große Produktlaunches, außergewöhnliche Events und Creator Kampagnen bringst du auf Social und bist dabei auch in den Kommentaren mittendrin statt nur Beobachter. Daten sind dein Vibe-Check: Du planst im Redaktionskalender, schaust auf Watch Time, Saves, Shares und Hook Rate und machst konsequent mehr von dem, was funktioniert. Kein Soloprojekt: Du arbeitest eng mit Content & Comms, Influencer & Creator, Creative, Brand Activation, Performance und E-Commerce zusammen. Social ist bei uns nicht einfach nur ein Kanal, sondern das Betriebssystem. DAS MACHT DICH AUS Deine Qualifikationen als Social Media Manager Du bist selbst Social: Aktiv auf TikTok, idealerweise mit eigenem Content – zeig uns gern deinen Kanal. Instagram und YouTube kennst du ebenfalls aus dem Effeff. 2+ Jahre Erfahrung im Social Media Marketing – ob Brand, Agentur, Start-up oder als Creator. Food, FMCG oder Lifestyle sind ein Plus, kein Muss. Plattform-Fluency: Sounds, Duett/Stitch, Green Screen, Reels, Carousels, Shorts – du weißt aus eigener Erfahrung, was wo funktioniert und warum. Creator-Verständnis: Du weißt, wie Creator ticken, und formulierst Briefings und Feedback so, dass sie auch ankommen. Analyse mit Attitüde: Watch Time, Saves, Shares, Hook-Rate sind für dich Steuerrad, kein Selbstzweck. Deutsch & Englisch fließend. WAS UNS ANTREIBT Wir sind ein bisschen anders – und genau das macht uns aus Leidenschaft – Wir brennen für das, was wir tun. Voller Energie, voller Optimismus, immer hungrig nach Neuem. description: <h2><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><strong>Lead AI Enablement Engineer</strong></span></h2> <p><strong>Location: </strong>Belfast</p> <p><strong>Department: </strong>Engineering Enablement</p> <p><strong>Reports to:</strong> VP Enablement</p> <p><strong>Employment Type: </strong>Full time</p> <h2><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><strong>About EverQuote</strong></span></h2> <p>EverQuote’s vision is to make it more efficient to shop for and buy insurance with confidence. We use data, technology and marketplace expertise to connect insurance shoppers with providers and help our customers grow their businesses.</p> <p>As AI becomes part of everyday work across the organisation, we want every colleague, technical or not, to get real value from it. Our enablement teams make that possible by turning new AI capabilities into reliable, trusted services.</p> <h2><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><strong>About the team</strong></span></h2> <p>The Lead AI Enablement Engineer sits within Engineering Enablement and owns the integration, usability and adoption of EverQuote’s enterprise AI services.</p> <p>You will also partner with IT, Security and Platform Engineering on service support and controls, and with data owners on access, privacy and auditability.</p> <h2><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><strong>About the role</strong></span></h2> <p>Help everyone across our organisation get more value from AI. We are looking for a hands-on Lead AI Enablement Engineer to make our AI products and services connected, reliable and useful in everyday work across Finance, Operations, HR, Sales, Engineering and beyond.</p> <p>We already use Claude, and there is significant opportunity to improve the experience through relevant features, connectors, skills and access to trusted knowledge. You will turn that opportunity into working services and practical ways of working that colleagues adopt and value, while evolving our capabilities as AI technology advances.</p> <p>You will lead the technical integration and continuous improvement of these services, combining engineering depth with curiosity about LLMs and a strong customer focus. The role combines hands-on delivery with technical leadership and mentoring.</p> <p>You will shape how an entire organisation works with AI. You will have the opportunity to explore new capabilities, turn promising ideas into dependable services and see the impact directly in colleagues’ daily work. Your technical decisions and customer insight will help define a new AI capability and how it evolves.</p> <h2><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><strong>What you’ll do:</strong></span></h2> <h4><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Own the AI service roadmap:</span></h4> <ul> <li>Understand how colleagues work and identify friction.</li> <li>Prioritise improvements with department leads.</li> <li>Treat technical and non-technical employees as customers, and test changes with them.</li> </ul> <h4><strong>Integrate AI into everyday work</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Configure and administer enterprise AI products.</li> <li>Work closely with other enablement teams to make sure the tooling is fully integrated.</li> <li>Work closely with InfoSec to make sure risks and standards have been met.</li> <li>Build connectors, MCP integrations, APIs and lightweight services that connect approved tools, business systems and knowledge sources.</li> <li>Keep permissions and data access aligned with users’ existing entitlements.</li> </ul> <h4><strong>Turn new capabilities into useful services</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Track model releases, product features and emerging tools.</li> <li>Evaluate quality, usability, cost and risk against real tasks.</li> <li>Recommend, pilot and roll out improvements with clear guidance and a way to reverse unsuccessful changes.</li> </ul> <h4><strong>Create reusable capabilities</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Make skills, shared instructions, workflow templates and agents discoverable, with clear owners, testing and version control.</li> <li>Help teams adapt proven approaches to their own work.</li> </ul> <h4><strong>Show colleagues what is possible</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Run practical demonstrations, workshops, office hours and hands-on sessions using real business workflows.</li> <li>Build a network of departmental champions.</li> <li>Make guidance accessible to different confidence and skill levels.</li> </ul> <h4><strong>Own the end-user experience</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Monitor integration health, answer quality and user feedback.</li> <li>Investigate failures and recurring friction.</li> <li>Coordinate fixes, vendor escalations, change communications and support arrangements with IT, Security and Platform Engineering.</li> </ul> <h4><strong>Provide technical leadership</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Establish integration and evaluation standards.</li> <li>Mentor others and shape vendor decisions.</li> <li>Continuously keep up to date with the latest LLM releases and harnesses to better inform the direction of the organisation.</li> <li>Partner with Security and data owners on access, privacy, auditability and safe tool use.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>What we’re looking for:</strong></h3> <ul> <li>10 years experience in software development with 3+ years in AI</li> <li>Strong hands-on engineering experience building and supporting integrations, internal tools or enterprise services: you write maintainable code, work with APIs and authentication, and diagnose problems across connected systems.</li> <li>Practical experience applying LLMs and AI tools to real workflows used by other people, with an understanding of context, retrieval, tool use and evaluation, the limits of model outputs, and when human review is needed.</li> <li>A sustained interest in AI tooling, demonstrated through experimentation and working solutions. You follow developments actively and can explain which changes are worth adopting, which need more testing and which add little value.</li> <li>A customer-focused approach: you listen, observe how work happens and stay involved until the solution is useful. You can support a non-technical colleague and discuss integration trade-offs with an engineer.</li> <li>Evidence of technical leadership, prioritisation and cross-functional delivery: you can turn broad needs into a practical roadmap, set standards and bring others with you through coaching and clear communication.</li> <li>Experience delivering reliable services with appropriate access controls, testing, monitoring and documentation, and taking ownership of how a capability performs after launch.</li> <li>You do not need experience with every product or tool listed, but experience in several would be valuable:</li> </ul> <ul> <li> <ul> <li>Claude Enterprise or similar enterprise AI products.</li> <li>MCP, reusable skills and agent workflows.</li> <li>Enterprise search and knowledge integration.</li> <li>Python or TypeScript.</li> <li>AWS.</li> <li>SaaS administration, SSO and OAuth.</li> <li>AI adoption programmes and communities of practice.</li> </ul> </li> </ul> <h3><strong>How you work</strong></h3> <p><strong>You put customers first: </strong>You observe how work actually happens, test changes with the people who will use them and stay involved until the solution is useful.</p> <p><strong>You are evidence-led: </strong>You evaluate new capabilities against real tasks, establish baselines with users and use evidence to improve or retire capabilities.</p> <p><strong>You stay curious: </strong>You experiment, follow developments in AI and separate changes worth adopting from those that add little value.</p> <p><strong>You own the integrations and reusable workflows across several departments.</li> <li>Established practical enablement sessions and a feedback loop.</li> </ul> <p>Over time, success means:</p> <ul> <li>Sustained baselines with users, track cost alongside benefit, and use evidence to improve or retire capabilities. title: Account Executive, UK Public Sector
description: <div class="content-intro"><h4><strong>Join Axon and be a Force for Good.</strong></h4> <p>At Axon, we’re on a mission to Protect Life. We’re explorers, pursuing society’s most critical safety and justice issues with our ecosystem of devices and cloud software. Like our products, we work better together. Constantly grow as you work hard for a mission that matters at a company where you matter.</p></div><p><strong>Job Title: Account Executive, UK Public Sector</strong></p> <p> </p> <p>Reporting to: Director of Sales, UK & Ireland</p> <p>Direct Reports: None</p> <p>Location: UK (remote)</p> <p>Travel expectations: Approximately 50%</p> <p><strong> </strong></p> <p><strong>Your Impact</strong></p> <p>As an Account Executive at Axon, you will play a key role in helping police forces across the UK adopt technology that saves lives, reduces risk to officers and the public, and enhances transparency and public trust. Your success will be measured by your ability to build and maintain senior-level relationships, drive large, complex opportunities through public sector procurement, and align Axon's solutions with the mission-critical needs of UK policing. This is a quota-carrying, external field position.</p> <p> </p> <p>At Axon, our goal is to make each individual feel valued for their contribution to the company's mission to protect life. We are looking for intelligent people who want to do remarkable things. We strive to create an environment where people can succeed and enjoy coming to work every day. Life at Axon is fast-paced, challenging and meaningful. Here, you'll take ownership and drive real change. You will constantly grow as you work hard for a mission that matters at a company where you matter.</p> <p><strong> </strong></p> <p><strong>What You'll Do</strong></p> <p><strong>Develop and Execute Account Strategies:</strong> Create comprehensive account strategies that align Axon's solutions with the mission-critical needs of UK police forces, focusing on officer safety, operational efficiency and digital transformation. This will require close collaboration with other internal members of the account team(s).</p> <p><strong>Drive Complex Sales Engagements:</strong> Manage long sales cycles, leading to high-value, multi-year agreements with forces and police-led collaboratives. Facilitate discovery meetings, present Axon's value propositions, and lead customer negotiations.</p> <p><strong>Help increase market share and achieve Axon's strategic objectives</strong> by maximising revenue and customer satisfaction within your designated forces and regions.</p> <p><strong>Support Public Safety Innovation:</strong> Partner with internal teams to present Axon's innovative public safety technologies - such as TASER 10, Axon Body 4, Axon Fleet, Axon Evidence, Axon Respond, Axon Fusus and Axon VR training - demonstrating how these solutions transform force operations and support national productivity and efficiency priorities.</p> <p><strong>Manage Customer Relationships:</strong> Cultivate relationships with both executive and operational leaders within police forces - including Chief Constables, Deputy Chief Constables, Police and Crime Commissioners and their offices, Chief Finance Officers, Heads of Digital/IT and operational commanders. Ensure seamless customer experiences through proactive engagement and problem-solving.</p> <p><strong>Champion Public Safety Outcomes:</strong> Position Axon as a key enabler of UK policing priorities, helping forces meet their operational and safety goals while enhancing transparency, accountability and public confidence.</p> <p><strong>Collaborate with Internal Teams:</strong> Work closely with Axon's customer success, engineering and programme management teams to ensure that customer projects are delivered on time and that forces derive measurable value from Axon's solutions.</p> <p><strong>Navigate UK Public Sector Procurement:</strong> Work with force commercial and procurement teams, national frameworks and police-owned commercial routes to structure compliant, competitive routes to market, and manage the associated governance and approvals.</p> <p><strong>Accurate CRM Management:</strong> Maintain up-to-date records of customer interactions, opportunities and forecasts in Salesforce. title: Senior Manager, New Business DACH & Benelux
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>Who we are </strong></p> <p>At Twilio, we’re shaping the future of communications, all from the comfort of our homes. As we continue to revolutionize how the world interacts, we’re acquiring new skills and experiences that make work feel truly rewarding. Your career at Twilio is in your hands.<br><span style="color: rgb(255, 255, 255);">.</span></p> <p><strong>Hiring and how we work</strong></p> <p>We use Artificial Intelligence (AI) to help make our hiring process efficient. That said, every hiring decision is made by real Twilions! </p> <p>Also, while we are a remote-first company, you may be asked to report in person on an ad-hoc basis for team gatherings, functional off-sites or customer meetings. <br><span style="color: rgb(255, 255, 255);">.</span></p></div><p><strong>See yourself at Twilio</strong></p> <p>Join the team as Twilio’s next Sales Senior Manager, New Business Accounts DACH & Benelux.</p> <p><strong>About the job</strong></p> <p>This position is needed to lead one of our New Business Account Executive teams selling into DACH & Benelux within the EMEA Region. Reporting into our EMEA Regional Vice President for South & DACH, the right person for this role is an experienced sales leader who is adept at building high-performing teams of solution-selling Account Executives disciplined in driving new logo acquisition and expanding market presence.</p> <p><strong>Responsibilities</strong></p> <p>In this role, you’ll:</p> <ul> <li>Build and manage a high performing team of account executives focused on acquiring new enterprise customers and driving new logo growth.</li> <li>Coach and lead a team to identify and execute targeted outbound prospecting strategies across the entire portfolio of Twilio Products.</li> <li>Enable and coach your team around how to engage across various levels of customer maturity and segmentation.</li> <li>Work closely with our Marketing, Professional Services & Partner teams to build a robust pipeline and accelerate time-to-value for new prospects.</li> <li>Forecast your team overachieving on their goals, and deftly present your guidance to your management</li> </ul> <p><strong>Qualifications </strong></p> <p>Twilio values diverse experiences from all kinds of industries, and we encourage everyone who meets the required qualifications to apply. We are always looking for people who will bring something new to the table!</p> <p><strong>*Required:</strong></p> <ul> <li>7+ years of managerial experience within a high performing CPaaS, Communications or API based company. </li> <li>Experience in building teams, driving pipeline creation, managing monthly forecasting, supporting fiscal planning, and tracking revenue for new business accounts.</li> <li>Experience managing a remote team spread across different countries. </li> <li>Consistent track record of exceeding revenue targets and business objectives.</li> <li>Industry experience in selling CPaaS or SaaS and managing complex sales negotiations. </li> <li>Highly analytical and data driven; an innovative thinker and creative problem solver who is naturally curious.</li> <li>A self-starter who can work with minimal supervision to drive results.</li> <li>Comfortable with ambiguity and working cross-functionally in a high growth business landscape.</li> <li>BA/BS degree or equivalent required. </li> <li>Energy and enthusiasm with a willingness to travel. </li> <li>Excellent written and verbal communication skills and strong executive presence. </li> <li>Ability to influence and build effective working relationships with all levels of the organisation.</li> <li>Fluent in German or Dutch</li> </ul> <p><strong>Location</strong></p> <p>This role will be remote, and based in UK, Ireland or Spain.</p> <p><strong>Travel </strong></p> <p>We prioritize connection and opportunities to build relationships with our customers and each other. For this role, approximately 25% travel is anticipated to help you connect in-person in a meaningful way. </p> <p><strong>What We Offer</strong></p> <p>Working at Twilio offers many benefits, including competitive pay, generous time off, ample parental and wellness leave, healthcare, a retirement savings program, and much more. That's why we seek out colleagues who embody our values — something we call <a href="https://www.twilio.com/company/values">Twilio Magic</a>. If this role isn't what you're looking for, <a href="https://www.twilio.com/company/jobs#open-positions">please consider other open positions.</a></p> <p><strong><span style="color: rgb(255, 255, 255);">.</span></strong></p> <p><strong>Stay alert to recruitment fraud</strong></p> <p>We care about your safety. Additionally, Twilio participates in the E-Verify program in certain locations, as required by law.</p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Office Manager (m/w/d)
description: Deine Rolle Als Office Manager (w/m/d) bist du das Herzstück unseres Berliner Offices. Du sorgst dafür, dass im Hintergrund alles funktioniert und sich Kolleg*innen, Kund*innen und Gäste rundum wohlfühlen. Du denkst voraus, behältst den Überblick und packst selbst mit an – vom täglichen Office-Betrieb über Events bis hin zu größeren Projekten wie Umzügen oder Umbauten. Was machst du dabei konkret? Du hältst unser Office am Laufen. Du koordinierst Hausverwaltung, Handwerker und Dienstleister und kümmerst dich um alles, was einen reibungslosen Office-Alltag ausmacht – von Meetingräumen, Bestellungen und Post bis zu Dokumentationen, Reisebuchungen, Rechnungen und Belegen. Auch ausgewählte Themen für unser Münchener Office liegen bei dir. Du bist Gastgeber*in und bringst Menschen zusammen. Du empfängst Kund*innen und Gäste, bereitest Meetings und Catering vor und sorgst dafür, dass unser Office ein Ort ist, an dem man gerne zusammenkommt. Dazu gehören auch unsere internen Events, All Hands sowie die kleinen Dinge, die unsere Office Culture ausmachen – von Geburtstagen bis Merchandise. Du sorgst für einen großartigen Employee Lifecycle. Gemeinsam mit IT und den relevanten Teams organisierst du ein reibungsloses On- und Offboarding und kümmerst dich um organisatorische Themen rund um Wellbeing und Arbeitssicherheit. Du übernimmst Projekte und packst an. Ob Event, Umbau oder Umzug: Du koordinierst Timelines, Budgets und Beteiligte und sorgst dafür, dass es läuft. Und wenn eine Glühbirne gewechselt oder ein Griff festgeschraubt werden muss, machst du das auch einfach selbst. Das bringst du mit Background Du hast eine abgeschlossene kaufmännische Ausbildung, eine Ausbildung in Hotellerie, Gastronomie oder Eventmanagement oder einen vergleichbaren Hintergrund. Entscheidend ist für uns aber nicht dein konkreter Abschluss, sondern dass du bereits relevante praktische Erfahrung mitbringst. Skills und Qualifikationen: Du hast Erfahrung im Office Management, Workplace Management, Hospitality, Eventmanagement oder in einer vergleichbaren Rolle. Du kommunizierst fließend auf Deutsch und Englisch und fühlst dich mit digitalen Tools wohl. Du bist stark in Organisation und Koordination und kannst mehrere Themen gleichzeitig souverän steuern. Erfahrung aus Hotellerie, Gastronomie oder Projektmanagement ist ein Plus. Mindset Hospitality & Service: Du hast Freude daran, dass sich andere willkommen und gut aufgehoben fühlen, und hast ein Auge für die Details, die den Unterschied machen. Ownership & Hands-on: Du siehst, was zu tun ist, übernimmst Verantwortung und findest pragmatische Lösungen – selbst oder mit den richtigen Leuten. Organisation & Ruhe: Du behältst auch dann den Überblick, wenn fünf Dinge gleichzeitig passieren, setzt Prioritäten und sorgst dafür, dass nichts liegen bleibt. Gut zu wissen: Die Position ist in Vollzeit (40 Std./Woche) und wird vor Ort in unserem Berliner Office ausgeübt, so bist du mittendrin im Team und im täglichen Austausch mit deinen Kolleg:innen. Deinen Starttermin stimmen wir flexibel mit dir ab. Du erfüllst nicht alle Anforderungen? Bewirb dich trotzdem bei uns! Wir sind gespannt auf deine Bewerbung! Das bieten wir dir Vielfalt: Flache Hierarchien und kulturelle Offenheit machen dich ab Tag 1 zum integralen Bestandteil unseres bunten Teams aus internationalen Talenten. Flexibilität: Wir machen dein Leben nicht kompliziert. In flexiblen Arbeitsmodellen, Arbeitszeiten und Mobile-Working-Regelungen findest du die richtige Balance. 28 Tage Urlaub und 2 zusätzliche freie Tage am 24. und 31.12. verschaffen dir zudem entspannte Auszeiten. Wertschätzung: Du gestaltest mit uns die Zukunft des digitalen Wealth Managements in einem innovativen, mehrfach ausgezeichneten Unternehmen auf Wachstumskurs, mit hoher Marktrelevanz und viel Raum für deine Ideen. Entwicklung: Wir unterstützen deine persönliche und fachliche Entwicklung mit einem jährlichen Development-Budget von 1.500€. Außerdem erhältst du zu Beginn deiner Tätigkeit bei LIQID ein hochwertiges Equipment, bestehend aus MacBook, Kopfhörern und Display. Smart Money: Als LIQIDian erhältst du attraktive Konditionen für unsere Anlagestrategien, einen monatlichen Lunch-Zuschuss und exklusive Discounts bei verschiedenen Anbietern. Wohlbefinden: Regionale Bio-Produkte halten Dich vor Ort im Office fit – und unsere Gesundheitsinitiativen oder unser Health Assistance Programm auch weit darüber hinaus. So geht es für dich weiter Eine ausgezeichnete Candidate Experience und Transparenz haben für uns im Interviewprozess die höchste Priorität. Die verschiedenen Bewerbungsphasen helfen uns zu verstehen, wie eine Zusammenarbeit aussehen könnte. Erstes Kennenlernen mit unserem Recruiting-Team via Videocall. Videointerview mit deiner zukünftigen Führungskraft: Wir tauschen uns aus, ob deine Erfahrungen und Erwartungen an die Position mit unseren Anforderungen übereinstimmen. Persönliches Kennenlernen: Du triffst das Team und erhältst praktische Einblicke in die Arbeit im Office Management Über uns Wir sind LIQID, einer der führenden digitalen Vermögensverwalter in Europa und eines der am schnellsten wachsenden deutschen Fintechs. Unsere Mission ist es, gleiche Bedingungen für wohlhabende Anlegerinnen und Anleger zu schaffen, indem wir ihnen Zugang zu Expertise und Anlagelösungen ermöglichen, die ihnen bisher verschlossen waren. Dabei setzen wir auf ein Gleichgewicht zwischen Mensch, Umwelt und Profit. Wir bieten unseren Kundinnen und Kunden umfassende Anlagelösungen – von erstklassiger Vermögensverwaltung bis hin zu kuratierten Portfolios aus den weltweit besten Private-Equity- und Venture-Capital-Fonds. Mit einem verwalteten Vermögen von über 3,8 Milliarden Euro gehören wir schon jetzt zu den führenden Vermögensverwaltern in Deutschland. In unserer weiteren Entwicklung arbeiten wir mit starken und erfahrenen Partnern wie LGT , Toscafund , HQ Trust und Project A zusammen. LIQID ist ein Arbeitgeber, der für Chancengleichheit steht. Alle qualifizierten Bewerbungen werden ohne Rücksicht auf Hautfarbe, Alter, Religion, Geschlecht, ethnische und nationale Herkunft, Behinderung oder aufgrund von anderen durch Gleichbehandlungsgesetze geschützte Eigenschaften berücksichtigt. title: Product Marketing Manager
description: Join BLP and help make the world’s business processes autonomous! Our agentic platform helps finance and operations teams worldwide remove manual work from their core business processes, so work runs end-to-end with greater control and significant productivity gains. Today, over 550 enterprise customers use BLP across 1,300+ deployed projects. In the processes we automate, customers achieve productivity improvements of 5 to 10 times. To date, BLP remains majority employee-owned, with Goldman Sachs holding a minority stake as a growth investor. Our success is driven by deep expertise in technology and business processes, a superior product with strong product-market fit, reflected in an expanding customer base that includes Fortune 500 companies. BLP is one of Switzerland's fastest-growing SaaS scale-ups; we are now entering our next phase of growth. From our headquarters on Zürich's Bahnhofstrasse, we're expanding globally, with a growing presence across Europe and North America. Join us and help make autonomous operations the new standard. About the role Agentic process automation is a category enterprises are actively budgeting for - and one crowded with claims. As our Product Marketing Manager, you make sure blp's story cuts through; sharp positioning against the alternatives our buyers actually consider, messaging that speaks to CFOs and COOs in business outcomes rather than technology, and sales teams equipped to win against ERP workflow add-ons, RPA vendors, and point-AI copilots. This is a hands-on individual contributor role at the center of how blp goes to market. You will own the translation layer between product capability and buyer value - across launches, enablement, competitive intelligence, and the content that carries our positioning into every deal. What you'll do Own positioning and messaging execution . Maintain and evolve blp's messaging house: value proposition, pillars, proof points, and persona-specific narratives, and enforce its consistent use across web, decks, campaigns, and sales conversations. Build and maintain competitive intelligence . Own battlecards and competitive positioning against ERP workflow automation, RPA, IDP/point-AI solutions, and adjacent AI platforms; keep sales ahead of competitor moves and objection patterns. Enable the field. Create and maintain the core sales toolkit - first-meeting decks, discovery guides, objection handling, ROI narratives, and persona playbooks for CFO, COO, shared services, and process excellence audiences. Sharpen personas and ICP. Continuously refine our understanding of buying committees, triggers (ERP transformation, e-invoicing mandates, shared-services efficiency programs), and where we win and lose - grounded in win/loss analysis and field feedback. Drive product launches and releases . Turn platform capabilities and new workflow coverage into launch narratives, internal enablement, and external announcements that land with executive buyers. Fuel demand and thought leadership . Supply campaigns, events, and content marketing with differentiated angles, from executive-facing reports to industry-specific value narratives. Bring buyer, analyst, and competitive insight back into product and leadership discussions, even when it complicates the roadmap story, to sharpen framing and packaging. What you'll bring 5–8 years in B2B software marketing, with at least 3 years in product marketing for enterprise SaaS - ideally in ERP-adjacent, finance operations, automation, or applied-AI categories. A portfolio of enablement assets that sales teams actually used - you measure your work by win rates and message adoption, not asset counts. Real substance. 550+ enterprise customers and measurable outcomes mean your positioning rests on proof, not promises. Scope and access. You get a seat at the table with product, sales leadership, and the executive team, and your work goes straight into deals and board narratives. A company at an inflection point. It has a strong European base, fresh US market entry, and a proven platform to build the story on. Learn more about blp and our values at blp.digital/company/careers . title: Full stack engineer
description: About Nabla Nabla delivers a unified clinical AI platform used by healthcare organizations across specialties and care settings. The platform includes: Ambient AI documentation that captures clinical conversations and generates structured notes. AI-powered dictation and clinical workflow tools embedded directly within EHR systems. Agentic AI capabilities that support multi-step clinical and administrative tasks. Enterprise-grade infrastructure built for secure deployment across health systems. The best of AI at the service of healthcare Nabla’s phenomenal traction is the result of 3 years of diligent product development. Led by former Meta AI Research engineers, our team has consistently anticipated how AI can revolutionize healthcare delivery. Our Machine Learning team continually leverages the latest advancements to unlock AI’s full potential in healthcare. Yann LeCun, Meta’s ex-Chief AI Scientist and Turing award winner, is an advisor to Nabla. He’s now focused on AMI Labs, with whom we have a close partnership. Engineering at Nabla Engineering at Nabla is lean, fast-moving, and deeply technical. Our teams span machine learning, native desktop applications, and platform infrastructure to deliver AI into clinical settings reliably and at scale. Your team At Nabla, product development is led jointly by Engineering and Product and organized into cross-functional squads, each focused on a specific product area. Squads bring together product managers, designers, engineers of different profiles, and domain experts, and operate with a high level of ownership. As a Full-stack Engineer, you'll join one of these squads and contribute end to end to a specific part of the product. The technical challenges Volumetry and efficiency: We handle more than 2.5 million medical encounters per month. Structured, analytical, and solution-oriented professional with strong ownership, facilitation, and stakeholder-management skills. description: Your Mission: Join VÆRIDION on our journey to develop the world’s first electric nine-seater aircraft. As Head of Propulsion Battery System (PBS), you will lead VÆRIDION’s PBS department and hold overall technical accountability for the Microliner’s propulsion battery system. The propulsion battery system encompasses the battery cells and packs, the battery management system, high-voltage power distribution and protection, thermal management, charging, and all interfaces to the aircraft, the electric propulsion system and the ground infrastructure. Reporting to the Chief Technology Officer, you will lead a multidisciplinary organisation of around 20 engineers, and growing, spanning electrical systems architecture, airborne electronics, airborne software, cell technology, high-voltage electrical systems, mechanical design and integration, and thermal management. title: Head of Product – SAP (m/f/d)
description: Almost every company running SAP faces the same task: the move to SAP S/4HANA. These programmes run for years, cost tens of millions, and regularly stall at the same point. Nobody fully understands the legacy landscape that has grown over decades. That is where Qorelo comes in. We are building the AI platform for S/4HANA transformation. Qorelo reads code, processes, documentation and how the system is actually used, makes the existing landscape transparent, and delivers the fit-to-standard analysis in weeks instead of months. We take a clean core, target-architecture-first approach and carry it end to end across SAP Activate, from Discover to Realize. The knowledge stays with the customer afterwards, long after the system integrators have moved on. We've raised $3.5M from HPI Ventures, the fund tied to the institute of SAP co-founder Hasso Plattner, along with other strong backers. We already work with Fortune 500 and DAX 40 companies, including Mercedes-Benz. The role We are looking for our first Head of Product. You own what Qorelo builds and why, and you build the product function around it. You lead our solution architects, the people who carry our SAP domain depth, you work hand in hand with our Head of Product Design and the engineering team, and you report directly to the C-level. This is a leadership role at an early-stage company, which means two things at once. You set product strategy and make the big roadmap calls together with the founders, and you still write the spec, sit in the customer workshop and draw the cut line when it matters. Your decisions show up in the product within weeks, running inside some of the largest SAP landscapes in Europe. What you'll own • Product strategy. Where Qorelo goes across the transformation lifecycle, which problems we solve first and which we deliberately leave to others. You turn that into a roadmap the whole company understands. • The roadmap and the calls behind it. You prioritise with evidence from customers, Proofs of Value and the market, and you can defend every call to the founders, to sales and to engineering. • The product team. You lead our two solution architects today and grow the product team as we scale: hiring, coaching and setting the bar. • Discovery with real users. Consultants, SAP leads and transformation teams use Qorelo inside live programmes. You and your team sit with them, see where the product wins and where it falls short, and bring that back as decisions, not just notes. • Product in the sales cycle. You join key customer and partner conversations, shape Proofs of Value with sales, and make sure what we promise matches what we ship. • The bridge between SAP and AI. SAP depth on one side, an AI-native engineering team on the other. You speak enough of both languages that nothing gets lost, and together with our solution architects you make sure what we ship is usable by SAP people, not just correct. • Shipping and outcomes. Specs, acceptance criteria, tradeoffs, cut lines and success metrics. Features reach real users on real landscapes, and you own whether they landed. What you need • 6+ years of professional experience, with deep hands-on SAP experience: S/4HANA transformation, fit-to-standard, and module-level depth in at least one core area such as FI/CO, SD, MM or PP. Whether you come from SAP consulting, solution architecture or product at an SAP ecosystem software company, all of it counts. • 4+ years in product: you've owned a B2B product and its roadmap end to end, prioritised with engineering and shipped to enterprise users. Title doesn't matter, ownership does. • Experience leading people: you have led product managers, solution architects or consultants, and you want to keep building a team. • A command of the SAP transformation lifecycle and SAP Activate deep enough to be credible with CIOs, Heads of SAP and senior consultants at enterprise clients. • Strong AI curiosity: you've actually built or worked hands-on with LLM tooling and formed opinions about where it breaks. • Comfort in an early-stage environment: ambiguity, speed, hands-on work alongside strategy. • Fluent English. German is a plus for our DACH client base, but not expected. You might be a fit if • You've sat inside an S/4HANA programme and thought "half of this should be software", and you can name which half. • Consultants trust you on module questions and engineers trust you to write a clear spec. You've taken a product from its first enterprise customers to something repeatable, and you know what you would do differently next time. • You know the SAP tool landscape, from Cloud ALM to Signavio and LeanIX, and where the gaps between them are. • You want your product decisions to run inside DAX 40 landscapes within weeks, not sit in a committee for quarters. What we offer • Real ownership. A seat at the leadership table, meaningful equity and a direct hand in the company's direction. We're looking for people who want to shape a company, not join one. • Competitive salary, benchmarked for product leadership in Berlin. • The problems. Fortune 500 and DAX 40 production landscapes, including Mercedes-Benz. Your roadmap runs at the core of companies most product leaders only read about. • The team. Short paths, fast decisions, and a direct line to the founders, engineers and architects who build what you define. • 25 days paid vacation plus German public holidays. • Company offsites with the whole team. • An office at the Wasserturm in Prenzlauer Berg. This role works from the office, because product decisions here happen in the room with the architects and engineers. • Wellhub membership, top-tier equipment and access to the latest AI tools. Hiring process 1. Intro call with our CTO Marino (30 min) 2. Deep dive on your SAP and product background with Louis, our CEO (45 min) 3. On-site workshop: a product strategy exercise with the team, including our solution architects and our Head of Product Design 4. description: About Dataleap Dataleap is the agentic operating system for the enterprise: a coding agent for business users. The next, you're running an agent hackathon at a customer or testing a new segment. What you'll do Drive strategic projects. Work with the founders on top priorities, bringing research, analysis and clear recommendations to key decisions. Make our customers win with Dataleap. Build alongside customers, prove the value with the first agents, and scale adoption, from hackathons to C-suite rollout strategy. Shape our go-to-market. Explore segments, test growth plays, support enterprise deals, and sharpen how we tell the Dataleap story. Connect customers and product. Turn customer insights into concrete feedback and help shape our product. Run growth as an agentic system. Agentify your way out of the job. Own projects end-to-end. You're high agency with a high clock speed. You drive the agenda, prioritize ruthlessly, and communicate sharply and to the point. You're low ego and high ownership. You'll do the unsexy work without flinching. You want to work hard and be deeply obsessed. You're commercially sharp. Renewals, expansion and navigating many stakeholders are second nature. You're great with people. You can walk into a room of executives and lead it, and customers and senior stakeholders trust you quickly. You speak native German and fluent English , and you're based in Munich or ready to move here. I'll index heavily on energy, values and slope. Why join us We're in a unique moment in time. For the next few years, enterprise agents will reshape how people work, and we're at the epicenter of that shift. We're looking for the first 15 exceptional people to lead this change. You'll work side by side with the founders, own projects that move the company, and help build the foundations of our Munich office. You'll be at the frontier of how the world's biggest companies change, and you'll grow even faster than they do. You'll build alongside ex-founders who know what it takes to break through walls. Bring your energy, take ownership, and build with us. How we work We operate like athletes. High standards, high output, and we enjoy the ride together. title: Senior Systems & Infrastructure Engineer
description: Join SE3 Labs as Senior Systems & Infrastructure Engineer Join our new Software Platform team and make the devices, networks and compute behind SE3's autonomy run reliably, so our engineers can focus on what they do best. About SE3 SE3 Labs builds spatial intelligence and autonomy software for unmanned systems. We combine 3D computer vision, state estimation and AI to help autonomous platforms perceive their surroundings, know where they are and operate when GPS and other sensors become unreliable. Defence is a core application of our work today. We are growing to a team of 100+ people. Join at a stage where you can shape our Software Platform team , help build the team and grow your responsibilities as the company expands. Our founding team's research has received more than 90,000 citations. You will work closely with technical founders and engineers with deep experience in computer vision and autonomous systems, turning that research depth into systems that work in the field. About the Role As Senior Systems & Infrastructure Engineer, you'll be a founding member of our new Software Platform team and own everything infrastructure apart from cybersecurity: software distribution to our platforms, device provisioning, networks, our compute cluster and CI. You'll work on-site in Munich alongside our cybersecurity engineer and the CV, robotics and firmware teams, with occasional visits to our second site. What You'll Work On Over-the-Air Updates: Unify our separate update and software distribution setups for Jetson, NXP and other edge nodes into one reliable system for every platform. Device Provisioning: Provision, configure and maintain Linux-based edge devices, workstations and ground systems, including ARM64 platforms. Deployment Automation: Build reproducible container images, deployments, device configuration, release workflows and recovery procedures, with Bash and Python tooling. Networks & Remote Access: Design and troubleshoot connectivity across networked and remote devices, including routing, SSH, VPNs, firewalls and constrained field links. Compute Cluster & CI: Make our GPU compute and evaluation cluster and self-hosted CI runners reliable, so engineers can depend on them without manual recovery. Monitoring & Documentation: Improve monitoring, service availability, security hygiene and operational documentation, working closely with our cybersecurity engineer. Engineering Standards: Set the infrastructure standards our teams follow, and support firmware, robotics, CV and test teams in the lab and the field. Your Profile You take ownership across many areas at once and enjoy covering several roles in a small team, from planning a system to fixing it by hand. You hold a degree in Computer Science or a closely related field. You bring around five years of hands-on experience in infrastructure, DevOps or Linux systems engineering, ideally in a small IT or platform team, and you can point to real systems you built and ran. You have distributed and updated software across large fleets of devices, whether laptops, servers or embedded systems. You have strong Linux administration and troubleshooting skills, write reliable Bash and Python automation, and understand your systems well enough to catch the edge cases tools miss. You can debug IP networks end to end, including routing, DNS, SSH, VPNs and firewalls, and you're experienced with Docker and container deployment. You speak fluent English; German is a plus. Given the nature of SE3's work in the defence sector, candidates must be eligible to work on defence-related projects and, where required, obtain the relevant security clearance. Especially Valued Bonus Skills Embedded Linux on NVIDIA Jetson or NXP, Yocto/BSP, flashing or hardware bring-up. GPU compute clusters, Slurm or Kubernetes, and self-hosted GitHub Actions runners. Infrastructure automation or observability with Ansible, Terraform, Prometheus or Grafana. ROS 2/DDS, MAVLink or field robotics. Involvement in technical student groups or societies during university. Perks & Benefits Real Ownership: Participate in SE3's growth through our employee participation programme Work Environment to Excel at: Find a high-quality and modern toolset, flat hierarchy and a skilled, driven team which will push the limits together with you AI-boosted workplace: We empower every employee with best-in-class AI tools and agents, giving you unlimited access to the latest advancements and a true productivity edge 31 Paid Days Off: 30 vacation days plus your birthday off Well-being Access: Free membership to gyms, yoga, and wellness through EGYM Wellpass Team Offsites: We go on 2 company retreats per year, our last ones were in Italy and Greece Mentorship: Work closely with experienced engineers and get paired with a professional mentor to support your growth Our Process Intro Call (30 min): Let's get to know each other. Technical Interview (60 min): We discuss software distribution, networking and how you approach problems across a broad infrastructure stack. On-site Interviews: Meet engineers from our CV, robotics and platform teams and work through real infrastructure scenarios together. Team Dinner / Lunch: Meet the team and see whether it is a strong fit on both sides. Equal Opportunity SE3 is an equal-opportunity employer committed to building a diverse and inclusive team. All qualified candidates will be considered for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, or any other characteristic protected under applicable law.
