Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p><strong>Available Location: Sydney</strong>, <strong>Australia</strong></p> <hr> <h3><strong>What you will do as a Customer Engineer</strong></h3> <p>The Customer Engineer (CE) is the core driver of our technical go-to-market strategy: a trusted technical advisor and primary architect of the customer journey. You will bridge the gap between technical strategy and business value—guiding enterprise clients from initial pre-sales technical validation through onboarding, deployment architecture, and full lifecycle expansion. Sitting within the GTM organization and reporting to a Customer Engineering Leader, you will not hand off your customers once an initial agreement is reached. Instead, you will operate as a quota-carrying technologist, leveraging AI-augmented workflows to eliminate administrative toil so you can focus on high-value architectural design and driving measurable business outcomes across the entire customer journey.</p> <p><strong>Key Responsibilities</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Technical Validation: </strong>Partner closely with Account Executives to lead technical deep-dive discovery, capture business requirements, and map complex customer infrastructure - DNS, CDN, Zero Trust, Network Security, Workers - to fit-for-purpose Cloudflare architectures and bespoke solutions. . Define, scope, success criteria, and technical evaluations plans for Proof of Concepts (PoCs) and Technical Validations. Deliver tailored technical presentations, architectural diagrams, and demonstrations that show how Cloudflare solves specific performance, security, and reliability challenges. Proactively address complex technical objections, security compliance questions, and edge-case architectural requirements during the sales cycle. Take accountability for a suitable solution deployment strategy (Customer, Partner or Cloudflare Professional services) being an integral part of all proposals.</li> <li><strong>Customer Adoption & Value Realization: </strong>Provide oversight to technical onboarding and implementation, but not execute the implementation, serving as the primary executive and engineering contact for the customer. Design structured migration and onboarding blueprints tailored to the customer’s environment (e.g. DNS migrations, Zero Trust rollouts, WAF tuning guidance), and act as the lead consultant for customer engineering teams, walking them step-by-step through configuration best practices.  Partner with Account Executives to own discovery, demos, onboarding, technical health, risk, and expansion strategy. Proactively monitor customer health scores and telemetry to ensure rapid time-to-value, resolve integration bottlenecks, and reduce deployment risk.</li> <li><strong>Commercial Accountability & Expansion: </strong>Carry a variable quota tied directly to new business acquisition and/or ongoing account growth. Be commercially accountable for ensuring deep platform adoption, retaining revenue, and identifying strategic cross-sell and up-sell opportunities based on product usage data. Lead technical Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) to translate platform capabilities into return on investment for C-level executives.</li> <li><strong>Trusted Advisory: </strong>Act as a trusted technical advisor throughout the entire customer lifecycle, maintaining a continuous, deep relationship with key stakeholders from initial onboarding through maturity, renewal, and expansion. Provide thought partnership on architecture, AI control layers, security posture, and deployment confidence. Identify potential deployment risks or integration bottlenecks early, and provide remediation strategies to de-risk customer outcomes. </li> <li><strong>AI Orchestration & Workflow Automation: </strong>Leverage AI agents, Large Language Models (LLMs), and internal platforms to automate routine tasks such as RFP/Security Questionnaire responses, sandbox provisioning, basic telemetry monitoring, and internal/external documentation, reclaiming your time for strategic customer advisory.</li> <li><strong>Education & Enablement:</strong> Partner closely with the Enablement Team to design, build, and govern technical resources. Define, document, and educate both internal teams and customers on deliverables such as Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), architectural best practices, and technical guides to continuously raise the technical baseline across the organization.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Minimum Qualifications</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience: Experience in a customer-facing technical role, such as Solutions Engineering, Customer Engineering, Professional Services,  Sales Engineering, Technical Account Management, or as a Forward Deployed Engineer (years of experience required will vary based on Associate, Senior, Staff, or Principal leveling).</li> <li>Architectural Mindset: Ability to white-board, design, and articulate complex enterprise network and security architectures clearly.</li> <li>Consultative & Advisory Skills: Excellent communication skills with the ability to translate deeply technical concepts into business outcomes for both hands-on engineers and C-level executives.</li> <li>Commercial Mindset: Proven track record of operating in a quota-carrying or revenue-aligned environment, with a strong understanding of SaaS metrics, business value translation, and enterprise sales cycles.</li> <li>Communication: Exceptional presentation and stakeholder management skills, capable of bridging the gap between deep technical implementation details and high-level C-suite business strategy.</li> <li>Technical Breadth: We do not expect every candidate to be an expert in every domain. Qualified candidates will demonstrate depth in at least four of the technical areas below:</li> <ul> <li>Internet fundamentals: Deep understanding of how the Internet works, including OSI Model layers 1–7, BGP, GRE, TCP/UDP, DNS (authoritative and recursive), HTTP(S), and SSL/TLS.</li> <li>Security: Expertise in the security of Internet properties, including WAF, Bot Management, Firewalls, Rate Limiting, (M)TLS, Zero Trust, and SASE concepts.</li> <li>Performance: Expertise in the performance of Internet properties, including speed, latency, caching, video streaming, HTTP/2, and TLS 1.3.</li> <li>AI Proficiency: Familiarity with prompt engineering, AI-assisted scripting and log analysis, LLM utilization, and workflow automation to augment everyday CE workflows.</li> <li>Coding/Scripting: Proficiency in Python, JavaScript, Bash, Lua, Go, or similar languages to write custom integration scripts, API connectors, and edge computing functions.</li> <li>Developer Platform Fluency: Experience designing, building, deploying or scaling applications using RESTful/GraphQL APIs, SDKs, webhooks, and developer tooling in cloud-native environments. Familiarity with infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, Pulumi), CI/CD pipelines, and observability for developer-led deployments.</li> </ul> </ul> <p><strong>Strongly Preferred Qualifications (The "Good-to-Haves")</strong></p> <ul> <li>Technical Enablement: Track record of creating and delivering technical enablement - workshops, code samples, documentation, or developer onboarding - that accelerates customer adoption of complex platforms. </li> <li>Applied AI Knowledge: Experience with LLM orchestration, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) architectures, and model-access controls.</li> <li>Regulatory Knowledge: Understanding of regulatory requirements such as PCI DSS, HIPAA, and SOC 2.</li> <li>Hyperscaler / Digital Native Background: Talent coming out of hyperscalers, digital natives, distributed systems environments, or startups is strongly valued for its deeper cloud fluency and advanced architecture depth.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Education</strong></p> <p>Undergraduate or graduate degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field. </p> <p><strong>Travel</strong></p> <p>This role may require travel up to 20–50% to attend customer meetings, conferences, industry events, and in-person team collaboration.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: We released</span><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">1.1.1.1</span></a><

title: Principal Java Engineer - Distributed Systems, Serverless - Elasticsearch
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale — unleashing the potential of businesses and people. The Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than 50% of the Fortune 500, brings together the precision of search and the intelligence of AI to enable everyone to accelerate the results that matter. By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data — securing and protecting private information more effectively — Elastic’s complete, cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI.</p></div><h3><strong>What Is The Role:</strong></h3> <p>We are on the lookout for a <strong>Principal Software Engineer</strong><span style="margin: 0px; padding: 0px;"><strong> </strong></span>to join our <strong>Elasticsearch - Distributed Systems team </strong>and focus on how Elasticsearch provides scale, performance, and resilience, especially in the context of our Serverless offering. This covers both technical design and working with others to develop needed components.</li> <li>You have experience managing projects involving multiple engineers.</li> <li>You have a proven track record of using AI to accelerate development, debug complex systems, and optimize code, while still owning the final outcomes.</li> <li>You possess the ability to collaborate across functions and teams and seamlessly transition between different projects, codebases, or teams based on business priorities</li> <li>You can work autonomously, drive decisions and results in a distributed team by leveraging asynchronous, direct, and transparent communication.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Bonus Points:</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Data stores</li> <li>Search, analytics, Lucene</li> <li>Strong knowledge of the JDK</li> <li>Asynchronous event-driven network frameworks such as Netty</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><h2><strong>Additional Information - We Take Care of Our People</strong></h2> <p>As a distributed company, diversity drives our identity. Whether you’re looking to launch a new career or grow an existing one, Elastic is the type of company where you can balance great work with great life. Your age is only a number. It doesn’t matter if you’re just out of college or your children are; we need you for what you can do.</p> <p>We strive to have parity of benefits across regions and while regulations differ from place to place, we believe taking care of our people is the right thing to do.</p> <ul> <li>Competitive pay based on the work you do here and not your previous salary</li> <li>Health coverage for you and your family in many locations</li> <li>Ability to craft your calendar with flexible locations and schedules for many roles</li> <li>Generous number of vacation days each year</li> <li>Increase your impact - We match up to $2000 (or local currency equivalent) for financial donations and service</li> <li>Up to 40 hours each year to use toward volunteer projects you love</li> <li>Embracing parenthood with minimum of 16 weeks of parental leave</li> </ul> <p>Different people approach problems differently. We need that. Elastic is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating an inclusive culture that celebrates different perspectives, experiences, and backgrounds. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, ethnicity, color, religion, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender perception or identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, disability status, or any other basis protected by federal, state or local law, ordinance or regulation.</p> <p>We welcome individuals with disabilities and strive to create an accessible and inclusive experience for all individuals. title: Senior Data & AI Architect
description: <p><strong>Who/What is Artefact?</strong><br>Artefact is a next-generation strategy and data consulting firm dedicated to transforming organizations through data and AI. We combine the rigor of top-tier strategy consulting with deep expertise in data, digital, and analytics to help clients achieve tangible<br>business impact.<br>With 1,800+ consultants, data scientists, and engineers across 23 countries, we work with global leaders such as Samsung, L’Oréal, Orange, and Sanofi. Our Zurich office is at the heart of Artefact’s growth, advising clients on their most pressing strategic challenges — from AI strategy and governance to digital transformation roadmaps and new business model design.</p> <p> </p> <div><strong>The role:</strong></div> <div> </div> <div>We are looking for a Senior Data & AI Architect who combines business strategy and technology across Data and GenAI. You will design the operating model and the organization of the Data & GenAI CoE, define the target architecture, and steer data products from demand through to rollout.</div> <div> </div> <div><strong>Key responsibilities:</strong></div> <div> </div> <div>Operating model and organization</div> <ul> <li> <div>Design the Data & AI operating model (centralized, federated, hub-and-spoke) following Data Mesh principles: roles, responsibilities, domain ownership and governance mechanisms.</div> </li> <li> <div>Define the organization of the Data & GenAI CoE: scope, service catalogue, skills, sizing and engagement model with business domains.</div> </li> <li> <div>Design end-to-end processes for demand management, use case prioritization, funding and value tracking.</div> </li> </ul> <div>Architecture and technology choices</div> <ul> <li> <div>Define the target data platform architecture on cloud (Azure, AWS, GCP) and Databricks, including GenAI components (RAG, agents, vector stores, LLMOps).</div> </li> <li> <div>Run make-or-buy analyses and vendor selections: scouting, evaluation criteria, business case, TCO and final recommendation.</div> </li> <li> <div>Check that architecture, security and data governance choices are consistent with enterprise standards and with the operating model.</div> </li> </ul> <div>Data products: from demand to rollout</div> <ul> <li> <div>Gather and formalize functional requirements with the business, translating them into data products with owners, consumers, SLAs and quality metrics.</div> </li> <li> <div>Design data products from both a functional angle (use cases, KPIs, impacted processes) and a technical one (data model, pipelines, interfaces, serving layer).</div> </li> <li> <div>Act as design authority during implementation: review system integrator solutions and oversee quality, progress and risks of the rollout.</div> </li> </ul> <div><strong>Requirements:</strong></div> <ul> <li> <div>At least 4 years of professional experience in IT.</div> </li> <li> <div>At least 2 years on projects focused on AI/GenAI, Data Mesh and functional requirements gathering.</div> </li> <li> <div>Consulting experience, ideally in strategy consulting, combined with experience at a system integrator or delivery firm.</div> </li> <li> <div>Hands-on experience designing operating models, Data/AI organizations or CoEs.</div> </li> <li> <div>Experience with make-or-buy analyses, vendor selection or target architecture definition.</div> </li> <li> <div>Excellent written and spoken English.</div> </li> </ul> <div>Technical and functional skills:</div> <div>You will not be expected to write code, but you need to know the technologies well enough to assess them, challenge vendors and spot a flawed setup.</div> <ul> <li> <div>Data Mesh and governance: domain ownership, data products, federated governance, data contracts, catalogues and lineage (e.g. Unity Catalog, OpenMetadata, Collibra).</div> </li> <li> <div>Cloud: data and AI PaaS services on at least one of Azure, AWS and GCP; security, networking and FinOps principles.</div> </li> <li> <div>Databricks: Lakehouse, Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, Workflows; ability to assess design and cost.</div> </li> <li> <div>GenAI: RAG and agentic architectures, LLMOps, model evaluation, platforms such as Azure AI Foundry, Vertex AI and Integrationen sind das, was diesem Motor echte Power gibt: die Daten, Tools und Systeme, die aus einem cleveren AI-Agenten einen machen, der Prozesse wirklich automatisiert und Probleme löst.</strong></p> <p>Gegründet im Jahr 2020, ist Superchat heute die Plattform für über <strong>10.000 Unternehmen weltweit</strong> - von bekannten Marken wie Allianz, Auto1, Enpal, Danone und GASAG bis hin zu kleinen Unternehmen, Zahnarztpraxen und Solo-Founder:innen, die professioneller auftreten möchten.</p> <p>Inzwischen laufen täglich <strong>Millionen von Nachrichten</strong> über Superchat.</p> <p>Gestartet sind wir als Unified Inbox - ein zentraler Ort für alle Kommunikationskanäle wie WhatsApp, E-Mail, SMS oder Instagram. Mit dem Aufstieg von ChatGPT begann unser nächstes Kapitel: AI Agents, die über Chat, E-Mail und Voice in einer Qualität kommunizieren, die mit den besten menschlichen Teams mithalten kann.</p> <p>Heute sind wir ein Team von rund <strong>100 Mitarbeitenden</strong>, arbeiten profitabel und haben insgesamt <strong>18 Millionen Euro Funding</strong> eingesammelt (unsere letzte Finanzierungsrunde liegt bereits 4,5 Jahre zurück - seitdem wachsen wir aus eigener Kraft weiter).</p> <p>Unser Hauptsitz ist in Berlin. </p> <p><em>In diesem Praktikum im AI & Automation Squad hilfst du unseren Kund:innen, unsere KI-Features wirklich einzusetzen, hältst die operativen Abläufe im Hintergrund am Laufen und unterstützt unser Product Marketing. KI-Expert:in musst du dafür nicht sein - genau das lernst du hier.</em></p> <p data-pm-slice="1 1 []"><strong>Das Praktikum ist in Vollzeit, dauert 6 Monate und startet so bald wie möglich in Berlin.</strong></p> <h4><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong>Who We Want</strong></span></h4> <p data-lfile-container="d64d8663-7ac9-42d2-a1b9-4217c33bcd2e" data-pm-slice="1 1 []"><strong>Customer-facing at heart.<br></strong>Du bist gerne im direkten Austausch mit Kund:innen, ob am Telefon oder im Meeting. Du hörst zu, verstehst, was dein Gegenüber braucht, und stellst dich auf jede Person individuell ein.</p> <p><strong>Explains tech in plain language.</strong><br>Du kannst technische Themen so einfach erklären, dass sie auch Menschen verstehen, die nicht in der Tech-Branche arbeiten.</p> <p><strong>Hands-on, not just interested.</strong><br>Du probierst ein Tool lieber aus, als nur darüber zu lesen. Wenn etwas Neues kommt, klickst du dich rein, testest herum und findest heraus, wie es funktioniert.</p> <p><strong>Takes ownership.</strong><br>Du wartest nicht auf Schritt-für-Schritt-Anleitungen. Du übernimmst Aufgaben, treibst sie selbst voran und stellst Fragen, wenn du sie brauchst.</p> <p><strong>Fluent German.</strong><br>Du sprichst fließend Deutsch, denn die meisten deiner Kundengespräche finden auf Deutsch statt.</p> <h4><span style="text-decoration: underline;">Who We Don’t Want</span></h4> <ul data-lfile-container="d64d8663-7ac9-42d2-a1b9-4217c33bcd2e" data-pm-slice="3 3 []"> <li>Du kommst nicht vom Fachjargon los - du sprichst in Anglizismen und Tech-Begriffen und tust dich schwer, dich auf eine:n SMB-Inhaber:in am Telefon einzustellen</li> <li>Du willst reine Marketing- oder Content-Arbeit machen und Calls oder Customer-Success-Meetings lieber vermeiden</li> <li>Du brauchst ständige Anleitung und wartest auf Schritt-für-Schritt-Vorgaben, statt Verantwortung zu übernehmen</li> <li>Du redest viel über den KI-Hype, hast die Tools aber noch nie selbst genutzt oder etwas damit gebaut</li> </ul> <h4><span style="text-decoration: underline;">Your Day To Day</span></h4> <p data-lfile-container="d64d8663-7ac9-42d2-a1b9-4217c33bcd2e" data-pm-slice="1 1 []"><span style="text-decoration: underline;">AI Adoption & Customer Success (~50%)</span><strong><br></strong></p> <ul> <li data-lfile-container="d64d8663-7ac9-42d2-a1b9-4217c33bcd2e" data-pm-slice="1 1 []"> <div> <div> <div> <div> <div> <div> <div> <div> <div> <div> <div> <div> <div> <div> <div> <p>Du führst Customer-Success-Meetings mit unseren Kund:innen und unterstützt sie dabei, das Beste aus den KI-Features von Superchat herauszuholen.</p> </div> </div> </div> </div> </div> </div> </div> </div> </div> </div> </div> </div> </div> </div> <div> <div> <div> </div> </div> </div> </div> </li> </ul> <p><span style="text-decoration: underline;">AI Operations (~20%) </span></p> <ul> <li>Du übernimmst Verantwortung für die operativen Prozesse rund um unsere KI-Features und sorgst dafür, dass alles reibungslos läuft. Dabei arbeitest du eng mit dem Product Team zusammen und bekommst tiefe Einblicke, wie unsere AI Agents funktionieren.</li> </ul> <p><span style="text-decoration: underline;">Product Marketing (~30%) </span></p> <ul> <li>Du unterstützt unser Product Marketing über Social Media, E-Mail-Kampagnen, Intercom und HubSpot und sorgst dafür, dass unsere KI-Launches auch wirklich bei unseren Kund:innen ankommen.</li> </ul> <h4>Why People Choose Us</h4> <ul> <li>Wir glauben an Zusammenarbeit vor Ort: Wir sind gerne gemeinsam im Berliner Office. Genau dort entstehen die besten Ideen, Entscheidungen werden schneller getroffen, wir lernen voneinander und wachsen als Team enger zusammen. Etwas Flexibilität für Remote Work bieten wir, aber unser Default und unsere Energie liegen im gemeinsamen Office-Alltag</li> <li>Wir sind ein internationales Team mit unterschiedlichsten kulturellen Hintergründen und Sprachen - Offenheit, gegenseitiger Respekt und der Austausch verschiedener Perspektiven prägen unsere Zusammenarbeit</li> <li>Wir schätzen Ambition und Motivation - wir suchen Menschen, die Verantwortung übernehmen, Initiative zeigen und Lust haben, sich schnell weiterzuentwickeln</li> <li>Wir arbeiten mit hoher Eigenverantwortung und einer starken Lernmentalität - Fragen stellen, neugierig bleiben und sich kontinuierlich verbessern gehört bei uns dazu</li> <li>Wir legen Wert auf Humbleness und Teamgeist - no Ego, offenes Feedback und die Bereitschaft voneinander zu lernen sind uns wichtiger als Titel</li> </ul> <p><strong>Benefits & culture</strong></p> <ul> <li>Regelmäßige Firmen- und Teamevents</li> <li>Eine integrative und aufregende Start-up-Kultur, die schnelles berufliches und persönliches Wachstum ermöglicht</li> <li>Schönes Büro im Herzen von Berlin (Prenzlauer Allee 242) mit kostenlosen Snacks, Getränken und bester Ausstattung</li> </ul> <p><strong>We want to build a community, not just a company.</strong></p> <p>Uns ist wichtig, ein Umfeld zu schaffen, in dem Menschen wirklich gerne Zeit miteinander verbringen - egal ob beim HYROX-Training, Golfen, Beer-Pong-Turnieren, Running Clubs, Warhammer, gemeinsamen Wochenendaktivitäten oder welcher Community auch immer du hier aufbauen möchtest!</p> <p><strong>Wir sind davon überzeugt, dass Diversität Unternehmen besser macht. Wir freuen uns über alle Bewerber:innen. Unabhängig von Gender, Herkunft, Nationalität oder Glaube. Fühl dich frei und schicke uns gerne deine Bewerbung!</strong></p> <p><strong>Mit deiner Bewerbung stimmst du unseren Datenschutzrichtlinien zu.</strong></p> <p><strong>Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung! 🙂</strong></p> <p> </p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><img src="https://i.imgur.com/Uicf3C7.jpg" alt="" width="800" style="max-width: 100%;"></p></div> Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Graduate Trading Operations Analyst - Instrument Operations

You will help run and improve the operational processes that support our trading platform and the instruments available to customers. Develop the knowledge required to support complex instrument and trading-related queries. Contribute to team projects and wider operational improvements. The ability to work effectively both independently and with others. Nice to have An interest in financial markets, investing, instruments or financial technology. Exposure to data analysis, automation or technical tools through university, an internship, extracurricular activities or personal interest. Knowledge of SQL, Python, APIs or similar tools. German language skills at C1 level or above. What we offer Challenges that will help you develop and realise your potential quickly. Meaningful responsibility and the opportunity to make an impact early in your career. The chance to improve services used by millions of investors. Smart, high-performing colleagues who share a common goal. An environment where ideas are valued and existing processes can be challenged. A generous remuneration package. Bring your ambition to Europe’s fastest-growing mobile broker! We thank all applicants, but only candidates selected for interview will be contacted. title: Security Associate - Internship
description: Health can’t wait . Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t. Alan exists to end the wait. Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way. So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience. We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture . We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR. Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond. ⭐ SECURITY ASSOCIATE INTERNSHIP ⭐ Six-month end-of-studies internship in Paris. Looking for an end-of-studies internship where you do real cybersecurity work, not a side project nobody uses? Alan protects the health data of more than 1M members, and keeping it safe is part of everyday work here. You join the Security team as a full member for six months. Topics span from compliance and certifications to vulnerabilities, detection and incident response, and you have room to pick the ones where you can have the most impact. A dedicated coach guides you and supervises your thesis. The goal at the end is a full-time job at Alan. ⭐ DETAILED MISSIONS ⭐ Alan is opening new countries, and each one brings more audits, certifications and customer security reviews. Possible topics span from governance and compliance to hands-on technical work. You won't do all of them: with your coach, you choose the ones that matter most for Alan and for you. Governance, risk and compliance: ISO 27001 and HDS (French health data hosting) certifications, statutory IT audit, customer security reviews, risk management Vulnerability management: triage reports and scanner findings, drive fixes with engineering teams, improve our tooling Detection and response: write detection rules, investigate alerts, support the team on incidents Build: technical projects you own from framing to adoption. Top of the range equipment: Macbook Pro, keyboard, laptop stand, monitor, and Bose noise-canceling headphones. Flexible vacation policy and flexible working hours . Organize your time as you wish. Transport . Country-specific commuter benefits. Learning & Training opportunities . A highly flexible Training policy free books and budget to attend and speak at conferences if the opportunity arises. title: Financial Controller - Disability and Life Insurance

And beyond. 📈 Finance community at Alan Finance & Strategy exists to enable better decisions, faster, at every level of the company, in a regulated, diverse and ever-changing business. We succeed when ambitious goals become credible plans, when strategic bets are grounded in financial reality, and when the entire company (not just Finance!) speaks the language of performance. We set the right ambition, we monitor whether we're getting there, and we raise our hand when something needs to change. We are not record-keepers. We are builders, partners, and challengers. We are looking for people who want to build, support decision-making processes and challenge the status quo. The core responsibilities of the Finance & Strategy community are: Strategy & Planning: steers Alan's financial performance through business planning, financial and operational monitoring, investor relations and financing Financial Reporting: is the steward of Alan's financial truth, ensuring that we produce accurate, timely financial data. It owns the reporting to all key stakeholders (board, leadership team, tax authorities, and regulators like the ACPR) and ensures that financial data is the single, uncontested source of truth for the company's performance Finance Data and Operations: Build and own the core finance data and tooling infrastructure (models, pipelines, and concepts that connect business operations to financial reality). This is where Finance meets product thinking Functional poles with end-to-end ownership of their domain: Treasury, Procurement, M&A ⭐️ The insurance controller role ⭐️ Our insurance scope is growing fast: more complex reinsurance treaties, prévoyance (disability and death cover) moving in-house, new products and markets. At the same time, Finance is taking over the Solvency 2 balance sheet, which will be audited from 2028. We’re looking for a rigorous, ownership-driven insurance finance professional to own our prévoyance technical flows and the production of the Solvency 2 balance sheet. You’ll join the Financial Controlling team (within Financial Reporting) and act as the hub between Risk, Actuarial, Ops, Data and Strategy, as well as the main contact for our reinsurers and external auditors. You’ll know these numbers inside out: how they’re produced, what business reality they reflect, and how to defend them to auditors, the ACPR and the Board. You read the source texts yourself (accounting rules, Solvency 2 regulation, treaty clauses), form your own view, and know when to escalate. ⭐️ What you will do ⭐️ Prévoyance flows: own premiums, claims, technical provisions (mathematical and claims reserves) and related reinsurance, from P&L through balance sheet and cash Reinsurance accounting: manage reinsurance accounts, quarterly settlements and profit-sharing clauses, making sure the books reflect what our treaties actually say Solvency 2 balance sheet (solo and group): restate French GAAP to Solvency 2, challenge actuarial best estimates and risk margin, and track own funds quarter to quarter Regulatory reporting: prepare balance sheet and own-funds QRTs and write the balance-sheet section of the SFCR Audit readiness: be the single point of contact for auditors on Solvency 2, starting with the 2027 dry run, with documentation and controls always ready Monthly review: analyse and comment on your scope (P&L, balance sheet, variances, loss ratio and other insurance KPIs) Automation: turn manual computations into clear specs for our Finance Data team, and use data and AI to make closing faster and more reliable Business partnering: flag the accounting and solvency impact of new products, treaties or markets early and follow through to implementation ⭐️ What we’re looking for ⭐️ At least 5 years in insurance accounting, ideally Big 4 insurance audit followed by finance or reporting at an insurer Strong command of French GAAP insurance accounting (technical provisions, reinsurance, insurance P&L) Hands-on experience with the Solvency 2 balance sheet and QRTs Strong analytical skills: reconciling large datasets, bridging French GAAP to Solvency 2, spotting inconsistencies; comfortable with SQL and AI tools Organised, rigorous and comfortable building structure from ambiguity; you close the loops and can explain technical topics to actuaries, auditors and non-finance stakeholders alike Fluent in English and French Big pluses: prévoyance experience (long-term reserves, mortality/disability tables, profit-sharing), having built a Solvency 2 production process, actuarial knowledge, IFRS 17. 🌍 How we work Location: You must be legally eligible to work from France. The role is based in Paris. Remote work: We offer remote work flexibility, but we value in-person collaboration. 🎯 Important note: we hire people, not roles. title: Staff Platform Engineer (f/m/d)
description: Our goal is to have a solar system on every roof, a storage unit in every house, and an electric car in every garage. Enpal makes this possible with an integrated total solution for decentralized energy—from solar systems and battery storage to wall boxes, smart meters, and heat pumps. At the heart of it all is our AI-powered platform Enpal.One +, which intelligently connects thousands of systems and efficiently optimizes electricity procurement and feed-in on the energy market. Are you ready for solutions that are more than just a promise and bring real quality of life to thousands of households every day? What you create at Enpal will deliver clean electricity tomorrow and bring about lasting change in how we use energy. Job Description As a Staff Platform Engineer, you will provide technical leadership for the internal platform that powers Enpal's applications and services. You will set technical direction, raise the bar on engineering standards, and drive cross-team initiatives that make our platform more reliable, secure, and scalable. You'll partner closely with engineering leadership, senior platform engineers, and development teams, acting as a force multiplier through mentorship, architectural guidance, and hands-on contribution to the platform's hardest problems. This role is ideal for engineers who have deep, proven expertise in platform and cloud engineering and want to shape the technical strategy of a growing engineering organization, not just execute within it. At Enpal, you would be: Owning platform architecture. Define and evolve the architecture of our internal platform, making build-vs-buy and long-term design decisions that balance reliability, scalability, security, and cost. Driving infrastructure automation at scale. Lead the design of automation and self-service tooling that removes manual toil across deployment, provisioning, and operations for the whole engineering org, not just your own team. title: SEO & GEO Lead (w/m/d)
description: Unser Ziel ist eine Solaranlage auf jedem Dach, ein Speicher in jedem Haus, und ein E-Auto in jeder Garage. Wie wir das schaffen? Auf unserem Weg zum größten Energieunternehmen Europas stehen wir gerade erst am Anfang. Deshalb sind wir auf der Suche nach Talenten, die uns auf diesem Weg begleiten, ihren Fußabdruck hinterlassen und Erfolge gemeinsam mit uns feiern. Als erstes grünes Unicorn in Deutschland und wachstumsstärkstes Energieunternehmen in Europa (FT1000 Ranking 2022 von Financial Times & Statista) treiben wir unsere Mission von grüner Energie für alle weiter voran. Sei auch Du Teil dieser Erfolgsgeschichte und verändere mit uns gemeinsam die Welt! Du hast mindestens 2–3 Jahre Führungserfahrung – idealerweise beim Aufbau, der Entwicklung oder Skalierung von SEO-Teams – und verstehst es, Menschen zu befähigen und mitzunehmen. Du verfügst über tiefgehende Expertise in allen SEO-Disziplinen: Technical SEO, On-Page, Content-Strategie und Offpage/Linkbuilding – und weißt, wie du diese strategisch miteinander verzahnst. title: Senior Sales Manager, AI & Enterprise (all genders)
description: About the Role You will win and grow our largest client relationships: enterprise and upper Mittelstand companies in DACH that want to run their commercial processes on one platform and automate them with AI agents. You open doors at C level, understand the business problem better than anyone else in the room, shape the solution together with our engineers and consultants, and close deals of six figures and more. We are not looking for a classic sales profile. We are looking for someone clients trust because they know what they are talking about: processes, data, integrations and what AI can and cannot do. Someone who listens first, asks the second and third question, and is comfortable saying "we are not the right partner for this". In a team of around 30 people, without Konzern overhead, and with direct access to our CEO. What You'll Do Own large enterprise deals end to end, from the first conversation with a C level sponsor to signature and handover to delivery. Open new accounts in our focus industries, especially manufacturing (machinery and industrial tech) and construction and building materials, often companies that sell through dealers, partners and installers. Lead discovery: understand the client's processes, data and systems, and turn a vague "we need something with AI" into a clear business case. Sell our full model: paid Discovery, a fixed price build (portals, CPQ, field service, CRM, AI agents) and ongoing operation of the solution. Shape solutions together with our solution architects and AI engineers, and sell only what we can deliver. Grow accounts after go-live with new use cases, entities and agents. Build your own pipeline through your network, the HubSpot partner ecosystem, referrals and targeted outreach. Use AI tools in your own daily work for research, preparation and proposals. What You Bring Must-haves At least eight years in B2B solution or services sales, including at least three years personally owning enterprise deals. A track record of deals of EUR 100k and more that you originated and closed yourself, with several decision makers, procurement and IT involved. A solid technical or process background (for example IT, engineering, business informatics or consulting) and real interest in AI, digitalisation and business processes. You don't code, but you can follow an architecture discussion and explain a trade-off to a CFO. A consultative way of selling: you listen more than you talk, and clients describe you as helpful, not pushy. Native or C2 level German and fluent English, written and spoken. Within commuting distance of Böblingen and happy to travel to clients in DACH. Nice-to-haves Experience at an IT consultancy, system integrator or B2B software vendor selling CRM, ERP, CPQ, PIM, field service, data or AI projects. Experience selling to machine builders or building materials companies with dealer or service networks. Knowledge of HubSpot, Salesforce or Microsoft Dynamics at enterprise scale. Experience with structured qualification such as MEDDPICC from real deals. Your Team You'll be part of our Sales Function and report directly to our CEO. You'll work alongside our Sales Manager and Senior Account Executive, and on every deal closely with solution architects, AI engineers, consultants and project managers from our Practices in Böblingen and Lisbon. Tech Stack HubSpot Sales Hub, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, PandaDoc, Confluence, Jira, Microsoft Teams, Claude. On the solution side you'll meet HubSpot, ERP integrations, custom portals and AI agents built on large language models. What We Offer Attractive package with a fixed salary and a variable component that rewards good deals, not just more deals. 31 vacation days per year: 30 days plus one extra company day for Christmas or a holiday of your choice. Baden-Württemberg public holidays come on top. Hybrid working with two office days per week at our Böblingen HQ. Company pension plan (Allianz) with an employer contribution from your second year that grows with tenure. Business Bike leasing with the 0.25 percent tax advantage, full insurance, annual service and free brand choice. Lunch subsidy of 5 EUR tax-free per working day, up to 100 EUR per month. Corporate Benefits discount platform covering travel, tech, fashion, mobility and insurance. Direct impact. Flat hierarchy, direct line to the CEO, and the chance to shape how a growing AI consultancy sells. About Thorit Thorit is the AI & CRM consultancy for the agent-native enterprise. Agentic means software that acts on goals instead of waiting for clicks. As a Diamond HubSpot Partner we work with enterprise B2B clients in DACH and the Nordics, building the agent layer on top of HubSpot and the systems around it, then operating it with them. Ready to Apply? Send your application via Ashby. A cover letter is optional, but please include a short description of the largest deal you personally originated and closed: what the client bought, rough deal size, how many people were involved in the decision, and what made the difference. title: Head of Business Unit Solaire H/F
description: 🐙 Rejoins la révolution énergétique chez Octopus Energy ! Octopus Energy , fournisseur d’énergie verte présent à l’international, a lancé sa filiale Octopus Energy Services pour accompagner ses clients dans la décarbonation complète de leur foyer. Déjà bien implantée au Royaume-Uni, cette entité propose un ensemble de solutions techniques : installation de panneaux photovoltaïques, de bornes de recharge pour véhicules électriques et de systèmes de chauffage décarboné, le tout avec une approche centrée sur la qualité, l’innovation et sans sous-traitance. Tu veux un job qui a du sens ? Octopus Energy Services a démarré son activité en 2024, avec un objectif clair : aider les particuliers à réduire leurs factures énergétiques tout en participant activement à la transition énergétique. Et aujourd’hui on a besoin de toi pour propulser notre croissance ! Nous sommes aujourd’hui une cinquantaine de salariés et nous visons 10 M€ de chiffre d'affaires en 2027, ce qui nous placera parmi les leaders du marché. Le cap derrière : que tout client qui veut s'équiper pense à nous en premier, parce que nous sommes la référence sur la qualité de l'accompagnement et des produits que nous vendons. Pour tenir ce cap, nous nous structurons en trois BU : La BU Solaire reste notre activité historique et notre cœur de métier : vente et pose avec nos propres installateu·rices. Notre réseau de Partenaires Certifiés , pour accompagner les clients sur des travaux que nous ne proposons pas en propre (vente et pose de pompe à chaleur notamment). Le matériel , afin de lancer sur le marché français les produits fabriqués par le groupe, comme sa pompe à chaleur Cosy, que l’on souhaite proposer à nos Partenaires Certifiés. Guillaume, Directeur Général Délégué, qui a lancé la filiale, supervisera les trois et cherche la personne qui dirigera la BU Solaire, notre activité historique. Ta mission : Tu diriges la BU Solaire comme un·e véritable dirigeant·e de business : tu fixes le cap, tu portes les résultats et tu construis l'organisation qui nous fera passer à l'échelle. Ton premier chantier : monter en cadence de pose, sans dégrader la qualité, tout en améliorant la rentabilité de la BU en 2027. Tu le fais depuis le terrain autant que depuis le bureau. Tes responsabilités seront les suivantes : 1. Stratégique : Définir le cap et faire grandir la BU. Tu portes la vision, la stratégie de développement de la BU et tu prends les arbitrages structurants, notamment : Fixer la trajectoire de la BU et trancher les décisions qui font avancer le business ; Décider, le moment venu, des extensions : nouvelle zone géographique, nouvelle ligne de produit ; Représenter la BU en interne et faire l'interface avec Octopus Energy France (fourniture d'énergie, offre bundlée pose + contrat + pilotage batterie), les fonctions support partagées et les deux autres BU. 2. Économique : Piloter le P&L, la rentabilité et les investissements Tu es owner des chiffres de la BU, tu devras notamment : Suivre la rentabilité à chaque maillon de la chaîne (vente, étude, pose, SAV) et les faire suivre à chaque manager ; Travailler avec eux à les améliorer : coût d'acquisition, délais de pose, SAV ; Produire les chiffres du reporting groupe et savoir les défendre. 3. Managériale et opérationnelle : Faire grandir les managers et structurer l'organisation. Tu fais monter les responsables de chaque équipe pour qu’ils portent la montée en cadence de la BU dans une organisation qui grandit : Accompagner les managers d’équipe au quotidien pour qu'ils·elles fassent grandir ses équipes, y compris dans les moments difficiles ; Structurer, avec les équipes techniques, la montée en cadence de pose ; Animer le collectif et incarner la culture de l'entreprise : exigence de qualité, jalons, victoires célébrées. Ce qu'on cherche : Ce qui compte d'abord, c'est qui tu es : Tu t’intéresses vraiment aux gens, tu es exigeant·e et tu dis les choses clairement, dans le respect de la personne en face. Tu sais engager des équipes pluridisciplinaires : commerce, administratif, technique et terrain ne parlent pas la même langue, tu fais le lien. Tu accompagnes tes managers pour qu'ils fassent monter leurs propres équipes. Tu es à l'aise dans une entreprise en construction : on teste, on se trompe, on recommence. Tu prends ton sujet en main et tu as le courage managérial de dire les choses. Tu es proactif·ve, tu trouves des solutions en autonomie et tu fais s'activer les équipes autour de toi. Côté compétences techniques : Tu as déjà dirigé une activité opérationnelle avec des équipes de terrain. Le solaire résidentiel n'est pas obligatoire. Tu lis un P&L et tu défends tes chiffres devant une direction. Tu as une vraie vision business : tu relies l'opérationnel à la rentabilité. Tu es prêt·e à aller sur le terrain, régulièrement. Tu sais communiquer (écrit et oral) en anglais pour échanger avec le Groupe. Conditions : Contrat : CDI – Statut Cadre Localisation : Paris ou Lille (déplacements à prévoir entre les deux bureaux et sur le terrain) Date de prise de poste : Dès que possible Rémunération : À définir selon profil et expérience Processus de recrutement : Premier échange avec Chloé, notre Talent Partner en charge de ce recrutement Échange visio de 30 min avec Guillaume pour comprendre tes motivations pour le poste Entretien en présentiel à Paris ou Lille avec Guillaume et potentiellement un échange avec un des membres du COMEX Octopus France Pourquoi tu vas adorer travailler pour nous ? Tu veux connaitre le salaire ? Demande-le nous ! Lors de notre premier contact, c’est un point que nous abordons toujours, car même si nous prenons soin de définir des grilles les plus justes possibles, il nous semble également important de faire correspondre ton expérience au bon salaire. Nous aurons l’occasion de t’en dire plus sur la manière dont nous avons défini le salaire et sur les autres avantages dont tu pourras bénéficier si tu nous rejoins ! Sache enfin que nous pouvons avoir un certain degré de flexibilité, car nous ne voudrions jamais que le salaire soit une raison pour laquelle quelqu’un·e ne postule pas chez Octopus - ce qui est le plus important pour nous est de trouver le bon Octofit ! Certifiée depuis 2024 et 4e en 2025, Octopus Energy France est classée 1ère sur plus de 200 entreprises au classement Great Place to Work 2026 ! Cela reflète bien notre engagement pour un environnement de travail épanouissant ! Nous sommes une organisation où les gens apprennent, décident et construisent plus rapidement. Où ils travaillent de manière autonome, avec des gens extraordinaires, sur des projets qui innovent. Intéressement au capital, flex-office, excellente mutuelle, forfait mobilité douce, prise en charge d’une partie de ton titre de transport au-delà du minimum légal, et même des jours de congés spéciaux pour t’investir dans un projet associatif qui te tient à coeur… Nous voulons que ton investissement soit récompensé par des avantages auxquels tu tiens vraiment ! title: Systems Engineer - Database Platform
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><h3><strong> Available Locations: Austin, New York, San Francisco, Remote</strong></h3> <h3><strong>About the Team</strong></h3> <p>We manage an internal, multi-region PostgreSQL platform that enables engineers to rapidly build, deploy, and operate services. Our mission is to provide a highly available, stable, and self-service platform with clear operational visibility. As a Systems Engineer, you will collaborate with database engineers, developers, and infrastructure teams to evolve our database architecture and automation. You will be instrumental in scaling our PostgreSQL infrastructure and enhancing database reliability. If you are passionate about PostgreSQL, automation, reliability, and database tooling, let's connect!</p> <p><strong>Role Responsibilities</strong></p> <ul> <li>Build, deploy, and manage PostgreSQL database clusters in production environments. </li> <li>Develop and maintain database tooling for automation, monitoring and performance tuning.</li> <li>Implement high availability, backup and disaster recovery solutions. </li> <li>Work closely with Infrastructure and Applications teams to integrate database tools. </li> <li>Implement proactive solutions using observability tools to monitor database health. </li> <li>Optimize database performance, indexing strategies, and query tuning. </li> </ul> <p><strong>Role Requirements (Must-Have Skills)</strong></p> <p><strong>Must-Have Skills</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience with building, scaling, and managing large-scale multi-tenant PostgreSQL database clusters, encompassing high availability failover, and disaster recovery strategies.</li> <li>Experience with infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, Ansible or Salt) .</li> <li>Experience in scripting languages (Python, Bash) for automation. </li> <li>Experience building and maintaining database tooling for automation and monitoring.</li> <li>Experience with containerization technologies like Docker and Kubernetes.</li> <li>Experience optimizing database performance and query tuning.</li> <li>Experience with alerting and monitoring tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, and Kibana.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Nice-to-Have Skills</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience developing software in Go, Ruby or C/C++</li> <li>Contributions to PostgreSQL or relevant open-source projects.</li> <li>Expertise in database schema migrations and automation using tools like Flyway, Liquibase or goose. </li> <li>Experience with connection pooling solutions such as PgBouncer, HAProxy.</li> <li>Experience with non-relational data stores such as Distributed & time-series databases (ex. Cassandra, Timescale) and key-value stores (eg., Redis) </li> </ul> <h2>Compensation</h2> <p>Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location.</p> <ul> <li>For Bay Area based hires: Estimated annual salary of $157,000 - $196,000</li> <li><span data-sheets-root="1">For New York based hires: Estimated annual salary of $150,000 - $187,000 </span></li> </ul> <h3>Equity</h3> <p>This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare’s equity plan.</p> <h3>Benefits</h3> <p>Cloudflare offers a complete package of benefits and programs to support you and your family.  Our benefits programs can help you pay health care expenses, support caregiving, build capital for the future and make life a little easier and fun!  The below is a description of our benefits for employees in the United States, and benefits may vary for employees based outside the U.S.</p> <h3>Health & Welfare Benefits</h3> <ul> <li>Medical/Rx Insurance</li> <li>Dental Insurance</li> <li>Vision Insurance</li> <li>Flexible Spending Accounts</li> <li>Commuter Spending Accounts</li> <li>Fertility & Family Forming Benefits</li> <li>On-demand mental health support and Employee Assistance Program</li> <li>Global Travel Medical Insurance</li> </ul> <h3>Financial Benefits</h3> <ul> <li>Short and Long Term Disability Insurance</li> <li>Life & Accident Insurance</li> <li>401(k) Retirement Savings Plan</li> <li>Employee Stock Participation Plan</li> </ul> <h3>Time Off</h3> <ul> <li>Flexible paid time off covering vacation and sick leave</li> <li>Leave programs, including parental, pregnancy health, medical, and bereavement leave</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: We released</span><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">1.1.1.1</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our</span><a href="https://developers.cloudflare.com/1.1.1.1/privacy/public-dns-resolver"> privacy commitment</a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs.  More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.  We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all people and place great value in both diversity and inclusiveness.  All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to their, or any other person's, perceived or actual</span> <span style="font-weight: 400;">race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, family care status, or any other basis protected by law. </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">We are an AA/Veterans/Disabled Employer.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities.  Please tell us if you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job. Examples of reasonable accommodations include, but are not limited to, changing the application process, providing documents in an alternate format, using a sign language interpreter, or using specialized equipment.  If you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job, please contact us via e-mail at </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">hr@cloudflare.com</span><span style="font-weight: 400;"> or via mail at 101 Townsend St. San Francisco, CA 94107.</span></p></div>

title: Marketing Manager (m/w/d)
description: Über Vestlane Vestlane ist die Plattform für Onboarding, KYC/AML und Tax Compliance für Private-Market-Fonds. Fondsmanager und Fondsadministratoren in ganz Europa wickeln über Vestlane ihre KYC-, AML- und Zeichnungsprozesse ab, in über 14 Jurisdiktionen und über den gesamten Investor-Lifecycle hinweg. Wir sind zertifiziert und für die regulatorische Realität spannender Akronyme gebaut – von GwG, BaFin, AMLR, RTS, CSSF bis hin zu DORA, RAIF, AIFMD, MiFID uvm. Du hast schon ein paar Jahre B2B-Marketing gemacht und willst jetzt Kanäle wirklich verantworten statt nur zuzuarbeiten? Du willst die Welt von Venture Capital und Private Equity von innen kennenlernen, ohne selbst in einem Fonds zu sitzen? Du kannst schreiben, denkst in Zielgruppen statt in Posts und findest es reizvoll, aus GwG und CSSF-Rundschreiben Inhalte zu machen, die Compliance-Verantwortliche tatsächlich lesen? Du betreibst Marketing mit KI-Tools und Daten statt mit der Gießkanne? Dann ist diese Rolle für dich! Als Marketing Manager arbeitest du direkt mit unserem COO zusammen, der Go-to-Market verantwortet, und in enger Abstimmung mit unserem CEO. Du übernimmst die Marketing-Themen, die heute auf seinem Tisch liegen – von Content und SEO über LinkedIn und Newsletter bis Website und Events – und bist nah dran an jeder Entscheidung, die unsere Positionierung bewegt. Kolleg:innen aus Regulatory, Design und Customer Success liefern dir Fachwissen, Grafiken und Kundenstimmen. Echte Verantwortung für eigene Kanäle ab Tag eins, kurze Wege zur Geschäftsführung, keine Agenturschleifen. Dein Arbeitsplatz ist unser Office in Bonn, mit flexiblen Home-Office-Regelungen. Deine Aufgaben Content, der gelesen wird: Du planst und schreibst Blogartikel, Landingpages und Fachbeiträge zu KYC/AML, AMLR, Fondsregulierung und unseren Produktfeatures – auf Deutsch und Englisch, fachlich sauber, verständlich und mit Haltung. SEO und GEO verantworten: Du baust auf unseren bestehenden Rankings auf, entwickelst die Keyword-Strategie weiter und sorgst dafür, dass Vestlane auch dort gefunden wird, wo heute gesucht wird. LinkedIn und Newsletter fahren: Du bespielst die Company Page, bereitest Posts für die Geschäftsführung vor und verantwortest unseren Regulatory- und Product-Newsletter von der Themenplanung bis zum Versand. Website weiterentwickeln: Du pflegst und erweiterst vestlane.com in unserem CMS (Storyblok), briefst Design, testest neue Seiten und misst, was funktioniert. Success Stories und Events: Du sammelst Kundenstimmen gemeinsam mit Customer Success, machst daraus Case Studies und verantwortest das Pre- und Post-Marketing von Events, Webinaren und Partner-Announcements. Die Marketing-Maschine bauen: Du strukturierst Contentplanung, Tracking und Reporting, baust KI-Workflows für Recherche, Entwürfe und Distribution und zeigst mit Zahlen, welche Maßnahmen Pipeline bringen. Dein Profil 1 bis 3 Jahre Erfahrung im B2B-Marketing, idealerweise SaaS, Finanz- oder Legal-/RegTech-Umfeld. Du hast schon mindestens einen Kanal eigenständig verantwortet (Content, SEO, LinkedIn oder Newsletter) und kannst zeigen, was dabei herausgekommen ist. Du schreibst sehr gut auf Deutsch und Englisch: klar, präzise, ohne Buzzword-Nebel. Du kannst einen komplexen Sachverhalt in drei Sätzen erklären und in einem Post zuspitzen. Solide SEO-Kenntnisse (Keyword-Recherche, On-Page, Content-Struktur, Tracking) und echtes Interesse an Generative Engine Optimization. Erfahrung mit einem CMS, LinkedIn Company Pages und einem Newsletter-Tool. Du nutzt KI-Tools im Alltag selbstverständlich für Recherche, Entwürfe und Analysen und weißt, wo du selbst nachschärfen musst. Du magst Zahlen: Du willst wissen, ob dein Artikel rankt, ob der Newsletter geöffnet wird und was davon im CRM ankommt. Interesse an Finanzregulierung und Compliance. Du musst kein GwG-Profi sein, aber du musst Lust haben, dich einzuarbeiten – Fachwissen bekommst du von Kolleg:innen, die täglich damit arbeiten. Du siehst dich als Unternehmer:in innerhalb von Vestlane, nicht als Content-Lieferant:in. Du willst heute Verantwortung und morgen Führung, und du willst dir beides erarbeiten, indem du etwas aufbaust. Deine Benefits Eigene Kanäle und Themen ab Tag eins, mit klarem Entwicklungspfad hin zu mehr Verantwortung im Marketing Direkte Zusammenarbeit mit COO und CEO, kurze Entscheidungswege, keine Agenturschleifen Vollzeit, unbefristet, Start ab sofort möglich Kompetitives Gehaltspaket 30 Tage Urlaub Bezahlte Weiterbildungen und Zertifizierungen Arbeitsplatz in unserem Bonner Office, flexible Arbeitszeiten und Home-Office-Regelungen Moderne Tools und KI im täglichen Einsatz Ein Team, das Compliance ernst nimmt, weil Compliance das Produkt ist, kein Kostenfaktor Abschluss Wir freuen uns auf deinen Lebenslauf und zwei bis drei Arbeitsproben (Artikel, Posts, Landingpages, Newsletter – was zeigt, wie du arbeitest). Ein klassisches Anschreiben brauchen wir nicht; ein paar Sätze dazu, warum Marketing für ein RegTech dich reizt, reichen. Wir prüfen deine Bewerbung persönlich und melden uns innerhalb von zwei Wochen. title: KYC & AML Operations Manager (m/w/d)
description: Über Vestlane Vestlane ist die Plattform für Onboarding, KYC/AML und Tax Compliance für Private-Market-Fonds. Dann ist diese Rolle für dich! “KYC/AML Services” ist Vestlanes jüngstes Team, das die operative KYC- und AML-Arbeit für Fonds- und Asset Manager-Kunden in Deutschland, Großbritannien und Luxemburg erbringt. Du arbeitest direkt mit unserem Head of KYC & AML Operations zusammen und übernimmst echte Verantwortung ab Tag eins und hast direkten Investoren- und Kundenkontakt. Deinen Entwicklungspfad gestaltest du aktiv mit, erfolgsabhängig, statt getrieben vom nächsten Beförderungszyklus. Deine Aufgaben Investorenakten von A bis Z: Du führst KYC-Prüfungen, Risikobewertungen und Enhanced Due Diligence für Investoren und Assets in Fondsstrukturen in Deutschland, Großbritannien und Luxemburg durch – mithilfe unserer KI-gestützten, digitalen Plattform. Screening-Treffer bearbeiten: Du bewertest und dokumentierst Treffer aus Namens-, Sanktions- und Adverse-Media-Screening und bereitest klare, entscheidungsreife Bewertungen vor – mithilfe nativer KI-Agenten. Geldwäschebeauftragte der Kunden unterstützen: Du erstellst Eskalationsvermerke und Reportings, damit Geldwäschebeauftragte und Responsables du Contrôle unserer Kunden auf solider Grundlage entscheiden können. Die Maschine mitbauen: Du wirkst an Policies, Checklisten, QA-Standards und Tooling unserer Abteilung aktiv mit. Du hinterfragst kritisch, denkst Prozesse neu. Du willst KYC/AML als Geschäftschance verstehen und nicht als Last. Das Produkt verbessern: Du zeigst auf, wo die Vestlane-Plattform KYC-Arbeit schneller und sicherer machen kann, und setzt das gemeinsam mit unserem Produktteam um. Dein Profil Mindestens 3 Jahre operative KYC/AML- oder vergleichbare Erfahrung, etwa bei einer Big-4- oder Wirtschaftsprüfungsgesellschaft, einem Fondsadministrator, einer KYC/AML-Beratung oder in der AML-Funktion eines Fonds oder Finanzinstituts. Sichere Kenntnisse des deutschen und des Luxemburger Rechtsrahmens: GwG und BaFin-Auslegungspraxis auf der einen Seite, CSSF-Anforderungen und das Luxemburger AML-Gesetz auf der anderen. Du kennst beide Welten und weißt, wo sie sich unterscheiden. UK-Erfahrung ist ein Plus. Erfahrung mit Fondsstrukturen und ihren Investoren (Institutionelle Anleger, Gesellschaften, Trusts, verschachtelte UBO-Ketten). Private-Markets-Erfahrung ist ein starkes Plus. Zertifizierungen (z. B. ACAMS, ICA) sind willkommen, keine Voraussetzung. Verhandlungssicheres Deutsch und Englisch. Französisch hilft in Luxemburg, ist aber keine Bedingung. Präzision und Urteilsvermögen: Du dokumentierst sauber, eskalierst im richtigen Moment und willst, dass deine Arbeit jeder Prüfung standhält. Gleichzeitig bist du pragmatisch, du weißt, dass Risiko aus “Impact” und “Likelihood” besteht. Du siehst dich als Unternehmer innerhalb von Vestlane, nicht als reiner Checklisten-Abhaker. Du willst heute Verantwortung und morgen Führung, und du willst dir beides erarbeiten, indem du etwas aufbaust. Benefits bei Vestlane Teammitglied mit klarem Entwicklungspfad, wenn der Kundenstamm wächst Direkter Kundenkontakt ab Tag eins, keine fünf Ebenen zwischen dir und den Menschen, für die deine Arbeit zählt Kompetitives Gehaltspaket 30 Tage Urlaub Bezahlte Weiterbildungen und Zertifizierungen (z. B. ACAMS, ICA) Büro in Bonn Flexiblen Arbeitszeiten und Home-Office-Regelungen Ein Team, das Compliance ernst nimmt, weil Compliance das Produkt ist, kein Kostenfaktor Abschluss Wir freuen uns auf deinen Lebenslauf und ein aussagekräftiges Anschreiben. Wir prüfen deine Bewerbung persönlich und melden uns innerhalb von zwei Wochen. Der Prozess ist bewusst kurz und hat drei Schritte: ein 30-minütiges Kennenlerngespräch, in dem es um dich, deinen Weg und die Frage geht, ob wir zueinander passen. Dann ein 45-minütiger Termin mit einer praktischen Aufgabe aus dem echten Alltag der Abteilung, damit du siehst, was dich erwartet, und wir sehen, wie du arbeitest. Zum Abschluss ein 30-minütiges Gespräch mit der Geschäftsführung. Insgesamt weniger als zwei Stunden deiner Zeit, und du bekommst nach jedem Schritt zeitnah Rückmeldung. Fragen vor der Bewerbung? solutions Deep understanding of Linux operating systems and strong programming or scripting skills (e.g., Python, Go, or Bash) focused on automation and tooling. Founded in Paris, Joko is a tech company and certified B Corp with over 120 talents across Paris, Barcelona, and New York (and beyond). This position is remote-friendly. ⚖️ Our Legal team The Legal team is at the heart of Joko’s growth and protection. We navigate the complexities of contracts, regulations, and risk management to ensure the company operates smoothly and seizes opportunities with confidence. We handle all legal matters: Contracts, Corporate, Labor, Data protection, IP etc… enabling other teams to innovate with confidence. Leveraging our expertise and external partners, we collaborate with all functions to protect Joko’s interests efficiently and proactively. 🚀 What you will do As Legal Counsel, Commercial & IP, you will work hand in hand with our business teams to negotiate the partnerships that drive Joko's growth, and you will own our contracts, IP, commercial disputes and insurance. You will report directly to the Head of Legal ( Maya ). 🛡️ IP and technology Define the legal framework for Juno, our AI shopping assistant: our rights to merchant content and catalogue data, the use of third-party brands and logos in the app and our marketing, and the ownership of AI-generated content. Protect the Joko brands across our markets with our IP counsel, from trademarks, domain names, oppositions and renewals to action against third parties that infringe our rights. Work with Product and Marketing to secure new features and brands before they launch. 🤝 Deals and commercial relationships Sit alongside the business teams in their negotiations with merchants and brands: partnership agreements, data-sharing contracts, CPG and B2B deals, and the contracts for our new business lines. Structure our merchant and brand relationships so they hold up under French and EU rules on restrictive commercial practices, including significant imbalance and the abrupt termination of established commercial relationships. Lead or support the negotiation of contracts on exclusivity, most-favoured-nation, competition law risks and parity clauses. Build the templates, playbooks, red lines and fallback positions the business teams use every day, and turn them into AI skills. ⚖️ Disputes and risk Handle disputes with merchants, partners and suppliers together with the teams who own the relationship, from formal notices to settlement, protecting both our position and the relationship. Brief and manage our litigation counsel when a dispute goes to court. Own our insurance programme (D&O, cyber, travel and any new line), from renewals to claims, and build an international programme with our brokers so coverage follows us into each new country. 🙌 Who you are You have 4 to 6 years of experience in commercial or IP/IT law, including time in a top-tier law firm. In-house experience in a tech or consumer company is a strong plus. You have negotiated complex commercial agreements directly with counterparties, in French and in English, and you enjoy it. Experience in commercial disputes, restrictive commercial practices or IP/IT matters related to AI is a strong plus. You understand how a business makes money, and you use the contract to support it rather than to slow it down. You turn your positions into templates and playbooks that non-lawyers can use on their own. You hold a Master's degree in business law, IP/IT law or contract law from a leading French law school. Admission to the Paris Bar is a plus. You are fluent in French and English. Another European language is a plus. You write clearly, you decide with incomplete information, and you like the pace of a scale-up. You are curious about AI and want to learn how to build the tools that change legal work. What we tell you upfront. Until the three poles are staffed, every Legal Counsel works across the full legal scope with the Head of Legal. Functional ownership is formalised as soon as the Commercial & IP and Product & Privacy seats are both filled. 💎 Our perks (Some of the benefits listed below are available to full-time positions only) At Joko, we believe that flexibility and trust are essential. Our work environment reflects this through: Flexible remote : If you live in Paris, you can choose to work from our office or from home with no constraints. If you live elsewhere, we can provide access to a coworking space and a coworking budget. Work from anywhere : Want to spend a month in Italy while working? You can work from most countries in the world for up to 3 months per year. On top of that, we offer plenty of perks: 💸 Top-market compensation 📈 Equity for everyone with the chance to own a piece of what you build 🤖 Half-day each week dedicated to leveling up with AI by exploring new tools, iterating hard, and sharpening your skills 🌴 Yearly offsite in amazing locations and budget for team-building events & monthly in-person gatherings 💪 Contribution to your ClassPass subscription 🍼 8-week leave paid 100% for the second parent …and much more, check the full list here ! 🤝 Our hiring process Intro call: Quick screening with the Hiring Manager or the Talent team. Step 1 – Team interview (45 min): Conversation with two Joko team members (could include the Hiring Manager, people from the team you’d join, or colleagues from other teams). Step 2 – Role-specific assessments For non-engineering roles : A take-home case study followed by a 45-min interview. We assess both your output and how you think in real time. The exercise will be relevant to your role (e.g. analysis, strategy, or process design). For engineering roles : A 90-min live technical interview on CoderPad covering code understanding, review, system design, and product thinking (with AI serving as a collaboration tool). Step 3 – Leadership interview (45 min): Conversation with a SteerCo member and a Founder. References: Up to 3 calls with former colleagues or managers. ☕ You may also be invited for coffee with team members to get a feel for our culture. We care about outcomes, not code quality for its own sake. What makes this fun is the loop from idea to reality, and AI just made that loop 10x shorter. There’s no room here for “my job is to solve interesting technical problems.” What a week can look like A call or a plant visit with a procurement team to see how they really buy A prototype built with Claude Code or Cursor the next morning Shipping with a team of 1-3 Builders on one of the quarter's bets Who we're looking for Hungry, creative people who care about the result more than anything else. Cursor, Claude, Codex and agents are your default and you've made something real with them that wouldn't exist otherwise. You have strong technical intuition: you reason about data and systems rather than getting caught up in the details of code. You're comfortable in front of industrial customers. We measure outcomes. Trust is high and feedback is direct. We offer competitive salary and meaningful equity. Our Background Tacto is building the intelligence layer that connects AI to the physical world of manufacturing, starting with procurement. AI is transforming every industry, but it stops at the factory gate. The knowledge that holds manufacturing together - part costs, suppliers, materials - is scattered across systems and people. Over 50% of a product's cost originates from suppliers, making procurement the single largest cost lever in manufacturing and the missing connection between the digital and the physical world. Yet it still runs on Excel and legacy systems. We're changing that with our Procurement Intelligence Platform, trusted by hundreds of companies running billions of Euros of material. Based in Munich, we are 100+ passionate builders who are in-office, with high expectations, fast growth, and a lot of fun. We are supported by >€50m from Sequoia, Index, and Europe's leading tech entrepreneurs and industry veterans. Why It Matters Manufacturing forms Europe's economic backbone, driving a fourth of Europe's GDP and providing over 30% of jobs.
