title: Electrical Engineer II
description: Help us use technology to make a big green dent in the universe! Kraken powers some of the most innovative global developments in energy. We create the technology that redefines utilities and unlocks a new energy system of the future. By optimising renewable generation, building a more intelligent grid, and empowering utilities to deliver an exceptional customer experience, our operating system is transforming the industry worldwide. It’s an incredibly exciting time to work in energy. Join us on our mission to improve the lives of ONE BILLION humans within the decade and shape a cleaner, better future for everyone. Please submit your application in English 🐙 Kraken Generation Flex The energy industry is undergoing the largest transformation since industrialisation, at an unprecedented rate of change and we are positioning ourselves at the heart of it. In Germany, home to the largest electricity market in Europe and a roadmap toward Net Zero by 2045, we are scaling rapidly to integrate Distributed Energy Resources (DERs) into the grid. Kraken is recognised as a thought leader and innovator. We are building a SaaS business that digitally connects hundreds of thousands of DERs with energy markets. As we expand our footprint in Germany and the wider European market, we are looking for an Electrical Engineer to help turn customer sites into market-connected, controllable assets. 🏠 Where you’ll fit in and role summary As we enter a stage of rapid commercialisation and customer growth in Germany, we are looking for an Electrical Engineer to support the delivery of our site integrations and grow into owning them, learning the full lifecycle from the early information stage through design, deployment and testing. You’ll work closely with our engineering team based in Manchester as we look to expand our engineering and operations in Germany and across Europe. Together, the team takes an integration project from the very early information stage, designs how it will be integrated into Kraken’s platform and then turns that design into a live, controllable, market-participating asset. The Gateway (Kraken’s IoT Edge Hardware & Software) and other connectivity technologies with their protocol engineering are owned by our UK-based team, who will support you in becoming configuration literate. Over time you will carry out configuration, deployments and testing for sites yourself, and feed back what you learn about hardware, connectivity and grid operator requirements for European countries so the wider team can build on it. Engineering delivery is an innovative and engineering-focused team with a culture that fosters collaboration and fresh thinking to create a new energy system. Alongside design, deployment and testing, they constantly look into ways to improve efficiency through tooling and the automation of repetitive tasks. They collaborate daily with delivery managers and customer success to onboard new sites as well as support the existing ones. 🚀 What you'll own Integration design contribution: With guidance, analyse provided information and contribute to hardware and software integration approaches for German sites, mainly BESS (grid-scale and C&I) and RES (Wind and Solar). When necessary, exchange information with customer technical representatives in German and English through meetings and emails, and take part in design discussions with other team members. Market access & prequalification support: Support the technical work needed for assets to enter ancillary-service markets (FCR, aFRR, mFRR) and to meet Redispatch 3.0 requirements. With guidance from senior engineers, help prepare the telemetry and control evidence for prequalification (Präqualifikation) with the relevant TSO. (Grid-code and plant-compliance obligations such as VDE-AR-N 4110/4120 remain with the plant/PPC; our focus is enabling market access, telemetry and dispatch.) Technical judgement: Develop your technical judgement, making well-reasoned decisions and trade-offs with support from senior engineers, and contributing technical input to discussions within the team. Developing domain knowledge: Build up your knowledge in one or more technical areas. This could include German grid connection rules and TSO-specific requirements, ancillary services, Redispatch 3.0, industrial communication protocols, industrial networking, internet of things, cyber security and so on. Gateway application & configuration: Learn how the Gateway software (developed by an internal software team) works and how it is configured. Understand the requirements for an integration and judge if the Gateway software is able to support it or will need new development work. The team will help you get Gateway configuration literate and you will carry out deployments and changes independently over time. Hardware and software deployments: Learn the process of our hardware and software deployments. Over time, take ownership of the configuration, deployment and testing of sites with guidance from the senior engineers. Networking and cyber security: Contribute to hardware and network connectivity designs, keeping our own cyber security posture in mind as well as addressing the concerns from customers, with the support of the internal security team. Hardware handling & dispatch: Berlin is planned as our stock base for our hardware going out to sites across Europe, so the role includes some hands-on work. This covers preparing units before they ship, such as flashing and configuring our industrial PCs and running pre-shipment tests, and helping to prepare and coordinate shipments. Site testing & commissioning: Carry out site testing and commissioning, initially with the support of the team and building toward doing this independently as onboarding demand in Germany and other parts of Europe grows. Hardware is deployed remotely in most cases via O&Ms and third parties, but occasional hands-on support in Germany may be needed before or after a deployment. Incidents & support: Help address engineering help requests from other teams and support incident response in the case of issues at existing sites. 🧠 What you'll bring to the party Language: Native or professional fluency in German and English , needed for technical documentation and for working with customers, grid operators and our UK-based team. Understanding of the German connection landscape: Working knowledge of the TSO/DSO hierarchy, the connection/integration process, and the technical connection rules (such as VDE-AR-N 4110/4120) a grid-connected asset must meet before it can participate in the energy markets. Understanding of the German energy markets: Working understanding of the German ancillary services (FCR, aFRR, mFRR), what prequalification involves, and the Redispatch 3.0 framework. Technical judgement: Sound technical judgement and a structured approach to problems, working with the team to agree and implement a solution. Power plant systems: Ability to read and analyse single line diagrams for a given power plant to understand the site architecture for the points of metering and control instrumentation. Asset integration: Exposure to, or a keen interest in, integrating BESS (grid-scale and/or C&I) and/or RES (Wind and Solar) for telemetry and control. Integration design: Ability to contribute to clear integration designs and design documentation. Hardware and networking: Familiarity with control systems deployments and their connectivity including the local networking and cyber security aspects, and an ability to help debug site connectivity and networking issues (including 4G routers and firewalls) with support. Hands-on hardware preparation: Comfortable working at the bench with our panels and industrial PCs. This includes safely powering panels up and down using our test setup, flashing operating system images, and following a set procedure for pre-shipment checks. Full training is provided. Industrial communication protocols: Practical experience or a good working knowledge of Modbus (TCP/RTU); awareness of one or more of IEC 60870-5-104, IEC 61400-25, OPC-UA or DNP3 is a plus. CAD, diagrams and tools: Experience or familiarity with CAD tools such as AutoCAD or BricsCAD, Miro and Notion. Communication: A clear communicator who documents their work (e.g. in design docs and Notion) and collaborates well with a team that is partly based in another country. Commissioning landscape: Awareness of the other parties involved in site commissioning for power plants, their roles and responsibilities, and how we work with them. Engineering background: Bachelor's in Electrical Engineering, Automation/Control, Software, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience in industrial/energy integration. A proactive and collaborative mindset: You are eager to learn and grow, reliable and collaborative. You take initiative, communicate openly, raise risks early, and care about safe working. You welcome feedback, support your teammates, and steadily build toward taking on more independent ownership of integrations over time. Location and travel: Ideally based close to Kraken’s Berlin office . Willingness to travel to customers and sites in Germany, and occasionally to our Manchester team, although travel is kept to a minimum. Awareness of site safety is required as we may work with site personnel even though we are remote. ⭐️ Bonus points Wider knowledge of German grid compliance (VDE-AR-N 4110/4120, TSO-specific technical requirements) and where the Kraken system fits in. Experience with AWS IoT Greengrass or similar edge-deployment architectures. Familiarity with software/scripting and templating (e.g. Python, Rust, the Linux command line) and Git-based workflows. Understanding of IT/OT security in the energy sector (NIS2, EnWG/KRITIS awareness; IEC 62443 a plus). Exposure to the wider European balancing markets / ENTSO-E frameworks beyond Germany. title: Sr. Director, Developer GTM
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Raise the bar on narrative clarity, and executive communication; model Cloudflare’s values in every region.</li> </ul> <h4><strong>Who You Are</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Track record hiring exceptional sales leadership talent for highly strategic roles</li> <li>10+ years in developer platform GTM, deal strategy, and commercial architecture; 5+ years leading managers across multiple regions/time zones</li> <li>Proven ability to translate technical workloads into compelling commercial outcomes and navigate complex approvals with Sales, Finance, Legal, and Security</li> <li>Builder’s mindset with strong operational chops: you design operating models, write crisp narratives, and drive cross-functional execution</li> <li>Data-driven and fluent in product usage telemetry; comfortable with Sheets/SQL-level analysis to size opportunities and measure impact</li> <li>Exceptional communicator—clear writer and presenter—from developer ICs to executive sponsors</li> <li>Experience enabling large field organizations with playbooks, training, and tooling; passion for coaching managers and building high performance teams.</li> <li>Background in usage-based/consumption pricing and commit structures</li> <li>Experience with startup programs or digital-native segments</li> <li>Bonus points for former startup CRO’s and founders</li> </ul> <p class="first-token" data-path-to-node="0"><strong class="" data-path-to-node="0" data-index-in-node="0">Application Deadline:</strong><span class=""> February 02,</span> 2027</p> <h4 data-path-to-node="1"><strong data-path-to-node="1" data-index-in-node="0">Compensation</strong></h4> <ul data-path-to-node="2"> <li> <p data-path-to-node="2,0,0">Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location.</p> </li> <li> <p data-path-to-node="2,1,0">For SF, SJ, and Bay Area Metro based hires: Estimated annual salary of $434,000 - title: Product Engineer (Frontend) (m/f/d)
description: Hi, we are Particula, the prime rating provider for digital assets! Our mission? To make the market for digital assets more accessible, secure and transparent for institutional investors. We support issuers, trading facilities, banks and asset managers to create trust, minimize risks and allocate capital effectively. Join our team and shape the future of the financial world with us! 👋 About the Role We are looking for a product engineer to own our user-facing applications end to end. We operate without dedicated designers or product managers. You will work directly with internal and external stakeholders as well as backend & AI engineers to turn high-level goals into shipped, well-measured features. This is not a ticket-closing role. You spot user friction, propose a fix, build it, measure the outcome and iterate quickly. You will also help shape how we build software with AI agents, translating requirements into working code and establishing the guardrails, automated tests and review habits that keep quality high when code is AI-assisted. You remain responsible for every line you ship, whether you or an agent wrote it. What you will do Ship features end to end: Take concepts from conversation to production, covering UX design, frontend implementation, API integration and deployment. Act as a product builder: Spot friction points yourself, pitch improvements and make sure every feature solves a real user need. Make decisions with data: Implement analytics, track feature adoption and iterate on the numbers. Work directly with users: Talk to internal teams as well as external stakeholders, and turn unstructured feedback into clear technical plans. Own AI-assisted delivery: Use and orchestrate coding agents daily. Write the specs and plans, choose the patterns and approach, and review generated code before you push it. Review your peers' work: Be one of the main reviewers of frontend pull requests, and keep a balance between delivering working functionality and keeping the review workload manageable. Own the design system: Maintain and extend the shared component library and UI guidelines so the product stays consistent. An external design agency will help set the visual language. Own quality and testing: Propose and set up the QA and testing strategy for your area, using automated E2E and component tests to ensure reliability, performance and security. How we work These are fixed parts of the job, and we ask candidates to read them as requirements. Delivery process: Work follows a defined delivery process. Inside it, you own the open decisions in your area, including solution design and implementation approach. Decision rights: Architecture, API contracts and design system direction are set centrally because they are shared across teams. You change them through a written proposal. Once a decision is made, everyone follows it. Backend engineers own the security and performance of services. Team rhythm: A daily stand-up and a biweekly Friday demo. Attendance is expected. Speed: We ship small and often and iterate on the interface quickly. Quality comes from tests and reviews, not from polishing before release. Requirements Must have 5+ years of commercial software engineering, with evidence of owned product work: features you took from problem to production and measured. Experience in a fast-paced startup is a plus. Strong frontend expertise: Deep proficiency in TypeScript and a modern component framework (Vue 3 / Nuxt preferred). Product and UX sense: A track record of designing clean, functional interfaces and delivering features without dedicated PMs or designers. Data-driven mindset: Hands-on experience setting up and using analytics tools (PostHog, Amplitude, Mixpanel or similar). Daily use of AI coding agents: Active experience with agentic tools (Claude Code, Copilot), a clear method for guiding them, and a clear method for checking what they produce. Testing and review habits: Experience with automated E2E and UI testing (Playwright, Cypress, Vitest), the ability to define a testing strategy, and the discipline to review code, yours and others', before it merges. title: Senior Security Engineer (m/f/d)
description: <p><strong>Mission Brief</strong> </p> <p>You are the guardian and the challenger of our security posture. At Isar Aerospace, the systems that build our rockets and the ground systems that launch them are mission critical, and protecting them takes more than good design. It takes someone who will attack their own work to be sure it holds. </p> <p>We are looking for a deeply hands-on Senior Security Engineer. You live in the consoles, the rule sets and the code. You own our secure access and network security controls, our endpoint and identity security stack, and our detection content, and you operate them yourself rather than directing from the sidelines. You wear two hats: the Builder who implements and runs the controls that keep us safe, and the Adversary who keeps testing whether those controls and detections actually fire. </p> <p>This is a senior engineering role with the spirit of an architect. You are expected to design what you operate, not just configure it: pick the pattern, write it down, and make it hold at fleet scale. A versatile engineer with real depth, comfortable switching from a firewall rule set to a detection query to a directory hardening sprint in the same week, and a technical anchor others lean on. </p> <p><strong>Your Role in Our Space Mission</strong> </p> <p> </p> <p><strong>SASE and Network Security</strong> </p> <ul> <li><strong>Own and operate our SASE platform</strong>, including revamping Internet Security policies and redefining Private Access policies. </li> </ul> <ul> <li><strong>Drive firewall security with the network team: </strong>own network security engineering and segmentation strategy, analyze rule sets, identify gaps, and see remediation through together with network engineering, who own the devices. </li> </ul> <ul> <li><strong>Coordinate firewall-adjacent controls: </strong>IPS, AV, sandboxing and DDoS protection. </li> </ul> <ul> <li><strong>Manage our DNS security and WAF solutions</strong>, including our edge and CDN-based protection services. </li> </ul> <p><strong>Security Posture and Hardening</strong> </p> <ul> <li><strong>Apply CIS Benchmarks </strong>to raise posture across firewalls, endpoints, our cloud identity platform and our cloud productivity suite. </li> </ul> <ul> <li><strong>Lead the clean-up and hardening of our on-premises and cloud identity directories </strong>together with the infrastructure team, then keep both hardened on an ongoing basis. </li> </ul> <ul> <li><strong>Drive our phishing-resistant MFA and privileged access programme, </strong>including just-in-time elevation and the remediation of the attack paths we find. </li> </ul> <ul> <li><strong>Own certificate lifecycle and PKI operations: </strong>key ceremonies, automated renewal, and input to our post-quantum migration plan. </li> </ul> <p><strong>Detection and Visibility</strong> </p> <ul> <li><strong>Manage and tune our IPS/IDS platforms; </strong>write and maintain custom IDS signatures, and operate network sensors for NTA appliances. </li> </ul> <ul> <li><strong>Build and maintain detections in our SIEM </strong>and apply MITRE ATT&CK to detection engineering and use-case design in support of the SOC. </li> </ul> <ul> <li><strong>Extend visibility into OT </strong>with purpose-built OT monitoring tooling. </li> </ul> <ul> <li><strong>Act as an L3 incident responder </strong>for escalated security events, and turn every finding into a fix, a new detection or a hardened configuration. </li> </ul> <p><strong>Security Stack and Automation</strong> </p> <ul> <li><strong>Own our endpoint detection and response, data protection and CASB platforms</strong> as their technical owner. </li> </ul> <ul> <li><strong>Script and build internal tooling </strong>in PowerShell and Python, so controls and checks run themselves. </li> </ul> <p><strong>Design and Engineering Partnership</strong> </p> <ul> <li><strong>Design what you operate: </strong>run threat modeling and attack-path analysis on the systems you own, choose the pattern, and document standards others can execute against. </li> </ul> <ul> <li><strong>Evaluate tooling and support vendor selection </strong>and renewal decisions in your domain, with a clear view of what each control costs us and what it buys. </li> </ul> <ul> <li><strong>Embed security with engineering: </strong>partner with IT, infrastructure, manufacturing and mission teams to implement and validate controls in their environments across both IT and OT, respecting launch-window and change-freeze constraints and producing the evidence our audits depend on. </li> </ul> <p><strong>Qualification Checklist</strong> </p> <ul> <li><strong>Experience: </strong>10+ years in security engineering, with real ownership of production security tooling, not policy or advisory work. </li> </ul> <ul> <li><strong>Architect Spirit: </strong>you can step back from the console, design the target state, write the pattern down, and then go build it yourself. </li> </ul> <ul> <li><strong>SASE: </strong>hands-on experience administering an enterprise SASE platform end to end, not just consuming it. </li> </ul> <ul> <li><strong>Hardening: </strong>experience applying CIS Benchmarks to firewalls, endpoints, cloud identity and cloud productivity platforms in production, plus experience rolling out phishing-resistant MFA or privileged access management. </li> </ul> <ul> <li><strong>Networking and Firewalls: </strong>solid fundamentals, enough to own segmentation strategy and to drive rule set analysis and gap remediation with a network team that owns the devices. Experience with CDN-based WAF and edge protection services. </li> </ul> <ul> <li><strong>Security Stack Depth: </strong>strong background across endpoint detection and response, data protection, SIEM and detection query languages, cloud identity and on-premises directory hardening, certificate lifecycle and PKI operations, ideally including a large-scale directory clean-up or remediation effort. </li> </ul> <ul> <li><strong>Detection Engineering: </strong>practical MITRE ATT&CK-driven detection work, and experience writing custom IDS/IPS signatures. </li> </ul> <ul> <li><strong>Operational Depth: </strong>strong capability in detection, incident response and vulnerability management, with time spent on escalated incidents. </li> </ul> <ul> <li><strong>Automation: </strong>scripting ability in PowerShell and Python, plus infrastructure-as-code and policy-as-code experience. </li> </ul> <ul> <li><strong>IT and OT: </strong>comfortable working across both. Working knowledge of OT protocols such as EtherNet/IP, OPC UA and Modbus, and familiarity with OT network monitoring, is a strong plus. </li> </ul> <ul> <li><strong>Autonomy: </strong>operates with very high autonomy as an internal expert, taking full ownership of their work and guiding others. </li> </ul> <ul> <li><strong>Mentoring: </strong>mentors engineers and analysts on the team, and acts services. </li> </ul> <ul> <li>Familiarity with industry standards such as ISO 27001 and NIST. </li> </ul> <ul> <li>Relevant certifications, defensive or engineering (e.g., Security+, GCIA) and offensive (e.g., OSCP or equivalent), are both valued. </li> </ul> <p><strong> </strong></p> <p><strong>What We Offer</strong> </p> <ul> <li>Real Ownership: the security tooling that protects a With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth. </p> <p>WPP Media is WPP's AI-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working.</p> <p>For more information, visit <a href="wppmedia.com">wppmedia.com</a>.</p></div><p></p> <p></p> <div> </div> <div>For clarity and accessibility, we have chosen not to use gender-neutral or inclusive writing conventions in our communications. WPP Media is firmly committed to diversity: we value inclusion and equality, considering all candidates regardless of gender identity, ethnic origin, or religion. All our positions are also open to people with disabilities.</div> <div> </div> <div><strong>About WPP Media</strong></div> <div>WPP is a creative transformation company. We use the power of creativity to build a better future for our people, our planet, our clients, and our communities. For more information, visit <a id="OWA519da216-b9bf-0b2e-cb31-6bf014a89cd1" class="fui-Link ___1q1shib f2hkw1w f3rmtva f1ewtqcl fyind8e f1k6fduh f1w7gpdv fk6fouc fjoy568 figsok6 f1s184ao f1mk8lai fnbmjn9 f1o700av f13mvf36 f1cmlufx f9n3di6 f1ids18y f1tx3yz7 f1deo86v f1eh06m1 f1iescvh fhgqx19 f1olyrje f1p93eir f1nev41a f1h8hb77 f1lqvz6u f10aw75t fsle3fq f17ae5zn OWAAutoLink" href="https://wpp.com/" target="_blank">wpp.com</a>.</div> <div>WPP Media is WPP's global media network. In a world where media is omnipresent, we bring together the best platform, the best talent, and the best partners to develop the most innovative solutions, delivering unparalleled growth for our clients. For more information, visit <a id="OWA26449dfe-1f3a-ebd7-2fa0-f1458cc16da5" class="fui-Link ___1q1shib f2hkw1w f3rmtva f1ewtqcl fyind8e f1k6fduh f1w7gpdv fk6fouc fjoy568 figsok6 f1s184ao f1mk8lai fnbmjn9 f1o700av f13mvf36 f1cmlufx f9n3di6 f1ids18y f1tx3yz7 f1deo86v f1eh06m1 f1iescvh fhgqx19 f1olyrje f1p93eir f1nev41a f1h8hb77 f1lqvz6u f10aw75t fsle3fq f17ae5zn OWAAutoLink" href="https://wppmedia.com/" target="_blank">wppmedia.com</a>.</div> <div>At WPP Media, we believe in the power of our culture and our people. It is through this synergy that we deliver truly exceptional experiences, for both our clients and our internal teams. To succeed in this role, it is crucial to embody the core values that unite WPP and WPP Media:</div> <ul> <li><strong>Be Extraordinary</strong> by fostering collective leadership that inspires truly transformative creativity.</li> <li><strong>Create an Open environment</strong> by finding the perfect balance between the fulfillment of our people and the satisfaction of our clients, all built on mutual trust.</li> <li><strong>Lead with Optimism</strong> by actively stimulating growth and development to mobilize our entire organization.</li> </ul> <div><strong> </strong></div> <div><strong>About the Opportunity</strong></div> <div> </div> <div>L’Oréal International Distribution (LID) is one of our flagship global media accounts, delivering full-funnel media planning and activation across 30+ markets in Europe, MENA, and Sub-Saharan Africa. Spanning five iconic L’Oréal divisions—Luxe, Consumer Products Division (CPD), L’Oréal Dermatological Beauty (LDB), Professional Products Division (PPD), and Dragon—the account is entering an ambitious growth phase, expanded scope across Amazon Ads and CPD, and fast-growing African markets.</div> <div>To sit directly alongside the client leadership, the core planning function is relocating from London to Paris.</div> <div>As Implementation Planning Director, you will be the operational anchor and strategic owner of every media plan across all five divisions. You will not simply inherit a structure—you will build, shape, and lead the new Paris-based planning hub while orchestrating scaled activation via our offshore specialist desks in Delhi.</div> <div>Key Responsibilities</div> <div>1. End-to-End Planning Ownership & Delivery</div> <ul> <li><span>Master the Account Plan:</span> Own end-to-end media implementation planning across all 30 markets and 5 divisions, ensuring plans translate overarching brand strategy into flawless execution.</li> <li><span>Lead Annual & Quarterly Prioritisation:</span> Drive the critical January client prioritisation and Tier 1 campaign slot allocations, establishing clear campaign tiering, budgets, and SLAs.</li> <li><span>Orchestrate Channel Specialists:</span> Steer briefs and execution across digital, offline, and emerging channels, working in lockstep with the <span>Amazon Ads Director</span>, Delhi offshore activation hubs (Programmatic, Social, Amazon Search), and central strategy.</li> <li><span>Quality Assurance & Rigour:</span> Safeguard delivery standards through high-stakes periods, ensuring flawless in-market execution, budget pacing, and post-campaign reporting.</li> </ul> <div>2. Client Partnership & Stakeholder Management</div> <ul> <li> <div>Senior Client Counsel: Partner daily with key client leaders to provide trusted, proactive planning consultation.</div> </li> <li><span>Expectation & Scope Management:</span> Own client relationships up to Procurement and Marketing Director levels. Confidently establish boundaries, negotiate priorities, and align expectations.</li> <li> <div>Close Internal Partnership: Collaborate daily on-site with the Client Leadership in Paris to maintain unified agency leadership and client health.</div> </li> </ul> <div>3. Team Leadership & Hub Building</div> <ul> <li> <div>Build & Scale the Paris Hub: Lead the onboarding, and mentoring of incoming Paris-based Planning Managers, setting team culture and best-in-class planning workflows.</div> </li> <li> <div>Offshore Hub Integration: Establish efficient, collaborative, and accountable working rhythms with our specialist activation leads in Delhi.</div> </li> </ul> <div>4. Cross-Functional Integration & Commercial Stewardship</div> <ul> <li><span>Holistic Solutions:</span> Bridge implementation planning with Strategy, Commerce, Analytics, and Finance to deliver connected consumer journeys and commercial value.</li> <li><span>Financial Governance:</span> Oversee accurate budget tracking, variance management, and financial reconciliations across multi-currency, multi-market plans.</li> </ul> <div><strong>What We Are Looking For</strong></div> <div> </div> <div>Non-Negotiable Requirements</div> <ul> <li><span>8+ years of media planning experience</span> within a leading media agency, with at least <span>3+ years leading multi-market / international accounts</span>.</li> <li><span>End-to-End Planning Mastery:</span> Proven track record running the entire lifecycle: brief deconstruction, multi-channel architecture, offshore/specialist briefing, client sign-off, QA, and advanced reporting.</li> <li><span>Senior Client Ownership:</span> Demonstrated authority managing and holding boundaries with Marketing Directors, Division Heads, and Procurement.</li> <li><span>Prioritisation & Backbone:</span> High level of planning judgement—comfortable deciding which campaigns warrant senior attention and clearly communicating trade-offs to senior clients.</li> <li><span>Team Leadership:</span> Experience managing planners/associate directors and leading through structural change or hub transitions.</li> <li><span>Languages & Location:</span> <span>Fluent English</span> is mandatory. Must be currently <span>based in Paris or actively relocating</span>.</li> </ul> <div>Preferred & Functional Skills</div> <ul> <li><span>Bilingual English / French:</span> A significant asset given daily proximity to the Paris-based client team.</li> <li><span>Channel Breadth:</span> Strong literacy across Digital Performance, Brand Media, Offline/Local channels, and <span>Amazon Ads / Retail Media</span>.</li> <li><span>Category Familiarity:</span> Experience in Beauty, FMCG, or Luxury is advantageous, though proven multi-market operational rigour is our primary criterion.</li> </ul> <div><strong>Why Join Us?</strong></div> <ul> <li><span>Shape, Don't Just Inherit:</span> You are architecting a new Paris hub from the ground up on one of the world's most prestigious beauty accounts.</li> <li> <div>Scale & Momentum: Work with a rapidly expanding media budget across 30 dynamic markets spanning Europe, the Middle East, and Sub-Saharan Africa.</div> </li> <li><span>Senior Visibility:</span> Direct proximity to global client decision-makers combined with the backing of scaled, mature offshore execution teams.</li> </ul> <div> </div> <div> </div> <div><strong>Life at WPP Media and its Benefits</strong></div> <div>Our commitment to shaping the future of media is manifested by active support for the professional development of our talents, helping them reach their full potential. This approach is accompanied by a responsible vision in our media investment strategies, thus reflecting our dual priority: valuing our employees while adopting sustainable practices in our sector. WPP Media employees have privileged access to WPP Media's and WPP's international networks, allowing them to develop their passions, expand their professional network, and stay at the forefront of innovations in marketing and advertising.</div> <div>We have vast and varied resources available to our employees; our company actively cultivates the inclusion of talents from all backgrounds. The successes and expertise of the teams are regularly highlighted during unifying events that also punctuate key moments of the year, thus strengthening our collaborative and diverse corporate culture.</div> <div><strong>Our benefits include:</strong></div> <ul> <li><strong>Remote work:</strong> up to 2 days per week and 2 full weeks to be taken twice a year.</li> <li><strong>Two additional days off offered</strong>, including Whit Monday.</li> <li><strong>Additional leave days</strong> based on seniority in 5-year increments.</li> <li><strong>5 additional remote work days per month</strong> for employees suffering from endometriosis.</li

End-to-End Media Planning & Craft</strong></div> <ul> <li><strong>Build Plans Unsupervised:</strong> Translate marketing briefs into actionable, robust media plans—defining audience segments, channel mix, budget splits by market, flighting/phasing, cost benchmarks, and KPIs.</li> <li><strong>Tier 2 & Always-On Ownership:</strong> Take full autonomous ownership of Tier 2 product activations and always-on campaigns for your assigned division, while actively supporting your Planning Director on Tier 1 flagship "big-bet" launches.</li> <li><strong>Budget & Excel Precision:</strong> Master complex, multi-currency plan templates, maintaining airtight budget tracking and financial hygiene in coordination with internal Finance teams.</li> </ul> <div><strong>2. Must be currently <strong>based in Paris or actively relocating</strong>.</li> </ul> <div><strong>Preferred & Functional Skills</strong></div> <ul> <li><strong>Bilingual English / French:</strong> A major advantage for daily, informal interactions with Parisian brand coordinators.</li> <li><strong>Category Affinity:</strong> Prior experience planning for <strong>Beauty, Fragrance, FMCG, or Luxury</strong> brands is a strong plus.</li> <li><strong>Offline & Retail Media Awareness:</strong> Familiarity with high-impact offline touchpoints and e-commerce/retail media (e.g., Amazon Ads).</li> <li><strong>Client Presentation Skills:</strong> Comfortable walking client brand managers through plan rationales and budget allocations independently.</li> </ul> <div><strong>Why Join This Team?</strong></div> <ul> <li><strong>Genuine Campaign Ownership:</strong> Lead end-to-end media activations across 30 diverse markets for globally recognized beauty and fragrance houses.</li> <li><strong>Brand-New Paris Hub:</strong> Join a newly forming team with a collaborative startup energy, supported by the stability and scale of a premier global agency account.</li> <li><strong>Scale Behind You:</strong> Lean on dedicated offshore activation desks for technical execution, allowing you to focus on planning craft, client consultation, and strategic optimization.</li> <li><strong>Fast-Track Progression:</strong> Work directly under newly appointed Directors and an account Lead committed to developing internal talent into future leadership seats.</li> </ul> <div><strong>Life at WPP Media and its Benefits</strong></div> <div>Our commitment to shaping the future of media is manifested by active support for the professional development of our talents, helping them reach their full potential. As part of the team, you will be responsible for all things related to services and infrastructure for our Enterprise products.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">A Staff Software Engineer is the next </span><strong>level up from</strong><span style="font-weight: 400;"> a Senior Software Engineer. boundaries as we build for the future.</li> </ul> <p><strong>In this role you will:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Drive revenue acquisition: Take ownership of net-new customer growth by generating 80-90% of your opportunity pipeline through outbound efforts.</li> <li>Expand key regional markets: Contribute to the growth of our mid-market segment across the Benelux region, leveraging expanding regional momentum.</li> <li>Leverage structured methodologies: Utilize professional sales frameworks such as MEDDPICC and Command the Message to effectively guide customer engagements.</li> </ul> multi-stakeholder evaluations and technical proofs-of-concept effectively.</li> <li>Language proficiency: Native-level fluency in Dutch.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Advantageous:</strong></p> <ul> forecasting.</li> <li>Adaptability and growth: A proactive focus on continuous learning, incorporating feedback, and refining tactics over time.</li> </ul><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div fast paced, dynamic environment</span></li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, title: Mission Planning & Ground Station Systems
description: VisionSpace is a dynamic consulting, technology and engineering company delivering solutions and services for the Space and Defence sectors. We work across satellite operations, ground data systems, ground stations, automation, artificial intelligence and cybersecurity. Our motto is Space and Beyond is Our Playground . We empower our customers to shape the future of satellite operations by bringing automation and intelligence into operational systems. About the Role We are looking for a Mission Planning & Ground Station Systems Engineer to join our team supporting activities at EUMETSAT in Darmstadt, Germany . The position will support the CGSS project , an established operational project responsible for an application used to generate ground station pass schedules for EUMETSAT missions . The successful candidate will contribute to the development, maintenance, verification and evolution of the application and will work closely with engineers, operational teams and end users. This is a great opportunity for a professionals in applying their technical skills to operational satellite ground systems and mission planning. What You'll Be Doing Your responsibilities will include: Contributing to the development, maintenance and evolution of the CGSS application . Developing and maintaining software components, with a particular focus on Python-based development . Supporting the development and maintenance of web-based applications and interfaces . Analysing software requirements and translating operational needs into technical solutions. Performing software Verification & Validation (V&V) activities. Preparing and executing functional, integration, regression and acceptance tests. Investigating and troubleshooting software anomalies and supporting their resolution. Supporting the integration and deployment of software releases. Contributing to technical and user documentation. Working directly with end users and operational stakeholders to understand requirements, collect feedback and support effective use of the system. Contributing to the reliability and maintainability of software used within an operational space environment. Working closely with other engineering teams involved in mission planning, ground station systems and satellite operations. What We Look For You do not need to fulfil every requirement below . We are looking for candidates who combine several of these skills and are motivated to develop further within the space operations domain. Technical Experience Ideally, you will bring experience in several of the following areas: Software engineering and the software development lifecycle. Python development . Development of web-based applications . Software Verification & Validation , testing and quality assurance. Requirements analysis and software documentation. Version control and collaborative development environments, preferably using tools such as Git/GitLab . CI/CD, automated testing or software deployment processes. Linux-based development or operational environments. Space Domain Experience Experience or knowledge in one or more of the following would be highly desirable: Satellite or spacecraft operations . Mission Planning Systems or scheduling applications. Ground segment software and operational systems. Ground Station Monitoring and Control systems . Ground station scheduling, pass planning or contact planning. Integration of mission planning applications with other mission control or ground segment systems. Working with operational teams or end users in a mission-critical environment. Previous experience with EUMETSAT, ESA or comparable European space programmes would be an advantage, but is not mandatory . Education Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Telecommunications, Electrical Engineering , or another relevant technical discipline. Relevant professional experience in a similar role is a plus. Personal Skills We're looking for someone who: Has strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Enjoys working directly with technical and operational end users. Can communicate effectively with both software engineers and operational stakeholders. Takes a structured and reliable approach to development, testing and troubleshooting. Can work independently while contributing effectively to a multidisciplinary team. Is curious and willing to learn about mission planning and satellite ground operations. Has good attention to detail, particularly when working with operational software and verification activities. Has English language proficiency at C1 level or above, both written and spoken. Additional Requirements Candidates must have the right to work in the European Union . The role is expected to support activities at EUMETSAT in Darmstadt , so candidates should be willing and able to work from Darmstadt according to the operational needs of the service. Availability to start as early as possible in 2027 , ideally during the first quarter of the year and preferably no later than April 2027 . Ready to join us? If you are passionate about software engineering and would like to apply your skills to real-world satellite operations, we'd love to hear from you . Even if you don't tick every box, we encourage you to apply. A strong background in several of the areas above, combined with the willingness to learn, may be exactly what we're looking for. Apply today! VisionSpace Technologies is committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate based on race, colour, ethnicity, ancestry, national origin, religion, sex, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, marital status, or any other legally protected status. title: Telecom security trainer
description: About P1 Security Founded in 2011, P1 Security is on a mission to secure critical and sovereign mobile networks by providing services and technologies to identify, detect, and recover from critical threats and vulnerabilities. We address telecom security challenges across 5G, cloud-based infrastructure, OpenRAN, network slicing, edge computing (MEC), and legacy telecom systems (2/3/4G), including Diameter, SS7, SIGTRAN, GTP, and related attack surfaces. Our team includes telecom operators, security professionals, and researchers who regularly share cutting-edge work at international security conferences and GSMA working groups. P1 Labs, our R&D branch, also shares open-source initiatives with the telecom security community (GitHub). Job Description Freelance Telecom Security Trainer — Worldwide Onsite Missions We are seeking an experienced Freelance Telecom Security Trainer to deliver high-impact, onsite technical training for mobile network operators (MNOs), regulators, and enterprise clients worldwide. Working on a per-mission basis, you will adapt and present established course content and practical lab materials from P1 Security’s training platform. You will help engineering and security operations center (SOC) teams understand telecom protocol vulnerabilities, assess their impact, and apply effective detection and defense strategies. This role combines deep telecom security expertise with strong classroom facilitation skills and a practical, hands-on approach to learning. Responsibilities Deliver multi-day onsite technical workshops worldwide, adapting your approach to participants’ technical backgrounds and learning objectives. Prepare for each mission by reviewing the course scope, audience prerequisites, learning objectives, and practical lab requirements with the P1 Security team. Adapt existing online curriculum, presentations, exercises, and lab materials for engaging live classroom delivery. Explain signaling flows, trust boundaries, protocol vulnerabilities, attack scenarios, and defensive controls clearly and accurately. Facilitate hands-on exercises in authorized, controlled lab environments and help participants troubleshoot technical issues. Answer participant questions on telecom security, including detection, mitigation, and operational defense strategies. Check participants’ understanding through practical exercises, discussion, and knowledge checks. Coordinate classroom and lab readiness with P1 Security and the client before delivery. Gather participant feedback and share recommendations to improve course content and delivery. Respect client confidentiality, intellectual property, and agreed rules of engagement throughout each mission. Required qualifications Deep telecom security expertise in one or more of the following domains: SS7 / SIGTRAN: MAP/CAP signaling, common abuse scenarios, and signaling security controls. Related course: TS-201 — 2G, 3G and SS7 Mobile Network Security. LTE / Diameter: S6a, Gx, and Gy interfaces, protocol vulnerabilities, and defensive measures. Related course: TS-401 — LTE Security and Insecurity. GTP-C: Versions 1 and 2, control-plane procedures, security risks, and mitigation strategies. Related training tracks: TS-201 — 2G/3G and TS-401 — LTE / EPC, depending on the mission scope. IMS / SIP: Signaling fundamentals, protocol weaknesses, and protection mechanisms. Related course: TS-250 — IMS Security. 5G: Service-based architecture (SBA), HTTP/2 and JSON-based APIs, and interconnect security involving N32 and the Security Edge Protection Proxy (SEPP). Related course: TS-501 — 5G Telecom Security hands-on course. You do not need to cover every domain to apply. Specialists in one or several domains are welcome. Missions will be matched to your demonstrated expertise; please indicate the courses and topics you are confident teaching independently. Proven experience delivering technical training, workshops, or hands-on instruction to engineering or SOC teams. Ability to explain complex technical concepts, manage classroom discussion, and adapt to mixed levels of experience. Practical experience analyzing telecom signaling traces and using packet-analysis tools such as Wireshark. Confidence working with Linux-based lab environments and troubleshooting connectivity or exercise issues. Professional preparation, reliable delivery, and clear communication with clients and the P1 Security team. Willingness and ability to travel internationally for short-term onsite engagements: typically around five days per mission including travel, with some engagements requiring up to two weeks onsite. Preferred qualifications Experience in telecom security consulting, penetration testing, incident response, signaling monitoring, or mobile core network operations. Familiarity with 3GPP security specifications and relevant GSMA signaling security guidance. Experience with signaling firewalls, roaming and interconnect security, or telecom threat detection. Experience adapting digital learning content into instructor-led courses and practical exercises. Familiarity with virtualized or containerized lab environments and scripting for lab preparation. Experience teaching international audiences or working across different cultural and organizational contexts. Language requirements Fluent professional English, with the ability to deliver technical instruction and facilitate discussions. Additional languages are a plus, including French. Engagement details Contract type: Freelance, on a per-mission basis. Delivery location: Onsite at client locations worldwide. Mission duration: Typically around five days including travel; some engagements may require up to two weeks onsite. Headquarters: Paris, France. Training materials: Established curriculum and lab materials from P1 Security’s training platform, adapted for each classroom engagement. Commercial arrangements: Scope, preparation time, delivery dates, fees, and travel and accommodation arrangements to be agreed for each mission. Hiring process First contact call (10-20min) Direct manager call (30min) Capability assessment exercice (depending on position) C-level & Director call (30 min) Contact If you are a motivated and experienced professional who is passionate about cybersecurity and driving innovation, we would love to hear from you! Join P1 Security and be part of a fascinating mission to protect critical infrastructure and work alongside industry experts in the cybersecurity field. To apply, please send your CV or professional profile and a short introduction highlighting your telecom security expertise and training experience. Include the protocols and courses you can teach, examples of previous workshops or audiences, your availability, your location and travel flexibility, and your indicative daily rate. Please do not include confidential client information. title: Directeur.rice des Finances
company: Syctom, agence métropolitaine des déchets ménagers
description: 283 – Directeur.rice des Finances Premier opérateur public européen de traitement et de valorisation des déchets, le Syctom, l’agence métropolitaine des déchets ménagers, est un acteur majeur de l'économie circulaire et de la ville durable. Au service de 81 communes franciliennes et de près de 6 millions d'habitants, le Syctom accomplit sa mission de service public avec pour objectif de faire des déchets une ressource. Une mission exigeante qu'il conduit grâce à ses 145 collaboratrices et collaborateurs et 7 apprenti.es, en lien étroit avec les collectivités adhérentes (Ville de Paris et 10 Etablissements publics territoriaux du Grand Paris) en charge de la collecte des déchets et l'ensemble des acteurs de la filière. Le budget annuel s’élève à 822 M€ et le Plan des Investissements 825 M€ d’ici 2030. Le Syctom traite et valorise chaque année 2,2 millions de tonnes de déchets ménagers dans ses unités de traitement innovantes (3 unités de valorisation énergétique - UVE -, 5 centres de tri, 2 centres de transfert et une future unité de Biométhanisation). Le patrimoine du syndicat, alliant performance industrielle et exemplarité environnementale, est exploité sous contrat par des entreprises privées ou des SemOp présidées par un.e élu.e du syndicat. Acteur responsable et innovant, le Syctom est engagé en première ligne dans la dynamique de transition écologique française. Il accompagne le développement de la collecte des déchets alimentaires, développe des solutions de traitement et de valorisation, agit en faveur de la réduction et du tri des déchets et s’engage dans la réduction des émissions de gaz à effet de serre (GES) liées à ses activités de transport et de logistique. La Direction générale adjointe Ressources et moyens (DGARM) pilote les moyens financiers, humains, informatiques, juridiques et logistiques ainsi que du fonctionnement de l’institution et des actions œuvrant à la qualité de vie au travail. Elle accompagne les directions opérationnelles au quotidien, pilote des processus et démarches collectives et participe au projet stratégique de la collectivité, qui définit des orientations communes afin que le Syctom accompagne au mieux le territoire dans ses ambitions de développement durable. Acteur clé de la performance et de la soutenabilité financière du Syctom, la Direction des Finances assure le pilotage des ressources financières de l’établissement. Elle accompagne les projets stratégiques de la collectivité en apportant son expertise en matière de planification et d’ingénierie financière, de construction budgétaire, de tarification et de financement des investissements, dans un environnement institutionnel, réglementaire et économique contraint et en constante évolution. Dans un contexte de structuration et de modernisation de ses fonctions ressources, le Syctom mène actuellement un audit stratégique visant à renforcer la fonction financière et à développer une culture de pilotage et de contrôle de gestion. Celle-ci vise à consolider les capacités d'analyse et d'anticipation de l'établissement, à développer une culture de pilotage de la performance et à renforcer les outils d'aide à la décision au service de la Direction générale et des élu.es. Missions Sous la responsabilité du Directeur général adjoint Ressources et moyens, vous pilotez la définition et la mise en œuvre de la stratégie financière et budgétaire de la collectivité. Le budget 2026 s’élève à 479 M€ en fonctionnement et 343 M€ en investissement. Le montant de la contribution acquittée par les collectivités membres du syndicat est de 268 M€. A partir d’hypothèses que vous coordonnez et documentez en lien avec les directions opérationnelles, vous réalisez des prospectives financières pluriannuelles. Dans ce cadre, vous êtes chargé.e de structurer un dialogue de gestion budgétaire qui permette d’optimiser les moyens financiers du Syctom et de piloter au plus juste le montant de redevance acquittée par les collectivités membres. Vous proposez un cadrage financier et pilotez les processus et calendriers budgétaires en lien avec les directions opérationnelles. Dans le cadre de la feuille de route, vous êtes force de proposition et préparez, sous la responsabilité de la Direction générale, les travaux et décisions des élu.es quant à la trajectoire financière et tarifaire du syndicat. Vous conduisez les analyses financières en vue de déterminer les risques et opportunités à court et long termes, et proposez des scénarios à la Direction générale. Vous construisez et pilotez des indicateurs financiers clés et proposez des outils d’aide à la décision pour la Direction générale et l’exécutif, en développant le SI décisionnel financier. title: Engineering Internship - Deep Learning for Infrared Thermography Antenna Measurements
description: THE POSITION ANYFIELDS measures antennas by infrared thermography: a thermosensitive film heated by the radiated field is imaged by an infrared camera, giving a 2D map of the electric field, nonintrusive and very close to the antenna. Two limits remain: the maps are noisy (dynamic range of 25 to 30 dB at best, 35 to 40 dB needed to retrieve side lobes and cross-polarization), and they are blurred by the response of the detector (film and optics), whose resolution is not explained by the theory. This internship develops physics-driven neural networks, trained without any clean reference, to restore the maps, and compares them rigorously with the conventional methods already implemented. Missions : Benchmark synthetic and measured datasets, reproduction of the conventional methods (wavelet denoising, drift removal, deconvolution, slanted edge). Estimate PSF of the detector: neural network constrained by the film heat diffusion and the optics, estimated from a few measurements; explain the gap between the theoretical (about 1 mm) and measured (4 to 8 mm) resolution. Compare with conventional methods. Implement Denoising by self-supervised deep denoising of the maps, quantified gain in dB towards 35 to 40 dB, ranking of the limiting factors of the setup. Validate by test whether the imaging resolves the individual elements of array antennas in the Ku and Ka bands, before and after improvement. Report on the retained methods. title: Chief Customer Officer
description: Work from anywhere, impact everywhere Diversity is at the heart of who we are at Xapo Bank. We're a fully distributed team of over 160 Xapiens that work remotely from 50+ countries around the world. Our beginning: A world that enjoys economic freedom and wealth protection,no matter where you live or who is running your country. To achieve that, we search the world for the best people for the job. We work hard, think globally, and inspire each other to learn and grow. We are committed to changing the way things are done. Although we are headquartered in Gibraltar, this is a full time, 100% remote position Work from anywhere! Position overview Xapo's product suite has grown from a Bitcoin vault into a full member proposition: BTC and USD accounts that pay interest, a global card with Bitcoin cashback, Bitcoin-backed loans, a growing suite of BTC wealth and credit products, and access to stocks, ETFs, and stablecoins, all inside one regulated relationship. Xapo is a bank, and a bank earns on the money its members choose to hold with it. Each of those products shipped well. What hasn't yet existed is a single owner of the economics of the customer relationship: one person accountable for winning the right members, growing what they hold with us, and keeping them, and for the balance-sheet products that make that possible. The Chief Customer Officer is a new role at the top of the house, reporting to the CEO. You will run the stream that grows what members hold with Xapo, and you will own the Customer P&L, retail and institutional. It brings growth, client coverage, product management, and product design under one leader who is judged on customer contribution, the assets attracted and kept, and the members who stay. This is a customer-focused role in the most commercial sense: what a member earns from us, not the feature we shipped, is the centre of every decision. The measure of success is a Customer P&L that grows on what members hold and keep: LTV:CAC improving, approved-to-paid rising, churn falling, and customer contribution the business can plan against. This is a banking role, not a requirements-gathering role, a marketing role, or a role you can run from a dashboard. Products are priced on the balance sheet and judged on the money they attract and keep. The mandate Own the Customer P&L, retail and institutional. You own customer contribution: customer gross profit from what members' balances earn, secured lending, Bitcoin yield, and conversion, stocks and ETFs, less the cost of winning and keeping members. We earn on what members hold, not on what they tap, send, or click, so you run on assets held and the margin they earn, not payment volume. Good looks like a Customer P&L the Exco and Board can plan against, where every line has a number you own and can explain, up or down. Grow what members hold with us, through earning products run like a banker would. You own the roadmap for the balance-sheet products: deposits and savings, lending and credit, and trading and structured. Each is led by a mission PM who is a banker, owning a product's contribution and its price on the balance sheet, not a backlog. Requirements go through the gate; the economics are the job. Every item is priced by Finance before it is built, on a shared risk appetite with Risk and Treasury. Good looks like products that scale assets held and member lifetime value at a risk profile the Board actually approved. Win the right members, efficiently. You own Growth: audience, lifecycle, and content, with one head accountable for the path from approval to paid. You own CAC and approved-to-paid, find the members who bring other members, and activate them in week one. Every incentive is priced before it runs. Good looks like net paid-member growth that improves every quarter, at a CAC that LTV comfortably justifies, because you diagnosed where the funnel leaks rather than spending more to fill it. Keep members, and deepen the relationship with the ones who hold balances. Retention is the most efficient growth we have. You own churn, and you own Client Coverage: relationship managers who sell the missions' products to the members who hold balances, and loop demand back into the roadmap. You are accountable for net new AUM flow, covered-book retention, and products per covered member, and for growth that is broad-based rather than concentrated in a few accounts. Good looks like falling churn and AUM growth from members who stay and expand rather than members re-acquired at cost. Make the value of Xapo visible, and the experience effortless. You own Product Design: one design system and one shell, so that members see the value of what they are earning clearly and early, and find every task simple. You design the proposition in the stream with Finance and partner with Operations, who run onboarding, KYC, support, cards, and payments, to remove friction at the points that affect members most. Good looks like members who understand their return, complete what they set out to do, and stay. Build one Customer organisation, not four. Growth, Client Coverage, Mission PMs, and Product Design come together under one operating model: one set of key results read weekly from one source, shared frameworks for discovery and prioritisation, and real career paths for the people in it. Engineering is pulled to a single ranked roadmap, and nobody in your line has engineers of their own. Good looks like fewer hand-offs per outcome and a number for every cell that its owner explains every week. Bring the regulated-bank and crypto-native lens to every customer call. You understand that a KYC onboarding decision and an AML monitoring decision carry different risk appetites, that a false positive at the gate is a paid-for member lost, and that a proposition built for a crypto-native power user can still fail a first-time bank customer. You can sit in the same room as a CRO, an MLRO, a CFO, and an engineering lead and make a customer case that survives all four conversations. How you'll operate This part matters as much as the mandate. The known failure mode for this role, in any company, is a CCO with a polished customer-insight deck and no ownership of the number. That is disqualifying here. You lead from inside the work. You sit in on growth reviews, mission PM reviews, client meetings, and member calls, not just steering committees. PMs, designers, and relationship managers three levels down know your name because you've solved problems with them. You move people with the business case, not the whip. When a priority needs to change, you diagnose the problem, build the case with data and the economics, and show teams why it matters, so they re-prioritise because they're convinced, not because they were told. Your authority comes from being right and being useful, not from your title. You have extreme ownership. You own the Customer P&L and the member metrics beneath it, not the feature ship date. If a launch didn't move contribution, LTV:CAC, approved-to-paid, or churn, you don't report "the roadmap item shipped", you change the approach. You have genuine gravitas. Senior, experienced leaders welcome your input because you've earned the standing to give it. You can challenge any executive's plan, including the CEO's, constructively, with evidence, and be thanked for it, because your challenge makes their work stronger. You diagnose before you prescribe. You can walk into a leaking funnel, a churning segment, or a product that isn't earning and find the structural cause, then fix the economics, not just the symptom. What you'll have done 10+ years in senior commercial or customer leadership (CCO, Chief Growth or Commercial Officer, MD or Head of Retail or Wealth, or equivalent) in digital banking, fintech, or payments, including meaningful time in a regulated environment (banking licence, e-money, or equivalent prudential/conduct regime). Crypto-native credibility: hands-on experience building and growing customer propositions on or around digital assets, custody, on-chain flows, Bitcoin-backed lending, or similar. You don't need Bitcoin explained to you, and you don't need banking explained to you either. Customer P&L ownership: you have owned a customer or product P&L judged on contribution, balances, and margin rather than transaction volume, and you are fluent in NIM, unit economics, customer contribution, and LTV:CAC. Vous apportez un carnet d'adresses immédiatement activable. Confirmé B2B, autre secteur — vente de projets à panier élevé (BTP, agencement, mobilier professionnel, équipement, retail, énergie). Vous apportez de l'énergie et une capacité à vous former sans habitudes à défaire. Le socle commun, non négociable Vente B2B de projets à cycle long et à panier élevé, à partir de 150 000 €. Capacité à ouvrir un compte à froid, sans lead entrant et sans introduction. Aptitude à lire un besoin d'aménagement, comprendre un plan et dialoguer avec des interlocuteurs techniques. Rigueur dans la tenue d'un CRM et dans le suivi des engagements pris. Qualité de l'écrit professionnel : une proposition mal écrite décrédibilise un projet à 200 000 €. Une posture de conseil : vous aidez un investisseur à réussir un projet, vous ne vendez pas des travaux. De l'exigence et de la fiabilité : ce que vous annoncez, vous le tenez. De la tenue dans la durée : un cycle de vente de 3 à 4 mois demande de la constance. Une ambition assumée : la part variable est déplafonnée, elle est faite pour ceux qui veulent aller la chercher. Avantages Une rémunération pensée pour la performance Le principe est simple et assumé : un fixe qui sécurise, un variable sans plafond qui récompense la performance réelle. Un fixe mensuel selon expérience et valeur apportée. Une prime versée à la signature de chaque projet de construction ou de rénovation, proportionnelle et non plafonnée. Une prime à la signature d'un partenariat structurant, franchise ou groupe. Une commission sur les marchés que vous apportez, selon les règles en vigueur dans l'entreprise. Le fixe couvre vos besoins. Le variable, lui, n'a pas de plafond : une personne performante gagne significativement plus que son fixe. title: Senior Product Manager - Zero-Day Protection
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><h3>Remote within: US, Canada, UK, Portugal<br><br>About the role</h3> <p>New vulnerabilities can be exploited soon after public disclosure, leaving application owners little time to patch. Cloudflare can drastically reduce this exposure through managed WAF protections, ad-hoc emergency policies, and tools that help customers identify affected applications and remediate them.</p> <p>As Senior Product Manager for Zero-Day Protection, your goal is to help protect more than 20% of the Internet from HTTP-exploitable vulnerabilities and attacks. You will own the strategy, roadmap, execution, and customer experience for Cloudflare’s zero-day protection products, beginning with WAF Managed Rules. The role also shapes how Cloudflare helps customers identify affected applications, deploy temporary mitigations, investigate active exploitation, and remediate vulnerable software.</p> <h1>Responsibilities</h1> <h2>Product strategy and roadmap</h2> <ul> <li>Own the strategy and roadmap for WAF Managed Rules and Cloudflare’s broader zero-day protection experience.</li> <li>Partner with other product and engineering teams to help customers identify exposure, deploy mitigations, investigate attacks, and remediate vulnerable software.</li> <li>Define how Managed Rules integrates with code scanning and exposure discovery to help customers identify applications affected by newly disclosed vulnerabilities.</li> <li>Prioritize shared security primitives, telemetry, and APIs that make emergency protections easier to automate across Cloudflare’s security products.</li> <li>Define workflows for creating, testing, deploying, and auditing ad-hoc emergency policies when a managed detection is not sufficient for a customer’s environment.</li> <li>Partner with the Cloudflare Security Research team to turn threat intelligence, vulnerability research, and detection opportunities into product priorities. Security provide technical guidance; the PM brings customer impact and product context.</li> <li>Partner with Security, Legal, and external researchers during coordinated disclosure processes to prepare customer protections and communications.</li> <li>Discover and prioritize Enterprise operational needs with customers, Solutions Engineering, Support, and Engineering.</li> </ul> <h2>Customer experience</h2> <ul> <li>Own the end-to-end customer journey: identifying affected applications, discovering protections, deploying them safely, testing before enforcement, reviewing security events, investigating incidents, configuring exceptions and confirming remediation</li> <li>Ensure customers can understand what protections they have, what events mean, and what action to take.</li> <li>Establish feedback loops with Support, Customer Success, Solutions Engineering, and customers. Turn recurring friction and unmet needs into product priorities.</li> </ul> <h2>Operations and communications</h2> <ul> <li>Support the Cloudflare Security Research team’s vulnerability-response work by providing product context and customer perspective</li> <li>Coordinate responsible disclosure and external vulnerability communications with Security, Legal, and Communications</li> <li>Write technical posts, customer guidance, and product communications for security researchers, customers, press, and non-technical audiences</li> <li>Represent Cloudflare in the broader security community, at conferences, and online as a product and technical spokesperson for Managed Rules and HTTP application vulnerabilities</li> </ul> <h2>Skills Required </h2> <ul> <li>Strong product-management experience, including strategy, roadmap ownership, discovery, prioritization, and cross-functional delivery.</li> <li>Technical fluency to understand HTTP applications, vulnerabilities, exploits, and detection systems.</li> <li>Ability to synthesize input from security research, engineers, customers, and commercial teams into clear product decisions.</li> <li>Customer empathy and strong product judgment, especially for complex technical workflows.</li> <li>Excellent written and verbal communication for technical and non-technical audiences.</li> <li>Comfort operating in a fast-moving, ambiguous security environment.</li> <li>Strong cross-functional leadership across Cloudflare Security Research, Engineering, Support, Customer Success, Solutions Engineering, Legal, Communications, and other product teams.</li> </ul> <h2>Nice to have</h2> <ul> <li>Security research, exploit-development, or detection-engineering experience.</li> <li>Experience with WAFs, managed rules, security-rule rollout, false-positive management, application security, threat intelligence, security operations or vulnerability management.</li> <li>Experience with Enterprise security operations, including APIs, automation, auditability, policy controls, logs, and SIEM integrations.</li> <li>Experience with code scanning, software supply-chain security, or exposure discovery.</li> <li>An established presence in the security research community, conference speaking, technical writing, or press engagement.</li> </ul> <h4>Compensation</h4> <p>Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location.</p> <ul> <li>For <strong>Lisbon </strong>based hires: Estimated annual salary of 65,000 - 80,000 EURO</li> <li>For <strong>New York City </strong>based hires: Estimated annual salary of $156,000 - $216,000</li> </ul> <h4>Equity</h4> <p>This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare's equity plan.</p> <h4>Benefits</h4> <p>Cloudflare offers a complete package of benefits and programs to support you and your family. Our benefits programs can help you pay health care expenses, support caregiving, build capital for the future and make life a little easier and fun! The below is a description of our benefits for employees in the United States, and benefits may vary for employees based outside the U.S.</p> <p><strong>Health & Welfare Benefits</strong></p> <ul> <li>Medical/Rx Insurance</li> <li>Dental Insurance</li> <li>Vision Insurance</li> <li>Flexible Spending Accounts</li> <li>Commuter Spending Accounts</li> <li>Fertility & Family Forming Benefits</li> <li>On-demand mental health support and Employee Assistance Program</li> <li>Global Travel Medical Insurance</li> </ul> <p><strong>Financial Benefits</strong></p> <ul> <li>Short and Long Term Disability Insurance</li> <li>Life & Accident Insurance</li> <li>401(k) Retirement Savings Plan</li> <li>Employee Stock Participation Plan</li> </ul> <p><strong>Time Off</strong></p> <ul> <li>Flexible paid time off covering vacation and sick leave</li> <li>Leave programs, including parental, pregnancy health, medical, and bereavement leave</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: We released</span><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">1.1.1.1</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our</span><a href="https://developers.cloudflare.com/1.1.1.1/privacy/public-dns-resolver"> privacy commitment</a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs.  More details about this will be available at that stage

Zeitfenster, Preise, Zahlungen, Lieferungen, Bestände: Überall steckt Logik, die stimmen muss. Und wir haben noch viel vor.
