title: Manager, Forward Deployed Engineering
description: <div class="content-intro"><h2><strong>About Anthropic</strong></h2> <p>Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.</p></div><h2><strong>About the role</strong></h2> <p>Anthropic is building the team to help the world's most ambitious organizations adopt Claude in ways that are transformative, safe, and lasting. Our Forward Deployed Engineers embed directly with strategic customers to ship production AI applications that solve real business problems. As this practice grows, we need a founding leader to build and scale it.</p> <p>As the first FDE Manager in DACH, you'll own the team that sits at the frontier of enterprise AI deployment. You'll hire and develop a high-performing team of FDEs, set the technical and operational bar for customer engagements, and build the playbooks that turn one-off successes into repeatable patterns. You'll work hand-in-hand with Engagement Managers who own delivery logistics and stakeholder management, while you ensure your team is shipping quality code, growing technically, and representing Anthropic at the highest level in customer environments.</p> <p>This is a player-coach role with a strong bias toward leadership. You'll stay close enough to the technical work to review architectures, debug production issues, and pair with your team when it matters — but your primary impact will come from the people you hire, the standards you set, and the culture you create. You'll partner cross-functionally with Sales, Product, and Engineering to shape how Anthropic serves its most strategic customers, and your team's field insights will directly influence product direction.</p> <p>This role requires someone who thrives in ambiguity and is energized by building from zero to one. You'll be defining what good looks like for FDE management at Anthropic — there is no existing playbook to follow.</p> <h2><strong>Responsibilities</strong></h2> <ul> <li> <p>Hire, develop, and retain a world-class team of Forward Deployed Engineers. Set a high bar for technical talent and customer instincts.</p> </li> <li> <p>Conduct regular 1:1s, provide technical mentorship, and invest in the career growth of each team member. Create an environment where FDEs do the best work of their careers.</p> </li> <li> <p>Staff and oversee customer engagements across your team's portfolio, making resource allocation decisions that balance customer needs, team development, and business priorities.</p> </li> <li> <p>Collaborate with account teams and Engagement Managers during the pre-sales process to qualify engagements, scope work, and inform statements of work.</p> </li> <li> <p>Review technical architectures and code produced by your FDEs, ensuring the team ships high-quality, production-ready solutions that solve real customer problems.</p> </li> <li> <p>Stay hands-on enough to lead technical discovery sessions, prototype solutions, and debug complex issues alongside your team when needed.</p> </li> <li> <p>Build repeatable playbooks, starter repositories, integration templates, and an internal knowledge base that captures what your team learns in the field.</p> </li> <li> <p>Define team OKRs that tie to customer success outcomes and product adoption goals. Create operational cadences — standups, retros, engagement reviews — that keep the team aligned.</p> </li> <li> <p>Partner with Product and Engineering to translate field insights into product improvements. Serve as the voice of the customer in internal planning.</p> </li> <li> <p>Travel to customer sites as needed (25-50%), particularly during engagement kickoffs and for your team's highest-priority accounts.</p> </li> </ul> <h2><strong>You may be a good fit if you have</strong></h2> <ul> <li> <p>10+ years of experience in software engineering, solutions architecture, or a technical customer-facing role such as forward deployed engineering or consulting.</p> </li> <li> <p>2+ years of people management experience within a services/post-sales/FDE organization with a track record of hiring, developing, and retaining strong engineers.</p> </li> <li> <p>Experience building organizations from 0->1, not just inheriting an existing one.</p> </li> <li> <p>Experience working directly with enterprise customers on technical implementations, including comfort navigating complex organizational dynamics.</p> </li> <li> <p>Executive presence with the ability to move fluidly between strategic conversations with senior stakeholders and hands-on debugging sessions with engineers.</p> </li> <li> <p>Strong written and verbal communication skills. You can translate technical complexity into clear narratives for diverse audiences.</p> </li> <li> <p>Genuine excitement about building something new and defining what great looks like for a team that doesn't yet exist.</p> </li> </ul> <h2>Why this role matters</h2> <p>You'll be a founding leader of a team that defines how enterprises adopt and scale AI. Your work will directly influence Anthropic's product direction, create reusable patterns for the broader customer base, and establish Anthropic as the trusted partner for AI transformation — all while advancing the responsible development of frontier AI systems.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><h2><strong>Logistics</strong></h2> <p><strong>Minimum education: </strong>Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience</p> <p><strong>Required field of study: </strong>A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience</p> <p><strong>Minimum years of experience: </strong>Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position</p> <p><strong>Location-based hybrid policy:</strong> Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.</p> <p><strong data-stringify-type="bold">Visa sponsorship:</strong> We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.</p> <p><strong>We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification.</strong> Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed.  Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.<br><br><strong data-stringify-type="bold">Your safety matters to us.</strong> To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you ----- addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit <u data-stringify-type="underline"><a class="c-link c-link--underline" href="http://anthropic.com/careers" target="_blank" data-stringify-link="http://anthropic.com/careers" data-sk="tooltip_parent" data-remove-tab-index="true">anthropic.com/careers</a></u> directly for confirmed position openings.</p> <h2><strong>How we're different</strong></h2> <p>We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.</p> <p>The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.</p> <h2><strong>Come work with us!</strong></h2> <p>Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. <strong data-stringify-type="bold">Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage:</strong> Learn about <a class="c-link" href="https://www.anthropic.com/candidate-ai-guidance" target="_blank" data-stringify-link="https://www.anthropic.com/candidate-ai-guidance" data-sk="tooltip_parent">our policy</a> for using AI in our application process.</p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

If you like building relationships that last, and you’d rather help shape a plan than follow one handed to you, we’d love to talk.</p> <p><strong>What you’ve done</strong></p> <ul> <li>You’ve spent around 8 years selling to businesses, ideally enterprise SaaS or technology, and you know how a complex deal moves through a big organisation.</li> <li>You hit your number, and you can talk through partner relationship takes time, trust and being useful to each other.</li> <li>You’ve found new business in tech without waiting for leads to arrive, through outbound, community, or whichever route worked.</li> <li>You’re at home in Salesforce and LinkedIn Sales Navigator, and you use your tools to save time rather than to fill a dashboard.</li> </ul> <p>Can you relate to the above? </p> <p><strong>Where you are</strong></p> <ul> <li>Based in the Netherlands, with fluent Dutch and English</li> </ul> <p><strong>What we hope you’re like</strong></p> <ul> <li class="whitespace-normal break-words">You are an enthusiastic, energetic team player who is comfortable working in a fast-paced and evolving environment</li> <li>You care about doing good work and you’re consistent about it</li> <li>You’d like to help build something new and see your impact, rather than slot into a big company with fixed ways of doing things</li> <li>You’re curious and like working through a problem with others to find a good way forward</li> <li>You stay calm and organised when priorities pull in different directions</li> <li>You can work well with a large team spread across locations to win and grow enterprise accounts</li> <li>You’re honest and thoughtful in how you treat prospects and customers, and you bring your values to the way you work</li> </ul> <p>Our process has four stages, including a panel interview, so you’ll meet several of the people you’d be working with. We’ll explain what to expect at each step, and you’re welcome to ask us anything along the way. This is a hybrid position, does require you to attend our Amsterdam office</p> <p>WeWork - Strawinskylaan 4117, 1077 <span data-highlighted="true" data-vc="highlighted-text"><span class="_1mT5xdRAKS"><span class="_0nmozVaHVx _2V7sgO2M4S _3BoeIDwZ7G _30zrXRyxdf _0ReiIH7zJH" data-testid="definition-highlighter">ZX</span></span></span> Amsterdam, Netherlands <br><br>This is a full time position</p> Find more English Speaking Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

title: Teamleiter (m/w/d) - Automation & Instandhaltung
description: <section class="section vacancy-detail-intro-section"> <div class="section-inner"> <div class="entry-intro"> <section class="section vacancy-detail-intro-section"> <div class="section-inner"> <div class="entry-intro"> <h2><strong>Kurz und knapp</strong></h2> <p>Als Teamleiter (m/w/d) - Automation & Instandhaltung arbeitest du in unserem neuen Fulfilment Center im Raum Berlin/Brandenburg (Falkensee) mit hochautomatisierten Intralogistiksystemen von Top-Marken wie Apollo, Qimarox und Regal Rexnord. Du übernimmst die operative Verantwortung für die Instandhaltung während deiner Schicht und führst unser Team aus Maintenance Technicians.</p> <p>Du setzt Prioritäten, sorgst für eine sichere und strukturierte Arbeitsweise und bist die zentrale Schnittstelle zwischen Maintenance und Operations. Bei kritischen Störungen übernimmst du die Führung und stellst gemeinsam mit deinem Team sicher, dass unsere Anlagen schnell wieder laufen.</p> <p>Deine Führungskompetenz, dein technisches Verständnis und deine Hands-on-Mentalität sind gefragt, damit täglich rund 10.000 Bestellungen pünktlich bei unseren Kund:innen ankommen.</p> <p><iframe src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/50pQKpPc24E" width="560" height="314"></iframe></p> <h2><strong>Das erwartet dich </strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>Führe & entwickle dein Team:</strong> Du führst die Maintenance Technicians während deiner Schicht, coachst sie im Arbeitsalltag und unterstützt ihre Entwicklung.</li> <li><strong>Steuere die Schicht:</strong> Du setzt Prioritäten, koordinierst die Maintenance-Aktivitäten und stellst eine hohe Qualität und Anlagenverfügbarkeit sicher.</li> <li><strong>Manage kritische Störungen:</strong> Du koordinierst dein Team bei technischen Problemen und arbeitest eng mit Operations zusammen, um Ausfallzeiten zu minimieren.</li> <li><strong>Sorge für Sicherheit & Struktur:</strong> Du stellst sicher, dass unsere Sicherheitsstandards sowie eine saubere und strukturierte Arbeitsweise eingehalten werden.</li> <li><strong>Treibe Verbesserungen voran:</strong> Du identifizierst Verbesserungspotenziale und setzt Lean-, 5S- und Continuous-Improvement-Maßnahmen gemeinsam mit deinem Team um.</li> <li><strong>Arbeite übergreifend zusammen:</strong> Du stimmst dich eng mit Operations, Maintenance Engineers und externen Maintenance-Partnern ab.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Das bringst du mit</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Du hast eine Weiterbildung zum Techniker oder Meister oder ein abgeschlossenes technisches Studium (Bachelor/Master), z. B. in Mechatronik, Maschinenbau, Elektrotechnik oder einem vergleichbaren Bereich</li> <li>Du bringst 10+ Jahre Erfahrung in einem technischen oder Instandhaltungsumfeld mit, idealerweise in einer automatisierten, logistischen oder produzierenden Umgebung</li> <li>Du hast mindestens 3 Jahre Führungserfahrung, z. B. als Team Lead, Lead Technician, Supervisor oder in einer vergleichbaren Rolle</li> <li>Du hast eine Hands-on-Mentalität und verstehst sowohl die technische als auch die operative Seite von Maintenance</li> <li>Du hast Erfahrung mit Lean, 5S und Continuous Improvement und setzt diese Prinzipien gerne praktisch auf der Fläche um</li> <li>Du arbeitest strukturiert, übernimmst Verantwortung und behältst auch bei kritischen Störungen den Überblick</li> <li>Du sprichst fließend Englisch (Deutschkenntnisse sind ein großes Plus)</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Darauf kannst du dich freuen </strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>Individuelle Mobilität:</strong> Du erhältst einen Firmenwagen (auch zur privaten Nutzung) und kannst zusätzlich unser „Lease-a-Bike“-Programm nutzen.</li> <li><strong>Zeit zum Auftanken: </strong>Mit 30 Urlaubstagen pro Jahr (bei einer 40-Stunden-Woche im Schichtsystem) sorgst du für den perfekten Ausgleich zwischen Arbeit und Erholung.</li> <li><strong>Verpflegung für Gewinner: </strong>Wir kümmern uns um dich. Genieße jeden Tag ein frisches, kostenloses Frühstück und Mittag- oder Abendessen in unserem Fulfilment Center, dazu gibt es reichlich Snacks und Obst für den Energiekick zwischendurch.</li> <li><strong>Die Basics:</strong> Wir stellen dir alles für deinen Erfolg bereit - inklusive Laptop und Handy sowie Zugang zu exklusiven Mitarbeiter-Rabatten (Corporate Benefits) für Reisen, Technik und vieles mehr.</li> <li><strong>Starte durch - mit uns: </strong>Werde Teil unseres internationalen Teams in einem Umfeld, das echtes Wachstum und eine „Act like an Owner“-Mentalität fördert. Bei uns hast du die Chance, Projekte eigenverantwortlich voranzutreiben, neue Ideen zu testen und direkt miterleben zu können, wie deine Arbeit in unserem schnell wachsenden Unternehmen Wirkung zeigt.</li> <li><strong>Nachhaltigkeit als Kern:</strong> Werde Teil der Revolution. Du trägst zu einer grüneren Zukunft bei - durch unsere 100 % elektrische Flotte und eine Lieferkette, die Lebensmittelverschwendung reduziert.</li> <li><strong>Unvergessliche Momente:</strong> Wir sind mehr als nur ein Team. Von unserem legendären jährlichen Ski-Trip über Weihnachtsfeiern bis hin zu Auftritten unserer eigenen Picnic-Band: Wir feiern unsere Erfolge gemeinsam.</li> <li><strong>Wohlbefinden & Gleichgewicht: </strong>Wir bieten dir professionelle Unterstützung für deine mentale Gesundheit mit OpenUp.</li> </ul> <p> </p> </div> </div> </section> </div> </div> </section> Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Betriebsingenieur / Senior Manufacturing Engineer (m/w/d) - Pharmaproduktion
description: <p style="text-align: justify;"><em>Simtra ist ein erstklassiges Auftragsentwicklungs- & Herstellungsunternehmen, welches seit über 65 Jahren in Zusammenarbeit mit mehr als 60 internationalen Kunden weltweit sterile, injizierbare Arzneimittel auf den Markt bringt. Unser Hauptaugenmerk liegt hierbei auf der Herstellung von Krebstherapeutika. <span style="font-style: italic;">Mit der Unterstützung von über 2.000 Mitarbeitenden an unseren drei Standorten in Bloomington, Indiana, USA; Parsippany, New Jersey, USA und Halle/Westfalen, Deutschland</span>, können wir unseren Kunden ein breites Portfolio von Verabreichungssystemen anbieten, darunter vorgefüllte Spritzen, flüssige/lyophilisierte Fläschchen, Verdünnungsmittel für die Rekonstitution, mit Pulver gefüllte Fläschchen und sterile Kristallisation. Neben der GMP-Herstellung bieten wir auch weitere Dienstleistungen an, darunter Unterstützung bei der Formulierung und Entwicklung, Gefriertrocknungsoptimierung, globale regulatorische Unterstützung sowie Sekundärverpackung.</em></p> <p style="text-align: justify;"><em>Simtra wird aus vielseitigen Teams in verschiedenen Bereichen gebildet! Werden Sie ein Teil des Teams und unterstützen Sie zukünftig dabei Patienten weltweit lebensverändernde Medikamente zur Verfügung zu stellen.</em></p> <hr> <p>Wir produzieren in unserem Werk in Halle/Westfalen Arzneimittel zur Therapie verschiedener Krebs- und anderer lebensbedrohenden Erkrankungen. </p> <p>Für unser Team suchen wir Dich als erfahrenen <strong>Senior Betriebsingenieur </strong>/ <strong>Senior Manufacturing Engineer (m/w/d).</strong></p> <p>Als Senior Manufacturing Engineer (m/w/d) übernimmst Du eine Schlüsselrolle an der Schnittstelle zwischen Produktion, Technik, Qualität und externen Partnern. Du stellst sicher, dass unsere Anlagen zuverlässig, GMP-konform und zukunftsfähig betrieben werden – und leistest damit einen direkten Beitrag dazu, lebensverändernde Medikamente sicher und effizient verfügbar zu machen.</p> <p>In dieser Position sicherst Du im laufenden Betrieb die Einhaltung von GMP- und EHS-Standards. Dein Schwerpunkt liegt auf der technischen Verfügbarkeit unserer Produktionsanlagen, einem strukturierten Wartungs- und Ersatzteilmanagement sowie der kontinuierlichen Verbesserung von Anlagen und Prozessen in der Pharmaproduktion. Zu Deinen Aufgaben gehören:</p> <ul> <li>Du verantwortest die Instandhaltung unserer Anlagen, zum Beispiel Kessel- und Rührsysteme sowie Filtrationsanlagen mit Isolatortechnik, und nutzt dafür ein Maintenance Management System</li> <li>Du übernimmst die Planung und Einhaltung des Wartungsbudgets, der Terminierungen und der Leistungsparameter sowie die Koordination interner und externer Dienstleister</li> <li>Als technische Expertin bzw. technischer Experte begleitest Du den Produktionsbetrieb, analysierst systematisch Fehler und Prozesse und treibst Optimierungen mithilfe von Lean- und Six-Sigma-Werkzeugen voran</li> <li>Du erstellst GMP-gerechte Projekt- und Qualifizierungsdokumentationen (u.a. Lastenheft, Pflichtenheft, Risikoanalyse, DQ-/IQ-/OQ-Dokumentation)</li> <li>Du koordinierst und führst Qualifizierungs-, Validierungs- und Optimierungsmaßnahmen durch</li> <li>Als technischer Ansprechpartner (m/w/d) übernimmst Du die Durchführung von Schulungen</li> </ul> <p>Dich erwartet ein technisch anspruchsvolles Produktionsumfeld mit modernen Anlagen, klaren Qualitätsstandards und einem Team, das lösungsorientiert zusammenarbeitet. In Deiner Rolle kannst Du Verantwortung übernehmen, Verbesserungen aktiv vorantreiben und Deine technische Expertise sichtbar einbringen.</p> <p>Bei uns kannst Du Deine Expertise in einem hochregulierten Produktionsumfeld weiterentwickeln, technische Verantwortung übernehmen und Verbesserungen sichtbar mitgestalten. Wir unterstützen Dich dabei, Deine fachlichen und methodischen Kompetenzen auszubauen und Deine Erfahrung gezielt in anspruchsvolle Projekte einzubringen.</p> <p><strong>Du bringst mit:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Du hast ein abgeschlossenes Studium im Bereich der (pharmazeutischen) Verfahrenstechnik oder Maschinenbau, alternativ eine vergleichbare Qualifikation</li> <li>Du bringst einschlägige Berufserfahrung (5 bis 10 Jahre) im Bereich Betriebstechnik mit, gerne mit Schwerpunkt in der Herstellung pharmazeutischer Produkte</li> <li>Du hast Freude daran, technische Projekte eigenverantwortlich zu planen, umzusetzen und gemeinsam mit internen sowie externen Schnittstellen erfolgreich abzuschließen</li> <li>Du bringst Interesse und idealerweise Erfahrung in Automatisierungsthemen mit und möchtest technische Verbesserungen aktiv vorantreiben</li> <li>Ein ausgeprägtes Verständnis für komplexe Prozesse, hohe Kommunikationsfähigkeit sowie eine lösungsorientierte und belastbare Arbeitsweise gehören zu Deinen Stärken</li> <li>Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift sowie gute EDV- und Softwarekenntnisse, insbesondere in ERP-Systemen und MS Office, runden Dein Profil ab</li> </ul> <p>Neben einer verantwortungsvollen Aufgabe in einem internationalen Unternehmensumfeld bieten wir Dir ein kollegiales Team, kurze Wege am Standort Halle/Westfalen und die Möglichkeit, technische Themen mit hoher Relevanz für Patientinnen und Patienten weltweit aktiv mitzugestalten.</p> <p><strong>Das bieten wir Dir:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Faire tarifgebundene Vergütung inkl. Sozialleistungen wie ein <strong>13. Tarifgehalt, Urlaubsgeld</strong>, betriebliche Altersvorsorge und eine zusätzliche Pflegeversicherung</li> <li>Hauseigene moderne Kantine mit attraktiver Be­zu­schus­sung</li> <li><strong>30 Tage Urlaub</strong> plus Sonderurlaub</li> <li>Wochenarbeitszeit von <strong>37,5 Stunden</strong></li> <li>Job-Rad Leasing</li> <li>Corporate Benefits: Exklusive Rabatte für Mitarbeitende bei zahlreichen bekannten Marken</li> <li>Gute Verkehrsanbindung und kostenlose Mitarbeitendenparkplätze </li> <li>Berufsbedingter Umzug? title: Strategic GTM Lead - Insurance DACH
description: About The Role Taktile empowers financial institutions to transform into truly AI-native organizations. We’re growing rapidly with enterprise customers across banks and insurance companies, and we’re looking for a Strategic GTM Lead for Insurance in DACH : someone who has led client engagements at a top-tier strategy consultancy and now wants to build a market rather than advise on one. You will decide which insurers we go after and why, develop those relationships from first contact to signed partnership, and be the person senior insurance executives trust to think through how AI changes underwriting, claims and operations in their business. This is not a classic sales role. You will open new strategic insurance accounts and grow them into long-term partnerships, from the first executive conversation to large, account-level commitments. Our Account Executives close individual deals and use cases; you set the direction for the account as a whole. Most of your impact comes from account strategy, executive dialogue, ecosystem work with consultancies and partners, and shaping how Taktile shows up in the German-speaking insurance market. You will work closely with our Head of Insurance, Account Executives, Solution Engineering, Product and Engineering. What You'll Do Identify and prioritize target accounts across DACH insurers (primary insurers, reinsurers, MGAs, insurance groups) based on a clear thesis: where the business case for AI-driven decisioning is strongest and where we can win Build account strategies for your portfolio: map the organization, its strategic agenda and transformation programs, the buying committee and the path to title: Senior LCA Engineer
description: 👷🏻‍♀️ What we do 👷🏻‍♀️ At Emidat, we are building the first climate-native product management system for building material manufacturers. Emidat aims to decarbonise building materials, making up 11% of global GHG emissions. We collect data from physical production processes, generate a digital product passport with verified environmental data and make it usable along the value chain. In short: One solution to assess, design, buy, sell and manage products - with environmental impact at the core. Embodied carbon is emitted on day zero and can never be reduced later, while global floor area is set to double by 2060. From January 2026, EU regulation (CPR) requires verified environmental data. 430,000 manufacturers will need it, and only about 2,500 have it today. That gap is our market. Find out more about us, the team and our values here. What you will work on Your mission Your core mission is to turn LCA methodology into software that works at scale. You own the full chain from methodological question to working software solution and take ownership of the team's most complex methodological and technical challenges. You make sure each new product category, market and verification takes less time and effort, working with high autonomy and high accountability. As an early senior member of a fast-growing climate-tech company, your career trajectory is entirely in your hands. This role offers unparalleled visibility and growth. You can deepen your expertise as a technical expert in the team, or leverage your domain knowledge to pivot into high-impact roles across Customer Success, Sales, or Product. Exceptional early joiners are primed for future Team Lead and leadership positions. In the first 6 months, you will Lead strategic projects: Take full ownership of complex, ambiguous projects such as new markets, program operators or complex product categories. Define requirements, navigate trade-offs, delegate across the team and drive delivery. Shape the product core: Work closely with our software engineers to translate environmental science and ISO/EN standards into clean, scalable software requirements, and propose complete implementation strategies for whole concepts, not individual features. Scale our LCA work: Reduce the time and effort for recurring work such as tool verifications, new product category implementations and matching, through automation, reusable standards and better processes. Turn verifier feedback into requirements that solve the issue for good. Scale tool verifications: Work with program operators and verifiers to establish processes that make tool verifications faster, more predictable and repeatable across markets and product categories. Set the standard: Define what clear requirements and architecturally sound solutions look like, and take ownership of refining our methodologies for PCFs, LCAs and EPDs. Improve how we work: Identify problems others don't see, turn them into actionable proposals, and solve recurring problems at the root instead of case by case. Grow the team: Mentor junior colleagues and give them regular, actionable feedback. Shape the industry: Help establish Emidat as a thought leader in LCA, e.g. by representing us in ECO Platform working groups and in the committees that author PCRs. What you will bring to this role Minimum requirements Extensive LCA expertise: You bring deep expertise and experience conducting Life Cycle Assessments, LCA calculation methodology, PCRs and ecoinvent/matching logic. You showcase ownership of complex, ambiguous methodological or technical challenges. Mastery of standards and regulation: You have comprehensive knowledge of the key LCA / EPD standards and program operator requirements (i.e ISO 14040/14044 and EN 15804+A2). You interpret these standards rigorously, and evaluate sources critically. From methodology to software: You have experience working with automated software solutions for LCA/EPD generation, with proven ability to translate regulatory and methodological logic into technical requirements. You bring a product mindset: you prioritise, scope and communicate requirements clearly. Verification and customer experience: You have created multiple EPDs that were successfully verified and published with a European program operator (e.g. EPD Global, EPD International, IBU). You have worked directly with customers, ideally in a consulting environment, and can represent methodological positions confidently towards customers and verifiers. Leadership and project management: You have a track record of leading large projects end-to-end: scoping, planning, delegating, coaching others and keeping quality high. You manage several projects at the same time and coordinate multiple internal and external stakeholders. Language: Business fluent in English (C1+). Nice to have’s Education: Bachelors, Masters Degree or PhD in a relevant subject, i.e Sustainable Energy Systems, Architecture, Urban Planning, Engineering (Environmental, Chemical, Mechanical, Electrical) etc. Languages: Proficiency in German, or any other of the following European languages (French, Italian, Dutch, a Nordic language). Verifier: Qualification as a verifier for EPDs acc. to EN 15804+A2 Engineering partnership: Experience completing partnering with software engineers to develop implementation strategies. AI-enabled way of working: You are experienced in leveraging AI tools to accelerate your work, e.g. for research, requirements and documentation. Tool Verifications: You have experience with EPD tool verifications. Industry: Experience working on Construction products, or familiarity with the latest regulatory developments affecting the construction industry (e.g. EU Taxonomy, national and regional regulations) and can assess their impact on methodology and product. How we support you Your manager / team lead will be Benedikt Team Lead, LCA and Product Manager You will work closely with Florian (CTO & Co-Founder) Anna (LCA Expert) Areeba (LCA Expert) Elahe (LCA Expert) Jonas (LCA Expert) Marzooka (LCA Expert) Tom (Tech Lead, Engineering) Fabio (Software Engineer) Kacper (Software Engineer) Andrea (Software Engineer) Timon (Customer Success) Meet the rest of the team HERE . Office: Office based. Visa / Relocation: Preference will be given to candidates already based in Munich and that do not require a visa. Actualiseren en verrijken van onze website, publicaties en online kennisproducten. Structureren, actualiseren en verder ontwikkelen van bestaande kenniscollecties tot een deelbare kenniscatalogus. Uitvoeren van markt- en deskresearch naar ontwikkelingen op het gebied van digitalisering, data en digitale autonomie. title: Teamleider Electromagnetic Warfare (m/v/x)
description: Ben jij die ambitieuze Teamleider / R&D engineer die graag helpt om civiele en militaire vliegtuigen veilig, duurzaam en competitief te laten vliegen? Wil jij jezelf verder ontwikkelen en word je enthousiast van techniek, innovatie en duurzaamheid? Wij zijn op zoek naar een teamleider voor de afdeling. Wat ga je doen? In een wereld waarin lucht- en ruimtevaartsystemen steeds complexer worden, is het belangrijk om innovatieve oplossingen te ontwikkelen om de veiligheid en efficiëntie te garanderen. Binnen NLR werken we aan de ontwikkeling van geavanceerde aerospace systemen. We maken hierbij gebruik van software modelering en simulatie om het gedrag van complexe systemen te begrijpen en te optimaliseren. Onze expertise in hardware testen en operationele ondersteuning (OPS) zorgt ervoor dat onze oplossingen niet alleen theoretisch solide zijn, maar ook praktisch toepasbaar en robuust. De belangstelling voor Electromagnetic Warfare (EW) neemt toe, met de noodzaak om onze lucht- en ruimtevaartsystemen te beschermen tegen elektromagnetische bedreigingen. We zoeken hierom een teamleider binnen onze nieuwe afdeling Aerospace Systems Electronic Warfare (ASEW) Als teamleider EW zal je leiding geven aan een team van professionals met expertise in het ontwerp, de ontwikkeling en het testen van aerospace systemen met focus op Electronic Warfare. Binnen onze nieuwe afdeling Aerospace Systems Electromagnetic Warfare zoeken wij een ervaren en gedreven Teamleider om ons team te leiden en te inspireren. De afdeling is gericht op het ontwikkelen van innovatieve oplossingen voor Electromagnetic Warfare (EW) en heeft als doel om de Nederlandse en internationale lucht- en ruimtevaartindustrie te ondersteunen. Als Teamleider binnen onze afdeling ASEW ben je verantwoordelijk voor het leiden en ontwikkelen van een team van specialisten op het gebied van EW. Je werkt nauw samen met de Afdelingsmanager en andere teams binnen NLR om onze doelen te bereiken. In afstemming met de Afdelingsmanager ASEW zal je één van de twee Electromagnetic Warfare kennisgebied overzien, namelijk Electronic Warfare Modelling and Simulation of Electronic Warfare Analyses. In de rol van teamleider blijf je actief en inhoudelijk betrokken bij het uitvoeren van projecten en krijg je de coördinatie over een team van technische collega’s en het verder ontwikkelen en uitbouwen van de faciliteiten waarvoor ASEW verantwoordelijk is. Je bent dus zowel een teamleider als een R&D Engineer. Als teamleider … Als teamleider bied jij het team alles wat nodig is om de werkzaamheden van jouw team succesvol te laten verlopen. Je bent de directe leidinggevende van betreffende collega’s en draagt ook de HR-verantwoordelijkheid. Je coacht, stuurt, geeft én vraagt feedback en je pakt de leiding wanneer nodig. Je stelt hen op deze wijze in staat om optimaal aan de projecten te werken en faciliteer jij hen waar nodig. Je zorgt voor het versterken van de kennispositie van het werkgebied en de realisatie van de werkzaamheden/opdrachten voor interne en externe stakeholders. Je hebt een open en enthousiasmerende stijl van leidinggeven. Je collega’s voelen zich vrij en gesteund en kunnen zichzelf goed ontwikkelen. Er wordt een goede teamspirit ervaren. Je zorgt voor een goede aansluiting van het werkgebied bij de rest van ASEW en voor het zoeken van synergie met andere afdelingen binnen flight test en certificatie. Je versterkt de samenwerkingsrelaties gericht op het verder volwassen laten worden van het team. Als R&D Engineer… Als R&D engineer EW werk je mee aan het veiliger, duurzamer en competitiever maken van de militaire en civiele luchtvaart. Je werkt aan vliegtuigen, helikopters en onbemande vliegende systemen. Je ondersteunt onze binnen- en buitenlandse opdrachtgevers bij het bereiken van hun doelen. Je voert testen uit, genereerd modellen en analyseert resultaten. In de rol van R&D engineer, trek of draag je inhoudelijk bij aan projectvoorstellen voor bijvoorbeeld betaalde projecten in opdracht van een (externe) stakeholder. Dit kunnen ook onderzoeksvoorstellen zijn voor bijvoorbeeld defensie onderzoeks-calls. Verantwoordelijkheden Leiden en ontwikkelen van een team van specialisten op het gebied van EW; Samenwerken met de Afdelingsmanager ASEW en andere teams binnen NLR om onze doelen te bereiken; Overzien van een kennisgebied (Electronic Warfare Modelling and Simulation of Electronic Warfare Analyses) waarmee je samen met de Afdelingsmanager tot strategische doelen van het team komt; Inspireren en motiveren van teamleden om hun beste werk te leveren; Coördineren van projecten en activiteiten om de doelen van de afdeling te bereiken. Wat breng je mee? Een afgeronde WO master in een relevante discipline (bijv. lucht- en ruimtevaarttechniek, elektrotechniek, informatica); Tenminste 3 jaar ervaring in een leidinggevende functie, bij voorkeur in de lucht- en ruimtevaartindustrie; Aantoonbare kennis en ervaring op het gebied van EW; Uitstekende communicatieve vaardigheden in zowel het Nederlands als het Engels (tenminste op C1 niveau); Sterke leiderschaps- en coachingsvaardigheden; In staat om een team te inspireren en te motiveren om hun beste werk te leveren. Wat bieden wij jou? Werken bij NLR, betekent werken in een nationale en internationale hightech omgeving. Samenwerken en betrokkenheid staan bij ons hoog in vaandel. Door jou vrijheid en eigen verantwoordelijkheid te geven, ben jij het best in staat om tot baanbrekende innovaties te komen. Wil jij jezelf vakinhoudelijk én op persoonlijk vlak ontwikkelen? Ook dat kan bij NLR als lerende organisatie, met daarnaast een opleidingsbudget, een mentor, interne coaches en goede contacten met mbo’s, hbo’s en universiteiten. Naast dit alles bieden wij jou: De kans om bij te dragen aan complexe en maatschappelijk relevante vraagstukken; Voldoende vakantie- en ATV-dagen (in totaal 45 bij fulltime dienstverband) voor een goede werk-privébalans; Een eindejaarsuitkering van 8%; Een tegemoetkoming in jouw zorgkosten; Extra betaald ouderschapsverlof; De mogelijkheid om jezelf te ontwikkelen met opleidingen en cursussen die passen bij jouw ambities. Jouw nieuwe werkomgeving Electromagnetic Warfare is een nieuwe afdeling binnen Aerospace systems en is voort gekomen uit de afdeling Defence Operations. Je zult de leidinggevende zijn van een team enthousiaste en gedreven professionals. Hierbij zul je nauw samenwerken met andere NLR afdelingen, in het bijzonder de afdeling waaruit ASEW voortgekomen is. De werkzaamheden zijn direct gerelateerd aan Defensie, weerbaarheid en de verdediging van Nederland en de Nederlandse krijgsmacht. Je werkt vanuit onze locatie in Amsterdam en zult veel contact met collega's en partners binnen en buiten NLR. Wat betekent werken bij NLR? Koninklijke NLR is al ruim 100 jaar een kennisorganisatie met de wil en ambitie om te vernieuwen. Vanuit die drijfveer maken wij de wereld van lucht- en ruimtevaart veiliger, duurzamer, efficiënter en effectiever en staan wij voor baanbrekende innovaties. Bij ons werken meer dan 1000 gedreven professionals, van vliegtuigbouwkundigen tot psychologen en van wiskundigen tot applicatiedeskundigen. NLR staat voor een inclusieve en diverse organisatie waar iedereen zich welkom, veilig, gewaardeerd en gerespecteerd voelt. Wil jij meer weten? Bel of mail dan met Frank Bax (recruiter) via 0615676915 of . Onze collega’s vertellen jou graag hoe het is om bij NLR te werken. Vergeet trouwens ook niet eens een kijkje op onze socials te nemen zoals ons YouTube kanaal . Solliciteren? Mooi, we zijn benieuwd naar jou! Stuur je motivatiebrief en CV via de ‘Solliciteren’ button. De teamleider is een parttime functie. Een assessment maakt deel uit van de procedure. Een positieve uitkomst van een veiligheidsonderzoek (VGB) is een voorwaarde voor indiensttreding. Meer informatie daarover lees je op de website van de MIVD. Acquisitie wordt niet op prijs gesteld! title: Engineering Manager, Stablecoins
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p><strong>Available Locations: London or Austin or SF or NYC</strong></p> <h3>About the Department</h3> <p>Emerging Technologies & Incubation (ETI) is where new and bold products are built and released within Cloudflare. Rather than being constrained by the structures which make Cloudflare a hugely successful business, we are able to leverage them to deliver entirely new tools and products to our customers. Cloudflare’s edge and network make it possible to solve problems at massive scale and efficiency which would be impossible for almost any other organization.</p> <h3>About the Team</h3> <p>We build the infrastructure that makes the web <strong>Payable</strong>, powering high-volume, low-value machine-to-machine transactions using blockchain technologies and decentralized protocols. Here at Cloudflare, stablecoin payments are a core initiative developing blockchain-based settlement systems, programmable agent wallets, and cryptographic primitives to make the web <strong>payable</strong> at machine scale. As AI agents increasingly navigate, consume, and act on the web, standard payment and authorization models built for humans are breaking down. We build tools that leverage Web3 wallets and decentralized rails to give domain owners and agents secure, scalable settlement options.</p> <p>Building these capabilities requires solving problems across high-throughput web infrastructure, low-latency transaction processing, digital wallets, and emerging agentic payment protocols. We bridge mainstream commerce rails with decentralized smart contract environments, enabling micropayments at Internet scale to keep the web <strong>payable</strong>.</p> <p>We are a tight-knit group that communicates and collaborates regularly. We celebrate our achievements, support each other when we make mistakes, and hold each other and our work to a high standard.</p> <h3>About the role</h3> <p>We are looking for an Engineering Manager to build and lead the engineering team across our stablecoin initiatives.</p> <p>You will be responsible for the people, execution, and engineering quality behind products that power decentralized agent transactions, such as Cloudflare’s stablecoin wallets and emerging micropayment rails that make web resources <strong>payable</strong>. You will partner closely with Product Management, cryptography experts, and engineering teams across Cloudflare to deliver current priorities and shape future opportunities. This is a management role for someone who is deeply technically credible in distributed systems, smart contracts, and cryptographic protocols. You will not be expected to write most of the code, but you should be able to understand the systems your engineers operate, challenge architectural decisions around blockchains (including transactions, RPCs, and execution + consensus clients)  and step in when necessary.</p> <p>At the same time, we are looking for a manager, not a tech lead with direct reports. Your success will be measured by the quality and output of the team you build, the engineers you develop, and the systems and products they deliver.</p> <p>This role may require flexibility to be on-call outside of standard working hours to address technical issues as needed.</p> <h3>What you'll do</h3> <ul> <li>Manage, coach, and grow engineers working across blockchain architecture, stablecoin wallets, and cryptographic payment channels to ensure the web remains <strong>payable</strong> for autonomous agents.</li> <li>Own execution by establishing clear priorities, creating predictable delivery, and giving engineers the context and autonomy to own meaningful areas of the product.</li> <li>Lead the development of a high-throughput blockchain leveraging cryptocurrency protocols and standards to enable ultra-low-latency micropayments.</li> <li>Lead the engineering behind usage metering, pricing definition engines, outcome verification, and revenue attribution models tailored for agentic workflows.</li> <li>Build capabilities that give businesses granular visibility and control over their agent-generated revenue streams.</li> <li>Partner closely with Product Management to understand customer problems, shape the roadmap, and turn broad opportunities into clear engineering outcomes.</li> <li>Interface directly with blockchain, wallet, and cryptography teams while scaling decentralized transaction pipelines on Cloudflare Workers and Durable Objects.</li> <li>Balance near-term product delivery with thoughtful technical investments that allow promising ideas to grow.</li> <li>Own the operational health of the systems in your area, including observability, incident response, cryptographic security, and long-term reliability.</li> <li>Develop technical leaders and create space for engineers to lead architecture and implementation.</li> </ul> <h3>Responsibilities</h3> <p>We want you to love it here. This role is a great fit for you if:</p> <ul> <li>You have led and developed a high-performing engineering team(s) and can point to what that team shipped and how the people on it grew.</li> <li>You are technically credible with experienced blockchain and systems engineers. You can review a design, understand the trade-offs in smart contract security or decentralized architecture, and evaluate cryptographic protocols.</li> <li>You are comfortable managing a team working across specialized crypto topics (like decentralized settlement, programmable wallets, and key management systems).</li> <li>You care deeply about reliability and quality, particularly when the output of a system handles monetary transactions or machine authorization.</li> <li>You have strong product judgment and enjoy working with Product Management to decide what is worth building, what needs improvement and what should not be built at all.</li> <li>You are comfortable with ambiguity and with finding structure in areas where the opportunity is clearer than the roadmap.</li> <li>You communicate clearly, give direct feedback, and can explain complex technical decisions to both engineers and non-engineers.</li> </ul> <h3>Examples of Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience</h3> <ul> <li>Strong technical grounding in blockchain architecture, smart contract environments, and cryptographic key management. Past experience building L1 or L2 blockchains is a plus.</li> <li>Experience building or operating cryptocurrency infrastructure, digital wallet providers, or decentralized settlement protocols. Past experience working on consumer or enterprise cryptocurrency wallets is a plus.</li> <li>Experience operating systems where correctness, reliability, and security matter as much as feature delivery.</li> <li>A track record of hiring, developing, and retaining strong engineers.</li> <li>Experience partnering closely with Product Management to shape and execute a roadmap.</li> <li>Experience taking products or major capabilities from an ambiguous opportunity to a clear customer outcome.</li> <li>Strong written and verbal communication.</li> </ul> <h3>Bonus Points</h3> <ul> <li>Hands-on experience with decentralized payment protocols or blockchain frameworks (e.g., Bitcoin Lightning, Ethereum rollups).</li> <li>Experience building hybrid fiat/crypto payment infrastructure, such as onramp/offramp providers or apps where cryptocurrencies are invisible to users.</li> <li>Familiarity with Cloudflare’s developer platform (Workers, Durable Objects, KV) or edge computing architectures.</li> <li>Experience turning complex underlying systems into useful payment or commerce products for a broad audience.</li> <li>Experience with usage-based billing, metering engines, attribution systems, or complex commercial pricing models.</li> <li>Previous experience working in payments or on payments technology (fiat or crypto)</li> </ul> <p><strong>Compensation</strong></p> <p>Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location.</p> <ul> <li><span data-sheets-root="1">For Bay Area based hires: Estimated annual salary of $200,000 - $288,000</span></li> <li><span data-sheets-root="1">For NYC based hires: Estimated annual salary of $190,000 - $275,000</span></li> </ul> <p><strong>Equity</strong></p> <p>This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare’s equity plan.</p> <p><strong>Benefits</strong></p> <p>Cloudflare offers a complete package of benefits and programs to support you and your family.  Our benefits programs can help you pay health care expenses, support caregiving, build capital for the future and make life a little easier and fun!  The below is a description of our benefits for employees in the United States, and benefits may vary for employees based outside the U.S.</p> <p><strong>Health & Welfare Benefits</strong></p> <ul> <li>Medical/Rx Insurance</li> <li>Dental Insurance</li> <li>Vision Insurance</li> <li>Flexible Spending Accounts</li> <li>Commuter Spending Accounts</li> <li>Fertility & Family Forming Benefits</li> <li>On-demand mental health support and Employee Assistance Program</li> <li>Global Travel Medical Insurance</li> </ul> <p><strong>Financial Benefits</strong></p> <ul> <li>Short and Long Term Disability Insurance</li> <li>Life & Accident Insurance</li> <li>401(k) Retirement Savings Plan</li> <li>Employee Stock Participation Plan&l

title: Security Operations Engineer 80–100 % (m/w)
description: Sicherheit gewährleisten. Bedrohungen erkennen. Lösungen weiterentwickeln. Du hast Freude daran, Sicherheitsrisiken gezielt zu reduzieren und gemeinsam mit unseren Kunden nachhaltige Schutzmassnahmen umzusetzen? Dann bist du bei uns genau richtig! Wir suchen in Fehraltorf oder Aarau eine/n Security Operations Engineer 80–100 % (m/w/d) UPGREAT mit Hauptsitz in Fehraltorf und Niederlassungen in Bern sowie Aarau ist Dein kompetenter Partner für Outsourcing, Modern Work und Cloudlösungen. Unsere Unternehmenskultur basiert auf den drei Grundwerten: Begeisterung, Menschlichkeit und Kompetenz. Deine Aufgaben Betrieb & Weiterentwicklung: Du verantwortest den sicheren und stabilen Betrieb, das Monitoring sowie die kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung unseres Toolings, unserer Security-Services und der Kundenumgebungen. Security Incident Management: Du bearbeitest Security-Events, Incidents und Findings end-to-end – von der Triage und Analyse über Containment und Kundenkommunikation bis hin zum Post-Incident-Review und zur vollständigen Dokumentation. Detection Engineering & Automatisierung: Du entwickelst und optimierst Detection Use Cases, Playbooks und Automatisierungen und reduzierst False Positives nachhaltig, indem du deren Ursachen identifizierst und behebst. Vulnerability & Patch Management: Du steuerst das Vulnerability- und Patch-Management über mehrere Kundenumgebungen hinweg, insbesondere bei kritischen Schwachstellen und Zero-Day-Exploits. Dabei priorisierst du Massnahmen anhand von Exposition, Ausnutzbarkeit und Risiko. Security Services & Kundenberatung: Du erbringst rund 50 % deiner Tätigkeit als verrechenbare Security-Leistungen direkt beim Kunden. Dazu gehören Onboardings, Security-Baselines, Reviews, Reporting und die fachliche Beratung. Zusammenarbeit & Stellvertretung: Du arbeitest eng mit Operations, Engineering, KAM, CISO und externen Security-Partnern zusammen und stellst durch gegenseitige Stellvertretung einen zuverlässigen und kontinuierlichen Betrieb sicher. Kontinuierliche Verbesserung: Du leistest einen messbaren Beitrag zur Verkürzung der Erkennungs- und Reaktionszeiten (MTTD/MTTR), zur Erhöhung der Detection-Abdeckung sowie zur Standardisierung und Skalierung unserer Security-Services. Toolmaking: Du entwickelst Tools und Skripte, die manuelle Abläufe vereinfachen oder vollständig automatisieren und so zur kontinuierlichen Verbesserung unserer IT-Prozesse beitragen. Dein Profil Ausbildung & Erfahrung: Du verfügst über eine abgeschlossene Informatikausbildung EFZ/HF/FH oder gleichwertige Praxiserfahrung im System-, Cloud- oder Security Engineering und bringst mindestens drei Jahre Erfahrung in SecOps, SOC/MDR, Incident Response oder Security Engineering mit, idealerweise im MSP- oder Kundenumfeld. Microsoft Security: Du hast fundierte Praxiserfahrung mit Microsoft Defender XDR, Microsoft Sentinel und Entra ID und setzt KQL für Threat Hunting und die Entwicklung von Analytics Rules sicher ein. Security Operations: Du bist erfahren in Incident Response, EDR/XDR, Vulnerability Management sowie in der strukturierten Fallbearbeitung und sauberen Ticketdokumentation. Scripting & Automatisierung: Du automatisierst wiederkehrende Aufgaben mit PowerShell. Kenntnisse in Python, der Microsoft Graph API sowie in Logic Apps und SIEM-/SOAR-Lösungen sind von Vorteil. Ganzheitliches Systemverständnis: Du verstehst die Zusammenhänge und Abhängigkeiten zwischen Identitäten, Endpoints, Netzwerken, Cloud, Backup, Applikationen und Betriebsprozessen und behältst auch in komplexen Umgebungen den Überblick. Analytische Stärke: Du gehst technische Herausforderungen ruhig, methodisch und lösungsorientiert an und triffst auch unter Zeitdruck sowie bei unvollständiger Informationslage fundierte Entscheidungen. Kommunikation & Kundenorientierung: Du kommunizierst sicher und adressatengerecht auf Deutsch und verfügst über gute Englischkenntnisse. Dabei gelingt es dir, technische Sachverhalte sowohl für Fachpersonen als auch für das Management verständlich aufzubereiten. Weiterentwicklung & Zertifizierungen: Du bist motiviert, dein Security-Know-how laufend weiterzuentwickeln. Zertifizierungen wie SC-200, SC-300, AZ-500, Security+ oder GIAC sind willkommen. Den Erwerb der Zertifizierung SC-200 innerhalb von zwölf Monaten unterstützen wir aktiv. Deine Perspektiven bei der UPGREAT: Du wirst Teil eines dynamischen, kollegialen Teams mit über 150 Mitarbeitenden, hier zählt Zusammenarbeit genauso wie individuelle Stärken. Dich erwartet ein spannendes Wirkungsfeld mit viel Gestaltungsfreiraum, Verantwortung übernehmen gehört bei uns dazu. Du arbeitest in modernen Büroräumlichkeiten mit ergonomisch ausgestatteten Arbeitsplätzen. Deine soziale Absicherung ist uns wichtig, wir übernehmen 55 % deines Pensionskassenbeitrags sowie den Beitrag zur Krankentaggeldversicherung. Deine Entwicklung liegt uns am Herzen, wir fördern deine Weiterbildung und begleiten dich auf deinem beruflichen Weg. Deine Leistung schätzen wir, mit attraktiven Fringe Benefits wie kostenlosen Parkplätzen, einem Geburtstagsgeschenk und Sonderkonditionen bei Fitnessstudios und weiteren Partnern. Interessiert den Weg mit uns zu gehen? Überzeugt, dass Du bei uns richtig bist? Dann sende uns doch Deine Bewerbung mit Lebenslauf, Zeugnissen & allfälligen Zertifikaten. WICHTIG: Für diese Stelle akzeptieren wir nur Direktbewerbungen. Dossiers von Personalvermittlern können wie Direktbewerbungen behandelt werden, ohne Anspruch auf Honorar. title: Junior International Sales & Business Development Representative – DACH Market
description: Empowering organizations in IT risk management Securance helps organizations build resilience and security, enabling them to provide assurance to stakeholders on IT risk management and cybersecurity. Based in Utrecht, the team works to structurally improve security for clients operating in the DACH market. Your responsibilities Junior International Sales & Partnership Representative – DACH Market Full-time Graduate Position / Part-time Working Student 📍 Utrecht, The Netherlands 🌍 International Sales & Marketing Team 🇩🇪 DACH Market – Germany, Austria & Switzerland Your market is DACH. Your team is international. Your career starts in Utrecht. Are you a German-speaking student or recent graduate looking for an exciting start to your international career? Would you like to work with colleagues from different countries, build business relationships, visit industry events and learn what professional B2B sales and partnership management are really about? Welcome to Securance! We are looking for an enthusiastic Junior International Sales & Partnership Representative to join our international Sales & Marketing team in Utrecht, the Netherlands. Whether you're finishing your studies or have recently graduated, we offer you the opportunity to develop your commercial skills, build an international network and gain hands-on experience in business development. One team. Many nationalities. Different markets. At Securance, international collaboration isn't just something we talk about. It's how we work every day. Our sales team brings together colleagues from different countries and cultural backgrounds. Each team member focuses on developing business in their own home market, combining local knowledge and language skills with the strength of an international organization. We work side by side in Utrecht, sharing experiences, exchanging ideas and supporting each other. As our German-speaking representative, you'll focus on developing our business and partnerships across the DACH region. You'll also work closely with our colleagues in Germany, travelling there regularly when needed to collaborate with the local team, meet partners, attend events and support commercial opportunities. Your home base is Utrecht, but your professional network will extend across borders. Learn Consultative Sales and Partnership Management from experienced professionals At Securance, we believe successful business development starts with understanding people, their organizations and their challenges. We don't focus on simply pushing products or closing quick deals. Instead, we practice Consultative Sales : asking the right questions, understanding customer needs, identifying opportunities and developing solutions that create long-term value. You'll also learn how to build and manage strategic business partnerships, develop professional networks and turn relationships into meaningful commercial opportunities. Our experienced and innovative team will coach you, involve you in real business activities and help you develop your own professional approach. We don't expect you to know everything when you join. We expect you to be curious, motivated and eager to learn. Our ambition is to help you become genuinely good at professional B2B sales, business development and partnership management. What will you be doing? As part of our international team, you will: Business Development: Identify potential customers, new business opportunities and commercial prospects in the DACH region. Consultative Sales: Connect with decision-makers, understand their challenges and learn how to develop valuable business solutions. Partnership Management: Help build, develop and maintain relationships with business partners, referral partners and other relevant organizations. Events & Networking: Attend industry conferences, networking events, trade fairs and business meetings to represent Securance and expand our professional network. International Collaboration: Work closely with your international colleagues in Utrecht and regularly visit Germany to collaborate with the German team when needed. Relationship Management: Support the development of long-term relationships with customers and partners. Sales & Marketing: Contribute to commercial campaigns, market research, lead generation and international business development initiatives. Market Development: Gradually take greater ownership of commercial activities and partnership opportunities in your market. From day one, you'll be involved in real business activities, supported by experienced colleagues. Who are we looking for? We're looking for someone with potential, personality and a strong willingness to learn. You: Are in the final year of your studies or have recently graduated. Speak German at native or near-native level and understand the German-speaking business environment. Have good English communication skills, as English is our international working language. Live in the Netherlands or are willing to relocate to the Utrecht area. Enjoy meeting people, networking and building professional relationships. Are curious, proactive, enthusiastic and commercially minded. Enjoy working with colleagues from different nationalities and cultures. Are interested in B2B sales, business development and partnership management. Are comfortable attending business events and travelling to Germany regularly when required. Previous sales experience is not required. Your attitude, motivation and willingness to learn matter much more. What can you expect from Securance? A genuinely international workplace Work alongside colleagues from different countries, each bringing their own perspectives, experience and market knowledge. Excellent professional development Receive practical training, personal coaching and guidance from experienced sales and business development professionals. International exposure and travel Visit Germany to collaborate with local colleagues, meet partners and customers, and attend relevant industry events. Build your professional network Develop relationships with companies, industry professionals and business partners across the DACH region. Real responsibility Contribute to developing your own market, commercial relationships and partnership opportunities. An innovative professional environment Learn about cybersecurity, risk management, IT assurance and related professional services. Opportunities for students and graduates We welcome recent graduates interested in a full-time position and final-year students looking to combine their studies with meaningful part-time work. A collaborative team culture Become part of a team that shares knowledge, celebrates success and helps each other grow. About Securance Securance is an international professional services organization specializing in cybersecurity, risk management, IT assurance and related advisory services. We help organizations understand risks, strengthen controls and build confidence in their business and technology environments. Our international approach combines professional expertise with local market understanding, strategic partnerships and long-term customer relationships. As part of our commercial team, you'll learn how to translate complex business challenges into valuable conversations, business opportunities and sustainable partnerships. Ready to start your international career? If you're German-speaking, internationally minded and excited to develop your skills in sales, business development and partnership management, we'd love to meet you. Join our international team in Utrecht. Build relationships across borders. Start your career with Securance. Apply now! Location: Utrecht, The Netherlands. This is an office-based international team position, involving regular business travel to Germany when required. It is not a remote position based in Germany. title: Data Analist E-commerce
description: Als Data Analist e-commerce ben jij dé analytics expert die data omzet in waardevolle commerciële inzichten. Je zorgt ervoor dat het E-commerce team kan sturen op betrouwbare inzichten en helpt collega's om betere beslissingen te nemen over onze website, app, assortiment, content en commerciële prestaties. Kortom: je krijgt veel verantwoordelijkheid in een uitdagende rol. Je bouwt mee aan de analytics-omgeving van My Jewellery en deze geef jij zelf mede vorm. Je bouwt niet direct wat er gevraagd wordt. Je daagt je collega’s uit en vormt gezamenlijk een plan welke inzichten nodig zijn en hoe jij die inzichten het beste kan bouwen en delen met je collega’s. Dit kan bijvoorbeeld een analyse zijn, een dashboard, een rekenmodel of een automatische e-mail feed met verbeter suggesties. Zo bouw je mee aan een My Jewellery dat stuurt op de juiste inzichten en leg je de basis voor de verdere groei van ons merk. Daarnaast duik je in commerciële vraagstukken. Je onderzoekt waarom conversie verandert, welke productcategorieën het beste presteren, waar bezoekers afhaken in de funnel en welke experimenten daadwerkelijk bijdragen aan omzet en marge. Je denkt actief mee over verbeterkansen, daagt aannames uit en vertaalt analyses naar concrete acties met aantoonbare business impact. In deze rol werk je intensief samen met collega's van E-commerce, CRO, Product, IT, Finance en Marketing & Customer Analytics. Samen bouwen jullie aan een data gedreven organisatie waarin analyses niet alleen inzicht geven, maar vooral leiden tot betere commerciële keuzes. Jouw taken Je ontwikkelt een betrouwbare analyticsomgeving en je zorgt voor eenduidige definities voor commerciële KPI's zoals conversie, omzet, marge en returns; Je bouwt datamodellen en dashboards voor website-, app-, funnel- en productperformance; Je analyseert conversie, funnelprestaties, productcategorieën en commerciële kansen en vertaalt deze naar concrete adviezen; Je bouwt AI coding oplossingen om je eigen werk efficiënter en effectiever te maken; Je bewaakt de kwaliteit van data, onderzoekt verschillen tussen databronnen en zorgt voor betrouwbare inzichten; Je werkt als businesspartner samen met E-commerce, CRO, Product, IT, Finance en Marketing om datagedreven besluitvorming verder te ontwikkelen. Je hebt minimaal 2 jaar ervaring binnen e-commerce, digital of product analytics; Je hebt goede SQL-vaardigheden en kunt zelfstandig datamodellen, analyses en dashboards ontwikkelen; Je weet commerciële vraagstukken te vertalen naar bruikbare inzichten en durft stakeholders kritisch te adviseren; Je hebt kennis van statistiek en experimentanalyse en begrijpt hoe je conversie en commerciële KPI's meet en verbetert; Ervaring met A/B testen, conversie optimalisatie en product analytics is een sterke pré; Ervaring met dbt, Python of web- en app-tracking is een pré; Je woont in Nederland. Over My Jewellery My Jewellery is een van de snelst groeiende merken en e-commerce bedrijven van Nederland met internationale bekendheid. We ontwikkelen collecties en campagnes die het leven van vrouwen een beetje mooier maken. Met meer dan 1.000 collega's bouwen we elke dag aan een merk vol ambitie en creativiteit. Onze cultuur? Persoonlijk, betrokken en sprankelend. Jij mag hier helemaal jezelf zijn en krijgt de ruimte om te groeien, te leren en impact te maken. Ondanks onze sterke, internationale groei blijven de lijnen kort, de structuur plat en het saamhorigheidsgevoel op hoog niveau. Als team proberen we iedere dag het verschil te maken! title: Data & Insights Analyst
description: Wat je over ons moet weten? Wij zijn Athora Netherlands, een verzekeringsbedrijf met de bekende merken Zwitserleven en Reaal. Wij houden ons voornamelijk bezig met pensioenen en levensverzekeringen op de Nederlandse markt. Dat doen wij als onderdeel van een Europese groep met vestigingen in Ierland, het Verenigd Koninkrijk, België, Duitsland en Italië. Wij zijn een sterk bedrijf met ruim één miljoen klanten en wij willen de komende jaren doorgroeien tot een van de belangrijkste spelers in de snel veranderende pensioenmarkt. Daarom zoeken wij mensen die niet terugdeinzen voor verandering, die van aanpakken weten, die de ambitie hebben om resultaten neer te zetten en die daarom het beste uit zichzelf en hun team weten te halen. Slimmer samen, noemen wij dat. Wat ga je doen? Bij Strategy & Portfolio Management verbind je strategie, prioriteiten en resultaat. Samen met collega’s in strategie, performance, programma management help je ExCo en de domeinen om onderbouwde keuzes te maken en gericht bij te sturen. Je bouwt mee aan een team waarin samenwerking, een scherpe inhoudelijke blik en eigenaarschap centraal staan. Maak van data inzichten die ertoe doen. Als Data & Insights Analyst vertaal je interne en externe data naar dashboards, analyses en kernboodschappen die strategie, performance, portfoliosturing en ExCo-besluitvorming ondersteunen. V erantwoordelijkheden Je ontsluit en combineert databronnen en bewaakt kwaliteit, definities en herleidbaarheid; Je ontwikkelt en beheert Power BI-dashboards die strategie- en portfolioperformance inzichtelijk maken en ExCo ondersteunen bij onderbouwde besluitvorming; Je vertaalt complexe data naar heldere analyses en kernboodschappen voor management en ExCo; Je levert betrouwbare inzichten voor de kwartaalreviews, op basis van maandrapportages en aanvullende analyses; Je verrijkt interne analyses met markt-, klant- en concurrentie-inzichten; Je verdiept inzichten met scenario- en oorzaakanalyses; Je signaleert trends, risico’s, afhankelijkheden en mogelijkheden om bij te sturen; Je helpt data- en rapportageprocessen verbeteren en ondersteunt waar passend andere afdelingen bij dashboarding. #LI-DN Wat vragen we van jou? Academisch werk- en denkniveau, bij voorkeur in Data Analytics, Bedrijfskunde, Economie, Informatiekunde of een vergelijkbare richting; Minimaal 5 tot 7 jaar relevante ervaring met data-analyse, business intelligence, performance management of managementinformatie; Aantoonbare ervaring met dashboards, rapportages en analyses, bij voorkeur met Power BI en meerdere databronnen; Ervaring met het vertalen van complexe data naar begrijpelijke inzichten en stuurinformatie voor management en besluitvorming. Daarnaast: Analytisch sterk: je brengt structuur in complexe informatie en herkent patronen en verbanden; Helder in communicatie: je maakt van analyses een begrijpelijk verhaal dat helpt bij keuzes; Samenwerkingsgericht: je begrijpt informatiebehoeften en stemt soepel af met uiteenlopende stakeholders; Kwaliteitsbewust en scherp: je bewaakt consistentie en maakt afwijkingen en datakwaliteitsproblemen bespreekbaar; Resultaatgericht: je plant zorgvuldig en levert tijdig betrouwbare, praktisch bruikbare inzichten. Wat krijg je van ons? Je krijgt pakweg 900 collega's die allemaal vinden dat ze bij een bijzonder bedrijf werken. Je krijgt de mogelijkheid om een belangrijke bijdrage te leveren aan het maatschappelijk relevante thema van pensioenen. Wij zorgen ervoor dat je pensioen goed geregeld is, zodat je zorgeloos kan genieten van je oude dag. Jij krijgt de kans om echt het verschil te maken als het gaat om duurzaamheid, omdat we in onze bedrijfsvoering en onze beleggingen al jaren de toon aangeven. Uiteraard krijg je een (flexibele) werkplek op ons kantoor in Amsterdam dat behoort tot de beste 7% van de wereld, echt waar. En omdat je ook regelmatig thuis zult werken, ontvang je een budget om je thuiswerkplek goed in te richten. In ruil voor jouw inzet, talent en vaardigheden krijg je naast je salaris plus een vakantietoeslag en een dertiende maand, 27 vakantiedagen (bij een contract van 36 uur) en een OV-kaart of reiskostenvergoeding voor de dagen dat je naar kantoor komt. En, niet onbelangrijk vinden wij, krijg je een goed opleidingsbudget, zodat je jezelf kunt blijven ontwikkelen. Zo krijg je de kans om door te groeien, binnen ons bedrijf of daarbuiten. Salaris per maand: Op basis van cao schaal 16 HAY is de range € 5.082,02 tot € 6.776,03 op basis van 36 uur. Enthousiast? Reageer dan snel via de sollicitatie button! title: Software Engineer - Optimisation Team
description: Role - Software Engineer - Optimisation Team Company - iwell - Harmonizing Clean Energy Location - Utrecht About iwell At iwell, we are all about reinforcing energy security. We help European businesses become more energy independent. With growing regulations, extreme price volatility and rising grid issues, they need to be resilient. It is time to take charge and think ahead. We deliver energy management solutions that ensure that businesses are always in control of their energy. Our in-house developed EMS and modular battery storage drive profit through sustainability, making businesses future-proof. We are a fast-growing international team of bold, talented individuals. From engineers and software developers to creative thinkers and customer-focused business developers. No matter what your strong suit is, we always are looking for people who are determined to make a positive impact. The Role The Optimisation team builds the Python applications that decide what our customers' energy assets should do, and when. Batteries, EV fleets, solar and grid connections all come together in our optimiser, and the team turns prices, forecasts and constraints into schedules and decisions that run in production every day. Much of this work has an operations-research flavour, and the problems rarely arrive neatly defined.. They arrive as a customer who needs their vans charged by 6:00 at the lowest cost or a battery whose value depends on the hour. We're looking for someone who is comfortable across that whole path: understanding the real-world problem, shaping it into something a computer can solve, and shipping and operating the result. You don't need to be an OR specialist. You do need to be a strong Python engineer who enjoys messy, concrete problems. Success in this role means being able to: Take a loosely defined operational problem and turn it into working, maintainable production code. Work with data and models (optimisation, forecasting or plain statistics) without losing sight of the engineering. What you will do Create charging schedules for EV fleets that minimise electricity costs while guaranteeing every vehicle is ready when it needs to be. This means modelling tariffs, grid limits and departure times, and handling what happens when reality deviates from the plan. Calculate the value of each kWh produced or consumed, so that batteries, solar and flexible loads are steered by what energy is actually worth at that moment, and customers can see where their savings come from. Build forecasting models that predict operational issues before they happen, to maximise asset uptime and reduce the number of support tickets our Operations team has to handle. Take your work all the way to production: packaging, deployment, monitoring and bugfixing. Work with the rest of the Optimisation team on the shared tooling, data pipelines and modelling conventions the team uses.. What are looking for 5+ years of production Python development experience, writing clean, tested, maintainable code. A proven ability to translate real-world problems into working code. A pragmatic mindset: you choose the boring, well-understood solution when it's the right one, and you know when it isn't. Strong communication skills and a habit of documenting your work. Fluency in English is required. Weekly working hours of 32-40 hours Coming into the office 3-4 days per week Bonus points for None of these are required. We'd rather hire a strong engineer and teach the domain than the other way around. Experience with a modelling library such as cvxpy or Pyomo, or other operations research experience.. Time-series forecasting in production, or basic MLOps: keeping models trained, monitored and honest. Data analysis experience Energy, battery or electricity domain knowledge: tariffs, grid constraints, day-ahead and imbalance markets. The willingness to take on a People lead role in the team. Note: at iwell, we value growth potential over perfection. Feel free to respond if you can see yourself meeting this list in the (near) future. What we offer A competitive salary within the range of EUR 4400-EUR6600 + 8% holiday allowance 30 holidays per year, plus an annual company trip of 3 days The opportunity to do volunteer work, by offering 1 volunteer day per year Learning & Development budget of EUR 1,500 per year Attractive pension plan with Brand New Day Working remotely for 2 weeks per year We cover your travel costs, regardless of whether you come by bike, car, or public transport. A mobile phone allowance of EUR 25 per month Additional activities such as a bootcamp, volleyball tournament, company drinks etc. iwell is a family-friendly company and employs many employees with care-taking responsibilities Interested? For more information about iwell, what we do, why we do it, and an overview of our partners, visit https://iwell.eu/ . Our application process Apply. Our People & Culture Team and the hiring manager will review your application and will respond within 2 weeks. Phone screening. Are you a true iweller-in-the-making? We will invite you for an introductory call. Are you the one? You will have two interviews. For the second interview,, you will also be asked to work on a case. Acquisition based on this vacancy is not appreciated. Find Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow
