If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><h2>Available Locations</h2> <p>New York, NY<br>Washington, DC<br>San Francisco, CA</p> <h2>About the Role</h2> <p>Cloudflare’s architecture is built on a homogeneous edge: every server in over 330 cities runs every service—from L4/L7 proxies (FL2, Pingora) and DNS to the Workers runtime, cache, and storage. While this design maximizes hardware utilization, it creates a difficult distributed attribution problem. Machine-level telemetry tells us how loaded a server is, but not which product, customer, or upstream service is responsible for that load.</p> <p><br>MAPS (Metrics and Analytics for Product Segmentation) is a newly formed team building the core instrumentation, collection, and data platform to solve this from the ground up. We are architecting a system to continuously measure CPU, network bandwidth, memory, and storage utilization across the entire global fleet without sampling—attributing resource consumption both to the underlying system service and to the specific product, account, and zone being served.</p> <p><br>The data MAPS produces serves two critical functions at Cloudflare:</p> <ol> <li>Real-Time Control Plane: MAPS is the primary telemetry input for Cloudflare’s next-generation global load balancer, shifting traffic management from open-loop heuristics to closed-loop routing driven by real-time, per-service resource capacity and consumption (within seconds).</li> <li>Fleet Economics & Capacity Planning: MAPS provides the long-term analytical dataset in ClickHouse used to map product demand forecasts to physical hardware requirements, calculate true cost-to-serve per product, and drive multi-year infrastructure investments.</li> </ol> <h2>What You’ll Do</h2> <p>You will work across the full lifecycle of a greenfield, high-throughput telemetry system running on every machine at the Cloudflare edge:</p> <ul> <li>Host-Level Instrumentation ("Outside View"): Build and maintain low-overhead Linux daemons (netacctd, maps_collector) in Rust and C that use eBPF (cgroup_skb) and cgroup v2 accounting to measure per-service resource consumption directly from the kernel.</li> <li>High-Performance Client Libraries ("Inside View"): Architect non-blocking, zero-allocation reporting SDKs in Rust and Go used by Cloudflare’s highest-throughput data-plane services to report per-request resource usage and product attribution over local Unix domain sockets.</li> <li>Edge Aggregation & Streaming: Build the per-machine collector daemon that ingests millions of events per second, performs bounded in-memory time-window aggregation, serves low-latency gRPC streams to the global load balancer, and flushes batch rollups to ClickHouse.</li> <li>Reconciliation & Correctness: Solve complex attribution problems—such as reconciling kernel-level cgroup measurements against application-reported metrics, and attributing resource usage when one multi-tenant service executes work on behalf of another.</li> <li>Cross-Team Architecture: Partner directly with the engineering teams behind Cloudflare’s core proxies, runtimes, and storage engines to instrument their critical paths without degrading tail latency.</li> </ul> <h2>What We’re Looking For</h2> <ul> <li>Strong systems programming experience in Rust, Go, or C, with a solid grasp of memory layout, concurrency, and performance-critical code paths.</li> <li>Experience designing and operating latency- and resource-sensitive server infrastructure or high-throughput data pipelines at scale.</li> <li>Strong fundamentals in Linux systems internals—processes, cgroups, sockets, and how the kernel accounts for compute, memory, and I/O.</li> <li>Proven ability to work across organizational boundaries: reading unfamiliar codebases, aligning with other infrastructure teams, and driving complex integrations to completion.</li> <li>A pragmatic approach to owning outcomes—from kernel-level data collection and wire protocols (protobuf/Cap'n Proto) all the way to the analytical tables consumers query.</li> </ul> <h2>Bonus Points</h2> <ul> <li>Hands-on experience writing and verifying eBPF programs, or deep familiarity with the Linux networking stack and scheduler.</li> <li>Experience designing schemas and query patterns for distributed columnar databases (particularly ClickHouse) at high ingestion rates.</li> <li>Background in profiling, benchmarking, and debugging performance bottlenecks in production Linux environments (perf, PMU counters, flamegraphs).</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: We released</span><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">1.1.1.1</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our</span><a href="https://developers.cloudflare.com/1.1.1.1/privacy/public-dns-resolver"> privacy commitment</a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs.  More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.  We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all people and place great value in both diversity and inclusiveness.  All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to their, or any other person's, perceived or actual</span> <span style="font-weight: 400;">race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, family care status, or any other basis protected by law. </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">We are an AA/Veterans/Disabled Employer.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities.  Please tell us if you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job. Examples of reasonable accommodations include, but are not limited to, changing the application process, providing documents in an alternate format, using a sign language interpreter, or using specialized equipment.  If you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job, please contact us via e-mail at </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">hr@cloudflare.com</span><span style="font-weight: 400;"> or via mail at 101 Townsend St. San Francisco, CA 94107.</span></p></div>

title: Senior Pricing Analyst
description: 👋🏻 Hello, we're Laka You might not have heard of us yet - that's OK, you've found us now - come and find out more about our journey... Founded in 2017, Laka set out to transform insurance by connecting passionate cyclists to form a collective and protect their bikes for when things go wrong - a better model for insurance was born. For once people come first in insurance by fairly sharing the cost amongst each other. We exist to rewrite the rules of insurance so it’s something people stand with, not against. Our model: Laka makes sure everything runs smoothly for The Collective - from exceptionally fast claims, splitting the cost fairly, guaranteeing a maximum price and all the other heavy lifting of a regulated insurance business. For that service, the collective pays Laka a fee relative to the claims in a month. Take a closer look at exactly what this means and how it works here . What have we been up to since then...? In a nutshell, we've been very busy! Here are a few of the massive achievements we've had: 🚀 Raised $10.4 million at series B! 🚀 Grown the team to over 60 Lakanauts, based across the UK and NL, enabling a choice-based, remote-first way of working 🚀 Launched Laka in a total of 11 countries, essentially helping more people in more places! 🚀 Captured the UK and NL enthusiast cyclist market and expanded into commercial business partnering 🚀 Been awarded 'Best Cycle Insurance Provider' (for the past 8 years in a row - go us! 🥳) 🚀 Opened 3 shiny new offices in London, Bristol & Amsterdam to provide spaces for people to collaborate as they like 🚀 We've also achieved a 5* rating on Google Reviews and Glassdoor - go check us out! Help us continue to change an outdated industry... We’re growing real fast on our path to make the Laka collective model the industry standard and we’re expanding across segments, products, and territories. We’re looking for innovative, bold and brave minds to help us build the world’s best insurance company. 🧮 Pricing at Laka Pricing our Collective is what makes Laka unique, so this role sits at the heart of what we do. Each month, members pay their share of the Collective's claims and a fee for Laka's services, up to their own cap. A stop loss from our insurers picks up anything above the total of all caps. Pricing it well means keeping the Collective healthy while balancing the interests of our members, Laka and our insurance partners. We have a fledgling pricing stack that we are looking to advance with your help. 🤘🏼 The role You'll own pricing across all five markets and both sides of our business. One side is cyclists who buy from us direct. The other is the partners who sell or bundle our cover, from bike brands and retailers to leasing companies and delivery fleets. It's a broad, hands-on role, working with our Pricing Analyst. What you'll be getting up to: Define and deliver pricing for our Collective in the UK and Europe: members' caps, rating factors and fees, based on claims frequency and severity by market and segment. Price our partner business, from bike brands and retailers to leasing companies and fleets, and support our Commercial team on new deals and renewals. Prepare rate reviews and pricing proposals for our insurance partners, and work with them on stop loss and capacity terms. Develop our pricing stack, tools and processes with Engineering and Data. Manage and develop our Pricing Analyst. You'll be successful by: Reviewing retail and partner pricing across all five markets in your first three months and agreeing priorities with us. Taking the first cap and fee changes live, with proposals our insurers approve first time. Taking our pricing stack to the next level within your first year. Requirements 🚀 Sound like you? 👉🏻 This role will be a great fit if you: Have 6+ years' experience in insurance pricing, with rate changes you've designed and taken live. Ideally have priced both direct-to-consumer and partner or B2B business: deep in one, credible in the other. Build pricing models in code: GLMs and GBMs in Python, with SQL. Are sharp and commercially minded, balancing growth, retention and profitability. Can explain technical work simply to partners, insurers and our leadership team. Have managed or mentored an analyst and are happy to stay hands-on. Already use AI tools like Claude and Claude Code, or are keen to make them core to how you work. Plus points: Actuarial exams (IFoA, AAG, DAV or Institut des Actuaires): welcome, but not required. We care most about what you've priced. Dutch, German or French. An interest in cycling. Benefits 🌟 Our perks 🏠 Remote-first way of working - you choose whether you work from home or our beautiful offices in London, Bristol and Amsterdam(we have no minimum expectation of how many days you come in, although we'd love to see your friendly face!) 📈 Share options - we want you to be rewarded for Laka's success - everyone in the business is granted share options when they join 💰 Performance driven scheme - if the company hits its targets, you'll get a cash bonus of 5% of your base salary annually 🌴 Annual leave - 25 days holiday (plus bank holidays), with the option to roll over up to 5 days per year 💶 Pension scheme - Laka pays 3% of your base salary into your pension to help you save for the future 💊 Private medical insurance - we’ll give you individual private cover, with the option to add partners & dependants too (at a small cost) 🍽 Lunch on us - £15 every first Wednesday of the month to enjoy lunch on Laka - pop out locally with people in the office, or order-in at home, the choice is yours 💃 Company-wide events - we love getting everyone together as much as possible - expect regular events throughout the year, for team building, bonding, and general good old-fashioned fun! 🎳 Monthly socials - as if quarterly company events weren't enough, we also give each office a budget for a monthly social activity (think anything from low-key dinner & drinks through to adventure golf, paddleboarding, bowling, electric darts, trampoline parks and more!) 👚 Laka swag - we'll give you some lovely Laka kit to get you started, including a jumper & t-shirts so you can feel (& look) like part of the family 🚴 Laka credit - for all you cyclists, we'll give you £10 credit per month towards insuring your bike(s) with us - plus give you access to a bunch of cycling industry discounts 🧠 Mental health support - unlimited support via Spill, including one-to-one therapy sessions 🌈 Belonging at Laka We're committed to building and sustaining a business that promotes diversity, equity, inclusion and belonging - our customer collective is broad and inclusive, and we'd like our own people to be too. We're fast becoming a global community of people and we believe each person's unique qualities should be celebrated as they are a huge part of what makes Laka a great place to be. We'd love you to bring your authentic self to work every single day, no matter your age, ethnicity, religion, citizenship, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability status, caring responsibilities, neurodiversity, or anything else that makes you, you. If you’d like to request a reasonable adjustment as part of our application or assessment process, please let us know by emailing View email address on apply.workable.com To find out more about what it’s like to work at Laka, visit our careers page here . Our customer collective is broad and inclusive, and we'd like our own people to be too. We continuously strive to build a diverse team from all backgrounds as we believe that varied experiences and perspectives makes the Laka collective even stronger. title: Global Senior Program Manager
description: Are you ready to lead complex engineering programs within the semiconductor industry? As Senior Program Manager, you drive multidisciplinary global projects from concept to delivery, working closely with leading customers, engineering teams and operations. You will be responsible for the full lifecycle of development programs, from the initial customer request and concept phase through industrialization and customer delivery. Working closely with engineering, operations, supply chain and our customers, you ensure technical ambitions are translated into successful business outcomes. Your main responsibilities are: Lead complex Design & Engineering programs from concept development through manufacturing ramp-up and customer delivery. Drive program execution across multidisciplinary teams of up to 50 engineers located across multiple global Benchmark sites. Take ownership of program scope, planning, budget, risks and key decision-making throughout the entire lifecycle. Align technical experts, project leaders and stakeholders around shared goals, priorities and deliverables. Work closely with operations, supply chain and external partners to ensure products are ready for successful industrialization and production. Act as the primary point of contact for customers, providing clear communication on progress, risks, decisions and their business impact. Create structure, alignment and momentum in technically complex environments where customer expectations, engineering challenges and business objectives come together. This role offers a unique opportunity to work at the forefront of semiconductor technology, leading strategic programs that have a direct impact on both our customers' success and Benchmark's future growth. Why do you want this position? Because few roles offer this combination of technical complexity, global collaboration and strategic impact. You will lead high-profile semiconductor programs, work directly with industry-leading customers, and drive the successful delivery of innovative products from concept through manufacturing, leaving a visible mark on both our organization and the future of semiconductor technology. What do we offer? At Benchmark, you work on products that truly matter. Je bent in staat om strategisch te denken en markttrends te vertalen naar een duidelijke productvisie. Je werkt zelfstandig en ondernemend, neemt initiatief en stimuleert een proactieve manier van werken. Je bent gericht op continu samen verbeteren en hebt oog voor de behoeften en ervaringen van gebruikers en afnemers. Feitelijk goed geregeld Voor onze arbeidsvoorwaarden volgen wij de CAO Rijk. title: Clinical Solutions Consultant
description: About Rivia Rivia is a technology company building a data engine that powers the future of clinical trial intelligence. Biotechs are the source of most therapeutic innovation, yet clinical development is constantly constrained by fragmented data and outdated tooling. Rivia unifies clinical trial data at scale through a core engine built as a reusable intelligence layer, comprising hundreds of configurations and trial-specific logic, independent of source structure. This vertical stack of data engine, workflows, and agents creates a distinct advantage in how trials are operated. Over the past two years, European- and US-based biotechs running global clinical trials on Rivia have demonstrated measurable impact, from earlier understanding of therapeutic potential to significantly more efficient trial execution. In March 2026, Rivia raised its $15M Series A led by Earlybird Venture Capital. Rivia's ambition is to become the standard infrastructure for modern drug development, transforming how trials are executed end-to-end. You'll partner closely with our Account Executives throughout the technical stages of the sales cycle, turning complex scientific and technical challenges into compelling product demonstrations, tailored sandboxes, and solutions that address real customer needs. title: Audit Methodology Lead
description: We build AI agents that perform audit procedures for audit firms. We need an experienced auditor to decide what correct output from those agents looks like, and whether our agents meet that bar. You'll join one of our product groups as its audit expert. You'll write the criteria and reference cases our agents are tested against, review agent output the way you'd review a file, and tell the team plainly when something isn't ready for a live engagement. You'll use AI to create realistic test material, and you'll review all of it yourself. About DataSnipper The hardest AI problems aren't about getting an answer fast. They're about getting one people can trust. We believe trust is essential to how society works. Every day, we rely on information that's been independently verified, from financial statements to the products we buy, to the sustainability claims companies make. Behind that trust are audit and finance professionals who examine evidence, verify information and hold organizations accountable. At DataSnipper, we build AI solutions that empower those professionals. By making evidence easier to trace and verify, we help them focus on the judgment and expertise that make their work so important. For our product and engineering team, this is where things get exciting. In audit, a plausible answer isn't good enough. Every output has to be explainable and traceable back to its source. We've just launched a brand new agentic platform, Alwin by DataSnipper. AI agents running in the cloud across hundreds of documents at once, reasoning across PDF, Word and Excel, with a full audit trail behind every step. There are lots of greenfield problems ahead, and real room to shape what we build and how we build it. And we build at scale. More than 600,000 professionals across 3,000+ organizations in 175 countries rely on DataSnipper, including Fortune 500 companies, government agencies and all Big Four audit firms. In 2025 alone, the DataSnipper platform delivered more than $1.4 billion in productivity savings to is customers . Backed by a $100 million Series B led by Index Ventures, at a $1 billion valuation, and as proud members of 1% for the Planet, we care about how we grow, not just how fast. If you want to build AI that professionals trust with work that really matters, this is your chance to help shape the future of audit and finance and do the best work of your career along the way. What you'll own Define the correct answer, and the reasoning behind it, for the procedures our agents perform Interpret ISAs and NV COS (IFRS for reporting matters; US GAAS and PCAOB where relevant) into requirements engineers can build against Create realistic audit cases with AI tools, including documents, workpapers, exceptions and judgement calls, and review every one Review agent output against those cases, and find misapplied standards, weak reasoning and conclusions that wouldn't pass partner review Turn recurring errors into findings product and engineering can fix Give a clear, evidenced view on whether a capability is ready for live engagements Review methodology content from partners and our own teams, with versioning, approval and documented changes Track changes in standards and inspection findings, and explain what they mean for the product Teach product and engineering how audit work is actually done, including how firms differ Work with customers and content partners when the work requires it What you'll bring A professional qualification: RA, AA, CPA, CA, ACA, ACCA or equivalent Experience as an Audit Manager: setting the approach, reviewing others' work, clearing review notes and defending conclusions Recent experience across several clients and industries Working knowledge of ISQM 1 and how firms document and review audit work Regular use of AI tools, and a clear sense of how they fail Precise writing: people without your training will build from what you write Patience for detail: line-by-line review, and real time spent on a single conclusion Nice to have: You want to use your audit expertise on hard problems in AI: judgement, evidence and review You'd rather change how audit work is done than automate how it's done today You've built something yourself, such as a tool, prototype or workflow, to fix a slow process You stay with open-ended problems until the answer holds up What this role is not Not product management. title: Software Engineer - Ruby on Rails
description: We're hiring a full-stack engineer to help us build the next version of FeedbackFruits. We believe in engineers who stay close to the product: domain experts who pay attention to how users actually behave and use the platform. Most of the work comes down to one thing: making the product better. We rethink each feature from the user's perspective and rebuild it on stronger foundations, together with our designers and product managers. We modernise the stack as we go, moving from Rails + Ember.js to Rails + Hotwire. There's deeper technical work alongside it, on performance, stability, and the platform, all in service of a product that feels faster and more reliable. Stabilisation and simplification are our top concerns, from both a product and an engineering standpoint. We'd rather fix root causes for the long term than patch symptoms, even when patching would be quicker. Our long-term aim is to get closer to our users by shipping faster, moving from one monthly release with regular hotfixes toward continuous delivery. We've also adopted agentic coding and integrations to sharpen how we work, and we value multipliers: engineers who raise the people around them and put the team before their own output. What you'll do: Join one of our engineering squads and own full-stack delivery on the roadmap, from backend logic and database design to the server-rendered UI it connects to Lead the migration of Ember features to Rails + Hotwire, which means understanding the existing functionality, redesigning it thoughtfully together with PMs/designers, and shipping something better than what was there before Handle support escalations and legacy bug-fixing as part of the mix alongside feature work. The balance will depend on which squad you join, but keeping the codebase healthy and customers unblocked is part of the job Contribute to improving our CI/CD practices and deployment pipeline as we work toward more frequent, more reliable releases Keep performance in mind across the stack Build and maintain integrations with Learning Management Systems using LTI and partner APIs Participate in code reviews and technical design discussions, bringing both quality standards and a pragmatist's sense of what's worth the effort What you bring: You have 3+ years of professional software engineering experience and Ruby on Rails is your home stack: you've shipped production code with it, you know its conventions, and you're comfortable in its edges You write tests as a matter of course, not as an afterthought. RSpec and Capybara are part of your regular toolkit, and you write tests that actually catch things rather than just confirm the happy path You are user-oriented: when you're deciding how a feature should work, your first instinct is to think about the person using it, not the implementation that's most convenient You've worked in a legacy codebase before and come through it well. You know what to fix, what to leave, and how to leave things better than you found them without getting stuck in a refactoring spiral You understand CI/CD well enough to work within good practices and to nudge a codebase toward them when they're missing You communicate clearly, give honest feedback in code reviews, and take it just as well. You’re collaborative without needing everyone to agree with you You are pragmatic and document your decisions; you'd rather make a thoughtful trade-off and write it down than chase the perfect solution indefinitely Familiarity with Ember.js or migration scenarios from it to Hotwire is a genuine advantage here; experience with AI dev tooling, Azure, or observability practices would serve you well too What you get: Hybrid work schedule (3 days onsite) 25 paid holidays per year A day off for your birthday Advantageous pension scheme 3 days of volunteering leave per year €550 Learning & Development budget per year + 3 days paid leave for learning Travel allowance and Swapfiets subscription Free access to our office gym Unlimited access to mental health support via OpenUp (EU, US, and AUS) Compensation: €60K – €75K • Annual base salary incl. 8% holiday allowance. description: Hi, I'm Alex, Finance Manager at FeedbackFruits. 👋 Our Finance team is ramping up over the next couple of years, and we are looking for someone to join the team on a 24-32 hour basis ! Finance here runs across two entities, a Dutch BV and a US Corp, each with its own invoicing, tax and banking rules. Our customers are universities all over the world, so the work ranges from a straightforward Dutch invoice to a US procurement portal with its own supplier onboarding forms and submission rules. The role is broader than most financial administration jobs at this level, and we are searching for someone who's ready to own it. I'm looking for a Financial Administrator to take on our day-to-day operations: billing and collections on the receivables side, supplier invoices and payment runs on the payables side, and the Finance mailbox where everything is coordinated. A lot of our processes are still manual, with limited documented processes. You'd be doing the work and improving it at the same time, formalising operating procedures as you go. The ideal team member is someone who notices when a workflow is clumsy, and is proactive in addressing it. We're a small team of two, and we support the wider organisation with a vast range of topics. You'd work closely with our New Business and Partner Success teams when it comes to billing, and with our Marketing team when it comes to purchasing. When an invoice goes out on time, a university pays on schedule or a purchasing inquiry is resolved ahead of an event, that's visible, and it will be thanks to you. If you're eager to get the full picture of operations in a company with an international customer base, this is the right place for it. What you'll do: Send out sales invoices on time. This includes setting up new customers and uploading invoices to procurement portals such as Ariba and PaymentWorks Set up and maintain customer subscriptions in the ERP system based on signed contracts, and create invoices and credit notes for all legal entities Keep track of unpaid invoices, send payment reminders to institutions that haven’t paid, and flag invoices that stay unpaid Partner with Sales and Partner Success to address billing and payment queries Ensure supplier invoices and expenses are processed on time Prepare the weekly payment run for approval Compare bank transactions with our accounting records and resolve any discrepancies Manage the Finance mailbox: customer invoice and payment questions, supplier requests, supplier onboarding forms, and internal requests that come in through the ticketing system Support month-end close and annual accounts Write down how finance processes work in the Finance database in Notion, and update it when you improve them What you bring: You stay accurate and organised during busy periods. At month-end you keep daily work running smoothly while closing the month. You follow things through to the end, in a friendly way. Late payments, missing details or an invoice that needs to match a contract: you stay on it until it’s sorted, and people enjoy working with you. You take ownership of your work from start to finish. You plan your own week, set your own priorities and keep things moving. You speak up when something in the numbers looks off, so we can fix it together. You enjoy working with tools and software, and like finding new ways to get more out of them. You’re comfortable building things as you go. You ask good questions, fill in the gaps and make sure you know the next steps before you start. You have at least one year of experience in a finance or similar administrative role (two or more is a plus), including hands-on work with billing or subscriptions. We care more about your experience than your degree. You’ve worked with an accounting system or ERP, such as Exact Online, NetSuite, Dynamics or SAP. Experience with Exact Online, Moss or procurement portals is a bonus You write and speak English fluently, as we use it for all internal and external work. You’re available 24 to 32 hours per week and can work from our Amsterdam office 2-3 days a week. title: Workplace Operations Manager
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p><strong>Available Locations: Austin, TX</strong></p> <ul> <li>Work onsite in the office 5 days a week (Monday–Friday)</li> </ul> <p><strong>About the role</strong></p> <p>The <strong>Places Team</strong> at Cloudflare is seeking an experienced and enthusiastic <strong>Workplace Operations Manager</strong> to lead and elevate the day-to-day operations of our Austin hub. In this role, you’ll be the go-to person for creating a smooth, welcoming, and highly functional workplace—partnering with global counterparts to share best practices and continuously enhance our spaces.</p> <p>You’ll gather feedback from employees and guests to shape how the hub evolves, contribute to future buildouts, and collaborate with teams across IT, Legal, Physical Security, EBC, and more. You're comfortable navigating fast-paced environments, solving problems on the fly, and thinking creatively about how to improve systems and experiences. With a hospitality mindset and strong communication skills, you take pride in delivering excellent service and building a space that reflects our culture and values.</p> <p>This role reports to the <strong>Regional Manager, Workplace Operations</strong>.</p> <p><strong>Responsibilities</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong><em>Workplace Experience:</em></strong> Ensure our hub is a functional, inspiring space that reflects our culture and supports hybrid work. Act as the first point of contact for employee workplace needs, solving issues quickly and thoughtfully.</li> <li><strong><em>Stay Connected Across Channels:</em></strong><strong> </strong>Maintain clear, responsive communication with the local team across platforms like chat, email, and in-person touchpoints—ensuring everyone stays informed, supported, and aligned on workplace updates and needs.</li> <li><strong><em>Track and Report Workplace Metrics: </em></strong>Monitor key data points such as space utilization, occupancy, and service ticket volume to support data-driven decision-making and long-term planning.</li> <li><strong><em>Support Workplace Programs: </em></strong>Help drive local implementation of global workplace programs—from our food program (think snack stocking, team lunches, and special food moments) and sustainability initiatives to employee engagement efforts.</li> <li><strong><em>Support Internal Events & Experiences:</em></strong> Plan and execute a range of onsite events—including team onsites, in-person weeks, executive briefings, customer meetings, and cultural moments—both independently and in collaboration with the Global Events & Experiences team, ensuring each gathering is seamless, engaging, and reflective of our culture.</li> <li><strong><em>Safety & Compliance:</em></strong><strong> </strong>Partner with Security and Legal teams to maintain a safe and compliant workplace. Support emergency preparedness efforts, safety drills, and incident response protocols.</li> <li><strong><em>Scale Smartly</em></strong><strong>: </strong>As the hub grows, help onboard new team members, support hiring needs for workplace roles, and participate in long-term workplace planning.</li> <li><strong><em>Support the Regional Places Team:</em></strong> Assist with administrative tasks such as responding to tickets, managing emails and inquiries, and providing holiday coverage to ensure seamless team operations across regions.</li> <li><strong><em>Lead Onsite Operations:</em></strong> Own the day-to-day management of the workplace—from front desk services, greeting guests/employees/visiting employees, and mail handling to office supplies, swag, deliveries, and space readiness. You’ll make sure everything flows, looks great, and feels seamless for employees and visitors alike.</li> <li><strong><em>Be the go-to for Vendors and Places Team:</em></strong><strong> </strong>Liaise with building management, building security, and external vendors (cleaning crews, caterers, property managers, etc.) to keep our operations running efficiently. Oversee vendor performance and contracts, lead RFPs when needed, and track workplace budgets responsibly.</li> <li><strong><em>Create a World-Class Environment:</em></strong> Champion an inspiring, inclusive, and vibrant office culture. Plan and execute engaging onsite events, team celebrations, catering, and daily amenities that make coming into the office exciting, productive, and memorable for our team.</li> </ul> <h4><strong>Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience:</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Have 5+ years of experience leading workplace operations teams, ideally in a fast-paced, high-growth environment, including 3+ years of people management experience.</li> <li>Are people-first and service-minded, with a friendly, professional presence that makes everyone feel welcome</li> <li>Know how to juggle vendors, projects, and priorities—and still sweat the small stuff</li> <li>Bring sharp budget management skills and make thoughtful, cost-effective decisions</li> <li>Communicate clearly and confidently across all levels and time zones using Google Workspace</li> <li>Are highly organized, detail-oriented, and proactive—you spot what needs doing before anyone else does</li> <li>Thrive in fast-moving environments, stay calm under pressure, and love finding creative solutions</li> <li>Have experience collaborating cross-functionally with teams like IT, Security, People Ops, and more</li> <li>Bring a hospitality mindset and a passion for building inspiring, functional spaces where people love to work</li> <li>Work onsite in the office 5 days a week (Monday–Friday).</li> </ul> <p> </p><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: We released</span><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">1.1.1.1</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our</span><a href="https://developers.cloudflare.com/1.1.1.1/privacy/public-dns-resolver"> privacy commitment</a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs.  More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.  We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all people and place great value in both diversity and inclusiveness.  All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to their, or any other person's, perceived or actual</span> <span style="font-weight: 400;">race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, family care status, or any other basis protected by law. </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">We are an AA/Veterans/Disabled Employe

title: Manager Organisational Transformation
description: About the job Please note that fluency in Dutch is mandatory for this role. Do you have a passion for organisational design and a drive to boost effectiveness? At Valcon, we are looking for experienced candidates with an ambition to improve organisational effectiveness and a passion for organisational design. Besides a proven track record in this domain, we value strong team players with an entrepreneurial spirit and the ability to carry out great ideas in practice. You fit in our team when you have highly developed analytical and conceptual thinking skills and when you can easily draw insights and conclusions from complex matters. What will you do? Your primary focus lies in the organisational transformation process, where translation of ambition and strategy to an effective organisational design take a centre stage. In close collaboration with our clients, you analyse challenges and identify improvement potential in the integral organisational design, such as processes, systems, functions and organisational structure. You play an important role in advancing Valcon’s capabilities with a strong emphasis on the People & Organisational Transformation domain. Your responsibilities will include: Managing organisational changes, from problem analysis, optimisation of processes to designing and implementing new business models. Developing different organisational transformation strategies and approaches (making an ambition strategy, design and guiding principles, organisational structure and required communication and engagement plans) that fits the client’s challenge best. Managing and regulating Organisational Transformation projects, with high emphasis on both delivery as stakeholder management. Building and maintaining a relevant network with current and new clients. Managing and guiding consultants during projects and in their personal development. Co-develop one of the industries in which Valcon is present. Building and promoting ‘Valcon’; focus on expanding the People & Organisational Transformation competence team, and primary Organisational Transformation. What do you bring to the table? A completed bachelor’s and master’s degree with a numerical component. At least 5 years of relevant work experience including experience in consultancy. At least 3 years of experience with the implementation of new business models. The ability to translate strategic goals into implications for employees. We don’t stop at design; we support our clients through implementation. Our integrated transformation projects connect strategy, data, AI and organisational change. An interest in data, AI, change management and the human side of change is therefore essential. Strong personality; you can retain your point of view while managing difficult stakeholders. Real team-player with excellent communication & analytical skills. Commercial expertise; experience in building and maintaining customer relationships. Fluent in Dutch and English. What do we offer you? Personal development: a tailor-made growth path with training, courses, certification and mentoring by experienced colleagues. An innovative work environment: collaborate with a team of experts pushing boundaries in data, technology, and consulting. Immediate impact and responsibility: you’ll make a difference for our clients from day one and are entrusted with responsibilities that challenge you to bring the best out of yourself. Inspiring work culture: a supportive, flexible, and no-nonsense environment that fosters your growth and fully allows you to be yourself. Additionally, we offer: Competitive and transparent salary according to our pay structure, an annual bonus (depending on seniority level, individual performance, and company results), and a monthly expense allowance of €95. A company car or mobility budget. A workplace that prioritises and respects your work-life balance (for example by offering you the option of taking a sabbatical or expand the number of holidays per year). An affordable sports membership that allows you to participate in 50 different sports offered by over 10,000 partners. The opportunity to work remotely from abroad for 10 days per year. A vibrant community that organises both professional and social events. Ready to apply? Has the above sparked your interest and are you ready to join our innovative and impactful environment? And do our core values - Together, Joy, Curious, Can do, and Integrity - resonate with you? Our recruitment team would be happy to hear from you! Please apply directly using the button on this page or get in touch with our recruitment team to schedule a coffee meeting at our office first. Find Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

The AE must be expert in identifying business opportunities with customers, developing Enterprise Account Plans, driving execution across functional stakeholders, and closing revenue. The Enterprise Account Executive should be comfortable engaging in business level outcome conversations with the C-suite, presenting Cloudflare’s vision and plan for value creation to all levels, and negotiating win-win scenarios for all parties. The AE will be accountable to obtaining new business and expansion of Cloudflare wallet-share within existing customers. The role involves handling multiple accounts and will require high degrees of attention to detail and coordination with customers, partners, and internal resources. Lastly, the AE should thrive in an entrepreneurial environment where initiative is celebrated and enthusiasm for the possible is expected.</li> </ul> <h3>Enterprise Account Team Core Values:</h3> <ul> <li>Be Successful – Success comes from hitting your goals on a consistent basis. Be in a position and ready to demonstrate your plan for success.</li> <li>Provide Customers with a Premium Business Experience - Solutions, Empathy, Proactiveness, Anticipation of needs, Company Support, Creativity, and Urgency to Deliver Value are core principles of a Cloudflare Strategic Account Experience. Give your customers a level of service that is unmatched in the industry.</li> <li>Be Brilliant in the Basics - The hallmark of a high performance team is their willingness to commit to Brilliance in the Basics in all aspects of their roles. Forecasting, SFDC Disciplines, Pipeline Management, Account Engagement, Negotiation, Closing, and Depth of Cloudflare Knowledge are the basic skills that make a Strategic Account Executive successful.</li> <li>Make Bold Decisions - Operating with the largest companies in the world is a “game of inches”. We are successful when we are all overachieving as a group.</li> <li>Proactively manage and grow a portfolio of assigned Enterprise level clients.</li> <li>Close new and expansion business monthly, quarterly, and annual basis, meeting or exceeding assigned quota.</li> <li>Manage customer relationships and assume ownership of deadlines and deliverables to ensure Cloudflare is correctly positioned to win business.</li> <li>Develop C level and Decision Maker relationships within accounts for the purpose of establishing strategic alignment to customer’s transformative objectives.</li> <li>Develop pipeline by maintaining a high level of activity/outreach directly and indirectly, deeply understanding the customers goals and objectives, and analyzing where Cloudflare can add value.</li> <li>Maintain accurate forecasts and report to the sales leader on the status of New and Expansion opportunities for weekly sales meetings. Strong closing skills are essential.</li> <li>Ability to build meaningful relationships quickly.</li> <li>Someone who acts with integrity and honesty in all situations.</li> <li>Be able to demonstrate a positive attitude internally and externally.</li> <li>Expert at building rapport and owning the room.</li> <li>Aggressiveness in execution and planning.</li> <li>Ability to take successes and challenges in stride.</li> <li>Discipline to work w/o instant gratification.</li> <li>Someone who is bold in their actions and never satisfied with complacency.</li> <li>A strong will and fortitude to work a plan in the face of challenge.</li> <li>A business professional who loves the sales profession.</li> </ul> <h2>Compensation</h2> <h4>For Washington DC, based hires: Estimated annual salary of $269,000 - If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><h2>Available Locations</h2> <ul> <li>Austin, US</li> <li>Atlanta, GA</li> <li>Denver, CO</li> <li>Seattle, WA</li> <li>Toronto, ON</li> </ul> <p><strong>Applications will be accepted until December 01, 2026.</strong></p> <h2>About the Role</h2> <p>Cloudflare operates one of the world's largest and most interconnected networks, spanning 335+ cities across every region of the globe. We are looking for a Senior Network Engineer to join our Edge Network & Backbone team — someone who brings deep operational experience, an AI-first mindset, and the instinct to mentor and lift the engineers around them. In your first year, this role is deliberately hands-on: you'll be in the operational trenches, owning complex faults, driving capacity work, and setting the standard for how we run the network. Beyond that, you'll help shape how the team works — building AI-enabled tooling and agents that reduce toil, accelerate troubleshooting, and make the whole team more effective. This is a North American based role, but you'll be joining one global team: the sun never sets on Cloudflare, and our engineers hand off work across every time zone to keep the network running around the clock.</p> <h2>Responsibilities</h2> <ul> <li>Own the technical operation, engineering, and architecture of Cloudflare's global network, including planning, installation, and day-to-day management of hardware and software across the edge and backbone.</li> <li>Serve as a hands-on operational anchor for the team — diagnosing and resolving complex network faults, owning incident response end-to-end including on-call rotation, and contributing to post-incident reviews to drive continuous improvement.</li> <li>Build production AI agents for network operations. Design, ship, and own LLM-powered tools that integrate with our operational systems of record via tool calling. Ship them with evals, observability of agent decisions, cost tracking, and human-in-the-loop checkpoints where autonomous action carries blast radius.</li> <li>Apply AI to accelerate troubleshooting. Use and extend our internal AI platform (Workers AI, AI Gateway) to speed up root cause analysis, pattern recognition across faults, and operational decision-making under pressure.</li> <li>Architect network improvements that lower latency, reduce packet loss, and increase scale — optimising end user experience across Cloudflare's global infrastructure.</li> <li>Mentor and develop junior engineers on the team, setting technical standards, conducting structured troubleshooting sessions, and building a culture of operational excellence and continuous learning.</li> <li>Collaborate with internal teams on cross-functional network projects, contributing to design documentation, SOPs, and knowledge base articles that outlast any individual contributor.</li> </ul> <h2>Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience</h2> <ul> <li>Proven track record in large-scale network engineering and operations.</li> <li>Proficiency in Python and/or TypeScript and/or Go sufficient to build, debug, and maintain agent code, not just to glue scripts together.</li> <li>Working knowledge of agent integration patterns: function/tool calling, MCP or equivalent, retrieval over operational corpora (runbooks, postmortems, change history), and prompt iteration with evals.</li> <li>Experience reasoning about agent failure modes in production: hallucination guards, fallback paths, rollback, blast-radius control.</li> <li>Deep expertise in BGP and anycast routing, with the ability to diagnose and resolve complex routing issues in a production environment.</li> <li>Strong understanding of MPLS and Segment Routing.</li> <li>Proficiency across multiple network vendor operating systems (Juniper, Cisco, Arista, or similar).</li> <li>Experience with network automation frameworks such as SaltStack, Ansible, or equivalent, and a strong instinct for solving operational problems through code.</li> <li>Ability to prioritise effectively and lead calmly when faced with high-pressure scenarios.</li> <li>An effective communicator who can adapt their style to any audience — whether guiding a junior engineer through a fault or presenting a network architecture decision to senior leadership.</li> </ul> <h2>Bonus Points</h2> <ul> <li>Shipped LLM-powered tooling into production use by a team other than your own, with measurable operational impact.</li> <li>Professional-level network certification (JNCIP, CCNP, or equivalent or higher).</li> <li>Experience with optical transport technologies such as CWDM and DWDM.</li> <li>Linux system administration.</li> <li>Experience writing network configuration and design documentation at an architectural level.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <h3>Compensation</h3> <p>Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location.</p> <ul> <li>For Colorado based hires: Estimated annual salary of $168,000 - $231,000</li> <li>Washington, based hires: Estimated annual salary of $172,000 - $237,000.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <h3>Equity</h3> <p>This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare's equity plan.</p> <h3>Benefits</h3> <p>Cloudflare offers a complete package of benefits and programs to support you and your family. Our benefits programs can help you pay health care expenses, support caregiving, build capital for the future and make life a little easier and fun! The below is a description of our benefits for employees in the United States, and benefits may vary for employees based outside the U.S.</p> <p>Health & Welfare Benefits</p> <ul> <li>Medical/Rx Insurance</li> <li>Dental Insurance</li> <li>Vision Insurance</li> <li>Flexible Spending Accounts</li> <li>Commuter Spending Accounts</li> <li>Fertility & Family Forming Benefits</li> <li>On-demand mental health support and Employee Assistance Program</li> <li>Global Travel Medical Insurance</li> </ul> <p>Financial Benefits</p> <ul> <li>Short and Long Term Disability Insurance</li> <li>Life & Accident Insurance</li> <li>401(k) Retirement Savings Plan</li> <li>Employee Stock Participation Plan</li> </ul> <p>Time Off</p> <ul> <li>Flexible paid time off covering vacation and sick leave</li> <li>Leave programs, including parental, pregnancy health, medical, and bereavement leave</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. title: Senior Software Engineer, Climate
description: <div class="content-intro"><h2><strong>About Flexport: </strong></h2> <p>At Flexport, we believe global trade can move the human race forward. That’s why it’s our mission to make global commerce so easy there will be more of it. We’re shaping the future of a $10T industry with solutions powered by innovative technology and exceptional people. Today, companies of all sizes—from emerging brands to Fortune 500s—use Flexport technology to move more than $19B of merchandise across 112 countries a year. </p> <p>The recent global supply chain crisis has put Flexport center stage as we continue to play a pivotal role in how goods move around the world. We are proud to have the support of the best investors in the game who believe in our mission, solutions and people. Ready to tackle global challenges that impact business, society, and the environment? Come join us.</p></div><h3><strong>Why Climate Matters More Than Ever</strong></h3> <p>Supply chain leaders are being asked to cut costs and carbon at the same time. Yet logistics and sustainability teams often work with different data, tools, and priorities. Meanwhile, regulations and industry standards are raising expectations for how companies measure and manage their emissions.</p> <p>Most climate tools stop at reporting: a dashboard or a year-end PDF, produced long after a shipment has moved. They rarely reach the people deciding how to route goods, when to ship, or how much inventory to hold.</p> <p>The Climate team at Flexport is building emissions intelligence directly into the platform where supply chain decisions are made. We help customers weigh cost, speed, and emissions together—and turn that understanding into action.</p> <h2><strong>The Opportunity</strong></h2> <p>Flexport already runs the shipments, holds the data, and provides the platform where customers manage their supply chains. That puts us in a strong position to connect climate insights with the operational decisions that drive emissions.</p> <p>You will be the primary engineer for Climate, working independently of our existing engineering teams and partnering closely with the Climate Manager, your main day-to-day business stakeholder.</p> <p>Think of it as a small startup within Flexport: direct access to the business, a broad scope, and substantial ownership. Together with the Climate Manager, you will identify the most valuable problems to solve, shape the product direction, and turn ideas into reliable software. This role calls for someone who enjoys both deciding what to build and building it.</p> <p><strong>Things We ❤️</strong></p> <ul> <li>Turning complex shipment and emissions data into clear, actionable choices.</li> <li>Working directly with stakeholders and users to understand what would make their lives better.</li> <li>Building simple, reliable products and learning from how people use them.</li> <li>Finding opportunities where lower costs and lower emissions go together.</li> <li>Taking an idea from an ambiguous problem to a useful product in production.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>You Will</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Work closely with Climate Programs Manager to understand customer needs, challenge assumptions, and translate business goals into a practical product roadmap.</li> <li>Own delivery from problem discovery and technical design through implementation, launch, operation, and iteration.</li> <li>Build emissions intelligence into everyday supply chain decisions, including routing, transport mode, shipment timing, and inventory planning.</li> <li>Help customers identify opportunities to reduce emissions using Flexport’s shipment data.</li> <li>Make lower-emission choices easier to understand and act on within existing workflows.</li> <li>Develop products that help customers understand the wider environmental footprint of their supply chains, beyond freight.</li> <li>Deliver useful improvements incrementally, balancing speed, scope, maintainability, and data accuracy.</li> <li>Coordinate with other engineering teams when your work depends on shared systems, integrations, or expertise.</li> <li>Measure whether what you ship solves the underlying problem, and use that evidence to decide what comes next.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>You Should Have</strong></h2> <ul> <li>5+ years of software engineering experience, with a strong engineering foundation and experience delivering production software.</li> <li>A track record of working independently: you can bring structure to an unclear problem, set priorities, unblock yourself, and follow through without a detailed specification or constant direction.</li> <li>Strong product judgment: you understand user needs, identify what is worth building, and make thoughtful tradeoffs between impact and effort.</li> <li>Experience working closely with business stakeholders: you ask good questions, explain technical choices in plain language, and constructively challenge ideas when needed.</li> <li>The ability to own features across the stack, including user interfaces, backend services, and data integrations.</li> <li>A love of simple, well-tested code that is easy to extend and hard to break.</li> <li>Comfort taking responsibility for the reliability and maintenance of what you build.</li> <li>A bias for action, combined with the judgment to recognize when you need input or help.</li> <li>An aptitude for learning quickly, including unfamiliar business domains and technologies.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Nice to Have</strong></h2> <ul> <li>A personal motivation to work on climate and environmental challenges.</li> <li>Experience in climate technology, emissions accounting, logistics, or supply chain software.</li> <li>Experience building products in a startup or another small team with broad ownership.</li> <li>Experience turning complex data into customer-facing insights and decision tools.</li> </ul> <p>Prior climate experience is a plus; curiosity and the ability to learn the domain matter more.</p> <h2><strong>How We Work</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Your day-to-day work will center on a close partnership with the Climate Manager, with collaboration across engineering as needed.</li> <li>You will have substantial autonomy and will be expected to keep stakeholders aligned on priorities, progress, and tradeoffs.</li> <li>We build and launch incrementally, using feedback to guide the next step.</li> <li>In Amsterdam, we come to the office two to three times a week to collaborate, whiteboard, and spend time together.</li> <li>Flexport’s broader technology stack includes React, TypeScript, Ruby on Rails, Kotlin, Kubernetes, GraphQL, gRPC, Postgres, Kafka, and Snowflake. We welcome candidates from different technology backgrounds.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What’s in It for You?</strong></p> <ul> <li>Direct ownership of products that help customers make better supply chain and environmental decisions.</li> <li>The opportunity to shape Climate technology with the autonomy of a small startup and the reach of Flexport.</li> <li>Equity participation and a defined pension contribution scheme.</li> <li>25 vacation days based on full-time employment.</li> <li>Fully paid premiums for Flexport’s collective health insurance plan.</li> <li>Catered lunches, breakfast, snacks, and drinks in the office.</li> <li>Covered home-to-office commuting costs for employees living outside Amsterdam.</li> <li>Employee assistance and parental leave benefits.</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><div id="1704749847.557549" class="c-virtual_list__item" data-qa="virtual-list-item" data-item-key="1704749847.557549"> <div class="c-message_kit__background p-message_pane_message__message c-message_kit__message" data-qa="message_container" data-qa-unprocessed="false" data-qa-placeholder="false"> <div class="c-message_kit__hover" data-qa-hover="true"> <div class="c-message_kit__actions c-message_kit__actions--default"> <div class="c-message_kit__gutter"> <div class="c-message_kit__gutter__right" data-qa="message_content"> <div class="c-message_kit__blocks c-message_kit__blocks--rich_text"> <div class="c-message__message_blocks c-message__message_blocks--rich_text" data-qa="message-text"> <div class="p-block_kit_renderer" data-qa="block-kit-renderer"> <div class="p-block_kit_renderer__block_wrapper p-block_kit_renderer__block_wrapper--first"> <div class="p-rich_text_block"> <h4>Commitment to Equal Opportunity</h4> <p>At Flexport, our ability to fulfill our mission of making global commerce easy and accessible relies on having a diverse, dedicated and engaged workforce. title: Senior Stack Scientist
description: Senior Stack Scientist About EH Energy Engineering EH Energy develops fuel cell technology for heavy-duty mobility and large-scale stationary power. Translate results into clear requirements for flow fields, bipolar plates, MEAs, sealing and compression. Mentor junior scientists and engineers, and present results to internal stakeholders and partners. Skills and Experience Required PhD or MSc in electrochemistry, chemical engineering, mechanical engineering, materials science, physics or a related field. 12+ years of experience in fuel cell stack development or testing (PEM preferred). Strong grasp of stack physics: water and heat management, reactant distribution, contact resistance and compression. Hands-on experience with stack test benches, cell voltage monitoring, EIS and durability/AST protocols. Solid understanding of MEA, GDL and bipolar plate degradation mechanisms. Team player who can also work autonomously in a fast-moving environment. Management experience English is mandatory; French or German is a plus. title: Senior SAP Integration Consultant (m/w/d)
description: Wir sind itesys, DEIN synonym für Engineering Excellence. Berufserfahrung im SAP PI/PO und SAP Integration Suite Umfeld und mehrere erfolgreich realisierte Projekte in diesen Bereichen sehr gute Kenntnis von mindestens drei relevanten SAP Produkten (Logistik, HCM, ERP, S/4 oder vergleichbares) fundierte Kenntnisse im Bereich SAP Software Architektur sowie Erfahrungen mit Integrationstechnologien wie z.B. Webservices/XML/SOAP/REST/OData eine strukturierte und zielführende Arbeitsweise, Eigenverantwortung und Begeisterung für herausfordernde Tätigkeiten Bereitschaft für Vor-Ort Termine bei Kunden sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift Benefits Kostenloser Kaffee und Firmenparkplätze - kennst du vermutlich schon, oder? Wir möchten dir da schon etwas mehr bieten: Flexibles Jahresarbeitszeitmodell : Bye, 9-to-5! Deine Arbeitszeit kannst du dir bei uns frei einteilen. Weiterbildung : Bleibe immer up to date – mit bis zu zwei Wochen bezahlter Weiterbildung kein Problem Zukunftsorientierung : Als globale Tech-Company leben wir am Puls der Zeit und blicken stets in die Zukunft. Tools : Digitale Werkzeuge – die Essentials deiner Karriere. Bei uns kannst du Laptop und Smartphone aber auch privat nutzen. Teamspirit : Teambuildings oder Grillabende – wir finden immer einen Grund zusammenzukommen. Come as you are! : Bei uns geht es um das, was du draufhast – nicht um das, was du anhast. Lieber Casual, Business oder etwas dazwischen - come as you are! Mehr Ferientage : Die gesetzlich vorgeschriebenen Ferientage sind dir nicht genug? Uns auch nicht, denn mit leeren Batterien arbeitet es sich nicht sehr gut! Workation & Entsendungen : Eigentlich am Schreibtisch aber mental schon wieder an deinem Lieblingsurlaubsort? Durch Workations und Entsendungen hat das Träumen ein Ende. Work-Life-Balance : Schon viel davon gehört aber nie erlebt? Bei uns bestimmst du deine Balance. Wellbeing : Es ist völlig okay, wenn nicht immer alles okay ist. Ob Stress, schlechter Schlaf oder schwierige Entscheidungen – unsere externe Online-Plattform bietet dir kostenlose, vertrauliche und anonyme Unterstützung durch erfahrene Expertinnen und Experten. Was macht es besonders, für uns zu arbeiten? Bei uns gleicht kein Tag dem anderen – Langeweile gibt es nicht. Du und deine Kolleg*innen werdet mit Blick auf eure Stärken individuell gefördert. Wir legen Wert auf Weiterbildungen und fördern den teamübergreifenden Wissenstransfer durch unsere Expertenteams. Zudem sind nahbare Führungskräfte und gezieltes Performance Management wichtige Bestandteile unserer Kultur. Teamwork makes the dream work – ist ja klar, oder? Jedes Teammitglied erfüllt eine wichtige Aufgabe, ohne die im Ganzen etwas fehlen würde. Wir sind uns sicher, dass diese Wertschätzung motiviert. Nicht ohne Grund sind wir alle mit Freude und Leidenschaft bei der Sache und erreichen dadurch Spitzenleistungen. Individualität macht uns aus: Teamwork ist uns wichtig, trotzdem verschwindet hier niemand in der Masse. Arbeiten mit Wohlfühl-Faktor Den itesys-Spirit haben wir ja schon erwähnt. Teamausflüge, gemeinsame Grillabende oder Office Brunch – wir finden immer einen Anlass zusammenzukommen. Bei uns muss niemand zum Lachen in den Keller gehen: in den Pausen herrscht eine lockere ausgelassene Atmosphäre bei dem alle willkommen sind. Beim Arbeiten kannst du jederzeit auf die Hilfsbereitschaft deiner Kolleg*innen zählen und musst dich nicht davor scheuen, Fragen zu stellen. Wir freuen uns darauf dich kennenzulernen! Seit 2012 stehen wir als Schweizer Dienstleister für verlässliche SAP-Landschaften und fundierte Betriebserfahrung. In dieser Rolle verantworten Sie den Betrieb, den Unterhalt und die Weiterentwicklung unserer Rechenzentren, Netzwerke und Firewall-Infrastrukturen. Sie analysieren komplexe Netzwerkstrukturen, optimieren die Performance unserer Systeme und sorgen für eine reibungslose und sichere Datenkommunikation im hybriden Arbeitsumfeld an unserem Standort in Frauenfeld. title: Project Manager/in Kassensysteme
description: Möchten Sie eine Schlüsselfunktion in einem aufstrebenden Unternehmen übernehmen? 4POS AG ist ein international tätiges Unternehmen im Bereich der Herstellung und Vermarktung von Kassenhardware& Self Checkout Systemen. Dabei verkörpert 4POS Schweizer Qualität in Design und Entwicklung von Kassensystemen und anderen Lösungen für den Point-Of-Sale (POS). Zur Ergänzung unseres Teams suchen wir Sie. Aufgaben Ihre Aufgaben: Sie sind für die selbstständige Abwicklung von Projekten zuständig und verantwortlich. Vor allem internationale Kundenprojekte, aber auch interne Projekte. Sowohl in technischer wie auch in kommerzieller Hinsicht. Zu den vielseitigen Tätigkeiten gehören die Analyse, Initialisierung, Planung, Umsetzung, Dokumentation und Nachbetreuung von Projekten, die Sicherstellung der Produktqualität sowie Mitarbeit bei Einführung, Optimierung und Weiterentwicklung von Produkten. Als Unterstützung des Verkaufs übernehmen Sie zudem vielfältige Aufgaben, koordinieren mit Herstellern, Partnern und Kunden. Zusätzlich helfen bei der Planung und Durchführung von Veranstaltungen und Messen mit und leisten stellvertretende Unterstützung im Team, insbesondere der anderen Project Manager und des CSO. Qualifikation Ihre Persönlichkeit: Sie verfügen über eine abgeschlossene technische oder kaufmännische Aus-/Weiterbildung sowie mehrjährige Erfahrung im Bereich Projektmanagement oder einer ähnlich gelagerten Tätigkeit im Bereich von Computer-Hardware, im Idealfall von POS-Lösungen für den Einzelhandel oder die Industrie. title: Triage audicien - Drachten, Friesland
description: Bouw mee aan hoogwaardige hoorzorg binnen een zelfstandige optiekwinkel Ben jij audicien en wil je méér dan alleen hoortoestellen aanpassen? Zoek je een plek waar je de tijd krijgt voor je klant, kwaliteit vooropstaat en je tegelijkertijd de ruimte krijgt om mee te bouwen aan een succesvolle audiotak? Dan is dit misschien wel jouw volgende stap. Premium hoorzorg, zoals het bedoeld is Binnen onze zelfstandige optiekwinkels staat persoonlijke aandacht centraal. Onze klanten kennen ons vanwege onze deskundigheid, kwaliteit en service. Diezelfde benadering willen we verder uitbouwen binnen horen. Daarom zoeken we een audicien die samen met ons wil bouwen aan een sterke audiotak. Afhankelijk van de situatie gaat het om het verder ontwikkelen van een bestaande klantenkring of het opbouwen van een nieuwe activiteit binnen een winkel waar al een vertrouwde klantenbasis aanwezig is. Je krijgt daarbij de ruimte om je vak uit te oefenen zoals jij vindt dat goede hoorzorg hoort te zijn: met tijd voor de klant, persoonlijke aandacht en premium hooroplossingen. Wat maakt deze functie anders? Je werkt in een professionele, persoonlijke omgeving waar niet de snelle verkoop, maar de beste oplossing voor de klant centraal staat. Je kunt rekenen op: · Premium hooroplossingen · Ruim voldoende tijd en aandacht voor iedere klant · Een bestaand klantenbestand vanuit de optiek · Warme leads via onze partner Audibene · Professionele ondersteuning en coaching vanuit de organisatie · Ruimte voor jouw ideeën en vakmanschap · De kans om daadwerkelijk mee te bouwen aan de audiotak · Dagen en uren in overleg, met aandacht voor een gezonde balans tussen werk en privé Voor wie is dit een mooie stap? Misschien werk je nu bij een grotere keten en zoek je meer persoonlijke aandacht, vrijheid en betrokkenheid. Of je bent toe aan een omgeving waarin je niet alleen audicien bent, maar ook kunt meedenken over hoe we de beste hoorzorg voor onze klanten organiseren. Ruime ervaring is voor ons niet het belangrijkste. Veel belangrijker is dat je passie hebt voor horen én voor mensen. Je bent iemand die kwaliteit belangrijk vindt, graag persoonlijk contact heeft met klanten en energie krijgt van samen iets moois opbouwen. Je wilt onderdeel zijn van een professioneel en kundig team, maar vindt het tegelijkertijd leuk om verantwoordelijkheid te nemen voor je eigen vakgebied. Wat bieden wij jou? Een zelfstandige functie met veel ruimte voor vakmanschap en persoonlijke aandacht, maar mét een professioneel team en organisatie achter je. Geen omgeving waarin iedere minuut wordt gestuurd door targets en agenda’s, maar een plek waar we geloven dat tevreden klanten en goede hoorzorg de basis zijn voor duurzaam succes. En minstens zo belangrijk: werk moet passen bij je leven. Daarom bespreken we graag samen welke dagen en uren het beste aansluiten. Of je nu een aantal dagen per week wilt werken of juist een volgende stap zoekt met meer verantwoordelijkheid: we kijken vooral naar wat bij elkaar past. Zin om samen iets moois op te bouwen? Ben jij audicien en spreekt de combinatie van kwaliteit, persoonlijke aandacht, vrijheid en bouwen je aan? Dan maken we graag kennis met je. Ook als je nog niet jarenlang ervaring hebt, maar wel gepassioneerd bent over het vak, nodigen we je van harte uit om te reageren. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow
