title: Founding ML Engineer (Spectrum)
description: <p>Software engineers and AI agents alike suffer from the same problem: finding that one person or place that will answer their tough, specific question. Many solutions promise to solve this with similarity search in vector databases. Unfortunately, finding the answer is often a puzzle with pieces to be collected across a myriad of contradictory sources and cannot be solved without surgical search and careful reasoning. </p> <p>Spectrum collects data from an organization’s code, docs, and issues, and organizes knowledge in a unified ontology that AI agents can efficiently search through and reason over. We aim to revolutionize the semantic layer space for software-building organizations and move beyond specs that fall out of sync with code, introducing a living spec – one that’s extracted from the whole system and used to keep it aligned. Spectrum is meant to be the single source of truth for all product and architectural knowledge.</p> <p>Spectrum is a resident of JetBrains' startup incubator, with startup speed and autonomy, and backed by 25 years of developer tooling expertise. We are looking for a top-class ML Engineer who will help us shape the future of software development. You will own our AI and ML engineering stack and help define the research agenda for our team. Your technical vision and design decisions will directly shape the product and determine its success.</p> <h1>Your responsibilities will include:</h1> <ul> <li>Designing and building the ML/LLM solution for data ingestion, knowledge extraction, retrieval, and subsequent reasoning.</li> <li>Creating the datasets, metrics, and pipelines that drive measurable improvements across the system.</li> <li>Architecting and improving agents for context retrieval, knowledge extraction, and data alignment, which includes prompt engineering, model selection, and inference optimization.</li> <li>Establishing MLOps practices, including orchestration, observability, and experiment tracking.</li> <li>Collaborating with the engineering team on system design and with JetBrains Research on the research agenda.</li> <li>Defining hiring criteria, growing the ML team, and shaping the ML team culture.</li> </ul> <h1>We expect you to have:</h1> <ul> <li>A proven track record as an ML/AI Lead.</li> <li>At least five years of experience in ML/AI systems, with at least two years focused on LLMs and generative AI.</li> <li>A deep understanding of the LLM ecosystem, including model architectures and fine-tuning approaches.</li> <li>Hands-on experience with:</li> <ul> <li>Prompt engineering and LLM pipeline design, including evaluation.</li> <li>Agentic frameworks such as LangChain, LlamaIndex, LangSmith, smolagents, or an equivalent.</li> <li>Vector databases and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) patterns.</li> <li>Deploying and scaling LLM-powered applications using APIs (e.g. OpenAI or Anthropic) or open-source models.</li> </ul> <li>Strong Python skills – Kotlin knowledge would be a plus.</li> <li>Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to diverse audiences.</li> <li>Proficiency in English, both written and verbal. </li> </ul> <h1>Our ideal candidate would have:</h1> <ul> <li>Experience with ontologies, knowledge graphs, or graph-based reasoning.</li> <li>Experience in early-stage startups – you enjoy the zero-to-one phase.</li> <li>The ability to think strategically about product-led AI, beyond just training models in isolation.</li> <li>A background in code analysis, developer tools, or software engineering research.</li> <li>Experience with multi-agent systems or complex agentic workflows.</li> <li>Actively contributed to relevant open-source projects or publications.</li> </ul> <h1>What we offer</h1> <ul> <li>A competitive salary and JetBrains benefits.</li> <li>A generous runway and corporate resources with startup autonomy.</li> </ul> <p><span style="color: rgb(255, 255, 255);">#LI-KP1</span></p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>We are an equal opportunity employer</strong><br><br>We know great ideas can come from anyone, anywhere. By eliminating the massive latency overhead of TCP, TLS, and database-specific handshakes, Hyperdrive allows developers to use the databases they already know and love—like PostgreSQL and MySQL—without the "cold start" performance penalties typically associated with serverless environments.</p> <h3>Responsibilities</h3> <p>Hyperdrive is integrated directly into the Cloudflare global network and features:</p> <ul> <li>Global Connection Pooling: Maintains "warm" connections to origin databases across the globe, reducing connection times by up to 90%.</li> <li>Intelligent Query Caching: Automatically caches frequently run read queries as close to the user as possible.</li> <li>Protocol-Aware Proxying: Features custom-built implementations of database wire protocols (PostgreSQL and MySQL) to parse and optimize traffic in real-time.</li> <li>Seamless Integration: Works with existing ORMs and drivers, providing a simple connection string that "just works" for developers.</li> <li>The team is geographically distributed across North America.</li> <li>You will own your code from inception to release, delivering solutions at all layers of the software stack to empower Cloudflare customers. On any given day, you might write a design document that outlines how you plan to solve a specific problem, or fix a bug in how our user experience renders. You can expect to interact with a variety of languages and technologies including, but not limited to Rust, Go, C++, Typescript.</li> </ul> <h3>Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience</h3> <ul> <li>You have 5+ years of professional experience with Rust, Go, or C++. You know your way around TCP/IP, TLS, and WebSockets.</li> <li>You don’t just use databases; you understand how they work. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: We released</span><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">1.1.1.1</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. title: Senior Account Manager | Toxic
description: Op duizenden werkvloeren in Nederland wordt dagelijks gewerkt met gevaarlijke stoffen. Dat kan veilig, als je weet wat je in huis hebt, wat het doet en welke regels erbij horen. Daar helpt Sdu Toxic organisaties bij. Toxic is de meest complete SaaS-oplossing voor wet- en regelgeving rond gevaarlijke stoffen in Nederland. Organisaties registreren er hun stoffen mee, beoordelen blootstelling, leggen maatregelen vast en informeren hun medewerkers. Zo helpen we QHSE-professionals om mensen veilig te laten werken en aan de arbowetgeving te voldoen. Achter Toxic staat een team met diepgaande kennis van chemische producten en de regels die erbij horen. En een succesvol marketing- en salesteam dat zorgt dat steeds meer organisaties ons vinden. Toxic is onderdeel van Lefebvre Sdu, dat al 200 jaar bouwt aan juridische en fiscale kennis, en van Lefebvre Group, de Europese leider op dat gebied. De vraag groeit. Onze Commercieel Medewerkers Binnendienst en marketing plannen meer afspraken in dan we nu kunnen afronden. Daarom zoeken we een Senior Accountmanager die van die gesprekken klanten maakt. HOE JIJ ONS VERDER BRENGT Jij bent het gezicht van Toxic. Voor de veiligheidskundigen, managers en directies die met ons werken, word jij degene die ze kennen en vertrouwen. Je leert hun organisatie kennen, luistert naar wat er speelt en denkt mee over wat ze nodig hebben. Zo bouw je relaties die jaren meegaan, en groeit Toxic met je klanten mee. Je leert je klanten kennen: hun mensen, hun processen en wat er bij hen speelt. Zo word je hun vaste gesprekspartner en denk je mee over de volgende stap. Elke nieuwe relatie begint met een goed gesprek. De binnendienst en marketing plannen de afspraken, jij bereidt je voor en ontdekt wat een organisatie nodig heeft. Daarnaast zoek je zelf nieuwe kansen. In je demo's laat je zien hoe Toxic werkt en wat het oplevert. Gaat de vraag verder dan het standaardplatform? Dan werk je met collega's een oplossing op maat uit, met API-koppelingen en AI-toepassingen. Je bouwt relaties met veiligheidskundigen, inkopers en directie, brengt hun belangen samen in 1 voorstel en sluit deals met een hogere dealwaarde. Met strategische accountplannen houd je overzicht op je belangrijkste klanten. Je ziet kansen voor up- en cross-sell en herkent retentierisico's vroeg. Samen met Customer Success zorg je dat nieuwe klanten goed starten. Je houdt je pipeline en forecast actueel in Salesforce en deelt wat je bij klanten hoort met marketing en product. Als senior ben je mentor en sparringpartner voor collega-accountmanagers. DIT ZOEKEN WIJ Je bent iemand bij wie klanten zich gehoord voelen. Je luistert goed, stelt de juiste vragen en vertaalt een complex vraagstuk naar een helder voorstel. De markt van gevaarlijke stoffen hoef je nog niet te kennen. Wat je wel meebrengt, is ervaring met het opbouwen van klantrelaties en interesse in software. Je hebt meerdere jaren ervaring als accountmanager, bij voorkeur in SaaS of met digitale oplossingen. Je hebt interesse in software en wilt begrijpen hoe een platform als Toxic werkt, inclusief API-koppelingen en AI-toepassingen. Je bouwt relaties met meerdere stakeholders tegelijk en beheerst het volledige salesproces, van eerste kennismaking tot getekend contract. Je stuurt op data en haalt je targets, met nieuwe klanten en binnen je eigen portefeuille. Je spreekt en schrijft vloeiend Nederlands. Je hoeft de markt nog niet te kennen. Klanten, stoffen en regelgeving leer je bij ons, van collega's die het vak door en door kennen. HIER TEKEN JE VOOR Je tekent voor een rol die past bij je ambitie. Je werkt aan grotere deals, bouwt je eigen netwerk op en ontwikkelt je in een groeiend SaaS-team. Dat doe je binnen Lefebvre Sdu, een legaltechbedrijf met 200 jaar kennis en de energie van een scale-up. Dit krijg je ervoor terug: Een inwerkperiode waarin je Toxic, de markt en onze klanten leert kennen. Een plek waar je vanaf dag 1 invloed hebt op de aanpak, de processen en de richting. Collega's met diepgaande kennis van stoffen en regelgeving, van wie je elke dag leert. Doorgroeimogelijkheden naar Teamlead, Key Accountmanager of Propositiemanager. Een salaris vanaf €4.477 per maand, op basis van een werkweek van 36 uur. Een variabele bonusregeling die kan oplopen tot 30% van je jaarsalaris. 23 vakantiedagen en een persoonlijk keuzebudget van 12%, waarvan 8% vakantiegeld en 4% vrij besteedbaar aan extra vakantiedagen of salaris. Een goede pensioenregeling via PGB, inclusief aanvullende partnerverzekering. Een leaseauto of een reiskostenvergoeding van €0,25 per kilometer, en een aantrekkelijke fietsregeling. Voor een reisafstand onder de 10 km of boven de 60 km geldt een aangepaste regeling. Thuiswerkvergoeding en hybride werken: reken op 2 dagen per week op kantoor in Den Haag. MEER WETEN? Benieuwd hoe Toxic werkt? Kijk alvast op toxic.nl/en. We vertellen je graag meer over het team en de rol. Stuur je cv en je hoort binnen 2 werkdagen van ons. Eerst nog vragen? App of bel Mak via +31 6 18 60 98 89. Find Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

title: Data & AI Engineer
description: Waarom jij hier JA op zegt! ✔ Werken aan data-oplossingen én AI-initiatieven met directe impact op de business ✔ Veel vrijheid, autonomie en ruimte voor eigen ideeën ✔ Salaris van maximaal €5.000 bruto per maand o.b.v. 40 uur en afhankelijk van ervaring ✔ Werken in een klein, wendbaar team zonder corporate bureaucratie ✔ 28 vakantiedagen bij een fulltime dienstverband + mogelijkheid om 5 dagen bij te kopen In deze rol ben je in de eerste plaats verantwoordelijk voor het bouwen en verbeteren van data-oplossingen. Je zorgt ervoor dat data beschikbaar, betrouwbaar en bruikbaar is voor de organisatie door data pipelines, dashboards en integraties te ontwikkelen. Tegelijkertijd krijg je de kans om mee te bouwen aan de verdere ontwikkeling van AI binnen Rail Innovators Group. AI vormt daarbij een waardevolle aanvulling op de rol, maar de basis ligt in data engineering en business intelligence. Je werkt aan uiteenlopende vraagstukken, van stuurinformatie voor de business tot innovatieve AI-toepassingen die processen slimmer en efficiënter maken. Rail Innovators Group Rail Innovators Group, opgericht in 2005 en gevestigd in Rotterdam, is een internationale specialist in goederenvervoer per spoor. Met meer dan 250 railprofessionals zijn wij actief in 23 landen en vervoeren wij jaarlijks meer dan 6 miljoen ton aan vracht. Onze moderne vloot bestaat uit hoogwaardige locomotieven, een breed scala aan wagons en intermodale units. Daarmee bieden wij flexibele, betrouwbare en duurzame transportoplossingen in heel Europa en daarbuiten. Via onze vier bedrijven Raillogix, Rail Force One, Railrelease en CWS verzorgen wij de volledige railketen: van planning en tractie tot leasing en onderhoud. Wat ga je doen? Je werkt aan uiteenlopende data- en AI-vraagstukken die bijdragen aan betere besluitvorming, efficiëntere processen en verdere digitalisering van de organisatie. Je werkt vanuit een backlog en roadmap, waarbij je samen met de business bepaalt welke oplossingen de meeste waarde toevoegen. Daarbij schakel je met verschillende stakeholders, van finance en operations tot directie. Concreet betekent dit dat je: Data pipelines bouwt en onderhoudt Verschillende databronnen integreert en ontsluit Dashboards en rapportages ontwikkelt waarmee de business kan sturen De data-architectuur verder professionaliseert en verbetert Businessvragen vertaalt naar concrete data-oplossingen Prioriteiten stelt op basis van impact en business value Werkt binnen een Agile omgeving met tweewekelijkse sprints Actief meebouwt aan de verdere AI-volwassenheid van de organisatie Wie ben jij? Iemand die analytisch sterk is, zelfstandig werkt en energie krijgt van complexe vraagstukken. Je vindt het leuk om techniek en business met elkaar te verbinden en durft kritisch mee te denken wanneer een antwoord niet de juiste oplossing lijkt. Dit past bij iemand die: Beschikt over HBO werk- en denkniveau Een opleiding heeft afgerond richting IT, Informatica, Bedrijfskundige Informatica, Econometrie of vergelijkbaar Communicatief sterk is en gemakkelijk schakelt met verschillende stakeholders Analytisch en probleemoplossend ingesteld is Zelfstandig werkt, verantwoordelijkheid neemt en prioriteiten weet te stellen Affiniteit met IT heeft De Nederlandse taal goed beheerst, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk Daarnaast is het mooi meegenomen als je ervaring hebt met: Data Engineering, SQL en ETL Business Intelligence AI-oplossingen en tooling zoals ChatGPT of Claude Agile of Scrum werkwijzen Heb je nog niet overal ervaring mee, maar beschik je over een sterk analytisch vermogen en een hoge leercurve? Dan nodigen we je ook van harte uit om te reageren Wat bieden wij? Het salaris voor deze functie bedraagt maximaal €5.000 bruto per maand, afhankelijk van jouw kennis, niveau en werkervaring Je krijgt 28 vakantiedagen op fulltime basis, met daarnaast de mogelijkheid om 5 extra dagen bij te kopen Daarnaast ontvang je een winstafhankelijke bonusregeling en profiteer je van een uitstekende pensioenregeling We bieden flexibele werktijden en de mogelijkheid om hybride te werken. Je werkt gemiddeld twee dagen per week op kantoor en de overige dagen flexibel vanuit huis Reiskostenvergoeding van €0,23 per kilometer Je beschikt over een laptop en mobiele telefoon om je werk optimaal uit te voeren Korting op fitness, zodat je ook buiten werktijd fit en vitaal blijft Werken vanuit een modern kantoor in de Rotterdamse Waalhaven, met goede faciliteiten en uitstekende koffie Herken jij jezelf in deze rol op het spoor? title: Meewerk Stage Continuous Improvement (Power BI & Power Automate)

Als stagiair werk je aan het verbeteren van processen binnen domeinen zoals sales, projecten in nieuwbouw en finance. Opgericht in 1952, vervult en overtreft Heras de beveiligingsbehoeften van klanten in heel Europa. Het is dankzij deze staat van dienst, samen met het blijvend groeiende vakmanschap van onze medewerkers, dat wij ons experts in perimeter protection kunnen noemen. Onze cultuur, werksfeer & waarden Wij hebben binnen Heras een informele, open en toegankelijke cultuur. We zijn trots op ons werk, producten en dienstverlening. We hebben een no-nonsense mentaliteit, tonen ondernemerschap, zijn energiek en werken allemaal gedisciplineerd volgens de drie kernwaarden; betrokkenheid, betrouwbaarheid en deskundigheid. Heras is gewaardeerd op een Ecovadis Zilveren Ster en dat plaatst ons bij de duurzaamste 15% bedrijven van Nederland. Onze doelstelling is streven naar Goud in de komende jaren en volledig CO2 neutraal zijn in 2050. Bij Heras bieden wij jou een meewerkstage binnen een zeer dynamische omgeving waarbij elke dag anders is met veel variatie en afwisseling. Je werkt in een moderne werkplaats aan personenauto’s van verschillende bekende automerken. Samen met betrokken collega’s zorg je ervoor dat klanten veilig en tevreden de weg op gaan. Als Automonteur krijg je afwisselende werkzaamheden die aansluiten bij jouw opleiding en ervaring. Wat je gaat doen · Uitvoeren van onderhoud, reparaties en technische aanpassingen aan personenauto’s; · Opsporen en verhelpen van storingen met moderne test- en diagnoseapparatuur; · Uitvoeren van werkzaamheden aan onder meer motoren en automatische versnellingsbakken; · Afleverklaar maken van nieuwe en gebruikte auto’s; · Overleggen met de diagnosetechnicus bij complexe technische problemen; · Oppakken van complexere reparaties en ondersteunen van collega’s wanneer je als eerste autotechnicus aan de slag gaat; · Uitvoeren van APK-keuringen als je hiervoor bevoegd bent. Wat wij vragen · Een afgeronde opleiding op minimaal MBO-2 niveau in de autotechniek; · Een diploma op MBO-3 niveau wanneer je als eerste autotechnicus aan de slag wilt; · Goede beheersing van de Nederlandse of Engelse taal; · Een geldig rijbewijs B; · Een nauwkeurige en zelfstandige werkhouding; · Technisch inzicht, initiatief en plezier in het oplossen van problemen; · Het vermogen om goed samen te werken met collega’s. Wat wij bieden · Een salaris van € 2.600 tot € 3.800 bruto per maand op basis van 40 uur, afhankelijk van jouw opleiding, ervaring en eventuele APK-bevoegdheid; · Een fulltimebaan voor 40 uur per week, waarbij 32 of 36 uur bespreekbaar is; · 24 vakantiedagen bij een fulltime dienstverband en de mogelijkheid om jaarlijks 64 extra verlofuren bij te kopen; · Trainingen en opleidingen via merkimporteurs en vakscholen; · De mogelijkheid om je APK-bevoegdheid te behalen; · Doorgroeimogelijkheden richting eerste autotechnicus of technisch specialist; · Een moderne werkplaats met goede gereedschappen en apparatuur; · Een zorgvuldig inwerktraject en begeleiding door ervaren collega’s; · Een goede pensioenregeling en diverse personeelsvoordelen, waaronder korting op je sportabonnement en op de aanschaf, het onderhoud en de verzekering van een auto. title: Territory Sales Director, West (Los Angeles/Phoenix)
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><h2>Available Locations</h2> <ul> <li>Los Angeles, CA or Phoenix, AZ</li> </ul> <h2>About the Role</h2> <p>We are looking for a Director of Sales to manage a team of Territory Account Executives in the SW . This leadership role within the Enterprise team focuses on both the acquisition of new accounts and the expansion of existing customer accounts. The ideal candidate will possess a strong sales management background and a technical foundation, enabling them to drive engagement with both technical professionals and executive buyers. As a Sales Director, you will have the opportunity to position and differentiate the Enterprise platform experience for Cloudflare while reinforcing strong pipeline and automated forecast management practices across Security, Network, Development, and Infrastructure teams.</p> <h2>Responsibilities</h2> <ul> <li>Accurately forecast commits by month and quarter, leveraging automated internal data layers and predictive metrics to consistently deliver attainment to quarterly and annual sales targets.</li> <li>Oversee, coach, and motivate a team of 8 Account Executives, measuring success against overall quota attainment, new logo acquisition, and expansion tactics.</li> <li>Develop and uplevel team selling abilities through consistent focus on enablement, solution selling, and interpreting automated, data-led customer insights.</li> <li>Assist in the continued codification and execution of product-focused playbooks to connect platform data to Cloudflare solutions that solve critical business challenges.</li> <li>Collaborate with Sales Enablement, Product, and Product Marketing to optimize sales training and accelerate execution around newly launched features and products.</li> <li>Maintain a robust funnel of new hire candidates by continuously interviewing and building a strong network of potential talent.</li> <li>Hold regular 1x1s with team members, maintaining open and transparent communication while monitoring the proficiency and adoption of sales enablement tooling and resources.</li> </ul> <h2>Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience</h2> <ul> <li>5+ years of Sales Management experience leading high-performing sales teams at a high-growth SaaS company.</li> <li>Proven record of high performance in consistently meeting and exceeding team plan through strategic acquisition and expansion tactics.</li> <li>Experience developing relationships with highly technical customers and selling through modern, data-driven Product-Led Growth (PLG) models.</li> <li>Coaching-level knowledge of Gap Selling, Sandler, Challenger, or other structured sales methodologies.</li> <li>Strong talent for multi-threading across business units to identify, engage, and close new divisional buyers, as well as driving consensus among internal and external stakeholders.</li> <li>Excellent written communication, presentation, and pipeline management skills.</li> </ul> <h2>Bonus Points</h2> <ul> <li>Experience leading sales teams specifically within Cloud Security or Hyperscaler ecosystems.</li> <li>Experience navigating complex accounts undergoing Mergers & Acquisitions (M&A) to expand the partner ecosystem.</li> </ul> <h2>Compensation</h2> <ul> <li>Compensation will be adjusted based on location and level.</li> <li>For California based hires: Estimated On Target Earnings of $361,000 - 496,000</li> </ul> <p><strong>This role is eligible to earn incentive compensation under Cloudflare’s Sales Compensation Plan. The estimated annual salary range includes the on-target incentive compensation that may be attained in this role under the Sales Compensation Plan.</strong></p> <h3>Equity</h3> <p>This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare’s equity plan.</p> <h3>Benefits</h3> <p>Cloudflare offers a complete package of benefits and programs to support you and your family.  Our benefits programs can help you pay health care expenses, support caregiving, build capital for the future and make life a little easier and fun!  The below is a description of our benefits for employees in the United States, and benefits may vary for employees based outside the U.S.</p> <h3>Health & Welfare Benefits</h3> <ul> <li>Medical/Rx Insurance</li> <li>Dental Insurance</li> <li>Vision Insurance</li> <li>Flexible Spending Accounts</li> <li>Commuter Spending Accounts</li> <li>Fertility & Family Forming Benefits</li> <li>On-demand mental health support and Employee Assistance Program</li> <li>Global Travel Medical Insurance</li> </ul> <h3>Financial Benefits</h3> <ul> <li>Short and Long Term Disability Insurance</li> <li>Life & Accident Insurance</li> <li>401(k) Retirement Savings Plan</li> <li>Employee Stock Participation Plan</li> </ul> <h3>Time Off</h3> <ul> <li>Flexible paid time off covering vacation and sick leave</li> <li>Leave programs, including parental, pregnancy health, medical, and bereavement leave</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: We released</span><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">1.1.1.1</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our</span><a href="https://developers.cloudflare.com/1.1.1.1/privacy/public-dns-resolver"> privacy commitment</a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs.  More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.  We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all people and place great value in both diversity and inclusiveness.  All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to their, or any other person's, perceived or actual</span> <span style="font-weight: 400;">race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, family care status, or any other basis protected by law. </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">We are an AA/Veterans/Disabled Employer.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities.  Please tell us if you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job. Examples of reasonable accommodations include, but are not limited to, changing the application process, providing documents in an alternate format, using a sign language interpreter, or using specialized equipment.  If you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job, please contact us via e-mail at </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">hr@cloudflare.com</span><span style="font-weight: 400;"> or via mail at 101 Townsend St. San Francisco, CA 94107.</span></p></div>

title: Accountant
description: <h3> </h3> <p>Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.</p> <p>The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.</p> <h3> </h3> <h3><strong>The role of an Accountant at Canonical:</strong></h3> <p>If you are passionate about the technology industry and want to work for a company that aligns with your interests, we might be the place for you! Canonical, and our world class Ubuntu product, attracts some of the leading talent from around the world. Come and work with exceptional people and advance your career in Finance! </p> <p>Our Finance team is growing and it's a really exciting time to join the team. We are looking for bright, motivated people who have a passion for making a difference. You will be seeking an opportunity to drive process improvements and change, input your ideas and truly contribute to a highly productive team. </p> <p>We are looking for an exceptional Accountant with IFRS experience to help us ready the business for public market scrutiny through our planned IPO.  The right candidate will have domain expertise and a passion for IFRS.  </p> <p><strong>Location: </strong>This role may be office based in London, or Remote in EMEA Time Zones. </p> <h3>What your day will look like</h3> <ul> <li>Assist in the month end reporting process to deliver timely and accurate information</li> <li>Have full responsibility for a part of the ledger processes relevant to your strengths</li> <li>Assist with the year end audit process and statutory reporting</li> <li>Support the finance team's wider plans to prepare for an IPO</li> <li>Improve the efficiency of financial processes and procedures and monitor compliance</li> <li>Share knowledge between team members to ensure cover is available when needed</li> <li>Actively develop your own skills to ensure current knowledge of applicable standards and regulations</li> <li>Establish strong relationships with key colleagues outside the wider finance team</li> </ul> <h3>What we are looking for in you</h3> <ul> <li>Exceptional academic track record and subsequent career performance</li> <li>Bachelor's degree in Accounting or equivalent</li> <li>Qualified accountant (ACCA, ACA, ACMA, CPA, etc.)</li> <li>Experience at a large public accounting firm, or public multinational corporate accounting department preferred</li> <li>NetSuite or similar enterprise grade systems experience</li> <li>Willingness to travel up to four times per year</li> </ul> <h3> </h3> <h3><strong>What we offer colleagues</strong></h3> <p>We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.</p> <ul> <li>Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person</li> <li>Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year</li> <li>Annual compensation review</li> <li>Recognition rewards</li> <li>Annual holiday leave</li> <li>Maternity and paternity leave</li> <li>Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform</li> <li>Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues</li> <li>Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long-haul company events</li> </ul> <h3> </h3> <h3><strong>About Canonical</strong></h3> <p>Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004.​ Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.</p> <p><strong>Canonical is an equal opportunity employer</strong></p> <p>We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products.<a href="https://canonical.com/careers/diversity/identity"> Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.</a></p> <p>#LI-remote</p> <h3> </h3>

title: Business Development Manager / Accountmanager Buitendienst – Logistics & Packaging
description: About AtMet Group Since 1995, AtMet Group has manufactured cargo securing solutions that keep goods safe at sea, on the road and on rail. Our core products are dunnage airbags, inflatable bags that fill voids between cargo to prevent movement, and lashing systems, straps and securing equipment for containers and other transport units. We manufacture in China and the USA, operate a French office (opened in 2021), and hold local stock in France and Rotterdam. The Netherlands and Belgium are our next step, and you will lead it. The Role You will be our first commercial presence in the Benelux, with real ownership of the market. You will: Win new B2B customers in the Netherlands and Belgium, starting with the Rotterdam port area Recruit and develop distributors of cargo securing products Prospect logistics companies, freight forwarders, exporters, manufacturers and packaging distributors Visit customers, present our range and run product demonstrations Spot high-volume opportunities and new market segments Keep your CRM pipeline up to date and report regularly on activity and results Represent AtMet at relevant trade shows and industry events Your Profile Essential 3+ years of B2B sales experience with a track record of winning new customers (logistics, transport, packaging or a related sector is a plus) Fluent Dutch and English, written and spoken Autonomous, self-organized and comfortable with field prospecting Strong communication and negotiation skills Experience with a CRM and Microsoft Office Category B driving licence Nice to have Existing network in the Rotterdam port, freight forwarding or industrial packaging community Knowledge of cargo securing or intermodal transport What We Offer Autonomy: you manage your own schedule and customer visits, against clearly agreed targets A market to build: the Benelux is open territory, with local stock already in Rotterdam to support fast delivery to your customers Fixed salary + commission: €4,500–€5,500 gross/month, plus commission on the new business you win Room to grow: more responsibility as the business expands Local employment: employed under Dutch employment law through an Employer of Record Everything you need: laptop, phone Travel covered: mileage allowance for your own vehicle, short-term car rental when needed Home-based: with regular customer visits Find Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

title: Customer Experience Manager - German Speaking
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><h3><strong>About the Department</strong></h3> <p>Renewals Account Managers, Customer Success Managers, Account Executives, Business Development Representatives, Solution Engineers, and Sales Operations - all working together help our customers adopt Cloudflare and create great Internet-enabled experiences.</p> <p>The sales team at Cloudflare helps customers solve real, technical problems while creating the revenue streams that help the company provide free service to millions in our community.</p> <h3><strong>Location: Lisbon, Portugal</strong></h3> <h3><strong>What You’ll Do</strong></h3> <p>The Customer Experience Manager leads the post-sale customer journey, managing everything from onboarding to long-term retention and contract renewals. You will collaborate tightly with the Sales team to maintain accurate weekly forecasts and contribute to  critical engagements like Executive Business Reviews. In addition, you will embed AI-driven optimization into your daily workflows—using advanced data analysis to uncover selling opportunities and automating routine tasks to accelerate customer outcomes and maximize operational efficiency.</p> <h3><strong>Key Responsibilities</strong></h3> <h3>Customer Lifecycle & Success</h3> <ul> <li> <p>Manage customer engagement across the entire customer lifecycle, from onboarding through renewal.</p> </li> <li> <p>Be a Trusted Advisor to your customers by helping them adopt the Cloudflare products and services to meet their needs and make them successful</p> </li> <li> <p>Work with your account teams to plan and execute long term Success Plans with our largest customers to facilitate retention and growth via product and new business unit expansion.</p> </li> <li> <p>Maintain a deep understanding of our solutions and present to customers about the most relevant features/functionality for their specific business needs.</p> </li> <li> <p>Own or be an active participant in several customer touch points including: Business Value Justification meetings, Business Reviews, and Renewal Meetings, with a track record of successful planning and execution of Executive Business Reviews.</p> </li> <li> <p>Demonstrate how your customer engagement directly impacts revenue growth and adoption of Cloudflare solutions and services.</p> </li> </ul> <h3>Commercial & Renewals</h3> <ul> <li> <p><strong>You are ultimately responsible for the retention and growth of your book of business. </strong>You will own and drive the renewal including maintaining and reporting an accurate weekly forecast.</p> </li> <li> <p>Negotiate and execute renewal contracts in accordance with customer objectives.</p> </li> <li> <p>You will be an expert in deal construction and pricing strategy. You will directly be designing renewals to create a win-win for customers and Cloudflare. </p> </li> <li> <p>Analyze data and leverage tools to identify selling opportunities and business value.</p> </li> <li> <p>Drive strong alignment with the Sales team, contributing to team forecasting, planning, and targets.</p> </li> </ul> <h3>Cross-Functional & Operational Management</h3> <ul> <li> <p>Develop and maintain long-term relationships with stakeholders in your account portfolio.</p> </li> <li> <p>Work cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, Support,Marketing and other teams to resolve customer business issues and work towards each customer’s stated goals.</p> </li> <li> <p>Manage customer feedback and product needs by providing feature requests to internal partner teams.</p> </li> <li> <p>Able to prioritize effectively to handle multiple deals at the same time.</p> </li> </ul> <h3>AI Competencies</h3> <ul> <li> <p>Generative AI: Mastery of LLMs to rapidly draft renewal communications, synthesize quarterly review data, and prepare executive summaries.</p> </li> <li> <p>Data Analysis: Proficiency in leveraging AI analytics tools to parse customer usage metrics and instantly highlight up-sell or cross-sell opportunities.</p> </li> <li> <p>Workflow Automation: Ability to build automations to synchronize CRM data, update weekly forecasts, and trigger lifecycle alerts.</p> </li> <li> <p>AI Problem Solving: The instinct to view AI as a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward.</p> </li> </ul> <h3><strong>Qualifications</strong></h3> <ul> <li> <p>Minimum of 3 years of experience in a Customer Success/Account Management role or Inside or Field sales.</p> </li> <li> <p>Fluency in German</p> </li> <li> <p>2+ years of industry experience, with experience in cloud security and/or performance industries preferred.</p> </li> <li> <p>Bachelor's degree and/or other professional qualifications.</p> </li> <li> <p>Direct experience in commercial sales, negotiation, and deal closure.</p> </li> <li> <p>Strong understanding of or willingness to learn about computer networking and “how the internet works,” with network security a plus.</p> </li> <li> <p>Manage and prioritize competing portfolio demands, aligning internal resources with the highest-impact commercial and retention goals</p> </li> <li> <p>Expertise in SaaS retention and sales process and excellent knowledge of value driven sales.</p> </li> <li> <p>Excellent problem solving skills with the ability to creatively achieve resolutions.</p> </li> </ul> <h3 data-path-to-node="0"><strong data-path-to-node="0" data-index-in-node="0">Compensation</strong></h3> <p data-path-to-node="2">● For Portugal based title: Senior Product Manager - Data Integrations
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.</p> <p>The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OuZIb5zszQI">Co-create the future with us</a> as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.</p> <p>*<em>Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><h2>An overview of this role</h2> <p>As a Senior Product Manager for Data Integrations, you'll help GitLab's analytics and artificial intelligence (AI) agents see beyond the data held in GitLab. You'll decide which external systems connect to the Data Insights Platform and Orbit, which integrations come first, and how their data fits into shared models.</p> <p>Engineering teams plan work, track incidents, monitor production, and manage security findings across different tools. Your challenge is to bring that context together with GitLab's code, merge requests, pipelines, deployments, and vulnerabilities. You'll shape a consistent approach that gives customers a trustworthy picture they can query, report on, and use with agents, rather than another set of disconnected data sources.</p> <p>This role is based in Bangalore, India. You'll work from home and come to the Bangalore office when needed for business or team activities. You should be based in Bangalore or willing to relocate there.</p> <h2>What you'll do</h2> <ul> <li value="1">Set integration priorities using evidence from customers, field teams, and other product managers to identify the biggest gaps in context.</li> <li value="2">Shape how external data maps into GitLab's shared data models, including the extract, transform, and load (ETL) approach and the transformations needed to make sources work together.</li> <li value="3">Define the customer problems and user groups each integration serves. Partner with engineering to agree on the intended experience, trade-offs, and delivery sequence.</li> <li value="4">Translate product decisions into a clear backlog of epics and issues for engineering.</li> <li value="5">Define telemetry and adoption signals to understand whether connected data helps customers answer new questions, and use those findings to guide priorities.</li> <li value="6">Help shape integration pricing and packaging as the product area matures.</li> <li value="7">Use AI coding agents and GitLab to explore data, prototype integrations, and document the intended experience.</li> </ul> <h2>What you'll bring</h2> <ul> <li value="1">Product management experience, with the ability to connect customer needs to priorities and make trade-offs with incomplete information.</li> <li value="2">Strong knowledge of the software development and operations (DevOps) ecosystem, including how planning, security, observability, and IT service management tools fit into engineering workflows.</li> <li value="3">A working understanding of data integration, ETL, and data transformation, including how data from different systems maps to a common model. You don't need a background as a data engineer.</li> <li value="4">Comfort using AI tools for prototyping and documentation as part of your product work.</li> <li value="5">Clear communication about customer problems, close collaboration with engineering, and a habit of using data to evaluate adoption.</li> <li value="6">Experience with integration products, data models, or value stream analytics is helpful, but isn't required.</li> </ul> <h2>About the team</h2> <p>We're part of GitLab's Core Data Products organization, which focuses on insights, analytics, and data-driven decision-making. You'll report to the Vice President of Product Management and join as our third product manager, focused on Data Integrations. You'll work alongside a Principal Product Manager responsible for the Data Insights Platform and dashboards, and a Product Manager focused on Orbit.</p> <p>GitLab is all-remote, with asynchronous collaboration across regions. Transparency, written communication, and clear decisions are central to how we work. This role has the Bangalore location and in-person requirements described above.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><h4><strong>How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees</strong></h4> <ul> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/">Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/time-off-and-absence/time-off-types/#flexible-paid-time-off-pto">Flexible Paid Time Off </a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/company/culture/inclusion/tmrg-tmag/">Team Member Resource Groups</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/stock-options/">Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/learning-and-development/growth-and-development/">Growth and Development Fund</a></li> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/#parental-leave">Parental Leave</a> </li> </ul> <p>Please note that we welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; many successful candidates do not meet every single requirement. Additionally, studies have shown that people from <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/company/culture/inclusion/#examples-of-select-underrepresented-groups">underrepresented groups</a> are less likely to apply to a job unless they meet every single qualification. If you're excited about this role, please apply and allow our recruiters to assess your application.</p> <hr> <p><strong>Country Hiring Guidelines: </strong>GitLab hires new team members in countries around the world. All of our roles are remote, however some roles may carry specific location-based eligibility requirements. Our Talent Acquisition team can help answer any questions about location after starting the recruiting process.  </p> <p><strong>Privacy Policy: </strong>Please review our <a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/hiring/candidate-faq/recruitment-privacy-policy/" target="_blank">Recruitment Privacy Policy.</a> Your privacy is important to us.</p> <p>GitLab is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. GitLab’s policies and practices relating to recruitment, employment, career development and advancement, promotion, and retirement are based solely on merit, regardless of race, color, religion, ancestry, sex (including pregnancy, lactation, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression), national origin, age, citizenship, marital status, mental or physical disability, genetic information (including family medical history), discharge status from the military, protected veteran status (which includes disabled veterans, recently separated veterans, active duty wartime or campaign badge veterans, and Armed Forces service medal veterans), or any other basis protected by law. GitLab will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics. See also <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/people-policies/inc-usa/#equal-employment-opportunity-policy" target="_blank">GitLab’s EEO Policy</a> and <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/labor-and-employment-notices/#eeoc-us-equal-employment-opportunity-commission-notices" target="_blank">EEO is the Law</a>. If you have a disability or special need that requires <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/people-policies/inc-usa/#reasonable-accommodation" target="_blank">accommodation</a>, please let us know during the <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/hiring/interviewing/#adjustments-to-our-interview-process" target="_blank">recruiting process</a>.</p></div>

title: Project Coordinator, Professional Services
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p><strong>Available Location: Austin, TX</strong></p> <hr> <h3><strong><span style="font-size: 13px;">About the role</span></strong></h3> <p>We are looking for a proactive, highly organized Project Coordinator to join our Professional Services team. You'll also be a key partner in resource coordination, working with Professional Services managers and project managers to staff engagements with the right people at the right time. As a day-to-day point of contact for both customers and internal delivery teams, you'll keep everyone aligned so that our cybersecurity and networking solutions are delivered smoothly and meet agreed-upon success criteria.</p> <p>The ideal candidate has experience in professional services, consulting, or a similar delivery role at a SaaS or cloud technology company. They take initiative, follow through on commitments, and collaborate effectively across teams. We believe that putting our people first and building a creative, exciting, and stimulating environment is essential to achieving our commercial goals.</p> <h3>Responsibilities</h3> <ul> <li>Own a portfolio of small- to medium-sized Professional Services engagements, managing the full project lifecycle—from leading kickoffs and status meetings to overseeing scope, timeline, budget, and final deliverables.</li> <li>Serve as the primary customer-facing point of contact by coordinating meetings, customer reporting, and stakeholder calls, ensuring all parties remain informed, aligned, and confident in project delivery.</li> <li>Partner with leadership to coordinate resource assignments, evaluating project requirements against team skills and availability to maximize utilization and PSA tooling, ensuring status updates, financials, and resource forecasts remain accurate while proactively managing scope changes.</li> <li>Anticipate future resource demands by tracking project pipelines and identifying talent gaps or bottlenecks to advise leadership on hiring or cross-training initiatives.</li> <li>Leverage AI tools to streamline status reporting, meeting summaries, and documentation, boosting efficiency and portfolio visibility.</li> </ul> <h3>Desired Skills</h3> <ul> <li><strong>Project Coordination:</strong> Strong grasp of project management fundamentals, able to manage several concurrent engagements without losing sight of details or deadlines.</li> <li><strong>Resource Coordination:</strong> Deep understanding of capacity, availability, skills matching, and utilization, partnering with managers to balance staffing across projects.</li> <li><strong>Capacity Forecasting:</strong> Track project pipelines to forecast resource needs, proactively identifying talent gaps and bottlenecks to guide cross-training and allocation strategies. </li> <li><strong>Proactivity and Ownership:</strong> Self-starter mindset, consistently taking initiative, anticipating needs, and following through without being asked.</li> <li><strong>Customer-Facing Communication:</strong> Clear and professional communicator, confident in leading customer meetings and proactively managing expectations.</li> <li><strong>Cross-Functional Collaboration:</strong> Proven ability to build strong relationships and keep multiple teams aligned on shared goals.</li> <li><strong>AI-Enabled Efficiency:</strong> Comfort using AI tools responsibly to optimize workflows, reduce manual work, and improve team productivity.</li> <li><strong>Technical Curiosity:</strong> Familiarity with, or eagerness to learn about, networking, security, and Cloudflare’s products and services.</li> </ul> <h3>Experience</h3> <ul> <li>2–4 years of experience in project coordination, similar platforms.</li> <li>Working knowledge of Salesforce, Jira, Google Workspace, and Confluence.</li> <li>Bachelor's degree in a relevant field, or equivalent practical experience.</li> <li>CAPM, PMP, or Agile certification is a plus, as is fluency in more than one language.</li> </ul> <h3 style="line-height: 1.5;"><strong>Compensation</strong> </h3> <p style="line-height: 1.5;">Compensation title: WerkstudentIn Sales & Business Development Legal AI (40–80%)
description: Über Jurata Jurata entwickelt den Jurata Legal Agent (www.jurata.ai), die juristische KI der nächsten Generation. Der Legal Agent übernimmt Recherche, Drafting und die Überarbeitung von Dokumenten und belegt seine Antworten mit Millionen verifizierter Erlasse, Gerichtsentscheide und weiterer relevanter Quellen. Entwickelt in der Schweiz, von Juristen für Juristen. Der Legal Agent ist täglich bei tausenden Legal Professionals im Einsatz, von führenden Kanzleien über Rechtsabteilungen renommierter Unternehmen bis hin zu Schaden- und Rechtsteams grosser Versicherungen wie der Mobiliar und Protekta. Weil die Nachfrage nach der Lösung stark wächst, bauen wir nun unser Sales- und Business-Development-Team gezielt aus. Dafür suchen wir dich. Deine Rolle KI verändert gerade fundamental, wie Juristinnen und Juristen arbeiten, und in dieser Rolle bist du mittendrin. Als Werkstudentin oder Werkstudent in unserem Sales- und Business-Development-Team in Zürich bringst du den Jurata Legal Agent zu Anwältinnen, Kanzleipartnern, General Counsels und AI Leads in Unternehmen. Du sprichst mit ihnen auf Augenhöhe, zeigst in Demos, was KI in ihrem Arbeitsalltag konkret verändern kann, und begleitest sie vom ersten Gespräch über den Vertragsabschluss bis zum erfolgreichen Onboarding. Du startest nicht bei null: Du erhältst ein bewährtes Setup mit Playbooks, qualifizierten Kundenanfragen und Coaching durch das Team. Gleichzeitig trägst du früh Verantwortung für eigene Ergebnisse und siehst direkt, was du zum Wachstum von Jurata beiträgst. Deine Aufgaben Du kontaktierst Kanzleien, Rechtsabteilungen und weitere juristische Organisationen per Telefon, E-Mail und LinkedIn und vereinbarst Termine. Du bearbeitest eingehende, qualifizierte Kundenanfragen und findest heraus, wo der Legal Agent konkreten Mehrwert schafft. Du zeigst live, was der Legal Agent kann, und überzeugst juristische Fachpersonen in Produktdemos mit deiner juristischen Kompetenz und echten Fällen aus der Praxis. Du begleitest Neukundinnen und Neukunden beim Onboarding, damit der Legal Agent schnell Teil ihres Alltags wird. Du bist an Events, Fachanlässen und Hochschulen das Gesicht von Jurata. Du pflegst deine Sales-Pipeline und unser CRM (HubSpot) sauber und zuverlässig. Du bringst Kundenfeedback und Einwände strukturiert ins Team ein und gestaltest so Produkt und Playbook direkt mit. Was du mitbringst Sales-Erfahrung ist keine Voraussetzung. Entscheidend sind deine Persönlichkeit, Tech-Affinität, Lernbereitschaft und dein juristisches Verständnis. Du studierst Rechtswissenschaften (Bachelor oder Master) und kannst dich mit einem Pensum von 40–80 % engagieren. Du arbeitest gerne mit Menschen und hast Freude am direkten Kundenkontakt. Es reizt dich, juristische Fachpersonen von technologischer Innovation zu überzeugen. Du interessierst dich für Legal Tech, KI und Sales und greifst ohne Scheu zum Telefon. Ein Nein bringt dich nicht aus der Ruhe: Du bleibst dran und lernst daraus. Du arbeitest strukturiert, zuverlässig und sorgfältig. Du sprichst fliessend Deutsch und kannst dich auf Englisch verständigen. Französisch oder Italienisch sind ein Plus. Was wir dir bieten Legal AI an vorderster Front: Du arbeitest in einem der am schnellsten wachsenden Legal-Tech-Start-ups der Schweiz, mit einem Produkt, das bereits täglich in der Praxis im Einsatz ist. Netzwerk in der Rechtsbranche: Du lernst Kanzleipartner, General Counsels und Rechtsabteilungen kennen, lange vor deinem Berufseinstieg. Bewährtes Setup: Playbooks, qualifizierte Anfragen und regelmässiges Coaching machen dich schnell selbstständig.
